job_role_definition: Accountants maintain and evaluate financial records to prepare reports, determine tax obligations, analyze financial performance, advise stakeholders, and establish accounting systems.
acquire_scope: Obtain and organize transaction records, account balances, asset and liability data, budgets, operational information, and applicable reporting or tax requirements.
interpret_scope: Reconcile and evaluate records and business data to identify inaccuracies, discrepancies, financial condition, trends, obligations, conformity, and required reporting conclusions.
decide_scope: Select account classifications, adjustments, discrepancy resolutions, tax treatment, forecasts, accounting-system changes, and financial recommendations.
act_scope: Record selected adjustments, resolve identified discrepancies, prepare compliant financial and tax reports, communicate selected advice, and implement accounting-system changes.

job_role_definition: Auditors examine financial, operational, compliance, and information-system evidence to evaluate records, controls, and activities and report findings and recommended improvements.
acquire_scope: Obtain records, system and transaction data, physical evidence, criteria, and explanations through selected interviews, observations, reconciliations, confirmations, and test procedures.
interpret_scope: Analyze records, controls, systems, interviews, and test results to identify discrepancies, fraud indicators, noncompliance, inefficiency, and findings about accuracy, control effectiveness, and reliability.
decide_scope: Set audit scope and testing priorities and select recommendations for control, operational, or financial improvements.
act_scope: Issue audit reports and communicate established findings, conclusions, selected recommendations, and required follow-up to management, officials, or audited parties.

job_role_definition: Interpret and perform characters or material through speech, movement, and related performance skills to entertain, inform, or instruct audiences.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Study scripts, characters, relationships, direction, cues, and performance requirements, and rehearse the speech, movement, music, dance, stunts, and other skills needed for the material.
interpret_scope: Develop a coherent understanding of characters, emotions, actions, situations, and material in relation to the production and ensemble.
decide_scope: Select the portrayal, delivery, expressive techniques, and coordinated performance choices most suited to the role or material.
act_scope: Perform characters or material through speech, movement, expression, narration, music, dance, comedy, stunts, illusion, puppetry, or event presentation to entertain, inform, or instruct audiences.

job_role_definition: Analyze risk and financial uncertainty to design, price, evaluate, and advise on insurance, pension, investment, and related financial obligations.
acquire_scope: Assemble actuarial, financial, contract, claims, credit, investment, and regulatory data needed to evaluate uncertain obligations and exposures.
interpret_scope: Analyze experience and financial information to estimate event rates, model probabilities, assess risk and solvency, and evaluate credit and investment outcomes.
decide_scope: Set premiums, reserves, liabilities, plan and contract provisions, surplus allocations, risk-management approaches, and reinsurance or security-pricing terms.
act_scope: Design, review, and help administer financial-risk products and plans, negotiate applicable terms, and communicate technical conclusions and advice to clients and stakeholders.

job_role_definition: Diagnose and treat patients using acupuncture and related traditional East Asian therapeutic modalities to promote or maintain health.
acquire_scope: Obtain patients’ medical, health, lifestyle, physical-observation, and relevant conventional-care information needed to assess conditions and treatment precautions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate histories, physical findings, anatomy, contraindications, and treatment responses to diagnose according to traditional East Asian medicine and assess progress.
decide_scope: Select individualized treatment strategies, point locations, traditional modalities, herbal preparations, referrals, and treatment changes appropriate to each patient.
act_scope: Safely deliver acupuncture and related traditional East Asian treatments, dispense prescribed herbal formulas with use instructions, and provide patient health education.

job_role_definition: Provide advanced nursing assessment, stabilization, treatment, monitoring, and care coordination for patients with acute or life-threatening conditions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and continuously assemble physiologic, technological, diagnostic, specimen, symptom, response, and patient-family needs information required for acute care.
interpret_scope: Assess and diagnose acute instability by interpreting clinical findings, diagnostic studies, age-related changes, illness impacts, and treatment risks and responses.
decide_scope: Set treatment, monitoring, diagnostic, device-adjustment, medication, consultation, referral, and transition plans and modify them as patient conditions change.
act_scope: Stabilize, treat, monitor, and document care for acutely ill patients through emergency procedures, therapies, infusions, wound care, device operation, patient-family communication, and coordinated admissions, transfers, discharges, and follow-up.

job_role_definition: Provide individualized adapted physical education instruction and services that develop the physical and motor abilities of people with disabilities or exceptional physical needs.
acquire_scope: Gather student motor, physical, functional, behavioral, and progress information; relevant education-plan requirements; and the instructional equipment and materials needed to provide services.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the collected information to characterize each student's physical abilities, disabilities, progress, and adapted physical education needs.
decide_scope: Determine eligibility, placement, accommodations, individualized goals, lesson plans, instructional adaptations, and inclusive activity arrangements consistent with applicable requirements.
act_scope: Deliver individualized and small-group adapted physical education instruction and services, maintain safe learning conditions, encourage participation, coordinate with educational personnel, and communicate and document student progress.

occupation_name: Adhesive Bonding Machine Operators and Tenders
job_role_name: Adhesive Bonding Machine Operators and Tenders
job_role_definition: Operate or tend adhesive bonding machines to join materials into components or finished products that meet production specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications, prepare and replenish adhesives, and load, position, and align materials while gathering operating readings and product measurements.
interpret_scope: Assess machine condition and product conformance from test runs, gauges, control displays, and completed-product measurements.
decide_scope: Determine required machine settings, process adjustments, and corrective responses to maintain specified bonding quality and production flow.
act_scope: Set up, operate, adjust, and maintain bonding equipment to apply adhesive or heat sealing, resolve jams or malfunctions, and deliver completed bonded materials or products.

occupation_name: Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers
job_role_name: Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers
job_role_definition: Conduct administrative hearings and make or recommend decisions on government-related claims, liabilities, sanctions, penalties, and settlements.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble the case record through document review, legal and precedent research, communications with involved parties, and formally elicited hearing evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the evidence and procedural record in light of applicable laws, regulations, policies, and precedents to reach case-relevant conclusions.
decide_scope: Determine liability, claim validity, payment method, settlements, and procedural evidentiary rulings, including recommendations where required.
act_scope: Conduct and direct fair hearings, issue required subpoenas and oaths, prepare and communicate written rulings and appeal information, and authorize valid claim payments.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate an organization's administrative support services, staff, resources, and operating procedures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect and review operational reports, schedules, records, contracts, regulations, and departmental resource and service needs to inform administration.
interpret_scope: Assess operational performance, process efficiency, compliance requirements, and administrative staffing, resource, and space needs.
decide_scope: Set administrative goals, deadlines, budgets, standards, procedures, work schedules, staffing actions, and vendor-service priorities.
act_scope: Direct administrative support operations by coordinating staff and vendors, administering resources and records, implementing procedural changes, and training personnel.

occupation_name: Adult Basic Education, Adult Secondary Education, and English as a Second Language Instructors
job_role_name: Adult Basic and Secondary Education Instructor
job_role_definition: Teach foundational academic, literacy, life, workforce-entry, and high-school-equivalency skills to adults and out-of-school youths.
acquire_scope: Gather learner intake, ability, interest, limitation, progress, and performance evidence; obtain curriculum-aligned content, materials, and accessibility supports needed for instruction.
interpret_scope: Assess learner needs and progress and evaluate instructional content, methods, and assessments to identify strengths, gaps, and needed improvements.
decide_scope: Set learning objectives and select, adapt, sequence, or revise instructional, remedial, and support approaches for individual learners and classes.
act_scope: Teach and guide adults and out-of-school youths through individual and group lessons, practice, assessments, feedback, counseling, structured learning activities, and high-school-equivalency preparation.

occupation_name: Adult Basic Education, Adult Secondary Education, and English as a Second Language Instructors
job_role_name: English as a Second Language Instructor
job_role_definition: Teach English-language skills to adult and out-of-school youth learners for communication, further education, and workforce participation.
acquire_scope: Gather learner intake, observations, completed work, assessment responses, curriculum requirements, and accessible instructional materials needed to teach English-language skills.
interpret_scope: Assess learners’ language abilities, progress, interests, limitations, and academic needs, and evaluate instructional results to identify strengths, gaps, and needed changes.
decide_scope: Set learning objectives and select, sequence, adapt, or revise instruction, assessments, remedial support, learning guidance, and classroom procedures for learners’ needs.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver individual and group English-language instruction, learning activities, assessments, feedback, supportive access, and guidance that advance communication, further education, and workforce participation.

job_role_definition: Assess, diagnose, and treat mental health and substance use disorders through psychiatric care, including psychotherapy and medication management.
acquire_scope: Gather psychiatric, behavioral, medical, medication-use, physical-screening, laboratory, history, and care-team information needed to assess each patient.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the collected information to assess mental and physical status, distinguish psychiatric from physiological conditions, diagnose mental health and substance use disorders, and judge treatment response.
decide_scope: Select individualized psychiatric treatment plans, medication regimens, referrals, and coordinated responses for routine, complex, or crisis care.
act_scope: Deliver psychiatric care through psychotherapy, prescribing or administering medications, treatment-plan implementation, patient and family education, care coordination, and required clinical documentation.

job_role_definition: Sell advertising space, time, and media solutions by developing client accounts and guiding advertising purchases from proposal through contract and delivery.
acquire_scope: Develop and maintain client and prospect accounts by obtaining information on their businesses, needs, advertising history, budgets, available media options, costs, artwork choices, and bid requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess client needs, advertising-market opportunities, and the fit of media, formats, artwork, and promotional approaches to determine how advertising can effectively promote the client’s offering.
decide_scope: Select and recommend the advertising solution, including medium, size, format, promotional plan, pricing estimate, and proposed product or market approach.
act_scope: Present and sell advertising proposals; prepare copy, samples, promotional materials, bids, contracts, and account documentation; secure approvals and payments; and coordinate delivery activities including production sessions.

job_role_definition: Direct advertising strategy, creative development, media placement, account activity, and campaign performance to promote products or services.
acquire_scope: Gather consumer, market, product, account, cost, media, and campaign-response inputs needed to plan and evaluate advertising campaigns.
interpret_scope: Analyze audience and sales trends, campaign and channel effectiveness, projected conditions, and creative-material compliance to form campaign assessments.
decide_scope: Set advertising strategy, creative direction, media choices, campaign priorities, budgets, and account and contractual terms.
act_scope: Direct the development, coordination, placement, and delivery of advertising campaigns and related account activity, including leading the campaign team.

job_role_definition: Direct promotional programs, incentives, events, partnerships, and outreach designed to stimulate interest in products or services.
acquire_scope: Gather market, consumer, sales, cost, response, regulatory, and prospective partner information needed to develop and evaluate promotional programs.
interpret_scope: Analyze audience and market conditions, campaign results, channel effectiveness, and budget performance to identify target audiences and assess promotional opportunities and cost effectiveness.
decide_scope: Set promotional objectives, strategies, incentives, media and communication approaches, partnerships, budgets, priorities, and performance targets.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate promotional programs, campaign teams, communications, events, outreach, demonstrations, and partner participation to stimulate interest in products or services.

occupation_name: Aerospace Engineering and Operations Technologists and Technicians
job_role_name: Aerospace Engineering and Operations Technologists and Technicians
job_role_definition: Operate, configure, maintain, and support aerospace testing and instrumentation systems to evaluate vehicle, component, and system performance and readiness.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain evaluation requirements and generate recorded performance, readiness, and equipment-condition evidence through calibrated measurements, simulated-condition tests, checkouts, and inspections.
interpret_scope: Analyze evaluation data and equipment observations to determine vehicle, component, and system performance, readiness, malfunctions, and result implications.
decide_scope: Select data-acquisition plans, evaluation parameters, setup configurations, and corrective actions needed to satisfy evaluation requirements.
act_scope: Configure and calibrate evaluation equipment; fabricate, install, maintain, repair, adjust, and remove test hardware and instrumentation; and communicate findings to engineering personnel.

job_role_definition: Design, analyze, test, and improve aircraft, missiles, spacecraft, and related aerospace systems to satisfy engineering, customer, quality, and regulatory requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain customer, engineering, quality, regulatory, environmental, cost, schedule, operational, inspection, test, field-performance, and materials-performance inputs for aerospace-system work.
interpret_scope: Model, analyze, inspect, test, and diagnose aerospace-system designs and performance to assess feasibility, producibility, conformance, emissions, and technical problems.
decide_scope: Set design and test criteria and select system concepts, modifications, technical-problem resolutions, development priorities, and suitable external sources when required.
act_scope: Design, engineer, modify, validate, document, and coordinate development of aircraft, missiles, spacecraft, and related systems to meet specified requirements.

occupation_name: Agents and Business Managers of Artists, Performers, and Athletes
job_role_name: Business Manager for Artists, Performers, and Athletes
job_role_definition: Manage clients' business and financial affairs in support of their professional careers.
acquire_scope: Gather client goals, financial records, contract terms, and logistical, market, and performance-support information needed to manage professional affairs.
interpret_scope: Assess the client's financial position, contractual obligations, career circumstances, and legal and tax considerations to derive account status and business implications.
decide_scope: Select career, financial, and business strategies and priorities, including arrangements, promotion, and professional support.
act_scope: Execute client business and financial management by completing transactions and arrangements, engaging service providers, directing promotional work, issuing accounting statements and advice, and reporting actions to clients.

occupation_name: Agents and Business Managers of Artists, Performers, and Athletes
job_role_definition: Represent and promote clients to secure opportunities and negotiate favorable engagement terms.
acquire_scope: Gather client work samples, audition and interview information, industry opportunities and deal trends, stakeholder contacts, and engagement-condition details.
interpret_scope: Assess prospective clients, market conditions, opportunity fit, and venue or accommodation compliance with client requirements.
decide_scope: Set client career strategies and select pursuit priorities, engagement arrangements, and contractual positions.
act_scope: Promote and represent clients, cultivate industry relationships, secure and schedule engagements, negotiate terms and obligations, coordinate client-related meetings, and collect contractually due payments.

job_role_definition: Apply engineering and biological-science knowledge to design, evaluate, and oversee agricultural equipment, structures, infrastructure, processing systems, and environmental solutions.
acquire_scope: Elicit client and operational needs and gather site observations, environmental and water-resource conditions, construction information, and equipment-performance measurements.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to determine agricultural system requirements, machinery performance, and environmental, soil, water, and land-reclamation implications.
decide_scope: Select feasible designs, specifications, budgets, and implementation approaches for agricultural equipment, structures, infrastructure, processing systems, and environmental solutions.
act_scope: Produce engineering designs and technical documentation, provide applicable resource-management guidance, and direct or oversee construction, installation, reclamation, and processing-system operations.

job_role_definition: Operate, set up, maintain, and support farm machinery and related equipment used to produce, handle, and process agricultural products.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Prepare machinery and implements and supply it with crops, seed, chemicals, water, and other agricultural materials while obtaining operating-condition and product-quality observations.
interpret_scope: Assess machinery behavior for malfunctions and identify diseased, rotten, or otherwise unsuitable products during handling or processing.
decide_scope: Determine equipment settings, operating adjustments, maintenance or repair responses, material flow, and disposition of unsuitable products needed for the work.
act_scope: Operate, tend, adjust, attach, service, and repair farm machinery and related equipment to plant, irrigate, fertilize, protect, harvest, handle, process, and transport agricultural products and materials.

job_role_definition: Evaluate and officially certify the grade, quality, and weight of agricultural commodities.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect, weigh, and measure agricultural commodities and observe company employees’ grading work to obtain condition, measurement, and process evidence.
interpret_scope: Apply grading standards to the commodity and observed grading evidence to establish quality characteristics, grade, weight, and conformance findings.
decide_scope: Select whether the commodity and associated company grading warrant official certification.
act_scope: Label and seal graded products and issue official certificates documenting the certified grade, quality, and weight.

job_role_definition: Inspect agricultural products, facilities, and operations to enforce health, quality, and safety requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect agricultural products, facilities, handling, processing, sanitation, employee practices, and operations, and collect or obtain samples and recipe information needed to assess compliance.
interpret_scope: Evaluate inspection observations, test results, product formulas, and operating conditions against health, quality, safety, and regulatory requirements to determine safety, acceptability, and compliance.
decide_scope: Determine required corrective measures, compliance dispositions, and when compromised safety warrants emergency restrictions or facility closure.
act_scope: Enforce applicable requirements by documenting findings and recommendations, advising regulated parties on corrective action and standards, and carrying out necessary emergency enforcement actions.

job_role_definition: Teach agricultural sciences courses and support postsecondary students' learning and academic progress.
acquire_scope: Gather current agricultural-science knowledge, course resources and supplies, and evidence from student work, examinations, attendance, and interactions needed to teach and support progress.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student performance and learning needs, and assess developments in the discipline and the effectiveness of course content and instructional methods.
decide_scope: Set and revise course content, materials, instructional approaches, assessments, and individualized academic or career guidance based on those assessments.
act_scope: Deliver agricultural-science instruction through lectures, discussions, laboratories, fieldwork, and supervision, and provide students with feedback, advising, and direct learning support.

job_role_definition: Support agricultural research and production trials by operating field and laboratory activities, collecting and testing samples, and documenting results for agricultural scientists.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Set up testing equipment and materials, prepare and collect samples, conduct surveys and laboratory or field tests, and record trial observations, measurements, and environmental data.
interpret_scope: Analyze specimens, observations, and test data to identify diseases, pests, weeds, seed performance, treatment effects, soil erosion, and other trial-relevant findings.
decide_scope: Select or devise trial treatment methods, environmental controls, pest-control approaches, application schedules, and operational priorities for agricultural research and production trials.
act_scope: Prepare and maintain trial sites and equipment, operate agricultural machinery, cultivate trial crops and plants, implement selected treatments and controls, and report research findings to agricultural scientists.

job_role_definition: Perform agricultural work not classified under a more specific agricultural occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the agricultural materials, equipment, site conditions, and work instructions required for the assigned work.
interpret_scope: Assess the relevant agricultural conditions and instructions to determine task requirements.
decide_scope: Select the work sequence, methods, and immediate adjustments appropriate to the assigned agricultural work.
act_scope: Perform the assigned agricultural work not classified under a more specific agricultural occupation.

job_role_definition: Perform specialized in-flight operational duties that support military combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search-and-rescue missions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and monitor mission information, aircraft and crew status, and in-flight operational inputs required to support assigned combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search-and-rescue missions.
interpret_scope: Assess mission, aircraft, environmental, and operational information to determine conditions relevant to in-flight mission support.
decide_scope: Select operational priorities, responses, and adjustments within assigned in-flight duties to support mission execution.
act_scope: Perform specialized in-flight operational duties that directly support military combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search-and-rescue missions.

job_role_definition: Perform and direct in-flight duties to ensure the successful completion of combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search and rescue missions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and monitor mission orders, aircraft status, navigation and sensor data, communications, and conditions affecting combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search-and-rescue operations.
interpret_scope: Assess the operational meaning of mission information, threats, aircraft performance, sensor observations, and changing flight conditions.
decide_scope: Select mission priorities, routes, tactics, crew tasking, and responses needed to complete the assigned operation safely and effectively.
act_scope: Perform and lead in-flight crew duties, operate assigned mission functions, coordinate the crew, and execute combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search-and-rescue missions.

job_role_definition: Controls aircraft and authorized ground traffic within assigned airspace and airport movement areas to maintain safe, orderly, and efficient traffic flow.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather flight plans, aircraft positions and movements, pilot requests and reports, weather and runway conditions, and coordination information from adjacent control units.
interpret_scope: Assess current and projected traffic, separation, hazards, capacity, and emergencies to understand constraints and aircraft needs within the assigned control area.
decide_scope: Select traffic sequences, clearances, routes, altitudes, vectors, handoff timing, and emergency responses that preserve separation while minimizing operational delay.
act_scope: Issue instructions, clearances, and safety advisories to pilots and ground traffic; coordinate control transfers and activate emergency or missing-aircraft responses when required.

job_role_definition: Supervise ground crews and coordinate the safe, efficient loading, unloading, securing, and staging of aircraft cargo or baggage.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Assemble cargo or baggage details, compartment information, aircraft load limits, and crew-readiness inputs needed to plan safe handling.
interpret_scope: Calculate compartment and total load weights, determine cargo quantities and orientations, and assess center-of-gravity and space-use implications.
decide_scope: Select the cargo distribution, placement, and handling priorities that meet balance, capacity, safety, and efficiency requirements.
act_scope: Coordinate and direct ground crews to load, unload, secure, and stage cargo or baggage, including training new employees in required safety and equipment practices.

job_role_definition: Plan and oversee aircraft loading and monitor cargo in flight as a member of the flight crew.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain cargo quantities, weights, dimensions, orientations, compartment constraints, and in-flight cargo-condition observations needed to plan and oversee the load.
interpret_scope: Calculate compartment loads and center of gravity and assess cargo-condition observations for their implications to aircraft balance and cargo security.
decide_scope: Select the cargo distribution, orientation, staging, and loading or in-flight handling priorities that use space effectively while maintaining an acceptable load condition.
act_scope: Direct ground crews in staging, loading, unloading, and securing cargo, and accompany the flight to monitor and handle cargo in flight.

job_role_definition: Plan and direct the safe operation, readiness, and maintenance of aircraft-carrier launch and recovery systems.
acquire_scope: Assemble aircraft-launch and recovery system status, maintenance condition, readiness, environmental, and operational-safety inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to determine system capability, hazards, readiness deficiencies, and maintenance needs.
decide_scope: Set operating plans, safety priorities, readiness actions, and maintenance dispositions for launch and recovery systems.
act_scope: Direct the safe operation, readiness preparation, and maintenance execution of aircraft-carrier launch and recovery systems.

job_role_definition: Operate and maintain aircraft launch and recovery systems to support safe takeoffs, landings, and emergency recoveries.
acquire_scope: Obtain aircraft movement requirements and equipment status, condition, and performance information needed for launch, landing, and emergency-recovery support.
interpret_scope: Assess system indications, equipment condition, and operational conditions to determine readiness and identify faults or hazards.
decide_scope: Select system configurations, maintenance actions, and recovery responses appropriate to the operating conditions.
act_scope: Operate, maintain, repair, and restore aircraft launch and recovery systems to support safe takeoffs, landings, and emergency recoveries.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses, inspects, services, repairs, overhauls, and modifies aircraft engines, structures, systems, and components to maintain airworthiness.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain maintenance specifications and pilot reports, inspect and measure aircraft and engine conditions, and collect operational, test, and fluid-contamination evidence needed to assess airworthiness.
interpret_scope: Diagnose faults and assess wear, damage, corrosion, leaks, alignment, and system performance against applicable maintenance requirements.
decide_scope: Determine the feasible maintenance method, repair limits, required corrective work, and whether completed maintenance supports return to operation.
act_scope: Service, repair, overhaul, fabricate, install, align, adjust, and modify aircraft engines, structures, systems, and components; complete required maintenance records and certify conforming work.

job_role_definition: Services aircraft and supports ground turnarounds by replenishing fluids, cleaning, inspecting, loading, and assisting with aircraft movement.
acquire_scope: Obtain turnaround requirements and movement information, inspect aircraft for visible defects or leaks, and prepare the fluids, cleaning solutions, equipment, and cargo inputs needed for service.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection observations and operational communications to determine aircraft condition and current servicing or movement needs.
decide_scope: Select the sequence and disposition of servicing, loading, and ground-movement work, including escalation of identified problems.
act_scope: Service and clean aircraft, replenish or replace operating fluids, load baggage or cargo, de-ice as required, and guide or tow aircraft during ground turnarounds.

occupation_name: Aircraft Structure, Surfaces, Rigging, and Systems Assemblers
job_role_definition: Assembles, fits, joins, and finishes aircraft structural components and exterior surfaces into airframe assemblies.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain structural parts and fasteners, establish measured reference points, and generate fit, alignment, performance, and defect evidence through measurement, inspection, and testing.
interpret_scope: Determine required part relationships, assembly sequence, placement, alignment, and conformance from specifications, layout references, measurements, and inspection or test results.
decide_scope: Select necessary fitting, adjustment, rework, repair, or replacement actions to achieve required airframe fit and operation.
act_scope: Fabricate, clean, prepare, position, align, join, fasten, finish, install, and correct structural components, exterior surfaces, subassemblies, and major airframe assemblies.

occupation_name: Aircraft Structure, Surfaces, Rigging, and Systems Assemblers
job_role_definition: Installs, connects, aligns, and tests aircraft mechanical systems, tubing, cables, controls, and rigging assemblies.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Read specifications and obtain layout references, then measure, verify, and test parts, cable assemblies, and installed systems for the inputs needed to build and validate the assemblies.
interpret_scope: Determine required part relationships, installation locations, sequences, tolerances, and the meaning of inspection or test results.
decide_scope: Select the assembly approach and any needed adjustment, rework, repair, or replacement to achieve compliant fit and operation.
act_scope: Fabricate, prepare, assemble, install, connect, secure, align, rig, adjust, and finish aircraft mechanical systems, tubing, cables, controls, and related assemblies.

job_role_definition: Ensure safe, coordinated airfield and aircraft operations by managing airfield conditions, operational support, and flight-related information.
acquire_scope: Collect and maintain airfield-condition, weather, flight-plan, aircraft-status, access-control, operational-record, and aircrew-support information through inspections, monitoring, communications, and required publications.
interpret_scope: Assess airfield, aircraft, weather, flight, security, wildlife, and support information to determine operational status, hazards, compliance, and service requirements.
decide_scope: Determine safety procedures, operating restrictions, coordination priorities, flight-support arrangements, and responses to changing conditions, construction, snow, wildlife, and emergencies.
act_scope: Carry out and coordinate safe airfield and aircraft operations by implementing safety measures, managing airfield conditions and access, communicating operational information, supporting aircrews, and directing necessary operational responses.

occupation_name: Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers
job_role_definition: Train and evaluate airline pilots and pilot applicants in aircraft operations and principles of flight.
acquire_scope: Observe pilots’ and applicants’ aircraft-operation performance and obtain the instructional and assessment inputs needed for training and proficiency evaluation.
interpret_scope: Assess observed performance against aircraft-operation and flight-principle standards to identify understanding, deficiencies, and proficiency.
decide_scope: Select instructional emphasis and corrective guidance and determine the appropriate proficiency disposition based on the assessment.
act_scope: Deliver instruction in aircraft operations and principles of flight and communicate or document proficiency-evaluation results.

occupation_name: Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers
job_role_name: Airline Pilot, Copilot, or Flight Engineer
job_role_definition: Operate, navigate, and monitor fixed-wing aircraft to transport passengers, mail, or freight safely.
acquire_scope: Obtain flight, weather, air-traffic, dispatch, aircraft-condition, weight-and-balance, fuel, and continuing instrument and system-status information required for safe transport.
interpret_scope: Assess flight conditions, aircraft performance, system indications, loading, and abnormal events to determine their operational significance.
decide_scope: Select or revise routes, altitudes, speeds, fuel and load changes, schedules, and emergency responses consistent with flight conditions and operating requirements.
act_scope: Prepare and operate, navigate, and control the aircraft; coordinate and direct the flight crew and air-traffic and ground activities; and carry out normal, low-visibility, and emergency flight procedures to transport passengers, mail, or freight safely.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent allergic diseases and disorders affecting the immune system.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient histories, examination findings, and allergy or immune diagnostic evidence through ordered or performed testing, including provocation challenges.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical and test findings to establish differential diagnoses and assess the expected benefits and risks of relevant therapies.
decide_scope: Select individualized treatment and prevention plans, including appropriate medications and therapeutic approaches, based on clinical evidence and patient preferences.
act_scope: Deliver or prescribe treatment, provide allergen or immunoglobulin therapies, educate patients and other clinicians, and coordinate care to manage and help prevent allergic and immunologic disorders.

occupation_name: Ambulance Drivers and Attendants, Except Emergency Medical Technicians
job_role_name: Ambulance Drivers and Attendants, Except Emergency Medical Technicians
job_role_definition: Transport sick, injured, or convalescent patients by ambulance while providing basic patient assistance and maintaining vehicle readiness.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain patient and incident information, monitor transport conditions, and inspect the ambulance, stretcher, supplies, and equipment for readiness.
interpret_scope: Assess patient needs and safety risks and evaluate route, vehicle, and equipment conditions for transport.
decide_scope: Select the transport approach and appropriate basic assistance, safety, and restraint measures for the patient.
act_scope: Load and transport patients, provide basic assistance and first aid, apply selected safety measures, report incident facts, and maintain ambulance sanitation, supplies, and operability.

job_role_definition: Operates amusement concessions by selling refreshments and promoting entertainment offerings to patrons.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain patron requests, payment and ticket details, current attraction information and rules, refreshments, and observable safety conditions needed to operate the concession.
interpret_scope: Assess patron needs and questions and determine whether observed conduct complies with applicable rules and safety procedures.
decide_scope: Choose which entertainment offerings to present and the appropriate response to unsafe or unruly patron behavior.
act_scope: Sell tickets and refreshments, promote and describe entertainment offerings, provide facility and rule information, record transactions and attendance, maintain the concession area, and carry out safety interventions when needed.

job_role_definition: Operates amusement rides and safely admits, directs, and assists patrons using them.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect ride equipment and safety devices, verify patron tickets, and observe patrons and ride conditions for safety-relevant information.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment condition, patron readiness, rule compliance, and observed hazards to determine whether safe use is possible.
decide_scope: Determine admission, safety instructions, ride operation, corrective adjustment, or removal and emergency response actions based on those assessments.
act_scope: Operate rides and deliver safe patron access by directing and assisting riders, securing or explaining safety devices, communicating applicable rules, monitoring use, and performing needed minor maintenance.

job_role_definition: Supports patrons’ use of recreation facilities by scheduling access and issuing and maintaining recreational equipment.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain reservation, attendance, payment and ticket information; track facility availability and equipment inventory and condition; and observe patron activities for safety concerns.
interpret_scope: Assess scheduling conflicts, admission validity, equipment wear or damage, and whether patron conduct complies with facility rules and safety procedures.
decide_scope: Determine access schedules, patron admission or removal, equipment issuance or repair disposition, and the response required for safety or emergency conditions.
act_scope: Schedule and admit patrons, collect fees, provide facility guidance, issue and retrieve equipment, perform needed cleaning or minor maintenance, maintain records, and enforce rules and emergency procedures.

job_role_definition: Assist anesthesiologists by preparing for, administering, monitoring, and supporting anesthesia care throughout surgical and nonsurgical procedures.
acquire_scope: Obtain pre-anesthetic histories, specimens, physiologic measurements, diagnostic and recovery data, and evidence of anesthesia equipment, supply, medication, and gas readiness through testing, monitoring, and verification.
interpret_scope: Assess patient history, physiologic and diagnostic findings, procedural responses, and recovery progress to identify anesthesia status, complications, and care needs.
decide_scope: Select anesthesia adjustments and immediate supportive, airway, or emergency responses based on patient status and procedural conditions.
act_scope: Prepare and calibrate anesthesia systems; administer and control anesthetics, related drugs, fluids, and blood products; provide anesthetic, airway, life-support, and post-anesthesia interventions; and document care and patient progress.

job_role_definition: Anesthesiologists plan and deliver anesthesia and peri-procedural pain control while maintaining airway, vital functions, and safe stabilization through recovery.
acquire_scope: Review the patient’s history and diagnostic results, perform the pre-anesthetic examination, clarify procedural requirements, and continuously obtain physiologic observations.
interpret_scope: Evaluate patient condition, procedural needs, and monitored responses to identify anesthetic risk, treatment adequacy, recovery status, and emerging complications.
decide_scope: Choose the anesthetic plan and support strategy, adapt care to patient responses or complications, and determine readiness for transfer or discharge.
act_scope: Position patients; administer anesthesia, sedation, and analgesia; maintain airway and life support; and implement selected adjustments or countermeasures through recovery.

job_role_definition: Breed and manage animals to produce offspring with desired hereditary characteristics.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe animals and reproductive readiness; examine health, collect and record animal, lineage, breeding, and semen-quality information; and obtain feed, medicines, and breeding supplies.
interpret_scope: Assess animal health, estrus status, hereditary traits, growth and condition records, and semen quality against the desired offspring characteristics.
decide_scope: Select breeding animals and semen specimens, determine breeding timing and methods, and choose needed husbandry, treatment, and environmental actions.
act_scope: Maintain animals and housing in healthy, safe condition; administer routine care and preventive measures; prepare and perform insemination; identify animals; and manage resulting animals or eggs for sale.

job_role_definition: Provide routine care that maintains the health, hygiene, comfort, and safe housing of companion and captive animals.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain care instructions and supplies, observe animals and housing conditions, and collect and record condition, intake, medication, and treatment information.
interpret_scope: Assess observations and care records to identify changes in animals’ health, injury status, comfort, hygiene, or housing conditions.
decide_scope: Determine routine-care priorities and adjustments, including whether directed treatment is appropriate or veterinary care must be secured.
act_scope: Provide routine animal care by preparing and delivering food, water, medications, and supplements; exercising and grooming animals; administering directed treatment; and cleaning, disinfecting, and regulating safe housing and equipment.

job_role_definition: Enforce animal-control laws and protect public and animal welfare by investigating incidents, handling animals, and managing their care and disposition.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather incident reports, witness accounts, physical evidence, licensing and inspection information, and observations of animal condition and custody needed to enforce animal-control laws and protect welfare.
interpret_scope: Assess evidence, compliance conditions, and animal health and behavior to identify violations, welfare risks, medical needs, and disposition constraints.
decide_scope: Select enforcement, medical-care, housing, release, adoption, euthanasia, prosecution, or law-enforcement escalation actions for each case.
act_scope: Document findings; capture, transport, confine, feed, clean, and arrange treatment or disposition of animals; notify owners; issue warnings or citations; support prosecutions; and provide animal-control guidance.

job_role_definition: Conduct research and provide scientifically grounded guidance to improve the breeding, nutrition, management, health, and production outcomes of domestic farm animals.
acquire_scope: Obtain animal, feed, environmental, management, production, and population-genetic data and materials needed to investigate domestic farm-animal outcomes.
interpret_scope: Analyze nutritional needs, genetic composition and heritability, and the effects of breeding, management, processing, feed, and environmental conditions on animal quality and production.
decide_scope: Develop and select scientifically grounded feeding, housing, sanitation, health-control, breeding, and management practices and recommendations to improve animal outcomes.
act_scope: Conduct research and controlled crossbreeding work, and deliver research findings and production guidance to scientific, producer, and public audiences.

job_role_definition: Train and condition animals to perform desired behaviors for work, assistance, security, riding, competition, entertainment, or obedience.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe animals’ health, behavior, responses, and care conditions, maintaining relevant health, diet, and behavior records.
interpret_scope: Assess physical condition, temperament, aptitude, trainability, and performance capability from observed evidence.
decide_scope: Select training objectives, conditioning methods, and behavioral adjustments suited to each animal and its intended work.
act_scope: Train, condition, retrain, care for, medicate as prescribed, and cue animals to reliably perform the desired behaviors across their assigned purposes.

job_role_definition: Studies human cultures, institutions, and behavior to develop knowledge and provide applied guidance to organizations and communities.
acquire_scope: Gather and document cultural, institutional, behavioral, historical, ecological, and community evidence through observation, interviews, participatory inquiry, recordings, archival research, and consultation with relevant communities and officials.
interpret_scope: Analyze and compare evidence to explain social and cultural patterns, institutions, beliefs, historical development, health and service-access factors, and resource-management conditions, including formulating generalizations about cultural behavior.
decide_scope: Determine research directions and select recommendations, intervention procedures, work-system designs, and policy or development approaches responsive to cultural conditions and community impacts.
act_scope: Communicate research findings and deliver culturally informed guidance, interventions, curriculum and work-system improvements, conflict-resolution assistance, and research-method training to organizations and communities.

job_role_definition: Investigates, interprets, and protects material evidence and sites associated with past human cultures.
acquire_scope: Survey sites and archival sources, observe and document provenience and conditions, and recover, label, and assemble artifacts and related material evidence.
interpret_scope: Examine, describe, identify, date, authenticate, compare, and assess material evidence and sites to explain past cultures and evaluate their condition.
decide_scope: Formulate research conclusions and select protection or conservation recommendations for archaeological sites and materials.
act_scope: Conduct field investigations, preserve or restore recovered artifacts, protect sites through the selected measures, and communicate research findings.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary anthropology or archeology courses while conducting research and supporting students and the academic institution.
acquire_scope: Generate and gather disciplinary literature, ethnographic observations and other research evidence, student work and advising information, and materials needed for instruction, scholarship, and academic service.
interpret_scope: Analyze anthropological or archeological evidence, assess student learning and needs, and evaluate scholarship, proposals, curricula, and academic issues to produce findings and assessments.
decide_scope: Choose instructional and assessment methods, research directions, student grades and guidance, and recommendations concerning curricula, scholarly work, funding, staffing, and institutional academic matters.
act_scope: Deliver courses and feedback, disseminate research findings, supervise and advise students, prepare instructional and funding materials, maintain required academic records, and implement departmental and institutional work.

occupation_name: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate
job_role_definition: Value taxable real property and administer equitable property assessments for a government jurisdiction.
acquire_scope: Gather and verify parcel ownership, legal, physical, market, income, cost, zoning, neighborhood, and exemption information through records review, field inspections, and jurisdictional property reviews.
interpret_scope: Analyze property characteristics, market and cost evidence, income and expense records, legal constraints, and property changes to estimate values, classify taxability, identify trends, and evaluate assessment accuracy.
decide_scope: Select valuation approaches and adjustments and establish uniform, equitable methods for applying valuation conclusions across property classes.
act_scope: Record finalized assessments, maintain current parcel data and assessment systems, communicate assessed values to property owners, and defend assessments in appeals and public hearings.

occupation_name: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate
job_role_definition: Estimate and document the value of real property for clients and legal proceedings.
acquire_scope: Inspect properties and improvements; obtain property, legal, market, neighborhood, income, cost, zoning, and comparable-sales information through records, observations, photographs, and informed contacts.
interpret_scope: Analyze property characteristics, local-market conditions, legal and neighborhood effects, income and operating data, comparable transactions, construction costs, depreciation, and replacement-cost evidence to derive value findings.
decide_scope: Select and apply the appropriate valuation methods, assumptions, comparisons, and adjustments to establish the final property-value conclusion.
act_scope: Document and substantiate the value conclusion in standards-compliant appraisal reports, including supporting land diagrams, and present or defend the valuation in legal proceedings when required.

occupation_name: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
job_role_name: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
job_role_definition: Determine and report the fair value of tangible personal and business property for financial, legal, insurance, and ownership decisions.
acquire_scope: Inspect and document the property’s physical characteristics, photographs, legal identity, and comparable-sales evidence needed for valuation.
interpret_scope: Analyze the property’s condition and market evidence, including sales, reproduction cost, income, and relevant changes, to develop value findings and forecasts.
decide_scope: Select the valuation basis and methods appropriate to the stated financial, legal, insurance, or ownership purpose and determine the resulting fair value.
act_scope: Prepare, submit, update, and, when required, defend appraisal reports that communicate the property description and concluded value.

job_role_definition: Resolves disputes by conducting formal proceedings, applying law to evidence, and issuing binding or authoritative decisions.
education_most_common_level: First Professional Degree - awarded for completion of a program that: requires at least 2 years of college work before entrance into the program, includes a total of at least 6 academic years of work to complete, and provides all remaining academic requirements to begin practice in a profession.
acquire_scope: Assemble the case record, evidence, testimony, and applicable legal and precedential materials through case preparation, hearings, and information gathering from parties and witnesses.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the evidentiary record and legal authorities to determine the facts, issues, and their legal significance.
decide_scope: Set necessary procedural terms, rule on motions and evidence, and determine liability, claim validity, and the dispute’s disposition.
act_scope: Carry out required formal procedural acts, participate in related court proceedings when required, and issue the written authoritative decision and any authorized payment.

job_role_definition: Facilitates communication and negotiated settlements so disputing parties can resolve conflicts by mutual agreement.
education_most_common_level: First Professional Degree - awarded for completion of a program that: requires at least 2 years of college work before entrance into the program, includes a total of at least 6 academic years of work to complete, and provides all remaining academic requirements to begin practice in a profession.
acquire_scope: Obtain disputants’ accounts, issues, concerns, needs, interests, perspectives, and settlement terms needed to address the conflict.
interpret_scope: Clarify the disputed issues and develop an understanding of the parties’ underlying concerns, interests, and differing perspectives.
decide_scope: Select mediation approaches and recommend whether proposed compromise settlement offers should be accepted or rejected.
act_scope: Arrange and conduct mediation communications that guide parties toward mutual agreement, and prepare settlement agreements for signature.

job_role_definition: Plans and develops integrated architectural designs and contract documents, coordinates technical contributors, and administers procurement and construction for design conformance.
acquire_scope: Gather client requirements, site and feasibility conditions, compliance and sustainability criteria, technical inputs, cost and schedule constraints, and construction progress evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate functional and spatial needs, site suitability, technical integration, environmental and energy performance, cost and schedule implications, and construction conformance.
decide_scope: Select design concepts, layouts, materials, systems, specifications, sustainability measures, procurement recommendations, and responses to design or construction issues.
act_scope: Produce coordinated drawings, representations, specifications, and contract documents; present the design, direct its technical development, and administer procurement and construction.

job_role_definition: Prepares coordinated drawings and construction documents for buildings, structural features, and interior spaces.
acquire_scope: Assemble preliminary concepts, sketches, specifications, engineering data, codes, site and space requirements, material dimensions, and field measurements and conditions needed to prepare and revise building documents.
interpret_scope: Evaluate regulatory, technical, and design-conformance requirements and calculate material quantities, structural factors, costs, and building-performance implications for the documents.
decide_scope: Select interior arrangements, drawing sequence and graphical presentation, documentation procedures, design corrections, and required material and equipment specifications.
act_scope: Produce and coordinate scale building, structural, interior, and presentation drawings and related construction documents; issue reproducible document packages; and explain or revise them for construction use.

job_role_definition: Prepares drawings, maps, profiles, and construction documents for infrastructure, earthwork, surveying, and site-development projects.
acquire_scope: Obtain project sketches, specifications, engineering data, material dimensions, and field, survey, topographic, subsurface, inspection, and investigation measurements needed for civil-site documentation.
interpret_scope: Convert design and site inputs into verified geometric, topographic, subsurface, material, quantity, cost, earthwork, and technical constraints for the documents.
decide_scope: Select drawing presentation, work sequence, documentation procedures, and necessary drawing adjustments consistent with design specifications.
act_scope: Prepare, revise, finish, reproduce, and communicate the required scaled drawings, maps, profiles, material information, and construction-document packages for infrastructure and site-development work.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate architectural, engineering, and related technical activities to achieve project and organizational objectives.
acquire_scope: Obtain client, organizational, technical, market, resource, cost, contractual, regulatory, environmental, survey, and stakeholder inputs needed to define and govern architectural and engineering work.
interpret_scope: Assess project feasibility, designs and proposed changes, cost estimates, environmental impacts, technical risks, and operating requirements to determine their implications for objectives.
decide_scope: Set technical goals, specifications, budgets, standards, staffing direction, sustainability priorities, and dispositions for designs, contracts, expenditures, and project changes.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate technical teams, resources, operational activities, and stakeholder communications to implement project plans, standards, contracts, and sustainability measures.

job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary architecture courses while supporting students and contributing to the academic work of the institution.
acquire_scope: Obtain current architectural scholarship and instructional resources, generate research evidence, and collect student work, examination results, and progress information needed for teaching, assessment, advising, and scholarship.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student learning and progress, synthesize architectural scholarship and research evidence, and assess curriculum effectiveness and teaching, research, and academic issues.
decide_scope: Select curriculum content, instructional and assessment methods, grades and student guidance, research directions, and priorities for collaborative academic work.
act_scope: Prepare course materials, deliver architecture instruction and feedback, maintain required academic records, advise and supervise students, disseminate research findings, and contribute to collaborative academic work.

job_role_definition: Appraise, preserve, organize, and provide access to permanent records and historically valuable materials.
acquire_scope: Locate, obtain, inspect, and research permanent records and historically valuable materials, including their provenance, significance, condition, and relevant subject context.
interpret_scope: Assess the authenticity, enduring value, historical significance, and preservation and access implications of archival materials.
decide_scope: Determine what materials to retain or acquire and establish their arrangement, description, preservation treatment, access conditions, and selection for display or publication.
act_scope: Preserve, organize, describe, maintain, and make archival materials accessible through collections systems, reference services, displays, publications, and public-facing programs.

occupation_name: Area, Ethnic, and Cultural Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: Area, Ethnic, and Cultural Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach and conduct research on the culture, development, and perspectives of areas, ethnic groups, and other social groups at the postsecondary level.
acquire_scope: Gather current scholarship and instructional resources, generate research evidence, and obtain student work, examination results, and feedback needed for teaching and scholarship.
interpret_scope: Analyze disciplinary evidence to derive scholarly findings and evaluate student performance to determine learning outcomes and needs.
decide_scope: Select research questions and methods, curricula and instructional approaches, evaluation criteria, and academic or career guidance for students.
act_scope: Deliver instruction and experiential learning, communicate evaluations and guidance, supervise student work, and publish and present scholarly findings.

job_role_definition: Operate and maintain armored assault vehicles and their combat systems during land or amphibious combat operations.
acquire_scope: Obtain operational orders, terrain and threat information, vehicle and combat-system status, and the fuel, ammunition, tools, and parts required for missions and maintenance.
interpret_scope: Assess the tactical situation, terrain, system indications, and equipment condition to determine operating constraints, targets, faults, and maintenance needs.
decide_scope: Select crew-level maneuver, combat-system employment, readiness, and corrective-maintenance actions consistent with assigned operational direction.
act_scope: Operate armored assault vehicles and combat systems during land or amphibious combat operations and perform required maintenance to keep them mission-ready.

job_role_definition: Direct armored assault vehicle units and coordinate their tactical employment during combat operations.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble battlefield intelligence, terrain and threat information, mission orders, and armored unit readiness and position reports.
interpret_scope: Assess the operational situation, enemy activity, terrain, and unit capabilities to determine their tactical implications.
decide_scope: Select the tactical employment, coordination, priorities, and movements of armored assault vehicle units during combat operations.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate armored assault vehicle units in executing the selected combat operations.

job_role_definition: Develop and direct the visual concept, design execution, and presentation of creative media productions for clients and organizations.
acquire_scope: Elicit client objectives, budget, background, and presentation constraints; gather production options, trend knowledge, and required visual and technical materials.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, concepts, illustrative materials, proofs, and production outputs for their meaning, feasibility, and conformity to creative standards and specifications.
decide_scope: Select design solutions, presentation approaches, layout and media specifications, production services, project priorities, and approvals needed to meet the brief.
act_scope: Direct staff and coordinated creative production, create or complete visual assets and layouts including multimedia interfaces or storyboards where needed, oversee shoots and printing, and present final layouts to clients.

job_role_definition: Plan and provide art therapy services that assess clients and use guided artistic expression to support their physical, cognitive, and emotional well-being.
acquire_scope: Gather client history and treatment-team information, observe responses and progress, and select or prepare suitable art media and equipment for therapy sessions.
interpret_scope: Assess clients’ functioning, needs, and progress by interpreting artistic expression and synthesizing clinical observations and treatment-outcome information.
decide_scope: Set therapy goals and select, individualize, coordinate, and revise art-therapy plans, session designs, and recommendations for each client or population.
act_scope: Deliver guided art-therapy sessions, build therapeutic rapport, instruct clients in media use, and document and communicate assessments, plans, progress, and recommendations.

occupation_name: Art, Drama, and Music Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: Art, Drama, and Music Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary students in art, drama, and music while supporting their academic development and contributing to the institution and field.
acquire_scope: Gather current disciplinary and research evidence, instructional and performance materials, and information on students’ work, progress, needs, and institutional matters.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and performances, analyze scholarly evidence and teaching issues, and identify academic, career, curricular, and institutional implications.
decide_scope: Set curricula, instructional and assessment methods, grades, academic guidance, rehearsal or presentation plans, and appropriate responses to departmental and field matters.
act_scope: Teach and demonstrate artistic practice, lead learning activities and rehearsals, administer assessments and advising or supervision, maintain required records, disseminate student and scholarly work, and provide institutional and professional service.

job_role_definition: Operate, target, fire, and maintain artillery, missile, rocket, and torpedo weapon systems in combat operations.
acquire_scope: Obtain target information, firing inputs, ammunition, and weapon-system status needed for combat employment and upkeep.
interpret_scope: Assess target, firing, and system-status inputs to determine targeting relevance, firing requirements, and maintenance needs.
decide_scope: Select firing solutions, engagement priorities, and maintenance actions within assigned combat operations.
act_scope: Operate, target, fire, and maintain artillery, missile, rocket, and torpedo weapon systems in combat operations.

job_role_definition: Manage personnel, weapons systems, and tactical or strategic operations involving artillery, air defense missiles, and other missile systems.
acquire_scope: Assemble mission requirements, operational intelligence, system-status data, and personnel readiness information for artillery and missile activities.
interpret_scope: Assess the tactical or strategic situation, weapon-system capabilities, and unit readiness to determine operational implications.
decide_scope: Select operational plans, employment priorities, resource assignments, and personnel actions for artillery, air-defense missile, and other missile operations.
act_scope: Direct and manage personnel, weapons systems, and tactical or strategic artillery and missile operations.

occupation_name: Artists and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Artists and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform artistic or related creative work not classified within a more specific O*NET artist occupation.
acquire_scope: Gather and select the materials, references, creative briefs, observations, and technical inputs needed for the artistic or related creative work.
interpret_scope: Develop those inputs into an understanding of the intended subject, form, style, constraints, and expressive direction.
decide_scope: Choose the creative approach, composition, methods, and revisions that will best realize the intended work.
act_scope: Produce, refine, and present the artistic or related creative result.

job_role_definition: Assemble or fabricate products and components not covered by a more specific assembler or fabricator occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain required parts, materials, tools, production specifications, measurements, and inspection observations for the assigned product or component.
interpret_scope: Determine required dimensions, fit, orientation, and quality criteria and assess whether materials and completed work conform to them.
decide_scope: Select the assembly or fabrication sequence and any routine adjustments needed to achieve the specified result.
act_scope: Assemble or fabricate and finish the assigned products or components according to specifications.

job_role_definition: Observe, research, interpret, and communicate knowledge about celestial and astronomical phenomena.
acquire_scope: Obtain astronomical observations, measurements, prior research, and other evidence using ground- and space-based instruments and scientific sources.
interpret_scope: Analyze observational and research evidence, calculate celestial properties and motions, and develop or refine theories and explanations of astronomical phenomena.
decide_scope: Select research questions, priorities, observational and analytical approaches, collaborations, and communication strategies.
act_scope: Develop needed research instrumentation and software, coordinate planned investigations, and communicate astronomical knowledge through scholarly publications, scientific presentations, teaching, and public programs.

job_role_definition: Compete in athletic events while training, maintaining competitive readiness, evaluating performance, and representing a team or club.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain coaching instructions, performance feedback, physical-condition information, and nutrition or health guidance needed for training and competition.
interpret_scope: Assess competition performance and current readiness to identify strengths, weaknesses, and preparation needs.
decide_scope: Select adjustments to training, conditioning, and event preparation based on performance and readiness assessments.
act_scope: Train and practice to maintain competitive readiness, maintain sport equipment, compete under event rules, and represent or lead the team or club as required.

job_role_definition: Evaluate, prevent, and manage athletic injuries and illnesses through emergency care, treatment, rehabilitation, and return-to-activity support.
acquire_scope: Obtain injury, illness, recovery, and readiness information from athletes and care records, and inspect activity environments and protective equipment for health and injury hazards.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical findings, recovery progress, participation readiness, and identified hazards to determine athletes’ condition and prevention needs.
decide_scope: Select referrals, treatment and rehabilitation plans, return-to-activity dispositions, and preventive measures including appropriate protective equipment and health guidance.
act_scope: Provide emergency and continuing care, treatment, rehabilitation, protective applications, prevention instruction and programs, status communication, and safe, sanitary event and treatment support.

job_role_definition: Research atmospheric and climate processes and apply scientific analysis to climate, air-quality, and related environmental questions.
acquire_scope: Collect and assemble atmospheric, climate, air-quality, oceanic, historical, remote-sensing, and field-sampling data, including developing or validating collection methods when needed.
interpret_scope: Analyze observations and climate datasets through modeling, simulations, data assimilation, and historical comparisons to explain atmospheric processes and derive forecasts, trends, and impact estimates.
decide_scope: Select research approaches, analytical assumptions, and the conclusions, predictions, warnings, or applied assessments appropriate to the environmental question.
act_scope: Conduct atmospheric and climate investigations and deliver usable scientific results through reports, visualizations, consultations, and applied analyses of climate, air-quality, and related environmental issues.

job_role_definition: Analyze atmospheric observations and models to produce and communicate weather forecasts, warnings, and briefings.
acquire_scope: Gather atmospheric, oceanic, radar, satellite, station, and upper-air measurements and obtain or prepare forecasting-model inputs and visual materials.
interpret_scope: Analyze observations, reports, maps, and model outputs using meteorological principles to determine current and expected weather conditions.
decide_scope: Select forecast conclusions, warning determinations, and the content and emphasis appropriate to each forecast or briefing audience.
act_scope: Produce and communicate weather forecasts, warnings, reports, maps, and tailored briefings through relevant public, media, and organizational channels.

occupation_name: Atmospheric, Earth, Marine, and Space Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: Atmospheric, Earth, Marine, and Space Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary students in atmospheric, earth, marine, and space sciences while supporting their academic development and contributing to teaching, research, and institutional service.
acquire_scope: Gather current disciplinary literature, course and laboratory resources, student work and assessment evidence, research data, and information needed for academic and institutional activities.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student learning and academic needs, assess instructional effectiveness, derive research findings, and analyze teaching, research, and institutional issues.
decide_scope: Select course content, instructional and assessment approaches, student academic and career guidance, research directions, and positions on relevant institutional matters.
act_scope: Deliver instruction, facilitate discussions, supervise laboratory, field, teaching, internship, and research work, communicate evaluations and guidance, disseminate research findings, and fulfill institutional service responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Set up, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot audio and video equipment for live events, broadcasts, and recorded productions.
acquire_scope: Obtain production requirements, schedules, media, equipment, facilities, incoming feeds, equipment-status observations, and signal-quality measurements needed for live events, broadcasts, and recorded productions.
interpret_scope: Assess production requirements and signal quality, identify media-system faults, and determine technical conditions affecting audio-video delivery.
decide_scope: Select equipment layouts, operating settings, signal routing, production approaches, and corrective or repair courses within production requirements.
act_scope: Set up, adjust, operate, switch, mix, record, edit, transmit, maintain, and repair audio-video equipment and coordinate production personnel to deliver productions.

job_role_definition: Assess, diagnose, treat, and help prevent hearing and balance disorders through clinical care, assistive technology, rehabilitation, and hearing-conservation services.
acquire_scope: Collect clinical histories and test results through hearing and balance examinations, ear-canal assessment, progress monitoring, hearing screenings, and workplace noise measurement.
interpret_scope: Assess the type and degree of hearing or balance impairment, evaluate patient progress and communication needs, and determine findings from screening and noise data.
decide_scope: Establish diagnoses and treatment priorities, select suitable assistive technology and rehabilitation approaches, and determine referrals and hearing-conservation measures.
act_scope: Deliver clinical treatment, device fitting, repair and programming, rehabilitation and communication counseling, and hearing-screening and conservation services.

job_role_definition: Install, connect, adjust, and demonstrate audiovisual and electronic entertainment equipment for customers or venues.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer requirements and the equipment specifications, drawings, circuit diagrams, and service information needed for the installation.
interpret_scope: Assess the site, customer needs, equipment condition, and technical documentation to determine installation and operating requirements.
