decide_scope: Select the equipment placement, connections, configuration, and adjustments that will meet the required audiovisual performance and safe use.
act_scope: Install, mount, wire, connect, service as needed for completion, tune, adjust, test, and demonstrate the audiovisual and electronic entertainment equipment.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, service, and repair defective audiovisual and electronic entertainment equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather customer problem descriptions, service documentation and specifications, diagnostic measurements, and required replacement components for the repair.
interpret_scope: Analyze symptoms, circuit information, and test results to identify faults and determine equipment condition.
decide_scope: Choose the repair approach, needed parts, adjustment targets, and whether work can be completed on-site or requires shop repair.
act_scope: Service the equipment by disassembling it as needed, repairing or replacing defective components and wiring, calibrating and adjusting it, and restoring proper audiovisual performance.

job_role_definition: Repair, realign, replace, and refinish damaged automotive vehicle bodies, frames, and related components.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain damage reports and specifications; inspect, measure, and test vehicles before and after repair; identify material properties; and assemble the parts and materials needed for body, frame, component, and finish work.
interpret_scope: Assess damage, dimensional and operational condition, surface defects, material characteristics, and completed fit and appearance to determine repair requirements and whether the work meets specifications.
decide_scope: Select the repair, realignment, replacement, refinishing, work sequence, and any corrective action needed to restore the vehicle.
act_scope: Disassemble affected areas; straighten, remove, repair, weld, fill, sand, refinish, reinstall, adjust, and secure vehicle bodies, frames, glass, trim, and related components.

job_role_definition: Assist automotive engineers by setting up, conducting, analyzing, and documenting tests of vehicles, systems, and components to assess performance, durability, efficiency, and design practicality.
acquire_scope: Obtain test requirements, specifications, vehicles or components, equipment, and supplies, configure instrumentation, and perform or monitor inspections and tests to generate measurements and observations.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings, schematics, specifications, measurements, and observations into assessments of performance, durability, efficiency, defects, malfunctions, and design practicality.
decide_scope: Select valid test methods and conditions and recommend product or component design improvements based on assessed results.
act_scope: Fabricate or modify prototype components and fixtures, build, install, and maintain test equipment, and document and deliver test findings and recommendations to automotive engineers.

job_role_definition: Develop and improve vehicle systems and components, directing their design, integration, validation, and production implementation.
acquire_scope: Gather vehicle requirements, operating constraints, technology research, cost inputs, and test data needed to develop and improve vehicle systems and components.
interpret_scope: Analyze system designs, models, test results, failures, variation, and root causes to assess performance, safety, efficiency, and manufacturability.
decide_scope: Select design concepts, control-feature requirements, specifications, calibration and test methods, quality standards, and changes needed to meet vehicle objectives.
act_scope: Design, modify, calibrate, validate, integrate, and direct production implementation of vehicle systems and components, coordinating the engineering work required for delivery.

job_role_definition: Replace and repair automotive windshields, windows, and related safety-glass components to restore vehicle safety and weatherproofing.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect the damaged glazing area and replacement materials, obtain vehicle-specific glass and related parts, and assemble the required tools, safety equipment, and installation inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess the damage, contamination, fit, material condition, and environmental conditions to establish repair or installation requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the repair or replacement course and the preparation, fitting, weatherproofing, and curing approach suited to the vehicle and conditions.
act_scope: Remove damaged glass and necessary trim, prepare and weatherproof mounting surfaces, repair or install safety glass and related components, restore removed parts or window mechanisms, shape or cut custom glass when needed, and allow adhesive installations to cure.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, adjust, repair, and overhaul automotive vehicles and their mechanical, electrical, and electronic systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect vehicles and components, obtain operating-symptom information, consult technical specifications, and perform road, electronic, and measurement-based tests to gather condition and performance evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate inspection and test evidence to identify damage, wear, malfunctions, and deviations from required vehicle-system performance.
decide_scope: Determine the necessary maintenance, adjustments, repairs, replacements, overhauls, and work procedure needed to restore the affected vehicle systems.
act_scope: Perform scheduled maintenance and physically adjust, repair, replace, rewire, rebuild, overhaul, align, tune, and verify automotive mechanical, electrical, electronic, fuel, climate-control, and related systems.

job_role_definition: Service automotive and marine vehicles with fuel, fluids, routine maintenance, minor repairs, tires, and accessories while handling related customer transactions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer service requests and selections, vehicle condition readings from fluid, tire, and battery checks, fuel specifications, and payment details.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle condition readings and service requests to identify needed routine maintenance, minor repairs, tire service, or accessory replacement.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate fluid addition, maintenance, minor repair, tire, battery, or accessory service based on assessed condition and customer request.
act_scope: Perform fueling, fluid addition, lubrication, routine maintenance, minor repairs, tire and battery service, accessory installation, windshield cleaning, and customer payment transactions.

job_role_definition: Inspect aircraft, aviation maintenance, equipment, records, and related operations to determine airworthiness and compliance with safety regulations.
acquire_scope: Examine aircraft, maintenance work, equipment, records, operating indications, and training programs, and obtain evidence through ground and flight tests, competency examinations, and accident or complaint investigations.
interpret_scope: Assess the evidence to identify defects and malfunctions, determine accident or complaint causes, and evaluate airworthiness, regulatory compliance, maintenance conformity, and personnel competency.
decide_scope: Select airworthiness certification dispositions and recommend necessary repairs, replacements, or equipment modifications.
act_scope: Prepare, maintain, and communicate detailed inspection, investigation, repair, competency, and certification findings, records, and reports.

job_role_definition: Install, inspect, test, troubleshoot, modify, and repair avionics systems in aircraft or space vehicles.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Review technical documentation and obtain diagnostic evidence by inspecting avionics, preparing test aids and test articles, and operating test equipment during functional and flight tests.
interpret_scope: Analyze inspection results and test and flight data to identify malfunctions and systemic performance problems.
decide_scope: Determine the corrective or modification approach and the layout for installing affected avionics assemblies and systems.
act_scope: Install, assemble, connect, adjust, repair, replace, and modify avionics systems, fabricate necessary parts, and document completed maintenance and repair work.

job_role_definition: Handles, documents, and transports travelers' baggage and assists travelers at transportation terminals.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Receive baggage and obtain traveler, claim, destination, service, shipment, accessibility, and baggage-measurement details needed for terminal assistance.
interpret_scope: Match baggage to claims and destinations, assess traveler and accessibility needs, and determine applicable handling, shipment, and service requirements and charges.
decide_scope: Select baggage routing and handling priorities, shipment arrangements, and appropriate forms of traveler assistance.
act_scope: Mark, document, and transport baggage; complete service, billing, shipment, and insurance records; and provide travelers with information and accessibility assistance.

job_role_definition: Assists hotel guests with arrivals, baggage, rooms, transportation, information, and other on-premises services.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Receive guest requests and service details, and obtain baggage, packages, messages, service items, room information, and property, local-area, and transportation information needed to assist guests.
interpret_scope: Identify guest service needs, accessibility requirements, destinations, room-related issues, and relevant safety or logistical constraints.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate handling method, route, transportation arrangement, service sequence, or referral for each guest need.
act_scope: Welcome and escort guests, transfer baggage and packages, provide directions and room or property information, explain room features, assist guests with disabilities, provide or arrange transportation, page guests, and complete deliveries, service-item transfers, and errands.

job_role_definition: Maintain courtroom order, safety, and the secure conduct of court proceedings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Screen entrants, inspect court spaces, monitor conduct and access, and receive or control evidence, exhibits, detainees, and jury movements to obtain the inputs needed for courtroom security.
interpret_scope: Assess observed persons, items, access conditions, and courtroom activity for security threats, rule violations, custody risks, or improper jury contact.
decide_scope: Determine access restrictions, security priorities, custody and escort arrangements, enforcement responses, and when police or medical assistance is needed.
act_scope: Maintain courtroom order and secure proceedings by controlling entry, enforcing conduct rules, patrolling and guarding court personnel and juries, escorting and holding prisoners, handling evidence, and making warranted arrests.

job_role_definition: Produce baked goods by preparing ingredients and doughs or batters, baking products, finishing them, and maintaining bakery production operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and measure ingredients, receive needed supplies and equipment, and assemble production inputs for the planned baked-goods output.
interpret_scope: Assess raw materials, baking progress, finished-product quality, and equipment condition against production, safety, and quality requirements.
decide_scope: Determine ingredient quantities and select or adjust mixing and baking settings in response to product and production conditions.
act_scope: Prepare, mix, portion, shape, bake, finish, decorate, and quality-check baked goods while cleaning and maintaining bakery equipment for ongoing production.

job_role_definition: Provide hair, beard, shaving, and related grooming services to clients.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain client preferences, observe hair, beard, skin, nail, and scalp conditions, and prepare sanitized tools, protective materials, and needed grooming products.
interpret_scope: Translate the consultation and observed conditions into an understanding of the client’s desired appearance and relevant grooming or hair-care needs.
decide_scope: Select suitable grooming techniques, products, treatments, and service sequence for the client’s desired result.
act_scope: Provide the selected hair, beard, shaving, chemical, skin, nail, massage, and related grooming services safely and to the intended result.

job_role_definition: Fulfills café orders by explaining offerings, preparing and serving specialty beverages and light foods, and completing transactions under sanitary conditions.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Gather customer orders and preferences, menu and product information, ingredients, service items, and transaction details.
interpret_scope: Translate customer requests into menu selections and preparation requirements while assessing product suitability and food-safety conditions.
decide_scope: Choose suitable recommendations, preparation methods, work sequence, and responses to order or payment issues.
act_scope: Prepare and serve beverages, light foods, or packaged coffee products, complete customer payments, and sanitize food-contact work areas and equipment.

job_role_definition: Mix and serve alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks while providing safe, orderly bar service to patrons.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain beverage orders, inspect identification, observe patrons and service conditions, and assemble the ingredients, glassware, and supplies needed for bar service.
interpret_scope: Determine whether identification satisfies alcohol-purchase requirements and recognize intoxication or disruptive conduct affecting safe, orderly service.
decide_scope: Select service priorities and determine whether to continue, limit, refuse, or end service and arrange an appropriate response for unsafe patron situations.
act_scope: Prepare and serve alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks, process payments, maintain stocked and sanitary bar areas, and carry out interventions that preserve safe, orderly service.

job_role_definition: Repair, maintain, assemble, and fit bicycles to keep them safe and functional for customers.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect bicycles, gather customers’ body-size and intended-use requirements, and obtain the parts and materials needed for fitting, assembly, maintenance, or repair.
interpret_scope: Evaluate bicycle condition and customer requirements to identify faults, maintenance needs, and fit suitability.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate bicycle, components, and repair, adjustment, or fitting approach.
act_scope: Repair, maintain, assemble, adjust, build, and fit bicycles, including brakes, wheels, drivetrains, tires, axles, accessories, and replacement parts.

job_role_definition: Recover overdue payments by locating and contacting delinquent account holders, arranging repayment, processing payments, maintaining account records, and escalating unresolved accounts.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor overdue accounts; locate delinquent account holders; and obtain account, contract, financial-status, payment, address, and claim information needed for collection.
interpret_scope: Assess account status, the reasons for delinquency, repayment capacity, applicable account terms, and claim-payment issues to clarify the collection situation.
decide_scope: Set or negotiate repayment arrangements, credit extensions, and customer repayment guidance, and determine when unresolved accounts require escalation.
act_scope: Contact and persuade account holders to resolve overdue balances, process and post payments, maintain account records and correspondence, pursue claim-payment appeals, and carry out escalations such as repossession, service disconnection, or referral.

job_role_definition: Compile, calculate, verify, record, and distribute bills and related account information for goods or services.
acquire_scope: Obtain transaction, service, account, payment, and rate information from source documents, records, customers, and reference materials needed to bill goods or services.
interpret_scope: Review, reconcile, and calculate the information to determine accurate charges, amounts due, account status, and billing discrepancies.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate fee, credit, correction, account adjustment, or payment restriction needed to resolve verified billing and account issues.
act_scope: Prepare and post bills and related account records, retain supporting documentation, apply approved adjustments or restrictions, and distribute billing and account information to customers.

job_role_definition: Study the chemical and molecular processes of living organisms to advance biological knowledge and develop diagnostic, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications.
acquire_scope: Generate experimental evidence and prepare the biological samples, compounds, instruments, and measurements needed to investigate molecular processes and potential diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or industrial applications.
interpret_scope: Analyze experimental results to determine molecular structures, mechanisms, genetic and immune processes, disease-related changes, and substance effects in living systems.
decide_scope: Select research directions, study designs, analytical methods, and development recommendations based on the resulting findings.
act_scope: Translate findings into research methods, laboratory equipment, diagnostic tests, drugs, compounds, processing methods, useful proteins, and communicated scientific results.

job_role_definition: Apply physical and quantitative principles to investigate the structures, energy, and mechanisms of living cells and organisms.
acquire_scope: Generate experimental measurements and structural observations of living systems and biological molecules using specialized instruments and research apparatus.
interpret_scope: Analyze physical and quantitative evidence to characterize biological structures, energy relationships, spatial configurations, and mechanisms.
decide_scope: Select research directions, experimental and analytical approaches, and recommendations based on the biological question and resulting findings.
act_scope: Develop and implement new research methods or specialized equipment and communicate findings and recommendations through scientific reports, articles, and presentations.

job_role_definition: Designs, models, tests, and evaluates biomedical technologies and biological systems for health and assistive applications.
acquire_scope: Gather scientific literature, material and biological-system information, stakeholder expertise, experimental measurements, and regulatory requirements needed to develop biomedical technologies and systems.
interpret_scope: Analyze research, test, simulation, and clinical-procedure information to assess biological behavior, forecast outcomes, and determine safety, efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance implications.
decide_scope: Select technical approaches, materials, system requirements, experimental follow-ups, and development priorities that meet health and assistive application objectives.
act_scope: Design, model, develop, test, evaluate, document, and deliver biomedical instrumentation, procedures, software, and assistive technologies.

job_role_definition: Develops, scales, validates, and improves biological production and remediation processes and their supporting equipment.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain experimental, production, equipment, materials, regulatory, and scientific inputs needed to develop, scale, validate, and improve biological production and remediation processes.
interpret_scope: Analyze process and experimental results, model biological operations, and assess process compatibility, performance, yield, variation, safety, and environmental-treatment needs.
decide_scope: Select process formulas, production scales, operating sequences, validation approaches, equipment and instrumentation specifications, and improvement priorities based on the assessments.
act_scope: Design, conduct, transfer, validate, document, and improve biological production and remediation processes and their supporting equipment, including resolving manufacturing process problems.

job_role_definition: Manages the safe selection, implementation, use, and support of medical equipment within healthcare organizations.
acquire_scope: Gather equipment performance and safety data, user and inventory needs, technical advances, and applicable regulatory and organizational requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment safety, efficiency, effectiveness, condition, suitability, and compliance implications from the collected evidence.
decide_scope: Set equipment selection, acquisition, use, support, improvement, resource, and capital plans and advise administrators on priorities.
act_scope: Implement and sustain safe equipment deployment and support through team and contract oversight, policies and protocols, training, compliance communication, and required technical documentation.

job_role_definition: Operate, monitor, maintain, and document biofuels production processes that convert feedstock into fuel and by-products meeting quality and safety requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure, sample, test, and record feedstock, process, flow, equipment, product, and storage-condition data required to run production safely and verify output quality.
interpret_scope: Assess process readings, laboratory results, additive quality, and equipment conditions against production, quality, and safety requirements.
decide_scope: Select operating adjustments, material handling, maintenance, repair, calibration, and escalation priorities based on process and condition assessments.
act_scope: Prepare and process feedstock; operate and adjust production, separation, and handling equipment; maintain, calibrate, repair, clean, monitor stored outputs, and complete required production documentation.

job_role_definition: Manage safe, efficient, and compliant biofuels plant production and operations.
acquire_scope: Gather production logs, process measurements, product samples, storage and transport conditions, and operating cost and material data needed to manage plant operations.
interpret_scope: Assess operating, quality, safety, environmental, efficiency, and cost information to identify abnormal conditions, compliance needs, and production constraints.
decide_scope: Set operating and corrective priorities, approve equipment, process, repair, and budget actions, and determine responses to safety, quality, maintenance, and production conditions.
act_scope: Direct and train plant personnel; oversee production, shipping, maintenance, and quality activities; adjust process conditions; and shut down or restart equipment when required.

occupation_name: Biofuels/Biodiesel Technology and Product Development Managers
job_role_name: Biofuels/Biodiesel Technology and Product Development Managers
job_role_definition: Define, lead, and execute applied research and development programs for commercially promising biofuel, biodiesel, feedstock, and production technologies.
acquire_scope: Generate and obtain experimental, laboratory, field, process, model, and feedstock evidence needed to investigate biofuel, biodiesel, crop, and production technologies.
interpret_scope: Analyze experimental and process evidence to assess reaction, fermentation, pretreatment, separation, recovery, efficiency, and feedstock performance.
decide_scope: Select research plans, technical priorities, experimental methods, and commercially promising product, process, technology, or application directions.
act_scope: Implement and oversee research and development plans by creating processes, models, tools, prototypes, and applications and delivering technical guidance and findings.

job_role_definition: Conduct computational biological research by developing and applying data, software, algorithmic, and statistical methods to analyze biological information.
acquire_scope: Obtain, curate, and organize biological datasets, database content, scientific knowledge, project requirements, and tool-performance evidence needed for computational research.
interpret_scope: Analyze molecular and genomic information and evaluate computational results to derive biologically relevant findings and method-performance conclusions.
decide_scope: Select computational strategies, algorithms, data representations, and technology-based solutions that address research problems.
act_scope: Develop and apply bioinformatics software, tools, databases, and analytical methods, and deliver research findings through reports, publications, and presentations.

job_role_definition: Apply and support computational tools, databases, and analytical methods to manage, analyze, and interpret biological data for scientific research.
acquire_scope: Retrieve and assemble biological data and research requirements, and obtain quality-control, performance, and testing evidence needed for computational analysis and tool support.
interpret_scope: Derive scientific findings from biological data and assess data quality, analytical results, predictions, tool performance, and database problems.
decide_scope: Select computational methods, data-management approaches, and tool or database changes needed to meet research requirements and resolve identified issues.
act_scope: Build, extend, maintain, and support databases, scripts, applications, and query tools, and document, package, or communicate resulting data and findings for research use.

job_role_definition: Teach biological sciences at the postsecondary level while supporting students and fulfilling associated scholarly and institutional faculty responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Generate and assemble current biological-science literature, instructional and laboratory resources, student learning evidence, and experimental observations and measurements needed for teaching, scholarship, and faculty service.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and laboratory performance, analyze experimental results and scholarly literature, and evaluate curricular, advising, and institutional issues.
decide_scope: Select curricula, course content, instructional and assessment methods, student guidance, research plans, and recommendations on academic and institutional matters.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver biological-science instruction, supervise and assist students, communicate grades and scholarly findings, submit funding proposals, maintain required academic records, and implement faculty-service responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Conduct biological research and analysis in areas not covered by separately classified biological science occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble biological specimens, observations, measurements, and relevant scientific information needed for research.
interpret_scope: Analyze biological evidence to determine findings, relationships, and scientifically supported conclusions.
decide_scope: Select research methods, analytical approaches, and next investigative steps based on the evidence.
act_scope: Document and communicate biological analyses, conclusions, and research results.

job_role_definition: Assist biological and medical scientists by conducting laboratory and field procedures, maintaining equipment, and producing reliable experimental observations, samples, and results.
acquire_scope: Collect and prepare biological and environmental samples and materials, perform standardized tests and experimental monitoring, and generate and record reliable observations, measurements, and data.
interpret_scope: Analyze observations, specimens, and experimental data to determine findings, quantities, qualities, compliance issues, disease indications, or other problems.
decide_scope: Select procedural adjustments, equipment remedies, and follow-up responses needed to keep assigned laboratory and field work valid and compliant.
act_scope: Deliver findings through reports and summaries, implement selected corrections, maintain laboratory and field readiness, and provide technical support for biological research and production.

job_role_definition: Research and study plant and animal life and communicate biological findings to support scientific understanding and applied environmental decisions.
acquire_scope: Collect representative biological and environmental samples, measurements, observations, literature, and other research inputs needed to study plant and animal life and environmental conditions.
interpret_scope: Analyze data and observations to identify, classify, and explain organismal characteristics, ecological relationships, environmental effects, and biological risks.
decide_scope: Select research approaches, sampling methods, management plans, control measures, and evidence-based recommendations for biological and environmental questions.
act_scope: Communicate technical findings and implement selected biological research programs, resource-management plans, and pest-control measures.

job_role_definition: Operate, monitor, and maintain biomass power or biofuel plant systems to support safe and reliable production.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain operating readings, equipment-condition observations, boiler-water test results, and biomass feedstock measurements needed to run the plant safely and reliably.
interpret_scope: Assess feedstock quality, evaluate process and equipment condition from measurements and inspections, and apply technical instructions and drawings to operating conditions.
decide_scope: Select operating adjustments, start-stop actions, and corrective priorities needed to keep biomass power or biofuel production within safe, reliable conditions.
act_scope: Operate and regulate boilers, generators, auxiliary and material-handling equipment; prepare and supply feedstock; and perform calibration, routine maintenance, minor repairs, and required safety cleaning.

job_role_definition: Manage safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective biomass power plant operations and the staff and resources supporting them.
acquire_scope: Obtain operating data, equipment condition observations, field-inspection findings, production and demand information, compliance requirements, and resource-status inputs for biomass plant operations.
interpret_scope: Assess operating performance, safety and regulatory compliance, equipment and process conditions, production adequacy, and cost-and-capacity improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Set operating, maintenance, safety, staffing, resource, budget, and emergency-response priorities and schedules to sustain compliant, reliable, cost-effective generation.
act_scope: Manage plant personnel and resources; oversee operations, maintenance, repairs, testing, fuel deliveries, ash removal, inventories, reporting, and required equipment adjustments, shutdowns, restarts, and restoration of biomass generation.

job_role_definition: Develop and apply statistical methods to design, analyze, and interpret life-sciences research.
acquire_scope: Obtain, organize, and quality-check clinical, survey, experimental, archival, and biological data required for life-sciences research.
interpret_scope: Apply statistical and mathematical analyses to data to derive findings, predictions, and explanations of biological phenomena.
decide_scope: Select and design statistically sound study methods, sample sizes, analysis plans, technical objectives, and research recommendations.
act_scope: Implement statistical methods through analysis code, algorithms, data resources, study execution support, and clear communication of results and advice.

job_role_definition: Design, build, secure, deploy, and maintain distributed blockchain networks and applications.
acquire_scope: Elicit blockchain, integration, and security requirements; gather security-control evidence; and generate network, infrastructure, security, and performance test results.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, threats, control reviews, cryptographic behavior, and test results to assess network and application security, performance, and operational behavior.
decide_scope: Select blockchain architectures, design patterns, cryptographic protections, logging specifications, technologies, and remediation or deployment plans that meet requirements.
act_scope: Design, build, verify, deploy, update, secure, and maintain distributed blockchain networks, applications, integration logic, monitoring, and failure protections.

job_role_definition: Construct, install, inspect, maintain, and repair boilers, pressure vessels, and related equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather blueprints, specifications, measurements, vessel components and materials, and generate condition evidence through inspections and pressure tests.
interpret_scope: Derive required dimensions, locations, and fit from drawings and measurements, and assess inspection and test evidence to identify defects or deficiencies.
decide_scope: Select fabrication, placement, installation, maintenance, or repair actions needed to meet vessel requirements.
act_scope: Fabricate, assemble, rig, position, join, fit, install, clean, reshape, maintain, and repair boilers, pressure vessels, and related equipment.

job_role_definition: Maintain accurate financial records by recording, calculating, verifying, reconciling, and reporting routine business transactions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain transaction documents, receipts, payment instruments, account information, prior records, and budget, inventory, and payroll inputs required to maintain financial records.
interpret_scope: Classify and code transactions; calculate amounts and balances; and verify, compare, reconcile, and identify discrepancies in financial records.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate record treatment, discrepancy disposition, payment status follow-up, and routine reporting or filing actions under established requirements.
act_scope: Record, post, total, transfer, and maintain financial data; process receipts, deposits, payroll, invoices, payments, and required forms; and produce financial records, statements, and reports.

job_role_definition: Construct and repair masonry structures by laying, aligning, bonding, and finishing brick, block, tile, and related materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain specifications and site-condition evidence, establish measured layout references, and clean surfaces and size and mix masonry and bonding materials for the work.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings, layout measurements, and structural conditions into material requirements, course geometry, alignment findings, and repair needs.
decide_scope: Select the masonry layout, course and alignment plan, and construction, repair, or protective-treatment approach appropriate to the specifications and observed condition.
act_scope: Construct or repair structures by laying, aligning, bonding, anchoring, and finishing masonry, removing damaged work, and applying protective refractory material.

job_role_definition: Operate and tend bridges, locks, and related waterway facilities to safely coordinate marine and surface traffic passage.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe vessel approach, signals, position, progress, traffic clearance, water and weather conditions, and facility or equipment condition to establish safe passage inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess vessel size, speed, movement, available lock or bridge space, traffic clearance, operating conditions, and observed defects to determine passage and facility status.
decide_scope: Select the safe timing, sequencing, spacing, traffic control, water-level adjustment, and needed maintenance response for each passage.
act_scope: Direct marine and surface traffic and operate signals, gates, alarms, locks, bridges, valves, vessel lines, and necessary minor equipment upkeep to carry out safe passage.

occupation_name: Broadcast Announcers and Radio Disc Jockeys
job_role_definition: Presents news, information, interviews, promotions, commentary, and other scripted or ad-libbed material through broadcast media.
acquire_scope: Gather background, current-event, audience, guest, and product information needed to prepare broadcast material and interviews.
interpret_scope: Assess, synthesize, rewrite, and shape gathered information into accurate, audience-relevant broadcast narratives, scripts, reports, and interview prompts suited to the available format and time.
decide_scope: Select program content, story lines, guests, and the ordering or timing of material for the broadcast.
act_scope: Present scripted or ad-libbed announcements, reports, commentary, interviews, promotions, and hosted or moderated programming through broadcast media, including operating broadcast controls and recording material for airing.

occupation_name: Broadcast Announcers and Radio Disc Jockeys
job_role_definition: Selects and presents music-centered radio programming while interacting with listeners and maintaining its on-air flow.
acquire_scope: Gather listener requests and audience feedback, program background, music-library materials, and current information needed for music-centered broadcasts.
interpret_scope: Assess audience interests, program context, and timely music or local-information cues to shape relevant on-air content.
decide_scope: Choose program content, musical selections, sequencing, and on-air transitions that sustain the intended broadcast flow.
act_scope: Present and operate music-centered broadcasts by announcing and commenting, identifying and framing shows, engaging listeners and competitions, airing or recording commercial and public-service content, and maintaining required broadcast logs.

job_role_definition: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain broadcast equipment and signals to deliver reliable audio and video programming.
acquire_scope: Obtain program schedules and transmission sources, and gather signal, equipment, audio, and video status readings needed to prepare and sustain broadcasts.
interpret_scope: Assess signal strength, clarity, reliability, program readiness, transmission levels, and equipment conditions to identify quality issues or faults.
decide_scope: Select transmission sources, operating settings, substitutions, equipment configurations, and corrective responses needed to preserve broadcast continuity and quality.
act_scope: Set up, operate, adjust, monitor, maintain, repair, and troubleshoot broadcast, transmission, audio, video, computer, network, and field equipment to deliver reliable programming.

job_role_definition: Process and maintain securities transactions, account records, and related customer servicing for brokerage operations.
acquire_scope: Receive customer transaction requests and inquiries and retrieve account, ownership, transaction, dividend-instruction, market-price, and regulatory-record inputs.
interpret_scope: Verify transaction and ownership details, calculate account holdings, payments, fees, and price fluctuations, and identify account issues or collateral needs.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate disposition of account problems, collateral requirements, and the timing and routing of certificate transfers and deliveries.
act_scope: Process and document securities transactions, prepare transaction and transfer records, coordinate certificate movement, allocate customer payments, produce account reports, and provide customer service.

occupation_name: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
job_role_name: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
job_role_definition: Plan and direct the assessment, cleanup, remediation, and sustainable reuse of contaminated non-Superfund properties.
acquire_scope: Inspect sites and assemble contamination, site-condition, cleanup-progress, regulatory, technical, cost, risk, feasibility, funding, and reuse inputs needed to plan and manage redevelopment.
interpret_scope: Characterize contamination and environmental damage, quantify health and environmental risks, and evaluate the feasibility, costs, benefits, and technical adequacy of cleanup and reuse options.
decide_scope: Select compliant remediation, demolition, waste-disposal, restoration, sustainable-regeneration, and reuse plans and determine project priorities, funding strategies, permitting approaches, contractors, and materials.
act_scope: Secure funding, permits, services, and materials; direct and coordinate cleanup, disposal, demolition, remediation, restoration, revegetation, and sustainable reuse; and document and communicate project status and results.

job_role_definition: Analyze, prepare, and oversee budgets to support the allocation and control of organizational financial resources.
acquire_scope: Compile budget estimates, accounting records, expenditure reports, program requirements, directives, and financial requests needed to prepare and oversee organizational budgets.
interpret_scope: Analyze expenditure controls, budget trends, resource requirements, estimate completeness and compliance, program costs and benefits, financing alternatives, and the implications of budget directives.
decide_scope: Formulate funding recommendations, allocation priorities, budget adjustments, and policies for carrying out budget directives.
act_scope: Prepare, direct, communicate, and oversee budgets and budget reports, provide budget and cost-analysis assistance, and present proposed budgets to funding authorities.

job_role_definition: Perform building-cleaning work not classified within a more specific building-cleaning occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain cleaning supplies, equipment, and access to the building areas requiring service.
interpret_scope: Assess area conditions to identify cleaning needs, contamination, and hazards.
decide_scope: Set the cleaning sequence and select suitable methods and materials for the conditions.
act_scope: Perform the building-cleaning work needed to restore and maintain acceptable area conditions.

job_role_definition: Transport students safely and reliably by operating school buses on scheduled routes and activities.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect the bus and safety equipment, obtain route and schedule directions, and monitor traffic, road, vehicle, and student conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle readiness, route progress, and changing roadway and student-safety conditions to identify hazards or deviations.
decide_scope: Choose safe routing, speed, stopping, passenger-management, and incident-response actions within traffic and school-bus safety requirements.
act_scope: Operate the bus to pick up, transport, and drop off students on schedule while carrying out boarding, crossing, and in-transit safety procedures and reporting safety-critical disruptions.

job_role_definition: Operate buses or motor coaches to transport passengers safely on scheduled routes or to specified destinations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect the vehicle and obtain route, schedule, fare, passenger, baggage, traffic, and operating-condition information needed to provide the trip.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle readiness, route conditions, passenger needs and conduct, and emerging emergencies or disruptions to understand their effect on safe transport.
decide_scope: Choose driving adjustments, routing and stop handling, passenger assistance, comfort settings, and incident responses that maintain a safe, orderly service.
act_scope: Operate and position the bus on scheduled routes or to specified destinations; board, assist, inform, and collect fares from passengers; handle baggage and disruptions; maintain passenger comfort, vehicle cleanliness, and required trip records and reports.

occupation_name: Bus and Truck Mechanics and Diesel Engine Specialists
job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, repair, and overhaul buses and trucks and their mechanical, electrical, safety, and emissions systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect vehicle systems and components; test-drive vehicles; and obtain diagnostic readings, measurements, clearances, and emissions data using appropriate instruments.
interpret_scope: Evaluate inspection, test, measurement, and operating evidence to identify malfunctions and determine conformance with operating, safety, and emissions specifications.
decide_scope: Select the necessary maintenance, adjustment, repair, replacement, rewiring, alignment, or overhaul work to restore the affected vehicle systems.
act_scope: Perform routine maintenance and physically adjust, repair, rebuild, recondition, replace, rewire, align, install, and overhaul bus and truck mechanical, electrical, safety, heating and cooling, and emissions systems.

occupation_name: Bus and Truck Mechanics and Diesel Engine Specialists
job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, repair, and rebuild diesel engines and their fuel, combustion, emissions, and related mechanical components.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect, test, listen to, and measure diesel engines, fuel, combustion, emissions, and related mechanical components to obtain condition, fault, clearance, and emissions inputs.
interpret_scope: Determine malfunctions, component condition, specification conformance, and emissions acceptability from inspection and test results.
decide_scope: Select the maintenance, adjustment, repair, replacement, overhaul, or rebuild work needed to restore compliant engine operation.
act_scope: Perform preventive maintenance and safely adjust, repair, recondition, replace, overhaul, rebuild, and verify diesel-engine, fuel, combustion, emissions, and related mechanical components, including alternative-fuel systems.

job_role_definition: Develop, maintain, test, and coordinate strategies and plans that enable organizations to continue or restore critical operations during and after disruptions.
acquire_scope: Gather organizational, operational, system, regulatory, resource, and threat inputs and generate evidence from continuity and recovery tests needed to evaluate disruption risks and recovery requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess business-function impacts, recovery needs, test outcomes, plan adequacy, threat indicators, and applicable requirements to establish continuity findings.
decide_scope: Select recovery objectives, resource and budget priorities, mitigation measures, disruption scenarios, and continuity approaches.
act_scope: Develop, update, document, integrate, and coordinate continuity and disaster-recovery plans, communications, training, mitigation measures, monitoring methods, and recovery arrangements.

job_role_definition: Produce and deliver business intelligence through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and trend-based recommendations.
acquire_scope: Collect business, financial, market, customer, competitive, industry, geographic, and technology data from available sources and gather reporting needs and feedback.
interpret_scope: Analyze and synthesize data to identify trends, market and customer patterns, competitive strategies, and findings relevant to business strategy.
decide_scope: Determine reporting-solution designs, information priorities, and trend-based recommendations for action.
act_scope: Create, test, maintain, support, and distribute reports, dashboards, databases, and related intelligence outputs so users receive timely, reliable business intelligence.

job_role_definition: Perform business operations specialist work not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the operational information, materials, and inputs required for the particular business operations assignment.
interpret_scope: Assess assignment-specific operational inputs to determine their business relevance and implications.
decide_scope: Select the priorities, recommendations, or course of action required by the assignment.
act_scope: Carry out the assigned business operations work and deliver its specified result.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary business courses while supporting student learning and, where assigned, contributing to academic research and service.
acquire_scope: Gather current business knowledge, instructional resources, student work and progress information, research evidence, and relevant program or institutional inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning, instructional needs, business scholarship, and academic or program issues to form findings and feedback.
decide_scope: Set course content, instructional and assessment approaches, student guidance, research directions, and assigned academic-service priorities.
act_scope: Teach and facilitate business courses, deliver student evaluations and advising, maintain required learning records and resources, conduct and disseminate research where assigned, and carry out academic service.

job_role_definition: Cut, prepare, package, and merchandise consumer-sized meat products for retail sale.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive, inspect, store, and track meat supplies, customer specifications, inventory levels, and product-order inputs needed for retail preparation.
interpret_scope: Assess meat quality, inventory needs, and customer requirements to determine suitable handling, preparation, and supply needs.
decide_scope: Select meat supply orders and determine product preparation, preservation, pricing, and display arrangements for retail sale.
act_scope: Cut, trim, bone, grind, shape, preserve, package, weigh, label, price, and merchandise consumer-sized meat products, including special customer cuts.

occupation_name: Buyers and Purchasing Agents, Farm Products
job_role_name: Buyers and Purchasing Agents, Farm Products
job_role_definition: Purchase farm products for processing or resale and manage the related commercial, logistical, assessment, and producer-support activities.
acquire_scope: Obtain demand, inventory, farm-property, and production-condition information and inspect or test crops and products for purchasing and producer-support work.
interpret_scope: Assess product grade, value, damage or disease, land production potential, and applicable grain quotas from the obtained information.
decide_scope: Determine required product types and quantities, purchasing and contract terms, product disposition and logistics, and producer recommendations, supplies, or financing arrangements.
act_scope: Purchase farm products, negotiate and conclude agreements, arrange or direct product processing, resale, transportation, and storage, maintain required commercial and inventory records, and provide producer advice, sell supplies, and arrange financing.

job_role_definition: Fabricate, assemble, fit, finish, and repair wooden cabinetry, furniture, fixtures, and related products using hand tools and woodworking machinery.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain project instructions and blueprints, select suitable wood and surfacing materials, measure and mark stock or existing pieces, and inspect dimensions, quality, and fit.
interpret_scope: Translate instructions, measurements, material characteristics, and inspection observations into requirements and conformity findings for fabrication or repair.
decide_scope: Determine construction or repair specifications, required materials, and the shaping, finishing, and assembly sequence.
act_scope: Cut, machine, shape, assemble, reinforce, fit, surface, finish, install hardware on, and repair wooden cabinetry, furniture, fixtures, and related products.

job_role_definition: Calibrate, test, and maintain measurement devices and related equipment to ensure accuracy and conformance with established standards.
acquire_scope: Obtain equipment specifications, standards, and technical drawings, and conduct inspections, calibration tests, and precision measurements to gather condition, performance, and conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze measurement, inspection, and test evidence to determine equipment performance, reliability, defects, dimensional conformance, and calibration requirements.
decide_scope: Design or select calibration methods, test sequences, fixtures, adjustments, maintenance, repairs, and other corrective measures based on requirements and findings.
act_scope: Implement selected calibration adjustments, fabricate needed fixtures, maintain or repair measurement devices and calibration equipment, reassemble serviced equipment, and report conformance findings.

occupation_name: Camera Operators, Television, Video, and Film
job_role_name: Camera Operators, Television, Video, and Film
job_role_definition: Operate and position cameras to record composed images and scenes for television, video, and film productions.
acquire_scope: Obtain production instructions and rehearsal cues, assess locations and lighting conditions, and prepare, test, and configure the cameras, mounts, lenses, and related equipment required for recording.
interpret_scope: Translate production requirements, scene conditions, and observed image results into the visual and technical requirements for each shot.
decide_scope: Select shot framing, camera position and movement, lens and exposure settings, and filming sequence adjustments needed to achieve the intended effects.
act_scope: Position and operate cameras and mounted or zoom equipment, make real-time focus, exposure, lighting, and movement adjustments, and record composed scenes and live shots.

job_role_definition: Repair, adjust, calibrate, test, and restore cameras and related photographic equipment to proper operating condition.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect equipment and technical documentation, measure and test performance and settings, and obtain the parts and materials needed for restoration.
interpret_scope: Diagnose malfunctions and assess component condition and performance against specifications using inspection, measurement, and test results.
decide_scope: Select the repair requirements, operating sequence, and adjustment, calibration, replacement, or component-fabrication approach needed to restore proper operation.
act_scope: Disassemble, clean, lubricate, fabricate or modify components, install and assemble parts and wiring, adjust mechanisms, calibrate systems, and restore the equipment to proper operating condition.

occupation_name: Captains, Mates, and Pilots of Water Vessels
job_role_definition: Provides specialized local navigational guidance for moving and docking vessels safely through ports, harbors, and restricted waters.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain local chart, weather, tide, current, depth, hazard, vessel-position, and traffic information, including operational updates exchanged with ship and shore personnel.
interpret_scope: Assess the vessel’s position, available water, environmental conditions, traffic, navigational aids, and local harbor requirements to determine safe maneuvering constraints.
decide_scope: Select safe courses, speeds, passing arrangements, docking or undocking maneuvers, and interventions needed to prevent unsafe vessel operations.
act_scope: Direct and, when required, operate vessel movements through restricted waters and berthing areas, communicate maneuvering instructions and signals, advise masters on local procedures, and assist with maritime rescue operations.

occupation_name: Captains, Mates, and Pilots of Water Vessels
job_role_definition: Serves as a deck officer responsible for navigational watches and assigned deck, cargo, maintenance, and safety operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather navigational, weather, water-depth, communication, cargo-handling, and vessel and equipment condition information through monitoring, measurement, and inspection during watches and assigned operations.
interpret_scope: Assess navigational conditions, vessel and equipment readiness, regulatory conformance, cargo-handling status, and safety risks from observations, charts, instruments, inspections, and reports.
decide_scope: Determine safe vessel movements, watch responses, operating priorities, crew directions, and corrective or emergency actions for navigation and assigned operations.
act_scope: Execute vessel movements and maneuvers, issue operational communications and signals, coordinate crew, cargo, and maintenance work, maintain assigned equipment, conduct safety drills, assist rescue operations, and record vessel operations.

occupation_name: Captains, Mates, and Pilots of Water Vessels
job_role_definition: Commands a vessel and holds overall responsibility for its safe, lawful, and efficient operation, crew, and voyage.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather navigational, weather, tide, current, depth, traffic, equipment-status, cargo-handling, supply, crew, and regulatory-condition inputs through charts, instruments, inspections, watches, and operational communications.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to determine navigational position and hazards, vessel readiness, safe and compliant operating conditions, cargo-handling conformance, and emerging emergencies or pollution concerns.
decide_scope: Select routes, courses, speeds, maneuvers, docking or towing actions, safety interventions, voyage provisions, maintenance or repair needs, and crew assignments or priorities for safe, lawful, efficient operation.
act_scope: Command and maneuver the vessel; direct and signal crew and other vessels; coordinate docking, cargo, maintenance, drills, rescue, and onboard operations; and complete required operational communications, reports, and records.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses and treats cardiac rhythm disorders using electrical cardiac assessment and implanted rhythm-management devices.
acquire_scope: Conduct and obtain electrical and other cardiovascular test recordings needed to evaluate cardiac rhythm disorders.
interpret_scope: Analyze cardiac activity recordings to determine the presence and nature of rhythm disorders.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate rhythm-management treatment and implanted-device plan.
act_scope: Treat rhythm disorders by performing minimally invasive implantation of pacemakers, defibrillators, or other indicated rhythm-management devices.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses, medically treats, and monitors cardiovascular conditions using clinical evaluation and noninvasive cardiac testing.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories, examinations, records, consultations, and noninvasive cardiovascular and pulmonary test measurements, including follow-up condition data.
interpret_scope: Analyze clinical findings and cardiac test results to identify cardiovascular abnormalities, calculate relevant measures, diagnose conditions, and assess treatment progress.
decide_scope: Select diagnostic testing, treatment and monitoring plans, medication therapy, preventive guidance, and referral or surgical recommendations based on the assessment.
act_scope: Deliver cardiovascular care by providing emergency cardiac treatment, carrying out the chosen medical management, and explaining procedures, results, treatments, and health guidance to patients.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses and treats cardiovascular disease through catheter-based imaging and vascular interventions.
acquire_scope: Obtain catheter-based cardiovascular imaging inputs by administering contrast media and operating diagnostic imaging equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess catheterization and contrast-enhanced cardiovascular images to diagnose cardiovascular disease.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate catheter-based vascular intervention or emergency cardiac treatment course based on the diagnostic assessment.
act_scope: Deliver emergency cardiac care and perform catheter-based vascular interventions, including balloon angioplasty and stent placement.

job_role_definition: Assists physicians with catheter-based cardiovascular diagnostic and therapeutic procedures while monitoring patients and maintaining procedural safety.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient identification, history, prior results, and continuous physiologic, imaging, and equipment-status inputs needed for catheter-based cardiovascular procedures.
interpret_scope: Assess monitored physiologic responses, comfort, safety conditions, and procedural displays to recognize abnormalities or changes requiring attention.
decide_scope: Select protocol- or physician-directed equipment settings and promptly determine when abnormal patient or procedural conditions warrant notifying the physician.
act_scope: Prepare and position patients, maintain sterile and functioning procedural equipment, operate cardiovascular imaging equipment, administer contrast, and assist physicians during diagnostic and therapeutic catheter-based procedures.

job_role_definition: Performs noninvasive cardiac and vascular diagnostic testing and records findings for physician interpretation.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient history and identification, prepare and position patients, ready and maintain equipment, and generate cardiac and vascular test recordings and measurements while monitoring patient status.
interpret_scope: Assess recorded waveforms, images, signals, and measurements against relevant norms to identify abnormalities and derive cardiac or vascular findings.
decide_scope: Select protocol-consistent equipment settings and determine when observed patient changes or abnormalities require physician notification.
act_scope: Explain procedures, maintain patient comfort and safety during testing, and document, transcribe, and communicate completed diagnostic findings for physician interpretation.

job_role_definition: Teach career and technical subjects to middle school students while managing instruction, assessment, student support, and related school responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Assemble curriculum-aligned objectives, instructional materials, equipment and accommodations, and gather evidence on students’ learning, behavior, development, and needs through observation, assessments, and consultation.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student evidence and feedback to determine progress, academic or behavioral needs, interests, and appropriate levels of support.
decide_scope: Select lesson and activity plans, instructional adaptations, assessment and intervention approaches, safety and classroom procedures, and student-support priorities within curriculum requirements.
act_scope: Teach and supervise career and technical learning activities, maintain a safe and orderly classroom, implement accommodations and remedial support, communicate with students and families, and complete required student documentation and reports.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary vocational courses that develop students’ occupational knowledge, practical skills, and career readiness.
acquire_scope: Gather evidence of students’ prior needs, progress, and performance; keep current in the vocational field; and obtain, prepare, maintain, and repair the instructional materials, tools, equipment, and workplace-learning inputs needed for courses.
interpret_scope: Assess student work, test results, observed performance, and training outcomes to determine competency, learning needs, and areas for improvement.
decide_scope: Set occupational and integrated academic learning goals, curricula, schedules, instructional methods, assessments, individualized support, practical-training arrangements, and course or career guidance.
act_scope: Teach, demonstrate, discuss, supervise safe hands-on and workplace-based learning, administer assessments, provide feedback and individualized instruction, and advise students to build occupational knowledge, practical skills, and career readiness.

job_role_definition: Teach secondary school students the occupational knowledge and practical skills required for specific career and technical fields.
acquire_scope: Assemble curriculum requirements, occupational-field updates, instructional resources and equipment, and evidence about students' learning needs and progress.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student performance, behavior, and learning evidence to determine understanding, skill development, and barriers to participation.
decide_scope: Set course and lesson objectives and select instructional, safety, experiential-learning, accommodation, and remedial approaches suited to students' needs.
act_scope: Deliver and supervise safe, structured occupational instruction, demonstrations, practice, laboratory, shop, field, and work-experience activities while guiding students' career and learning development.

job_role_definition: Expedite, document, route, and coordinate the movement and delivery of cargo and freight shipments.
acquire_scope: Obtain shipment requests, cargo specifications, weights, costs, invoices, import or export records, location and delivery-status information, and the materials needed to prepare and handle freight.
interpret_scope: Verify received cargo and documentation, classify goods for tariff purposes, estimate applicable charges, and assess shipment progress, discrepancies, damage, losses, and delivery issues.
decide_scope: Select transportation, routing, storage or flight allocation, payment, insurance, delivery, and corrective-handling arrangements for each shipment.
act_scope: Arrange and expedite transport; create, enter, transmit, and maintain shipping records and documents; coordinate packing, labeling, loading, unloading, storage, and delivery; and communicate arrivals and resolve shipment problems.

job_role_definition: Constructs, installs, and repairs structural components and fixtures from wood and comparable materials according to plans, site conditions, and safety requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain plans, site observations, structural-condition evidence, measurements, material specifications and options, and relevant hazard information.
interpret_scope: Translate plans and measurements into required dimensions and layouts, assess structural condition and hazards, and determine whether completed work conforms to specifications, level, and plumb.
decide_scope: Select materials, construction or repair methods, work sequences, cuts, fastening and bracing arrangements, and corrective actions for defects or unsafe conditions.
act_scope: Fabricate, erect, install, finish, and repair structural components and fixtures while verifying alignment and maintaining safe access and working conditions.

job_role_definition: Install fitted carpet and its supporting materials to provide finished, durable floor coverings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect and measure floor surfaces and obtain floor-sketch details needed for fitting the carpet.
interpret_scope: Assess surface condition and translate measurements and sketches into area and material estimates.
decide_scope: Select necessary surface corrections and plan carpet layout, seam placement, and fitting allowances for appearance and wear.
act_scope: Prepare and correct floor surfaces; install supporting materials and fasteners; and cut, join, fit, stretch, secure, and finish the carpet and transitions.

job_role_definition: Creates, revises, and quality-checks maps and other spatial products for defined uses.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Compile, select, and maintain spatial source materials and digital geographic data, including survey, imagery, records, reports, maps, and boundary documentation.
interpret_scope: Analyze spatial and legal source information to establish terrain, boundaries, accuracy, completeness, and other map-relevant findings.
decide_scope: Set acceptable source-material guidelines and determine the map’s content, layout, scale, projection, dimensions, colors, and production specifications for its defined use.
act_scope: Create, revise, quality-check, and direct production of maps and related spatial products, applying required corrections and maintaining the underlying digital data.

job_role_definition: Derives precise geographic and terrain information from aerial imagery, remote sensing, surveys, and geodetic measurements.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Compile aerial imagery, remote-sensing, survey, geodetic, and reference inputs, including field observations used to verify relevant ground features.
interpret_scope: Analyze and mathematically resolve imagery and measurements to identify, position, scale, orient, and assess geographic, terrain, hydrographic, and cultural features for accuracy and completeness.
decide_scope: Select the imagery, remote-sensing, and plotting methods and equipment needed to meet required accuracy standards.
act_scope: Delineate features and produce, revise, and maintain precise topographic maps, mosaics, charts, terrain models, drawings, and associated geographic data.

job_role_definition: Process customer purchases and related transactions by calculating charges, receiving payments, and issuing receipts, change, refunds, or credits.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and enter merchandise, service, price, weight, account, return, payment, coupon, and cash-drawer information needed for a customer transaction.
interpret_scope: Determine applicable prices, charges, totals, payment amounts, and transaction discrepancies from the collected information.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate transaction disposition, including payment handling, refund, credit, exchange, or escalation needed to resolve a purchase-related issue.
act_scope: Process purchases and related transactions by receiving or posting payment, recording totals, and issuing receipts, change, refunds, credits, or exchanged merchandise.

job_role_definition: Prepare, place, finish, cure, and repair concrete surfaces and related concrete features to the required grade, texture, and durability.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain specifications and prepare materials, and inspect forms, surfaces, concrete condition, and environmental conditions needed for placement, finishing, curing, and repair.
interpret_scope: Assess alignment, grade, surface condition, concrete workability, and curing effects to identify deviations and treatment needs.
decide_scope: Select placement direction, finishing sequence, curing adjustments, and repair or surface-treatment methods needed to achieve the specified result.
act_scope: Set forms and place, compact, shape, finish, cure, waterproof, restore, repair, or fabricate concrete surfaces and related features, including specified decorative treatments.

job_role_definition: Direct and participate in kitchen operations by overseeing food preparation, quality, safety, menus, staff, supplies, and operating costs.
acquire_scope: Gather customer requirements, assess ingredient availability and received-product condition, inspect food, equipment, work areas, and sanitation practices, and obtain the supply, cost, production, and operating data needed for kitchen operations.
interpret_scope: Evaluate food quality, safety, supply needs, recipe costs, customer demand, and operational data against culinary, regulatory, timing, and cost standards.
decide_scope: Set menus, recipes, presentations, menu prices, purchasing and budget plans, production schedules, staffing requirements, and corrective priorities for food operations.
act_scope: Direct, supervise, train, and staff kitchen personnel; prepare and present food; procure supplies and equipment services; and carry out coordinated kitchen operations across assigned facilities.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, optimize, and oversee chemical manufacturing processes, equipment, and control systems to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient production.
acquire_scope: Conduct laboratory and pilot-plant studies, process tests, and production monitoring to assemble operating, experimental, cost, progress, and equipment-performance data.
interpret_scope: Analyze process, experiment, and equipment data and chemical-process models to assess control, performance, safety, environmental compliance, and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Select process configurations, equipment layouts, separation or reaction methods, control-system designs, operating improvements, and safety procedures that meet production requirements.
act_scope: Design, develop, optimize, and oversee chemical manufacturing processes, equipment, and control systems, including directing work to construct, operate, or improve them.

job_role_definition: Operate and tend chemical-processing equipment to produce industrial or consumer products safely under specified process conditions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications and material requirements, measure and load ingredients, and collect operating, inspection, and product-quality observations and samples.
interpret_scope: Assess process readings, equipment condition, and product tests against specified conditions and standards to identify deviations, hazards, impurities, or malfunctions.
decide_scope: Determine needed process changes, material treatment, equipment disposition, and emergency response based on assessed operating and product conditions.
act_scope: Operate and regulate chemical-processing equipment, carry out material treatment and product separation, maintain safe conditions, and clean, maintain, or shut down equipment as required.

job_role_definition: Control and monitor integrated chemical processes and equipment to maintain safe, efficient, specification-compliant production.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor instruments, alarms, operating units, tank levels, visible reactions, and product samples, and obtain laboratory reports and recorded process data needed to assess production conditions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate process readings, observations, quality-test results, chemical reactions, and material-yield calculations to determine conformance, safety, efficiency, and equipment-condition implications.
decide_scope: Select process adjustments, operating priorities, emergency responses, and corrective-action escalation needed to maintain safe, efficient, specification-compliant production.
act_scope: Operate, adjust, start, regulate, or shut down integrated process equipment and flows, coordinate corrective support, and direct process-operation work to carry out the selected response.

job_role_definition: Conduct laboratory testing, analysis, and technical support that enables chemical research, process work, and quality control.
acquire_scope: Prepare solutions, samples, apparatus, supplies, and safe operating conditions, then conduct sampling, laboratory tests, experiments, and pilot-plant operations to obtain chemical and physical data.
interpret_scope: Compile test and analysis results to determine material characteristics, product conformance, and findings relevant to research, process work, and quality control.
decide_scope: Select appropriate sampling, analytical, experimental, and technical-support approaches, including adjustments to methods or apparatus needed to address the work objective.
act_scope: Carry out the selected laboratory and process-support work, maintain instruments and quality controls, assist chemists or engineers, and communicate documented results through reports, charts, and technical support.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary chemistry courses and support student learning, with scholarly research and related faculty responsibilities as applicable.
