acquire_scope: Obtain current chemistry literature, course requirements, student work and performance observations, student advising information, teaching and laboratory resources, and experimental or other research evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student learning and laboratory performance, assess instructional and curricular needs, and analyze research evidence into scholarly findings.
decide_scope: Select course content, instructional and laboratory methods, safety procedures, assessments and grades, student guidance, research directions, and needed teaching or research resources.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver chemistry courses, administer assessments and feedback, supervise laboratory and student research work, enforce safety procedures, advise students, maintain required instructional records, publish findings, and pursue research funding.

job_role_definition: Conducts chemical analyses and quality-control testing to characterize materials, assess conformance, diagnose process or equipment problems, and issue technical findings and specifications.
acquire_scope: Obtain representative samples, requirements, and process context; prepare reagents and instruments; and conduct selected analyses and tests to generate valid measurements.
interpret_scope: Evaluate measurements and test information to determine composition, properties, reactions, conformance, and likely sources of process or equipment malfunction.
decide_scope: Select analytical methods, follow-up tests, instrument adjustments, corrective actions, and appropriate product, process, or test specifications.
act_scope: Document and deliver validated characterizations, conformance findings, diagnostic conclusions, standards, and specifications to relevant technical or production teams.

job_role_definition: Research and Development Chemists design and conduct chemical analyses and experiments to create or improve products, formulas, processes, methods, and scientific knowledge.
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements and prior findings, and prepare samples, reagents, instruments, and selected experiments to generate relevant measurements and observations.
interpret_scope: Analyze chemical and physical data, reaction behavior, and process performance to determine properties, relationships, validity, and causes of anomalies.
decide_scope: Select experimental designs, analytical methods, formulation or process changes, safety controls, and specifications based on evidence and research objectives.
act_scope: Implement selected product, formulation, process, or method improvements and communicate validated findings, procedures, and specifications.

job_role_definition: Provide overall organizational direction by establishing policy, leading senior management, and overseeing strategic, operational, financial, and governance performance.
acquire_scope: Obtain performance, financial, operational, governance, workforce, legal, and stakeholder information through reports, reviews, meetings, and directed inquiry.
interpret_scope: Assess organizational results, resource use, risks, proposed actions, and applicable policies, laws, and regulations to determine their implications.
decide_scope: Set organizational policies, objectives, priorities, budgets, structures, senior leadership assignments, agreements, and corrective or strategic courses of action.
act_scope: Provide overall direction by leading senior management, coordinating organizational functions and governance, implementing approved policies and controls, and carrying out corrective actions.

job_role_definition: Lead an organization's sustainability strategy, programs, compliance, performance evaluation, and stakeholder engagement.
acquire_scope: Research sustainability issues and stakeholder interests and assemble operational, environmental, financial, regulatory, and project-performance information.
interpret_scope: Assess sustainability risks, initiative viability, compliance status, and program performance to establish findings on progress and effectiveness.
decide_scope: Set sustainability strategy, priorities, evaluation methods, resource plans, project approvals, and corrective or compliance actions.
act_scope: Lead and direct sustainability programs, projects, personnel, outreach, reporting, funding efforts, and stakeholder engagement to deliver organizational sustainability outcomes.

occupation_name: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
job_role_definition: Improves the well-being of children and families through assessment, counseling, case management, advocacy, and coordinated support services.
acquire_scope: Gather client, family, home, school, medical, employment, and service information through interviews, records, follow-ups, and arranged evaluations.
interpret_scope: Assess needs, risks, capabilities, service quality, eligibility, and foster or adoptive home suitability from the available information.
decide_scope: Determine required interventions, service plans, referrals, protective or placement recommendations, and legal or custody-related recommendations.
act_scope: Counsel children and families, coordinate and arrange support and placement services, advocate and testify when needed, maintain case documentation, and provide ongoing case management.

occupation_name: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
job_role_definition: Helps students overcome social, behavioral, family, and attendance barriers that impair their academic functioning.
acquire_scope: Gather student, family, school, medical, and service information through interviews, consultations, records, follow-ups, and arranged assessments needed to address barriers to academic functioning.
interpret_scope: Assess the causes and effects of students’ social, behavioral, family, attendance, and health-related difficulties, including needs, capabilities, eligibility, and adequacy of provided services.
decide_scope: Develop and revise service plans and determine the appropriate counseling, supports, referrals, testing, and coordinated interventions for each student.
act_scope: Counsel students and families, coordinate with schools and outside agencies, arrange services and assessments, provide referral guidance, implement interventions, and maintain case documentation.

job_role_definition: Provide daily supervision, personal care, safety, and developmentally appropriate activities for children.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe children and gather information about their needs, routines, health, behavior, development, and relevant care requirements from caregivers and records.
interpret_scope: Assess observations and care information to recognize safety concerns, developmental or emotional needs, and changes requiring attention.
decide_scope: Select appropriate supervision, care, behavior guidance, rest, activity, accommodation, and escalation measures for each child and setting.
act_scope: Provide safe daily supervision and personal care; maintain hygienic, orderly care environments; conduct developmentally appropriate learning, play, meals, rest, transport, and support activities; and communicate relevant daily information to caregivers.

job_role_definition: Assess, diagnose, and treat patients' neuromusculoskeletal conditions primarily through spinal and musculoskeletal manipulation and related conservative care.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient histories and gather clinical examination findings and diagnostic imaging or test inputs needed to assess neuromusculoskeletal conditions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate neuromusculoskeletal and spinal function and interpret histories, examinations, and imaging to diagnose conditions and exclude fractures or disease.
decide_scope: Select diagnostic procedures, conservative treatment and self-care recommendations, supportive devices, and referrals appropriate to the patient's condition.
act_scope: Deliver conservative care through spinal and musculoskeletal manipulation, apply indicated supports, counsel patients on health practices, and maintain patient case records.

job_role_definition: Create, rehearse, and stage dance works and performances.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather artistic source material, musical and narrative inputs, dancer audition and rehearsal feedback, and production requirements for the dance work.
interpret_scope: Translate artistic and musical sources into movement possibilities and assess dancers' abilities, technique, and needed improvements.
decide_scope: Select the choreographic approach, performers, movement and formation choices, accompanying sound, and coordinated artistic production elements.
act_scope: Create and document dances, teach and direct performers through rehearsals, and stage original or restaged dance presentations.

job_role_definition: Support civil engineering projects through technical design, analysis, documentation, field evaluation, testing, estimating, and coordination under engineering direction.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements from drawings and specifications and gather site, contractor-work, survey, materials-test, and project-activity data needed for civil project support.
interpret_scope: Calculate dimensions, quantities, specifications, and costs; analyze site and test data; and assess field conditions, defects, and conformance with designs and applicable codes.
decide_scope: Recommend technical project details, evaluation and testing approaches, design or installation plans, budgets, and changes needed to address field conflicts or contract modifications under engineering direction.
act_scope: Produce detailed drawings, layouts, maps, diagrams, estimates, reports, and project documentation, and coordinate communication of findings, problems, and agreed changes during project delivery.

job_role_definition: Plans, designs, and oversees civil infrastructure construction, operation, and maintenance to meet technical, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather project requirements, survey and site data, drawings, technical studies, material tests, and cost inputs needed for civil works.
interpret_scope: Analyze physical, structural, hydraulic, traffic, and environmental evidence to establish constraints, risks, feasibility, and compliance or performance gaps.
decide_scope: Select system layouts, design specifications, materials, risk controls, construction guidance, and corrective actions appropriate to project requirements and site conditions.
act_scope: Produce civil designs and engineering solutions, provide technical direction, and oversee construction, operation, or maintenance for conformance and regulatory compliance.

job_role_definition: Investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and settle insurance claims within assigned authority.
acquire_scope: Obtain and organize claim forms, coverage records, incident and treatment evidence, party accounts, property/title information, and damage details needed to handle each claim.
interpret_scope: Assess coverage, liability, property damage, claim severity, exposure, and the validity of relevant property interests from the assembled evidence.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate claim disposition and financial position, including settlement, denial, further review, reserves, settlement terms, or litigation recommendation within assigned authority.
act_scope: Negotiate and settle claims, process authorized payments and records, manage complex or disputed matters through counsel, committees, mediations, trials, or property-owner transactions, and maintain the claim file.

job_role_definition: Review claims and claim handling to determine validity, authorize payments, and ensure procedural and financial compliance.
acquire_scope: Obtain claim forms, policy and settlement records, investigation results, bill details, and additional information from claimants, witnesses, medical and legal parties, employers, and reinsurance brokers.
interpret_scope: Assess coverage, claim validity, settlement evidence, claim-handling methods, billing, and payment irregularities against applicable procedures and financial requirements.
decide_scope: Select claim disposition, payment authorization within designated authority, and escalation or corrective handling for questionable, litigated, or noncompliant matters.
act_scope: Process authorized claims and payments, record reserves and file documentation, maintain claim files, carry out referrals and case presentations, oversee handling adherence, and report irregularities.

job_role_definition: Investigate questionable or contested insurance claims and develop findings and evidence for claim or litigation decisions.
acquire_scope: Gather and verify claim, background, credit, employment, medical, and witness information through records review, correspondence, and interviews, including evidence for contested claims.
interpret_scope: Analyze the collected information to assess claim facts, discrepancies, credibility, and evidentiary support.
decide_scope: Recommend claim settlement, denial, further review, or a litigation-related disposition based on the investigative findings.
act_scope: Document and communicate investigative findings and evidence, and present or support them in mediations or trials when required.

job_role_definition: Clean machinery, tanks, parts, and other equipment for safe operation, maintenance, or reuse.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare cleaning media, tools, hoses, connections, and accessible equipment parts, and inspect contamination, cleanliness, damage, and cleaning-machine operation.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection and operating observations to determine cleaning status, damage or noncompliance, and equipment malfunctions.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate cleaning method, compound, equipment settings, and response to inadequate cleanliness or abnormal machine operation.
act_scope: Set up and operate cleaning equipment to remove contamination and debris, rinse, dry, and drain surfaces, disassemble and reassemble equipment as needed, and stop equipment or report malfunctions when required.

job_role_definition: Clean, condition, and prepare vehicles for customer use, display, or delivery.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect vehicles for cleanliness, condition, damage, and applicable standards, and assemble the required cleaning materials, compounds, and equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection findings and cleaning results to identify treatment needs and determine readiness for customer use, display, or delivery.
decide_scope: Select the cleaning and conditioning methods, sequence, equipment settings, and responses to defects or malfunctions.
act_scope: Prepare cleaning compounds; clean, rinse, dry, polish, condition, and protect vehicle interiors and exteriors; operate cleaning equipment, remove and reattach trim when needed, and position or transport prepared vehicles.

occupation_name: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
job_role_name: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
job_role_definition: Operate or tend industrial cleaning, washing, and metal-pickling equipment to remove impurities from products and materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Load and unload items; measure, weigh, mix, and replenish cleaning solutions; and collect operating, condition, and solution-conformance inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess machine observations, gauge and temperature readings, solution tests, and equipment inspections against required processing conditions.
decide_scope: Select operating adjustments, solution corrections, and maintenance responses needed to keep cleaning or pickling within specification.
act_scope: Operate and regulate cleaning, washing, and pickling equipment to remove impurities, including starting process equipment, servicing tanks, and maintaining mechanical parts.

job_role_definition: Conduct religious worship and rites while providing spiritual leadership, education, pastoral guidance, and support to a faith community.
acquire_scope: Study sacred texts, religious laws, doctrines, and traditions, and gather the circumstances, questions, and spiritual, emotional, or personal needs of community members seeking guidance or care.
interpret_scope: Relate religious teachings and traditions to worship, education, ceremonies, and the needs or circumstances presented by individuals and groups.
decide_scope: Select worship content and service arrangements, educational and leadership-development approaches, pastoral guidance, ceremony preparation, crisis responses, and appropriate referrals.
act_scope: Conduct worship, prayer, sermons, readings, rites and special ceremonies; teach and train; and provide pastoral counseling, visits, comfort, support, and emergency assistance to the faith community.

job_role_definition: Research, analyze, and communicate climate-related policy evidence and recommendations to guide public, organizational, and stakeholder action.
acquire_scope: Gather climate-related studies and research policy, practices, procedures, and existing legislation relevant to climate and environmental management.
interpret_scope: Analyze, assess, and distill climate research and policy evidence, including the environmental impacts of existing policies or legislation.
decide_scope: Formulate policy and legislative recommendations, including proposed new or modified climate-related policies.
act_scope: Communicate evidence and recommendations through briefs, reports, testimony, meetings, and outreach that promotes climate-mitigation initiatives.

job_role_definition: Manage clinical-study data systems and processes to deliver accurate, complete, analysis-ready clinical data and related reporting.
acquire_scope: Receive, enter, verify, track, and assemble clinical-study data, workflow status, user requirements, and quality-control evidence needed to manage the study data environment.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical data and system outputs for accuracy, completeness, errors, omissions, compliance, and analysis findings, including statistical evaluation of clinical data.
decide_scope: Set study-specific data-management plans, requirements, validation rules, data formats, release and lock approaches, and process or technology revisions to achieve reliable data delivery.
act_scope: Build, validate, operate, and improve clinical data systems and workflows; resolve data discrepancies; prepare analysis-ready datasets and reports; and provide the controlled documentation, procedures, training, and oversight required for delivery.

job_role_definition: Assess, diagnose, and treat neurobehavioral conditions associated with nervous-system disorders while guiding patients, families, and care teams.
acquire_scope: Obtain clinical histories and behavioral, cognitive, functional, observational, and longitudinal measures needed to assess neurobehavioral conditions and treatment progress.
interpret_scope: Integrate assessment findings to characterize neurobehavioral functioning, establish baselines, distinguish neurological and psychological etiologies, and diagnose nervous-system-related conditions across patient populations.
decide_scope: Select diagnostic conclusions, treatment or rehabilitation approaches, monitoring priorities, and risk-related recommendations appropriate to the patient's condition.
act_scope: Deliver neuropsychological reports, treatment and rehabilitation interventions, progress comparisons, risk communications, and education or counseling for patients, families, and care teams.

job_role_definition: Provide advanced specialty nursing care while guiding clinical practice, education, quality improvement, and compliance across care delivery.
acquire_scope: Gather patient histories, observations, assessments, test and record information, practice-quality data, evidence, and regulatory requirements needed for specialty care and nursing-service improvement.
interpret_scope: Assess patient conditions and care needs, evaluate treatment and nursing-practice effectiveness, and synthesize clinical evidence and compliance findings into specialty-specific conclusions.
decide_scope: Determine differential diagnoses, treatment and discharge plans, nursing orders, clinical recommendations, practice standards, educational priorities, and quality-improvement or compliance actions.
act_scope: Deliver and coordinate advanced specialty nursing care, implement treatment and practice changes, supervise and consult with caregivers, provide patient and staff education, and carry out quality, research, and regulatory activities.

job_role_definition: Plan and coordinate clinical research studies while protecting participants and ensuring protocol, regulatory, and operational compliance.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble protocol requirements, participant consent and eligibility information, clinical observations, specimens, follow-up and laboratory findings, study supplies, and operational status records needed to run the study.
interpret_scope: Evaluate protocols, participant eligibility and risks, collected study data, laboratory findings, adverse events, enrollment and dropout patterns, and compliance records to identify study findings or problems.
decide_scope: Select study plans and procedures, recruitment practices, participant treatment or dosage adjustments within the protocol, resource arrangements, reporting responses, and corrective or protocol-revision actions.
act_scope: Coordinate and conduct study procedures; enroll, inform, schedule, monitor, and follow participants; dispense protocol treatments; manage specimens and records; train staff; communicate required information; and maintain compliant study operations and reporting.

job_role_definition: Assesses and diagnoses psychological conditions and provides counseling or psychotherapy to improve clients' functioning, adjustment, safety, and well-being.
acquire_scope: Gather histories, records, and contextual information through client and collateral interviews, observation, and psychological testing.
interpret_scope: Evaluate concerns, behavior, history, test findings, context, and treatment response to determine diagnoses, risk, needs, and meaningful clinical change.
decide_scope: Formulate the case and select treatment goals and methods, crisis responses, referrals, or plan revisions.
act_scope: Deliver counseling, psychotherapy, and crisis interventions; coordinate care; and document and communicate findings, plans, progress, and recommendations.

job_role_definition: Evaluate prospective athletes and provide assessments and recommendations for recruitment.
acquire_scope: Gather prospective athletes’ performance records and firsthand observations relevant to their current ability and potential.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the collected evidence to assess athletes’ skills, fitness, and potential within the relevant athletic area.
decide_scope: Select recruitment recommendations and priorities, including athletes and locations warranting future recruitment attention.
act_scope: Deliver documented player assessments and recruitment recommendations in scouting reports.

job_role_definition: Train and direct athletes or teams to improve performance and prepare for competition.
acquire_scope: Gather observations, performance records, opponent information, and current sport rules and techniques needed to prepare athletes and teams safely for competition.
interpret_scope: Assess athletes’ skills, fitness, strengths, weaknesses, and potential, and analyze opponents and competitive requirements to identify preparation needs.
decide_scope: Choose training and conditioning approaches, game strategies, team selections, practice priorities, and coaching adjustments suited to athletes and competition.
act_scope: Conduct practices, conditioning, instruction, demonstrations, motivation, and competition direction while enforcing safe, proper participation.

occupation_name: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Prepare, paint, and finish transportation-vehicle surfaces to restore their protective coating and appearance.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect vehicle surfaces and coating operations, assemble color-matched coating materials, and position vehicles, materials, and access equipment for surface work.
interpret_scope: Identify surface and finish defects and determine their likely causes and refinishing requirements.
decide_scope: Select the needed surface treatments, coating adjustments, drying settings, and corrective measures.
act_scope: Prepare, repair, seal, prime, coat, dry, retouch, buff, and wax vehicle surfaces, while maintaining painting equipment and work areas and disposing of hazardous waste appropriately.

occupation_name: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Industrial Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Operator
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend production machinery that applies coatings or paint to manufactured products.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Load and measure coatings and chemicals, feed manufactured products through the production line, and obtain operating and product-quality readings and samples.
interpret_scope: Assess coating flow, viscosity, spray dispersion, machine conditions, and finished-product samples to identify deviations, flaws, and their causes.
decide_scope: Select machine settings and corrective adjustments needed to meet specified coating quality and production conditions.
act_scope: Set up, start, regulate, and tend coating and auxiliary equipment to apply specified coatings, remove finished workpieces, and maintain clean equipment and work areas with proper hazardous-waste disposal.

job_role_definition: Produce and finish wire-wound electrical coils and components using coiling equipment, hand tools, and related assembly and testing processes.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work orders and specifications, assemble and load the required wire, insulation, workpieces, and machine parts, and collect component measurements and test readings.
interpret_scope: Determine material and processing requirements from specifications and assess measurements and test results for conformance.
decide_scope: Select materials, equipment setups, processing adjustments, and component dispositions based on requirements and conformance findings.
act_scope: Operate coiling equipment and use hand tools and finishing processes to wind, shape, insulate, install, coat, bake, assemble, remove, and finish wire-wound electrical coils and components.

occupation_name: Coin, Vending, and Amusement Machine Servicers and Repairers
job_role_name: Coin, Vending, and Amusement Machine Servicers and Repairers
job_role_definition: Install, stock, service, maintain, and repair coin-operated, vending, and amusement machines.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect and test machines and meters, retrieve transaction and service information, consult technical references, and obtain the products, supplies, tools, and replacement parts needed for installation and service.
interpret_scope: Determine operating condition, malfunction causes, transaction discrepancies, and service requirements from test results, observations, records, and technical specifications.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate stocking, adjustment, maintenance, repair, part replacement, installation, or major-repair disposition.
act_scope: Install and connect machines, stock and service them, collect and account for their contents, and clean, lubricate, adjust, disassemble, reassemble, and repair components to restore proper operation.

job_role_definition: Manage command-center communications, surveillance, emergency coordination, operational reporting, and weapons-control systems to direct military operations.
acquire_scope: Monitor and assemble communications, surveillance information, emergency details, operational status data, and weapons-control inputs needed to direct military operations.
interpret_scope: Assess the combined operational information to establish the current situation, threats, resource status, and reporting significance.
decide_scope: Set operational priorities and select directions, coordination actions, reporting dispositions, and weapons-control courses of action.
act_scope: Issue operational directions, coordinate emergency responses, transmit reports and communications, and execute selected weapons-control actions.

job_role_definition: Operate and monitor command-center communications, surveillance, tactical assessment, emergency-response, and weapons-control systems to support military operations.
acquire_scope: Receive and monitor communications, surveillance feeds, operational reports, system-status indications, and emergency information required to support military operations.
interpret_scope: Assess incoming operational and tactical information to identify relevant conditions, threats, incidents, and system implications.
decide_scope: Select response priorities, communications handling, tactical dispositions, and control actions within assigned procedures and operational direction.
act_scope: Operate, coordinate, and control command-center communications, emergency-response, and weapons-control systems to execute the selected actions.

job_role_definition: Performs underwater inspection, construction, maintenance, salvage, recovery, and related operations using diving equipment and specialized tools.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain dive-task and environmental information, verify equipment and safety conditions, and collect underwater observations, images, samples, measurements, and test results from structures, vessels, systems, and sites.
interpret_scope: Assess collected observations and test results to determine the condition, integrity, hazards, obstructions, and relevant features of underwater assets, materials, and locations.
decide_scope: Select safe dive parameters and the operational method, sequence, positioning, and equipment required for the assigned inspection, construction, maintenance, salvage, recovery, cleanup, exploration, extraction, or demolition operation.
act_scope: Prepare and maintain diving equipment, conduct dives with surface coordination, deliver inspection and survey findings, and use specialized tools, rigging, and construction or recovery methods to install, repair, maintain, cut, weld, clear, salvage, recover, clean up, extract, or demolish as assigned.

job_role_definition: Pilot and navigate fixed-wing aircraft or helicopters for nonscheduled commercial operations while ensuring safe and compliant flight performance.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect aircraft and loading, obtain flight, weather, fuel, weight, schedule, and air-traffic information, and monitor instruments and aircraft systems throughout flight.
interpret_scope: Assess aircraft condition, operating data, weather, load, performance factors, and navigation indications to determine their implications for safe, compliant flight.
decide_scope: Develop and adjust flight plans and select routes, altitudes, speeds, fuel, load, maintenance, and emergency actions consistent with operating conditions and clearances.
act_scope: Operate and navigate the aircraft, communicate and coordinate required flight activities, and carry out approved changes and emergency measures to complete the commercial flight safely and compliantly.

job_role_definition: Design and develop functional, manufacturable, and marketable products from initial concept through production support.
acquire_scope: Gather customer and market needs, competing-product and design-trend perspective, product-use and safety characteristics, and manufacturing materials, methods, specifications, costs, and regulatory requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess research and model or sample evidence to determine product appeal, functional performance, safety, serviceability, manufacturability, quality, cost, and fit with production and market constraints.
decide_scope: Select and refine product concepts, visual and functional direction, production requirements and procedures, design changes, and product-line coordination needed to meet established requirements.
act_scope: Create and communicate drawings, specifications, graphic and physical models or samples, coordinate their fabrication, and support and monitor manufacture to deliver production-ready products.

job_role_definition: Operate communications equipment to transmit, receive, route, or monitor information and communications services not classified elsewhere.
acquire_scope: Receive communications and obtain the message content, transmission requests, routing details, and equipment status needed to handle them.
interpret_scope: Assess communication content, signal quality, destination requirements, and equipment indications to determine operational meaning.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate transmission, routing, monitoring response, priority, and corrective handling for each communication.
act_scope: Operate communications equipment to transmit, receive, route, and monitor information and communications services.

job_role_definition: Teach communications courses, support students, and may conduct scholarly research and related academic service.
acquire_scope: Obtain student work and assessment evidence, advising information, instructional resources, current disciplinary knowledge, scholarly data, and inputs needed for academic-service responsibilities.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and support needs, instructional effectiveness, scholarly evidence, and relevant academic issues.
decide_scope: Select curricula, instructional and assessment approaches, student guidance, research directions and methods, and responses to academic issues.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver instruction, facilitate discussion, advise and supervise students, maintain required records, communicate scholarly findings, and carry out related academic service.

job_role_definition: Promote community and individual health by providing outreach, education, navigation, advocacy, and basic preventive support to community members.
acquire_scope: Build outreach relationships and obtain community and client information through targeted contact, home visits, monitoring, screenings, vital-statistics collection, and maintained records.
interpret_scope: Assess health needs, risks, progress, screening observations, and barriers to access, including the cultural and language context needed to make health information meaningful.
decide_scope: Determine priorities and select individualized or community health-improvement plans, preventive actions, referrals, follow-up, advocacy, and required protective reporting.
act_scope: Deliver outreach, culturally appropriate education, navigation and application assistance, advocacy, follow-up, accompaniment, basic preventive care and first aid, referrals, translation or cultural mediation, and service-access feedback.

occupation_name: Community and Social Service Specialists, All Other
job_role_name: Community and Social Service Specialists, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide community and social services in specialist functions not classified under a separate occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain client, community, and service-context information needed to provide the applicable specialist social service.
interpret_scope: Assess the information to identify needs, circumstances, and relevant service considerations within the specialist function.
decide_scope: Determine appropriate service priorities, recommendations, referrals, or intervention approaches for the circumstances.
act_scope: Provide the applicable specialist community or social service and coordinate its delivery with relevant parties.

job_role_definition: Plans and directs employee benefit programs, including program design, administration, compliance, and communication.
acquire_scope: Gather benefit-plan requirements, employee questions and needs, provider information, regulatory obligations, market conditions, and program records.
interpret_scope: Assess benefit data, legislation, contracts, employee feedback, and provider information to evaluate program adequacy, compliance, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set benefit policies, program designs, modifications, administrative procedures, provider arrangements, and recommendations for management.
act_scope: Direct and administer benefit programs, complete required reporting, coordinate providers and staff, deliver employee benefit communications and selection support, and resolve benefits-related issues.

job_role_definition: Plans and directs employee compensation programs, pay structures, and job-classification systems.
acquire_scope: Obtain compensation market rates, regulatory and contractual requirements, job information, personnel data, and organizational inputs needed to design and administer compensation and classification programs.
interpret_scope: Analyze pay practices, wage data, regulations, contracts, job content, and workforce statistics to assess competitiveness, compliance, classification relationships, and compensation-related issues.
decide_scope: Select compensation plans, pay structures, job levels and families, classification policies, procedures, bargaining positions, and recommended program changes.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate compensation and job-classification programs, develop classification and decision-support materials, communicate applicable policies, and negotiate compensation terms.

occupation_name: Compensation, Benefits, and Job Analysis Specialists
job_role_definition: Develops, administers, analyzes, and advises on employee compensation and benefit programs and related employment requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather compensation, benefits, job-analysis, cost, personnel, carrier, regulatory, and collective-agreement information needed to manage programs and employment requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze program, job, cost, market, practice, and requirement data to assess compensation and benefits arrangements, classifications, compliance, and employee concerns.
decide_scope: Select program designs, policy modifications, compliance responses, and recommended resolutions for compensation, benefits, classification, and related employment matters.
act_scope: Implement and administer compensation and benefit programs and related employment requirements, and deliver guidance, required documentation, training, and negotiated or mediated resolutions.

occupation_name: Compensation, Benefits, and Job Analysis Specialists
job_role_definition: Analyzes and evaluates jobs and worker requirements to develop classifications, descriptions, pay structures, and organizational information.
acquire_scope: Collect job, worker, organizational, occupational, and labor-market information through research, job-analysis instruments, observations, interviews, surveys, and focus groups.
interpret_scope: Analyze job requirements, work relationships, organizational data, and applicable employment rules to assess the nature, relative value, and structure of jobs.
decide_scope: Determine job classifications, exempt status, salary assignments and scales, and appropriate methods for job-related organizational practices.
act_scope: Develop and communicate occupational classifications, job descriptions, pay structures, organizational analyses, and related technical information.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate organizational programs that ensure compliance with ethical and regulatory standards.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain regulatory requirements, emerging standards, complaints and hotline reports, audit and monitoring results, investigation evidence, and compliance-program records.
interpret_scope: Assess evidence, operational and environmental conditions, communications, procedures, and legal input to identify violations, evaluate compliance and risk exposure, and determine program effectiveness.
decide_scope: Set compliance and risk-management priorities, choose policy, monitoring, communication, reporting, and enforcement approaches, and determine required follow-up and disciplinary strategies.
act_scope: Plan, direct, and coordinate organization-wide compliance programs by implementing and communicating policies and controls, directing reviews and investigations, training and advising personnel, overseeing corrective and disciplinary measures, and submitting required reports or violation disclosures.

job_role_definition: Evaluates licensing eligibility and regulatory compliance, makes licensing and enforcement determinations, and delivers or refers resulting actions to regulated parties and authorities.
acquire_scope: Gather applications, records, interview evidence, test performance, and inspection observations relevant to licensing eligibility and regulatory compliance.
interpret_scope: Evaluate evidence against licensing and permit requirements to identify qualifications, deficiencies, violations, and matters requiring investigation.
decide_scope: Select licensing dispositions, enforcement responses, investigation priorities, and appropriate referrals based on applicable standards and evaluated evidence.
act_scope: Deliver licensing and enforcement outcomes by issuing licenses, communicating decisions or warnings, and documenting or referring violations to appropriate authorities.

job_role_definition: Organizational Compliance Officers evaluate whether organizational policies and practices conform to applicable requirements, identify deficiencies, and report findings, recommendations, and violations.
acquire_scope: Gather applicable laws, regulations, industry developments, organizational policies and procedures, implementation evidence, and information about suspected compliance issues.
interpret_scope: Evaluate documented requirements and operational evidence to form conclusions about conformity, implementation gaps, potential violations, and matters requiring investigation.
decide_scope: Select follow-up and investigative priorities, recommended corrective actions, and whether identified violations require referral to appropriate authorities.
act_scope: Produce compliance reports and recommendations, communicate required follow-up, and report identified legal or regulatory violations to appropriate boards or agencies.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, test, configure, and support computer hardware and related equipment to meet system requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather system, user, interface, performance, environmental, cost, security, and power requirements; retrieve capability data; and generate verification evidence through prototype and hardware testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, hardware-software interfaces, system capabilities, operating behavior, and recorded test results to assess conformance and identify needed changes.
decide_scope: Determine and recommend the hardware architecture, configuration, materials, power provisions, equipment layout, environmental controls, and modifications that meet requirements.
act_scope: Design, develop, document, build, configure, modify, verify, and support computer hardware and related equipment, including directing technical implementation and assisting designers and users.

job_role_definition: Design, plan, implement, and improve data communications networks to meet capacity, reliability, security, and operational requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather stakeholder requirements, network performance and utilization data, operational problem reports, product and vendor information, and prototype or interoperability test results.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, performance evidence, reliability, security exposure, capacity use, and test outcomes to identify constraints, deficiencies, and feasible design options.
decide_scope: Select network architectures, configurations, security and recovery measures, capacity changes, equipment replacements, and project plans that meet operational requirements.
act_scope: Produce network designs, specifications, procedures, and plans; coordinate and carry out installations, integrations, upgrades, maintenance, repairs, and corrective improvements.

job_role_definition: Maintain, configure, diagnose, and support computer networks to keep connectivity, performance, and security operating reliably.
acquire_scope: Gather network activity, performance, capacity, security, diagnostic, user-issue, and relevant patch or product information needed to maintain reliable network operation.
interpret_scope: Analyze monitoring data, test results, incidents, and user symptoms to identify network conditions, performance constraints, security events, and causes of connectivity problems.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate configuration, access-control, repair, maintenance, recovery, upgrade, or user-support response for identified network needs.
act_scope: Configure, install, integrate, secure, back up, repair, test, maintain, document, report on, and support network hardware, software, cabling, and users to sustain reliable connectivity, performance, and security.

job_role_definition: Operate, set up, monitor, and adjust computer-controlled machine tools or robots to produce conforming workpieces.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job specifications and programmed instructions, verify part and setup inputs, and collect in-process machine-condition and finished-workpiece measurements.
interpret_scope: Determine required machining parameters and sequences from specifications and assess measurements, displays, sounds, and visual inspections for conformance or operating problems.
decide_scope: Select machine settings, tooling, program changes, and corrective actions needed to produce conforming workpieces.
act_scope: Set up, load, program, run, monitor, adjust, service, and unload computer-controlled machines or robots to produce conforming workpieces.

job_role_definition: Develop and verify numerical-control programs that direct automated machine tools to produce workpieces to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and organize job orders, drawings, specifications, design data, part patterns, existing programs, and geometric reference information needed to define the workpiece and machining inputs.
interpret_scope: Analyze the technical inputs to calculate dimensions, geometry, speeds, feeds, and machining requirements, and evaluate instruction accuracy and trial or simulation results against specifications.
decide_scope: Select machining-operation sequences, cutting tools, reference points, toolpaths, hole locations, and production groupings that meet specifications while using materials and setup time effectively.
act_scope: Develop, enter, store, revise, and verify numerical-control programs and associated setup instructions so automated machine tools produce conforming workpieces.

job_role_definition: Perform computer-related work not classified in a more specific computer occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information, requirements, materials, and technical inputs needed for the assigned computer-related work.
interpret_scope: Assess the gathered inputs to determine their relevance, condition, and implications for the assigned work.
decide_scope: Select the approach, priorities, and disposition needed to carry out the assigned computer-related work.
act_scope: Perform and deliver the assigned computer-related work.

job_role_definition: Creates, tests, maintains, and documents application programs that meet specified business or user requirements.
acquire_scope: Elicit and assemble business or user requirements, operational problems, existing-program information, and technical constraints needed to develop or revise application programs.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, workflows, program logic, trial-run results, and defects to determine program behavior, causes of problems, and needed changes.
decide_scope: Select program designs, coding approaches, corrections, revisions, and changes that will satisfy requirements and resolve operating problems.
act_scope: Create, test, repair, revise, maintain, and document application programs and associated user guidance so they produce the required results.

job_role_definition: Creates and maintains systems software that controls computer resources and supports reliable program operation.
acquire_scope: Gather operating requirements, program intent, system-resource behavior, fault reports, and trial-run results needed to maintain systems software.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, program logic, test outcomes, and hardware or network responses to identify defects, performance needs, and operating constraints.
decide_scope: Select system-software designs, code changes, repairs, expansions, and troubleshooting approaches that will meet requirements and improve reliable operation.
act_scope: Create, revise, debug, test, and maintain systems software and its technical documentation to control computer resources and support dependable program operation.

job_role_definition: Teach and support postsecondary students in computer science while carrying out associated academic faculty responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Obtain current computer science knowledge and instructional resources, collect student performance and progress evidence through assessments and observation, and generate or gather evidence for faculty research.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student work, learning progress, and advising needs, assess instructional and curricular effectiveness, and analyze research evidence into disciplinary findings.
decide_scope: Select course content, instructional methods, assessment standards, student guidance, curriculum revisions, and research directions.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver computer science instruction, facilitate learning, communicate evaluations, advise and supervise students, maintain required academic records and instructional resources, and publish and oversee academic research.

job_role_definition: Analyze organizational needs and design, implement, integrate, maintain, and improve computer systems and related solutions.
acquire_scope: Elicit organizational and user requirements, observe work processes, test and monitor system performance, and gather technical, cost, and solution-option information.
interpret_scope: Analyze information-processing needs and system evidence to define requirements, diagnose malfunctions and code problems, evaluate solution suitability, and assess costs, benefits, and implementation value.
decide_scope: Select system goals, operating principles, designs, workflows, technologies, quality standards, and implementation or improvement plans.
act_scope: Develop and document system specifications and procedures; build, integrate, install, correct, maintain, and improve systems; coordinate project delivery; and assist and train users.

job_role_definition: Design, integrate, implement, and sustain computer system architectures that meet organizational, operational, and security requirements.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Elicit organizational, operational, security, and user requirements; gather component, technology, system-operation, and test data needed to engineer the architecture.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements and evidence to determine needed components and to evaluate existing or proposed systems for performance, compatibility, scalability, reliability, portability, and security.
decide_scope: Select the architecture, component use, design changes, standards, and implementation priorities that satisfy requirements and constraints.
act_scope: Design and integrate the system architecture, direct and perform its installation and configuration, validate it, and sustain it through maintenance, upgrades, troubleshooting, and secure implementation guidance.

job_role_definition: Provides technical assistance to computer users by diagnosing problems and installing, maintaining, evaluating, and supporting end-user hardware and software.
acquire_scope: Gather user-reported issues and requirements, inspect end-user equipment and delivery needs, and monitor system operation through observation, commands, diagnostics, and relevant technical documentation.
interpret_scope: Diagnose hardware, software, and operating problems; assess system performance and requirements; and evaluate end-user technology for suitability, defects, and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Select configurations, remedies, service escalation, and recommendations for system modifications, repairs, upgrades, or feasible end-user technology improvements.
act_scope: Provide user assistance, install and configure equipment and software, perform minor repairs and maintenance, verify operation, coordinate external service when needed, and train users in proper use.

job_role_definition: Conduct computer and information science research and develop innovative solutions to hardware and software problems.
acquire_scope: Elicit computing needs and system requirements and assemble technical, scientific, organizational, and feasibility constraints for hardware and software research and solution development.
interpret_scope: Analyze technical problems, formulate mathematical models, assess feasibility, and evaluate proposed solutions against performance standards and relevant goals.
decide_scope: Select the research, technology, design, and project approach most suitable for addressing the identified hardware or software problem.
act_scope: Develop, apply, and design innovative computing technologies and hardware and software solutions while coordinating necessary multidisciplinary implementation.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate an organization's information technology operations, systems, resources, and staff.
acquire_scope: Gather organizational computing needs, system requirements, project and operational status, technology developments, and resource information from users, staff, managers, vendors, and reports.
interpret_scope: Assess workflows, technology use, security and recovery needs, project feasibility, system designs, and operational performance to determine requirements and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Set IT priorities, standards, deadlines, policies, project plans, staffing and budget allocations, technology recommendations, procurement choices, and implementation approvals.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate IT operations, projects, systems, resources, security, backup, user-help, technical-support, and staff activities to deliver reliable organizational information technology services.

occupation_name: Computer, Automated Teller, and Office Machine Repairers
job_role_name: Computer, Automated Teller, and Office Machine Repairers
job_role_definition: Install, maintain, diagnose, and repair computers, automated teller machines, and electronic office equipment.
acquire_scope: Gather problem details, specifications, performance histories, diagnostic measurements, test results, and required parts and calibrated test equipment for servicing electronic machines.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment behavior, schematics, inspection findings, and component or circuit test results to identify malfunctions and required settings.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate installation, maintenance, repair, replacement, adjustment, software-setting, or equipment-update approach and required parts.
act_scope: Install, configure, assemble, connect, maintain, calibrate, clean, adjust, repair, replace, and reassemble computers, automated teller machines, and electronic office equipment to restore or establish operation.

job_role_definition: Assist hotel, apartment, or office-building patrons by arranging and delivering personal, travel, local-information, and guest-support services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather patrons’ requests, constraints, and relevant local, travel, service-provider, ticket, item, and equipment availability information.
interpret_scope: Assess patron needs and available options to determine suitable local information, travel, personal, accessibility, business, and guest-support solutions.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate services, providers, reservations, arrangements, and priorities for each patron request.
act_scope: Arrange and deliver requested information, reservations, travel and event services, personal assistance, business support, items, luggage, mail, food and beverages, and other guest services.

job_role_definition: Manage, improve, and protect soil, water, wetlands, and related natural resources through scientific assessment, conservation planning, technical assistance, and program oversight.
acquire_scope: Collect field, survey, GIS, weather, soil, water, wetland, land-use, biodata, project, program, and stakeholder information needed to assess resources and conservation work.
interpret_scope: Assess scientific, environmental, design, cost, compliance, and investigation evidence to characterize resource conditions, impacts, causes, practice requirements, and program performance.
decide_scope: Select or recommend conservation, restoration, soil and water management, pest-management, funding, easement, plan-amendment, and corrective-action approaches suited to documented conditions and requirements.
act_scope: Deliver conservation plans, specifications, technical assistance, training, implementation support, studies, monitoring, audits, compliance oversight, and dispute-resolution work to manage, improve, and protect natural resources.

job_role_definition: Construction Laborers perform general physical work to prepare and secure sites, move materials, and execute or support basic construction and demolition activities.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather plans and instructions, inspect site and environmental conditions, and obtain measurements, materials, tools, and equipment needed for assigned construction work.
interpret_scope: Determine work requirements, layouts and grades, hazards or environmental controls, and the readiness of materials, equipment, and temporary structures.
decide_scope: Select work sequences, physical methods, material and equipment placement, and safety controls or coordination needed to complete assigned activities.
act_scope: Prepare and secure work areas, move and shape earth or materials, and use equipment to execute or support basic installation, finishing, and demolition.

job_role_definition: Plans, organizes, and directs construction or maintenance projects to deliver structures, facilities, or systems within schedule, budget, quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather project plans, specifications, site conditions, regulatory requirements, contract terms, cost data, and resource availability needed to organize construction.
interpret_scope: Assess feasibility, construction methods, costs, schedules, site performance, quality, safety, environmental impacts, and compliance, including causes of delays or deviations.
decide_scope: Set project methods, budgets, schedules, staffing, procurement, contracting, corrective actions, and plan changes needed to meet delivery and compliance requirements.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate construction work, deploy labor and materials, manage contracts and permits, and implement quality, environmental, and corrective controls.

job_role_definition: Inspect structures, construction sites, building systems, and related installations to determine compliance with plans, codes, safety standards, and other regulations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain plans and specifications and inspect or monitor sites, structures, systems, installations, premises, and environmental conditions using observations, measurements, instrument readings, photographs, and samples.
interpret_scope: Evaluate plans, construction methods, test results, and observed conditions to determine structural quality, safety, proper functioning, environmental effects, cleanliness, and compliance with applicable requirements.
decide_scope: Select compliance dispositions and needed corrective actions, including whether plans meet specifications and whether construction, relocation, demolition, or occupancy should be authorized.
act_scope: Deliver compliance findings, explain applicable requirements and remedial recommendations, and issue plan approvals or permits.

occupation_name: Construction and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Construction and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Performs construction or related work not classified within a separately listed construction occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the work instructions, site information, materials, tools, and measurements needed for the assigned construction or related work.
interpret_scope: Assess instructions, measurements, site conditions, and material requirements to determine the work’s applicable requirements.
decide_scope: Select the work sequence, methods, and immediate adjustments needed to complete the assigned work safely and acceptably.
act_scope: Perform the assigned construction or related work not classified within a separately listed construction occupation.

job_role_definition: Operate continuous mining machines to cut and load mined material while maintaining safe, ventilated, supported mining-face operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain operating inputs by checking methane levels, roof and rib support conditions, and machine and conveyor performance at the mining face.
interpret_scope: Assess atmospheric, ground-support, and equipment observations to identify safe operating conditions, malfunctions, and required adjustments.
decide_scope: Set the locations, boundaries, and depths of cuts and determine machine positioning, operating adjustments, and corrective actions needed to continue mining safely.
act_scope: Operate, position, regulate, maintain, and repair continuous mining and conveying equipment while cutting and loading material and establishing ventilation and roof-support protections.

occupation_name: Control and Valve Installers and Repairers, Except Mechanical Door
job_role_name: Control Valve and Regulator Installer and Repairer
job_role_definition: Install, test, calibrate, maintain, and repair valves, regulators, thermostats, and related mechanical control devices.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather device specifications and blueprints, inspect components, and obtain dimensional, pressure, temperature, flow, leak, and functional test measurements.
interpret_scope: Assess measurements and component condition to identify defects, leaks, malfunctions, calibration deviations, and conformance with required settings and tolerances.
decide_scope: Determine the required installation, adjustment, calibration, maintenance, repair, replacement, or salvage approach and the parts or settings needed to achieve compliant operation.
act_scope: Install, disassemble, clean, lubricate, adjust, calibrate, repair, replace, and reassemble valves, regulators, thermostats, and related mechanical control devices to achieve or restore specified performance.

occupation_name: Control and Valve Installers and Repairers, Except Mechanical Door
job_role_definition: Install, test, maintain, and repair utility meters and associated service equipment to ensure accurate and safe measurement.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect meters and associated service equipment and perform operational, accuracy, flow, pressure, and leak tests to obtain readings, measurements, installation details, and field observations.
interpret_scope: Assess test results and observations to identify inaccuracies, malfunctions, leaks, hazardous conditions, or unauthorized connections.
decide_scope: Determine the needed calibration, adjustment, repair, replacement, service status, or escalation based on the assessment.
act_scope: Install, connect, calibrate, maintain, adjust, repair, replace, or remove meters and associated service equipment; control service as selected and document or report the completed work and safety issues.

job_role_definition: Control and tend conveyor systems to move and route materials or products while maintaining proper operating flow.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain routing and delivery requirements and monitor material identity, quantity, condition, conveyor readings, operating flow, and equipment status.
interpret_scope: Assess monitored flow, measurements, package condition, samples, and equipment indications for conformity, overloads, defects, jams, and malfunctions.
decide_scope: Determine required conveyor settings, material routing, handling priorities, corrective responses, and when equipment problems require escalation.
act_scope: Operate, adjust, and tend conveyors and associated equipment to load, transfer, divert, distribute, and protect materials; clear obstructions, remove damaged material, and maintain operating equipment and work areas.

job_role_definition: Prepare and cook food in cooking jobs not classified under a more specific cook occupation.
acquire_scope: Select, gather, and portion ingredients, seasonings, and cooking supplies needed to prepare the food.
interpret_scope: Assess ingredient condition and the food’s appearance, texture, aroma, and doneness against the intended preparation.
decide_scope: Determine cooking methods, timing, heat adjustments, seasoning, and preparation sequence needed to produce the dish.
act_scope: Prepare, cook, and finish food for service.

job_role_definition: Prepare and cook limited-menu fast food items safely and efficiently to fulfill customer orders.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive customer orders and retrieve and measure the ingredients, beverages, recipes, packaging, and workstation supplies needed to fulfill them.
interpret_scope: Determine order-specific preparation requirements and assess prepared items for required quality and quantity.
decide_scope: Prioritize concurrent orders and coordinate cooking activities and equipment use according to demand and menu information.
act_scope: Prepare, cook, package, and serve limited-menu food and beverages while operating equipment and maintaining clean, stocked, sanitary, and safe work areas.

job_role_definition: Prepare and serve large quantities of food in institutional and cafeteria settings while supporting safe, sanitary, and efficient kitchen operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and organize food, supplies, equipment-status information, menu and dietary requirements, portion counts, inventory data, and food-temperature readings needed for large-scale meal service.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, temperatures, stock condition, sanitation and equipment condition, food availability, and costs to establish safe and efficient production needs.
decide_scope: Set menus, production quantities, preparation approaches, food rotation and storage actions, and supply needs in accordance with dietary, nutritional, and operational requirements.
act_scope: Prepare, cook, bake, portion, and serve meals; requisition supplies; and maintain sanitary food storage, equipment, utensils, and kitchen work areas.

job_role_definition: Prepare and manage meals and related food service for private households according to employers’ preferences and dietary needs.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain employers’ meal preferences and dietary requirements, assess available provisions, and procure the food, supplies, and equipment needed for household meal service.
interpret_scope: Evaluate dietary, taste, occasion, and kitchen-inventory information to identify meal constraints, suitability, and preparation requirements.
decide_scope: Select menus, recipes, cuisines, special-diet preparations, and service arrangements for routine meals and household events.
act_scope: Operate and maintain the household kitchen; prepare, cook, package, store, present, and serve meals; and provide reheating instructions as needed.

job_role_definition: Prepare and cook restaurant dishes safely and consistently for service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and measure ingredients and inspect their condition, preparation areas, cooking progress, temperature, and doneness through observation and testing.
interpret_scope: Assess ingredient freshness, sanitation conditions, and whether foods are cooking evenly and have reached the required quality and doneness.
decide_scope: Select preparation methods, sequencing, seasoning, substitutions, heat settings, timing, and corrective adjustments needed for safe, consistent dishes.
act_scope: Store and rotate ingredients, maintain sanitary work areas, prepare and combine foods, regulate cooking processes, and portion, garnish, and deliver completed dishes for service.

job_role_definition: Prepare and cook made-to-order foods with short preparation times for customer service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive customer orders and requirements and assemble the stocked, properly rotated ingredients, supplies, and equipment needed for preparation.
interpret_scope: Determine the requested items, modifications, and current order status needed to coordinate preparation.
decide_scope: Sequence and time preparation so foods ordered together are ready for service at the same time.
act_scope: Prepare, cook, garnish, plate, and serve made-to-order foods within short service times while maintaining sanitary preparation equipment and work areas.

occupation_name: Cooling and Freezing Equipment Operators and Tenders
job_role_name: Cooling and Freezing Equipment Operators and Tenders
job_role_definition: Operate and tend cooling and freezing equipment to process products under specified conditions.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Measure, weigh, load, and sample product materials, and obtain operating readings on product condition and equipment controls required for cooling or freezing.
interpret_scope: Assess gauge readings, product consistency, mixture characteristics, and test results against specified processing conditions.
decide_scope: Determine the needed operating settings, process adjustments, or corrective response to maintain specified cooling or freezing conditions and product output.
act_scope: Set up, start, operate, adjust, clean, and clear cooling or freezing equipment to process, transfer, cool, freeze, and portion products under the specified conditions.

job_role_definition: Investigate deaths within a legal jurisdiction to determine and certify their cause and manner and fulfill associated medicolegal responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Conduct or direct scene and body examinations, autopsies, and analytical testing, and obtain, document, and preserve witness, medical, identity, kinship, property, and case-document evidence.
interpret_scope: Integrate examination, analytical, historical, testimonial, and documentary findings to establish identity and conclude the cause, manner, timing, and circumstances of death.
decide_scope: Select the findings to certify and the appropriate case, notification, custody, release, remains, property, interagency, and judicial dispositions.
act_scope: Certify deaths and finalize case records; arrange notifications, body transport and disposition, and release of effects; communicate findings to relatives and public authorities; and provide official testimony and judicial death certification.

job_role_definition: Maintain the custody, security, order, movement, and daily care of prisoners in correctional facilities and during transport.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe prisoner conduct and presence; inspect people, property, mail, vehicles, facilities, and safety conditions; verify identity and custody information; and document activities, incidents, and reported concerns.
interpret_scope: Assess observations, records, inspections, and inquiries to identify security, safety, conduct, health-care delivery, movement, and daily-care conditions requiring attention.
decide_scope: Determine appropriate custody responses, discipline or dispute resolution, movement and daily schedules, work assignments, access to authorized items, and incident or escape response priorities.
act_scope: Maintain custody, security, order, movement, and daily care by screening and guarding, searching, escorting and transporting, booking, restraining or recapturing when necessary, coordinating prisoner activities, providing authorized meals, medication, clothing, tools, and commissary items, and reporting or investigating significant occurrences.

job_role_definition: Manage incoming correspondence and prepare accurate written responses and related records for customer, account, billing, service, merchandise, and information requests.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain incoming correspondence, relevant account, billing, service, merchandise, and information records, and needed feasibility or cost details for each request.
interpret_scope: Determine the concern or request presented and assess the completeness and accuracy of the supporting information and applicable requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate disposition, including whether to answer, route, fulfill, seek payment, or take another responsive action.
act_scope: Prepare and quality-check accurate correspondence and required records, explain applicable rules, process authorized request outcomes, route or dispatch materials, and record correspondence and collected funds.

job_role_definition: Prepare and manage cost estimates to support pricing, bidding, planning, procurement, and cost control for products, projects, or services.
acquire_scope: Gather and verify project documentation, historical and current cost data, site conditions, resource requirements, supplier and subcontractor information, and stakeholder inputs needed for estimating and cost control.
interpret_scope: Analyze specifications, labor and material needs, production or purchase costs, market inputs, and actual-versus-bid performance to develop cost findings, standard cost data, and cost-effectiveness assessments.
decide_scope: Determine estimate assumptions and revisions, recommend cost-reduction or make-or-buy approaches, and select tendering and negotiation positions.
act_scope: Prepare, issue, update, and manage estimates, cost-monitoring and reporting procedures, tender activities, negotiations, and periodic cost and expenditure documentation for pricing, planning, procurement, and project control.

job_role_definition: Prepare, fit, maintain, manage, and assist performers with costumes and wardrobe needs for productions and performances.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather production, period, cast-fit, inventory, and wardrobe-supply information needed to prepare and manage costumes.
interpret_scope: Assess production requirements, available costume condition, performer fit, and onstage appearance to identify wardrobe needs and required adjustments.
decide_scope: Determine costume selections, alteration and construction needs, item allocation and sequencing, and wardrobe-work priorities for the production.
act_scope: Prepare, construct or arrange, issue, maintain, store, and return costumes and related wardrobe items, while assisting performers with dressing and changes during rehearsals and performances.

job_role_definition: Provide counseling services in specialties not separately classified within O*NET.
acquire_scope: Obtain clients' presenting concerns, histories, goals, circumstances, and other counseling-relevant information.
interpret_scope: Assess the meaning of clients' concerns and circumstances to formulate counseling-relevant understanding.
decide_scope: Select counseling goals, priorities, and an appropriate course of intervention for the specialty involved.
act_scope: Provide the selected counseling services to help clients address their identified concerns and goals.

job_role_definition: Receives customer orders for repairs and other counter services and processes the associated transactions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive customer orders and service requests by gathering customer details, examining and tagging articles, and obtaining relevant service, item, and pricing information.
