interpret_scope: Determine the requested service requirements, item condition, applicable charges, and information needed to explain appropriate use and care.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate service, rental, return, or product arrangement and any related recommendation for the customer's request.
act_scope: Process orders and associated transactions by arranging services or rentals, accepting returns and payments, preparing items for purchase or rental, and maintaining transaction records.

job_role_definition: Arranges rentals by advising customers, preparing equipment and documentation, and managing payments, returns, and reservations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer requests, rental requirements, identification and payment details, and current item availability and condition.
interpret_scope: Assess customer needs and item suitability, and explain relevant item operation, care, fees, policies, and procedures.
decide_scope: Select and recommend appropriate rental items, services, quantities, and reservation or equipment allocations.
act_scope: Prepare and adjust rental equipment, complete rental documentation, process payments, reservations, rentals, and returns, and provide the agreed rental service.

job_role_definition: Pick up, transport, and deliver messages, documents, packages, and other items to designated recipients.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive, pick up, and verify items and delivery instructions, including recipient details and any collection requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess item handling needs, recipient information, delivery instructions, and route conditions to identify handling constraints and delivery requirements.
decide_scope: Select delivery sequencing, transportation methods, handling precautions, and efficient routes for the assigned items.
act_scope: Load, transport, unload, deliver or communicate messages to designated recipients, obtain required acknowledgments or payments, document completion, and maintain delivery readiness.

job_role_definition: Creates verbatim records and official transcripts of legal and other proceedings.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Capture spoken proceedings verbatim and obtain clarification whenever speech is inaudible or uncertain.
interpret_scope: Compare captured proceedings and transcript text with source records and confirmed rulings to identify spelling, transcription, and accuracy issues.
decide_scope: Determine how to resolve ambiguities and discrepancies and which corrections are required for an accurate official record.
act_scope: Produce and format official transcripts, read back requested portions, provide or file completed transcripts, and retain the underlying proceeding notes.

job_role_definition: Converts spoken content into real-time or prepared text captions for people who are deaf or hard of hearing.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Capture spoken content as shorthand, stenotype, or equivalent symbolic notation.
interpret_scope: Convert captured notation into accurate, readable caption text while resolving contextual meaning and ambiguities.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate textual rendering when speech or captured notation permits multiple interpretations.
act_scope: Present completed captions to deaf or hard-of-hearing users in real time or prepared form.

job_role_definition: Maintains court records and filings, prepares judicial documents and calendars, and assists the public with court procedures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and retrieve court filings, case information, dispositions, orders, payment arrangements, and needed details from court participants.
interpret_scope: Review submitted legal documents and case information for compliance with applicable court procedures and identify the information needed for records, documents, and scheduling.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate filing disposition, document or order preparation, and case-calendar placement under established court procedures.
act_scope: Maintain official court records and filings; prepare and issue judicial documents, orders, dockets, and calendars; and provide the public and parties with procedural and appearance information.

job_role_definition: Processes license and permit applications, verifies applicant eligibility, issues credentials, and provides related public services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and record application details, supporting documents, required fees, and relevant license-record information from applicants and official sources.
interpret_scope: Evaluate application and record information for completeness, accuracy, document authenticity, and eligibility under licensing requirements.
decide_scope: Determine whether an application qualifies for the requested license or permit and its appropriate disposition.
act_scope: Enter application information, issue approved licenses or permits, collect fees, and provide the public with licensing procedures and regulatory guidance.

job_role_definition: Maintains municipal records and supports official meetings, legislative actions, elections, and local-government administration.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Assemble municipal records, fiscal and budget information, archival materials, correspondence, meeting materials, contract-bid submissions, and election inputs needed for official administration.
interpret_scope: Review, verify, edit, research, and reconcile official information to produce accurate minutes, records, responses, budget and contract materials, and election results.
decide_scope: Determine recordkeeping, filing, safekeeping, follow-up, and procedural dispositions needed to support meetings, legislative actions, contracts, elections, and municipal administration.
act_scope: Maintain and preserve official records; prepare, record, archive, distribute, and publicly notify official materials; respond to information requests; and administer required meeting, legislative, fiscal, contract, and election processes.

job_role_definition: Create handmade functional or decorative craft objects for sale or exhibition.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather customer requirements, sources of inspiration, and information about the characteristics and availability of candidate materials.
interpret_scope: Translate requirements, inspirations, and material properties into feasible design concepts and production considerations for the intended craft object.
decide_scope: Select the object concept, design, materials, dimensions, finishes, and production approach.
act_scope: Develop drawings or digital designs, patterns, and prototypes as needed, then hand-process, assemble, and finish materials to create the functional or decorative craft object.

job_role_definition: Operate cranes and related lifting equipment to safely lift, move, and place materials, machines, and products.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain load weights, lifting-capacity information, work schedules, loading instructions, and equipment and rigging condition observations needed for each lift.
interpret_scope: Assess load and equipment information to identify capacity limits, safe operating conditions, and the required lifting or delivery sequence.
decide_scope: Select the lift setup, operating sequence, equipment adjustments, and placement approach that safely meets the assigned movement requirements.
act_scope: Operate cranes and related lifting equipment to lift, move, load, unload, and place materials, while directing required setup assistance and maintaining lifting mechanisms and accessories.

job_role_definition: Analyze borrower financial and credit information to assess lending risk and support credit decisions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and verify borrower financial, credit, transaction, industry, and peer-comparison information needed to evaluate a lending request.
interpret_scope: Analyze financial statements, ratios, credit histories, management and market factors to assess borrower condition, repayment capacity, loan profitability, and lending risk.
decide_scope: Formulate the risk assessment and recommended credit disposition or loan terms for consideration in the credit decision.
act_scope: Prepare and submit completed loan applications, credit analyses, risk summaries, and reports that support lending decisions.

job_role_definition: Process and administer credit applications and customer credit accounts by verifying information, evaluating creditworthiness, maintaining records, and communicating account decisions.
acquire_scope: Receive credit applications, charge records, and account information; obtain applicant, reference, public-record, and credit-service data; and assemble customer payment and transaction records.
interpret_scope: Analyze verified credit and payment information to assess creditworthiness, reconcile account transactions, and identify delinquent accounts requiring attention.
decide_scope: Determine credit approval or other account dispositions under established standards, select delinquent accounts for collection, and establish resolutions for account issues.
act_scope: Administer customer credit accounts by recording charges and payments, preparing billing and account instruments, communicating reports and account decisions, and pursuing delinquent payments.

job_role_definition: Counsel clients on managing credit, debt, loans, budgets, and repayment obligations.
acquire_scope: Gather and review clients’ income, assets, debts, expenses, credit information, obligations, account activity, and changes in financial circumstances, including investigating payment-related discrepancies.
interpret_scope: Assess clients’ financial positions, calculate funds available for obligations, and estimate repayment timing and consequences under applicable credit, loan, and debt conditions.
decide_scope: Set repayment priorities and develop or revise budgets, debt-management plans, financial strategies, referrals, and educational resources suited to clients’ goals and circumstances.
act_scope: Deliver financial counseling and education, communicate recommendations and required information in writing or conversation, negotiate payment arrangements with creditors, and administer client payments when applicable.

job_role_definition: Counsel clients on obtaining or retaining housing through rental, mortgage, delinquency, and foreclosure assistance.
acquire_scope: Gather and update clients’ financial, credit, family, employment, and housing circumstances, and research relevant rental, mortgage, delinquency, foreclosure, loan, and community-resource options.
interpret_scope: Assess clients’ financial and housing situations to determine constraints, eligibility, risks, and the implications of available housing-finance options.
decide_scope: Develop or revise housing-retention or housing-obtainment strategies, including budgets, action plans, program pathways, educational resources, and referrals.
act_scope: Counsel clients by explaining applicable housing and loan information, communicating tailored recommendations and plans, and preparing the related written client communications or agreements.

job_role_definition: Operate crematory equipment and prepare, identify, handle, process, and transport human or animal remains in accordance with applicable requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain remains, retrieve identity, custody, and handling information, and create records needed to track divided remains.
interpret_scope: Verify identity and assess the documentation, condition of the remains, and applicable requirements to establish correct handling and processing needs.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate preparation, transport, equipment-use, and remains-disposition steps consistent with the verified information and requirements.
act_scope: Prepare, respectfully handle, and transport remains; remove and secure personal effects; operate crematory equipment; recover and process remains; clean the crematory facilities and equipment; and place processed remains in their designated container.

occupation_name: Criminal Justice and Law Enforcement Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: Criminal Justice and Law Enforcement Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary students in criminal justice, corrections, and law enforcement while supporting their academic development.
acquire_scope: Gather current criminal justice, corrections, and law-enforcement knowledge; select instructional resources; and collect student participation, performance, and academic-progress information.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student work, examinations, participation, and advising information to determine learning outcomes, academic needs, and areas requiring support.
decide_scope: Set and revise course content, instructional methods, assessment approaches, and academic or career guidance based on subject developments and student needs.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver instruction and discussions, administer and grade assessments, maintain required academic records, and provide students with academic-development support.

job_role_definition: Provide specialized nursing assessment, intervention, monitoring, coordination, and support for critically ill patients and their families.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient, family, and care-context inputs through clinical, pulmonary, pain, psychosocial, nutritional, and age-specific assessments; vital-sign, fluid, laboratory, specimen, device, and equipment-status monitoring.
interpret_scope: Analyze assessment, monitoring, and diagnostic information to identify deterioration, respiratory, fluid, nutritional, psychosocial, device, and treatment-response concerns, including patients’ and families’ support needs.
decide_scope: Set nursing-care priorities, determine intervention and escalation needs, and develop or revise individualized treatment and care plans with the care team.
act_scope: Deliver and coordinate specialized critical-care nursing, including therapies, medications and blood products, procedures and equipment setup, patient and family support and advocacy, care conferences, post-mortem care, and treatment documentation.

job_role_definition: Protects and guides pedestrians across streets and other crossings by monitoring and controlling traffic.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor vehicle and pedestrian flow, crossing conditions, hazards, and applicable traffic signs to obtain the inputs needed for safe crossing control.
interpret_scope: Assess traffic patterns, safe crossing gaps, and observed hazards or unsafe conduct to determine current crossing conditions.
decide_scope: Select when pedestrians may proceed and the appropriate traffic-control, warning, or safety response for the conditions.
act_scope: Protect and guide pedestrians by stopping, directing, and warning traffic, escorting crossings, and communicating crossing rules and safety information.

job_role_definition: Controls traffic and communicates hazards or routing information at construction sites and other temporary control points.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain the assigned traffic-control plan, control-point details, and signs or markers needed to manage the temporary site.
interpret_scope: Assess approaching traffic, pedestrian movement, hazards, and site conditions to understand safe routing needs.
decide_scope: Select the immediate traffic movements, warnings, detours, and control adjustments consistent with the routing plan and observed conditions.
act_scope: Position control devices and direct or warn drivers and pedestrians using signs, flags, lanterns, hand signals, and route information.

occupation_name: Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and maintain machinery that crushes, grinds, polishes, blends, or otherwise processes materials to production specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications; load, transfer, identify, and prepare materials and ingredients; and collect operational, measurement, inspection, and test inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess material and product conformance, process flow, equipment condition, safety, wear, and malfunctions against production requirements.
decide_scope: Determine whether to adjust processing conditions or equipment, reject nonconforming output, clear disruptions, or request needed repairs.
act_scope: Set up, operate, tend, regulate, clean, maintain, and troubleshoot processing and accessory equipment to produce materials to specification.

job_role_definition: Administer institutional collections by acquiring, documenting, preserving, interpreting, and making them available through exhibitions and public programs.
acquire_scope: Gather research, provenance, condition, composition, environmental, audience, and resource evidence by examining and testing objects, inspecting premises, and consulting collection records and relevant sources.
interpret_scope: Establish objects’ authenticity, origin, history, value, significance, and preservation needs, and develop collection-based interpretations for scholarly and public use.
decide_scope: Select acquisitions, loans, dispositions, preservation priorities, exhibition themes and designs, educational programming, insurance coverage, and collection operations within institutional policies and resources.
act_scope: Execute collection transactions; register, catalog, preserve, and provide access to holdings; develop and install exhibitions; deliver public programs; and administer collection staff and operations.

job_role_definition: Provides routine product and service assistance by answering customer inquiries, processing account or order requests, and resolving or routing general complaints.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather customer inquiries, requests, complaint details, and relevant account, order, billing, product, service, or policy records.
interpret_scope: Assess customer needs, applicable terms and charges, complaint validity or causes, transaction status, and whether issues can be resolved directly.
decide_scope: Choose the appropriate response or transaction, determine allowable complaint remedies, and identify when follow-up or referral is required.
act_scope: Fulfill routine requests by providing information and processing transactions, resolve or refer complaints, and document, communicate, and verify outcomes.

job_role_definition: Facilitate clients' lawful import and export of goods by managing customs compliance, clearance, duties, and related shipment arrangements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain shipment, product, origin, valuation, cargo-status, tariff, regulatory, and carrier information and the documentation required for customs transactions.
interpret_scope: Classify goods, determine applicable customs requirements and restrictions, calculate duties and taxes, and assess shipment compliance and available duty-relief options.
decide_scope: Select the compliant clearance approach and recommend duty, bond, insurance, packaging or labeling, routing, carrier, storage, distribution, appeal, and refund arrangements.
act_scope: Prepare, sign, submit, and process customs and related shipping documents; secure releases and clearance, coordinate with agencies and service providers, arrange payments and protections, and execute shipment arrangements.

job_role_definition: Inspect people, conveyances, and goods crossing U.S. borders and enforce applicable immigration and customs laws.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine travel and immigration documents, interview people, inspect people, conveyances, goods, baggage, and personal articles, collect merchandise samples, and investigate suspected violations and duty-refund applications.
interpret_scope: Assess eligibility for admission, residence, or travel; evaluate customs and revenue-law compliance and potential violations; calculate duties and taxes; and evaluate grounds for refunds or penalty relief.
decide_scope: Select admission, enforcement, refund, and penalty dispositions, including whether detention, seizure, or legal proceedings are warranted.
act_scope: Implement dispositions by detaining persons, seizing contraband and associated property, arranging or instituting legal proceedings, cooperating with other agencies, explaining applicable requirements, testifying, and recording and reporting findings, transactions, violations, and dispositions.

job_role_definition: Cut, trim, shape, and finish manufactured materials or products using hand, portable power, or bench-mounted tools to meet specified dimensions and quality standards.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Read work orders and assemble, position, measure, and lay out materials, templates, tools, and cutter settings for the specified work.
interpret_scope: Inspect materials and completed work against dimensional and quality requirements to identify defects and verify conformance.
decide_scope: Determine cut placement, equipment adjustments, and the disposition of nonconforming items to achieve required dimensions, yield, and finish.
act_scope: Cut, trim, shape, route, and finish manufactured materials or products to the specified dimensions and quality standards.

occupation_name: Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and maintain cutting or slicing machines to produce materials that meet specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job requirements and machine-ready stock, and gather dimensional, weight, quality, and operating-condition evidence from materials, products, and equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, measurements, product condition, and machine behavior to determine setup requirements, conformance, malfunctions, and supply needs.
decide_scope: Select machine components, setup settings, operating adjustments, and corrective dispositions needed to produce conforming material.
act_scope: Prepare stock; install, set up, start, feed, tend, adjust, clean, lubricate, and maintain cutting equipment; and remove, sort, and stage completed material.

occupation_name: Cutting, Punching, and Press Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Cutting, Punching, and Press Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut, punch, press, bend, straighten, or otherwise form metal or plastic materials to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications and materials, position workpieces, and collect dimensional, condition, and machine-operation readings.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, material properties, machine behavior, and finished-piece measurements and defects for conformance.
decide_scope: Determine operation sequences and select machine settings, tooling, fixtures, and process adjustments needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Set up, maintain, and run forming equipment; load and process material; and finish, identify, and sort completed workpieces.

job_role_definition: Perform cytogenetic laboratory testing and chromosome analysis to identify and report genetic abnormalities in biological specimens.
acquire_scope: Receive and document specimens, referral information, and controls, then culture, harvest, stain, image, and instrumentally process cells or DNA to produce analyzable chromosome, FISH, and array evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate specimen suitability and test validity, analyze chromosome, cell, FISH, and array evidence, and characterize genetic abnormalities using standardized cytogenetic nomenclature.
decide_scope: Select appropriate culture, preparation, storage, harvest timing, banding, and testing procedures and determine needed corrective or specimen-remediation steps.
act_scope: Document and communicate validated findings in finalized reports and carry out selected quality, corrective, or specimen-remediation actions.

job_role_definition: Prepare, examine, and report on cell specimens to identify abnormalities that may indicate cancer, hormonal disorders, or other pathological conditions.
acquire_scope: Verify patient and specimen information, assist with cell-sample collection, and prepare, stain, and maintain specimens and microscopy resources under required laboratory standards.
interpret_scope: Assess specimen quality and microscopically evaluate cellular and hormonal features to determine whether abnormal conditions are present.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate disposition of specimens and findings, including referral of abnormal slides for further pathological examination.
act_scope: Document and communicate clinical and microscopic findings, submitting abnormal specimens and information for pathology reporting.

job_role_definition: Perform rehearsed dance works in live, broadcast, or recorded productions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Learn assigned choreography and performance cues, receive musical and production inputs, and prepare the body, costume, and required dance equipment for rehearsals and performances.
interpret_scope: Translate choreography, rhythm, narrative intent, spatial relationships, and personal physical capacity into controlled movement requirements.
decide_scope: Select moment-to-moment movement adjustments and appropriate execution within the rehearsed work to maintain timing, coordination, expression, and physical safety.
act_scope: Rehearse and perform the assigned dance work, coordinating with partners or ensembles and expressing its intended rhythm, sound, and story in live, broadcast, or recorded productions.

job_role_definition: Enter and verify information from source documents while maintaining related records and materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, sort, and prepare source documents and required work materials, verifying input completeness and accuracy before entry.
interpret_scope: Compare entered information with source documents and resolve unclear content to identify discrepancies or errors.
decide_scope: Determine whether identified errors can be corrected or should be reported for resolution.
act_scope: Enter and correct information in the required fields, retain completed documents appropriately, and maintain associated activity records and materials.

job_role_definition: Transform data into validated analyses, models, visualizations, and recommendations that inform decisions and solve problems.
acquire_scope: Design data-collection instruments, select samples, and obtain, clean, and prepare the data required for analysis.
interpret_scope: Translate business problems and objectives into analytic questions, analyze data to identify relationships and trends, and assess factors, model performance, and predictive validity.
decide_scope: Select model features and analytical approaches, and formulate data-driven solutions and recommendations for the identified problem.
act_scope: Develop and refine analytical functions and models, and communicate validated analyses, visualizations, and recommendations to intended users.

job_role_definition: Design, implement, maintain, test, and support data warehouse systems that make organizational data usable and reliable.
acquire_scope: Elicit organizational requirements, obtain source schemas and data, and run reviews, checks, and tests to collect operational, quality, and diagnostic evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, source and warehouse data, mappings, system behavior, and quality evidence to derive technical implications, assess data quality, and diagnose defects.
decide_scope: Select the warehouse architecture, data models, mappings, standards, extraction and transformation approaches, business rules, optimization tradeoffs, and evaluation plans.
act_scope: Build, program, deploy, document, operate, and repair warehouse databases, data pipelines, metadata frameworks, and integrations to deliver usable, reliable organizational data.

job_role_definition: Administer, maintain, secure, and optimize organizational databases and database management systems.
acquire_scope: Gather operational requirements, documentation, technology information, and evidence about database performance, errors, security, access, workflows, and proposed changes through monitoring, review, and testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze operational evidence and requirements to diagnose database issues, assess security and performance needs, and determine the implications of proposed changes.
decide_scope: Select database configurations, access levels, security measures, standards, technologies, upgrade plans, and implementation priorities.
act_scope: Administer and modify database systems by implementing data models and definitions, configurations, security controls, upgrades, production environments, and error corrections.

job_role_definition: Design, integrate, govern, and optimize enterprise database architectures and data models to meet organizational requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather organizational and user requirements, project constraints, technology information, and database test and operating evidence needed to shape enterprise data architecture.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, data relationships, scalability, security, reliability, performance, compliance with development standards, and implementation effort to form architectural assessments.
decide_scope: Select database architectural strategies, data-model and integration approaches, standards, technologies, configurations, upgrade plans, and corrective priorities that meet organizational requirements.
act_scope: Design, document, implement, integrate, tune, and govern database architectures, schemas, structures, availability processes, and corrective database changes.

job_role_definition: Create public interest and encourage purchases by demonstrating, explaining, and promoting products or services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Research product, competitor, and audience information; gather customer questions and needs; and prepare the products, materials, incentives, and presentation area required for demonstrations.
interpret_scope: Assess prospective customers’ interest, qualifications, questions, and stated needs in relation to the products or services being promoted.
decide_scope: Select the product recommendations, audience-tailored presentation content, and persuasive information best suited to each customer or audience.
act_scope: Attract prospective customers and deliver demonstrations, explanations, product-use instruction, incentives, and sales through orderly in-person presentation activities.

job_role_definition: Support dentists by preparing patients and equipment, assisting with treatment, providing delegated clinical care, and performing related administrative duties.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient histories, vital signs, diagnostic images, impressions, and registrations, and assemble sterile instruments, materials, equipment, and supplies needed for dental services.
interpret_scope: Evaluate records, measurements, images, impressions, procedural observations, and supply status for completeness, usability, readiness, care-support needs, and urgent concerns.
decide_scope: Select and sequence preparations, chairside support, delegated-care techniques, patient guidance, and immediate emergency actions appropriate to the planned service and observed conditions.
act_scope: Prepare patients, assist during treatment and emergencies, perform delegated clinical care, produce and maintain casts, temporary restorations, and appliances, instruct patients, document delivered care, and maintain supply readiness.

job_role_definition: Provide preventive oral health care, assess oral conditions, maintain patient records, and educate patients on oral health maintenance.
acquire_scope: Obtain and review medical history, examine oral and related tissues, and capture radiographic and impression inputs needed for oral-condition assessment and preventive care.
interpret_scope: Assess examination, probing, lymph-node, radiographic, and history findings to identify and chart oral conditions, decay, disease indicators, and preventive-care needs.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate preventive-care approach, patient guidance, follow-up needs, and matters requiring dentist diagnosis or treatment.
act_scope: Deliver preventive oral care, including cleaning and cavity-preventing applications as needed, maintain accurate patient records, and educate individual patients and community groups on oral-health maintenance.

job_role_definition: Construct, alter, repair, finish, and verify custom dental prostheses and orthodontic appliances from prescriptions and dental impressions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain prescriptions, specifications, impressions, and materials; prepare and mount working mouth models; and test appliance dimensions, occlusion, and jaw movement.
interpret_scope: Assess the prescription, models, observations, and test results to establish functional, occlusal, and specification-conformance findings.
decide_scope: Select the product design, fabrication approach, and any alterations, repairs, or corrective adjustments needed.
act_scope: Construct, alter, repair, shape, bond, cure, solder, finish, and polish custom dental prostheses and orthodontic appliances.

job_role_definition: Provide specialized dental services not classified under separately listed dentist occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain specialized dental histories, examinations, imaging, and clinical measurements required to provide the indicated dental service.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical findings to characterize oral conditions and treatment needs within the specialty service.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate specialized dental treatment approach, priorities, and follow-up plan.
act_scope: Perform specialized dental procedures and deliver related patient care and instructions.

job_role_definition: Examines, diagnoses, prevents, and treats conditions of teeth, gums, and related oral structures through clinical procedures, appliances, medications, and patient guidance.
acquire_scope: Elicit patient concerns and history, examine the teeth, gums, bite, and related oral structures, and obtain diagnostic images and measurements.
interpret_scope: Evaluate examination findings and images to diagnose oral disease, injury, malformation, or functional problems and assess severity, causes, and treatment-relevant risks.
decide_scope: Select treatment priorities, procedures, appliances, medications, pain management, and preventive guidance appropriate to the diagnosed oral condition.
act_scope: Perform planned dental interventions and counsel patients, using appropriate pain management and infection controls to restore, protect, or maintain oral health.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and manage diseases and conditions of the skin, hair, and nails, including dermatologic procedures when indicated.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories, conduct skin examinations, and obtain or order diagnostic testing and biopsy specimens needed to evaluate skin, hair, and nail conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical findings and test or biopsy results to diagnose dermatologic diseases, lesions, and cosmetic-treatment eligibility.
decide_scope: Select appropriate monitoring, medication, therapy, procedure, preventive guidance, diagnostic follow-up, or specialist referral for each condition.
act_scope: Treat and manage dermatologic conditions through prescribing, procedures and surgery when indicated, patient counseling, and consultation with other health professionals.

job_role_definition: Rig and maintain derrick equipment and operate drilling-fluid systems to support oil and gas well drilling.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect derrick and hoisting equipment, monitor mud-pump and drilling-fluid-system condition, and obtain the materials and measurements needed to prepare drilling mud.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment integrity, pump-system abnormalities, and drilling-fluid viscosity and weight to determine operating condition.
decide_scope: Select fluid adjustments, equipment repair or maintenance needs, and safe crew work coordination for derrick and drilling-fluid operations.
act_scope: Rig, position, secure, maintain, and repair derrick and hoisting equipment; prepare and circulate drilling fluid; and physically guide and steady pipe during drilling connections.

job_role_definition: Create visual, functional, or experiential designs in designer specialties not separately classified.
acquire_scope: Obtain design requirements, constraints, reference information, and materials needed to create the specified visual, functional, or experiential design.
interpret_scope: Translate requirements and contextual inputs into an understanding of user needs, design objectives, and applicable aesthetic or functional considerations.
decide_scope: Select design concepts, specifications, and revisions that best address the identified objectives and constraints.
act_scope: Create and refine the visual, functional, or experiential design deliverable.

job_role_definition: Format text, graphics, and other publication elements into production-ready print or electronic materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain design instructions, feedback, text, graphics, photographs, digitized data, and required publication specifications from source files and collaborators.
interpret_scope: Assess instructions, work-in-progress displays, and preliminary and final proofs to identify layout requirements, production sequencing, and errors requiring correction.
decide_scope: Choose the arrangement of text and art and the typographic, spacing, color, separation, and output treatments that meet the design specifications.
act_scope: Create, revise, and finalize the publication by entering and positioning content, editing images and effects, preparing layouts, converting files, and delivering production-ready print or electronic materials.

job_role_definition: Investigate suspected violations of law by gathering and evaluating evidence, identifying suspects, developing cases, and supporting criminal proceedings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather, document, preserve, and verify scene, physical, interview, surveillance, laboratory, and record-based evidence and case information.
interpret_scope: Evaluate evidence, reports, records, and allegations to establish investigative issues, identify suspects and evidentiary links, and determine outstanding information needs.
decide_scope: Set the investigation’s scope, timing, direction, evidence needs, and the appropriate case, warrant, charging, and enforcement actions.
act_scope: Conduct and coordinate investigative operations, secure scenes and persons, process and route evidence, execute authorized warrants and arrests, prepare case materials, and support criminal proceedings through testimony.

job_role_definition: Produce and document diagnostic ultrasound images and technical findings for physicians while safely preparing and caring for patients.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient history and prior results, prepare the patient, equipment, and materials, and generate and record diagnostic ultrasound images and measurements while monitoring patient condition.
interpret_scope: Evaluate ultrasound appearances and image quality to distinguish relevant normal and abnormal findings and formulate technical findings.
decide_scope: Select imaging settings, patient positions, and views, determine whether to extend the examination, and choose images suitable for diagnostic use.
act_scope: Care for the patient and respond to clinical needs throughout the examination, then document and communicate the resulting images and technical findings to physicians.

job_role_definition: Assist dietitians in assessing, monitoring, coordinating, and educating individuals about nutritional care.
acquire_scope: Obtain dietary histories and monitor food intake, body weight, nutritional progress, and dietary problems, gathering relevant information from care discussions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate dietary and monitoring information to assess nutritional status, needs, progress, and emerging dietary concerns.
decide_scope: Determine appropriate diet or menu guidance, care-coordination priorities, and referrals within established nutritional guidelines.
act_scope: Assist in carrying out nutritional care by reporting findings, coordinating with the care team, guiding food selection and preparation, and educating individuals, families, and groups.

job_role_definition: Support the planning, production, supervision, and operational control of nutrition-focused food services.
acquire_scope: Gather nutrition requirements, established guidelines, recipe and menu data, food-service research, product-test results, and cost information needed to plan and control food service.
interpret_scope: Assess nutritional needs and analyze menus, recipes, products, quantities, and food-and-beverage costs to establish workable nutrition-focused service requirements.
decide_scope: Choose menus or diets, food selections and quantities, standardized recipes, staffing schedules, training arrangements, and cost-control measures consistent with those requirements.
act_scope: Prepare meals and carry out food-production, service-supervision, staff-orientation, and operational-control activities that deliver the nutrition-focused food service.

job_role_definition: Assess patients’ nutritional needs and provide individualized dietary care and counseling to promote health and manage disease.
education_most_common_level: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate - awarded for completion of an organized program of study; designed for people who have completed a Baccalaureate degree but do not meet the requirements of academic degrees carrying the title of Master.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient and family health, food, medication, allergy, exposure, laboratory, care-plan, restriction, and cultural or religious preference information through records and consultation.
interpret_scope: Assess nutritional status, needs, restrictions, and relevant laboratory findings to establish the patient-specific dietary care requirements.
decide_scope: Select individualized dietary-care plans, diet modifications, food choices, recipes or menus, and nutrition recommendations that address health and disease-management needs.
act_scope: Deliver dietary care and nutrition counseling to patients, families, and groups, and coordinate the counseling services needed to carry out the plan.

job_role_definition: Develop and deliver nutrition education and community programs that promote healthy eating and public health.
education_most_common_level: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate - awarded for completion of an organized program of study; designed for people who have completed a Baccalaureate degree but do not meet the requirements of academic degrees carrying the title of Master.
acquire_scope: Obtain community nutrition needs, health-promotion requirements, and the evidence and instructional inputs needed to design education and nutrition programs.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to identify nutrition priorities, learning needs, and appropriate healthy-eating guidance for individuals, groups, and community programs.
decide_scope: Select program objectives, curricula, teaching methods, nutrition-program policies, and recommendations to promote health and disease control.
act_scope: Develop educational materials and program policies, and deliver nutrition counseling, community education, and training programs.

job_role_definition: Plan, manage, and evaluate food service operations that provide safe, nutritious meals meeting dietary and organizational requirements.
education_most_common_level: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate - awarded for completion of an organized program of study; designed for people who have completed a Baccalaureate degree but do not meet the requirements of academic degrees carrying the title of Master.
acquire_scope: Obtain dietary, organizational, food-safety, sanitation, quality, budgetary, and operational inputs, including observations of meals and food-service performance.
interpret_scope: Assess menus, recipes, meals, products, equipment, and service operations for nutritional adequacy, prescribed-diet conformity, safety, quality, palatability, and operational needs.
decide_scope: Select menus, standardized recipes, special-meal approaches, purchasing, staffing, budgets, policies, and operational improvements that meet dietary and organizational requirements.
act_scope: Plan, manage, monitor, and evaluate food-service operations; develop and implement menus and special meals; procure supplies; and train and supervise meal-service staff.

job_role_definition: Conduct nutrition research and communicate findings that advance nutritional knowledge and practice.
education_most_common_level: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate - awarded for completion of an organized program of study; designed for people who have completed a Baccalaureate degree but do not meet the requirements of academic degrees carrying the title of Master.
acquire_scope: Conduct dietary, nutritional, epidemiological, and nutrigenomic or nutrigenetic studies to generate and assemble research data and other required inputs.
interpret_scope: Analyze and evaluate study evidence to derive findings, conclusions, and implications for nutritional knowledge and practice.
decide_scope: Select research questions, study designs, analytical approaches, and priorities for communicating results.
act_scope: Document and communicate research findings through reports and publications.

job_role_definition: Investigate computer-related crimes and security incidents by preserving, analyzing, and presenting digital evidence to support legal proceedings and vulnerability mitigation.
acquire_scope: Preserve, image, duplicate, recover, decrypt, and securely maintain digital evidence and relevant system, network, and log data for examination.
interpret_scope: Examine digital media, files, systems, traffic, and security information to establish forensic findings, intrusion indicators, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and attributable activity.
decide_scope: Set investigation approaches and determine evidence-handling and cyber-defense recommendations responsive to the findings.
act_scope: Deliver admissible forensic results and mitigation guidance through technical reports, legal documentation, affidavits, depositions, and findings summaries.

occupation_name: Dining Room and Cafeteria Attendants and Bartender Helpers
job_role_definition: Support bar operations by stocking beverages and equipment, cleaning barware, and preparing drink ingredients and garnishes.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Retrieve beverages, barware, drink ingredients, and fruit supplies needed to maintain bar readiness.
interpret_scope: NA — the role does not require a distinct transformation of inputs into task-relevant conclusions.
decide_scope: NA — the role does not require selecting a separate operational course of action.
act_scope: Stock refrigerated beverages and replace kegs, wash serving equipment, and prepare mixed-drink flavors and fruit garnishes for bar service.

occupation_name: Dining Room and Cafeteria Attendants and Bartender Helpers
job_role_definition: Facilitate dining service by assisting patrons and preparing, stocking, clearing, and cleaning dining and cafeteria areas.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe patron requests and the condition, availability, and supply levels of dining and cafeteria areas, and obtain the needed service items.
interpret_scope: Assess patron needs and identify seating, replenishment, clearing, cleaning, or spill-response requirements from observed conditions.
decide_scope: Prioritize patron assistance and select the immediate service, stocking, clearing, or cleaning response needed to keep dining operations orderly.
act_scope: Facilitate dining service by greeting and seating patrons, processing payments, serving and transporting food and tableware, preparing and replenishing service areas, and clearing and cleaning dining spaces.

job_role_definition: Coordinate and direct religious education, congregational activity, and outreach programs for a denominational group.
acquire_scope: Gather participation, congregational-emphasis, financial, volunteer, and community information, and obtain program ideas, curricula, materials, and other resources for education, congregational, and outreach work.
interpret_scope: Assess participation and congregational needs and analyze revenue and program-cost information to determine educational and program requirements.
decide_scope: Set program goals and budget priorities, choose curricula and class structures, and determine plans for educational offerings, events, fundraising, outreach, and participation-building.
act_scope: Coordinate and direct religious education, congregational activities, and outreach by developing courses, recruiting and supervising workers, arranging and publicizing programs, distributing resources, counseling and informing members, and leading denominational and public-facing activities.

job_role_definition: Play and mix prerecorded music to provide entertainment for live event audiences.
acquire_scope: Gather event requirements, guest music requests, music-library options, and venue sound-check information needed to prepare the performance.
interpret_scope: Assess music suitability, venue audio conditions, and audience preferences and mood to determine their implications for the event.
decide_scope: Choose and sequence the music and performance timing to fit event functions, schedules, and the evolving audience response.
act_scope: Set up and operate the audio equipment and play, mix, cut, and sample prerecorded music to entertain the live audience.

job_role_definition: Clean and maintain dishes, utensils, kitchen equipment, and related kitchen work areas.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect dirty dishes, utensils, cookware, and equipment, and obtain the cleaning materials needed for kitchen sanitation and upkeep.
interpret_scope: Assess the cleanliness, condition, and handling requirements of items and work areas, including classifying them for cleaning, storage, or disposal.
decide_scope: Select cleaning methods and prioritize sanitation, storage, and waste-removal work according to operational needs and safe handling requirements.
act_scope: Wash and sanitize dishes, utensils, cookware, equipment, and related kitchen areas; store clean items in their proper locations; and remove waste.

occupation_name: Dispatchers, Except Police, Fire, and Ambulance
job_role_name: Dispatchers, Except Police, Fire, and Ambulance
job_role_definition: Coordinate and dispatch personnel, vehicles, equipment, and field services to meet customer and operational needs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive customer service requests and work orders, maintain dispatch records, and monitor personnel, equipment, service conditions, and field hazards.
interpret_scope: Assess requests, specifications, locations, utilization, service disruptions, and hazards to identify operational requirements and constraints.
decide_scope: Set work and run schedules, prioritize service needs, determine required personnel and resources, and select assignments or service-recovery arrangements.
act_scope: Dispatch personnel, vehicles, and equipment; relay work orders, updates, and hazard information; coordinate communications; and arrange necessary repairs.

job_role_definition: Implement and administer enterprise document management systems that securely capture, organize, control, retrieve, and distribute electronic documents and records.
acquire_scope: Gather departmental requirements, regulatory and security information, system-performance evidence, and electronic documents or repository assets needed to operate the document-management environment.
interpret_scope: Classify content and evaluate requirements, compliance conditions, access issues, testing results, and system performance to determine their operational meaning.
decide_scope: Set or recommend document policies, taxonomies, access and workflow designs, testing approaches, system changes, and improvements to meet secure records-management needs.
act_scope: Implement, configure, test, and administer document-management systems by capturing and organizing documents, maintaining controlled access and revisions, processing official changes, monitoring security, retrieving and distributing content, and supporting users.

occupation_name: Door-to-Door Sales Workers, News and Street Vendors, and Related Workers
job_role_name: Door-to-Door Sales Workers, News and Street Vendors, and Related Workers
job_role_definition: Sell goods or services directly to customers through door-to-door, street, stand, or party-based channels.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Develop prospect lists and obtain and assemble the merchandise, supplies, samples, literature, and display stock needed for direct selling.
interpret_scope: Assess customer questions and responses to determine their interests and relate them to product features, benefits, prices, and uses.
decide_scope: Select prospective contacts, selling locations or party arrangements, merchandise presentations, and responses suited to each customer interaction.
act_scope: Travel to or circulate among customers, arrange and set up selling events or stands, present and demonstrate offerings, answer questions, distribute materials, solicit purchases, record orders, deliver merchandise, and collect payment.

job_role_definition: Prepare technical drawings and related design documentation for drafting specialties not separately classified.
acquire_scope: Obtain design requirements, reference materials, specifications, dimensions, and applicable drafting standards needed to prepare technical drawings and related documentation.
interpret_scope: Translate requirements, technical information, and spatial or dimensional relationships into accurate drawing content and documentation details.
decide_scope: Select suitable drafting conventions, views, layouts, detail levels, and documentation organization to communicate the design clearly and consistently.
act_scope: Produce and revise technical drawings and related design documentation for drafting specialties not separately classified.

job_role_definition: Operate dredging equipment to excavate and remove materials from waterways while maintaining the dredge's position and operating systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain excavation-depth readings and operating-condition inputs from depth gauges, anchor-pole checks, and dredge equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess depth readings and equipment conditions to determine excavation progress and dredge operating status.
decide_scope: Select the dredge-positioning, excavation-control, and operating adjustments needed to continue the work.
act_scope: Operate engines, pumps, winches, booms, cutterheads, cables, anchors, and associated piping to excavate material, maintain position, and keep systems functioning.

occupation_name: Drilling and Boring Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Drilling and Boring Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, or tend drilling and boring machine tools to machine metal or plastic workpieces to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain machining instructions and specifications, and generate layout, alignment, zero-reference, machine-operation, and dimensional inputs through observation, inspection, and measurement.
interpret_scope: Translate instructions and gathered evidence into dimensional, finish, sequence, setup, and tooling requirements and assessments of operating problems and workpiece conformance.
decide_scope: Select cutting tools, machining parameters, setup methods, operation sequences, and any needed tool, coolant, or process adjustments.
act_scope: Load and secure workpieces, install and maintain tools, configure references and controls, manage coolant, and operate drilling, boring, or tracing equipment to produce specified features and contours.

job_role_definition: Drive established routes to deliver or sell goods while servicing customer accounts and related equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Review route and customer-account information, receive customer orders and complaints, inspect goods and related equipment, and load the truck with needed merchandise and supplies.
interpret_scope: Assess customer needs, account conditions, equipment status, and merchandise suitability from route observations and customer interactions.
decide_scope: Select sales, promotional, replenishment, removal, maintenance, and complaint-resolution actions for each customer account.
act_scope: Drive established routes to deliver and sell goods, inform customers and resolve complaints, process payments and transaction records, arrange promotions, and refill, clean, and maintain related equipment while removing aged merchandise.

job_role_definition: Install suspended or directly mounted acoustical and decorative tile systems on ceilings and walls.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain installation specifications and take surface, fixture, and level measurements needed to prepare the tile-system installation.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, layout measurements, and mounting-surface conditions to determine fit, alignment, and installation requirements.
decide_scope: Select the installation method, work sequence, layout, and required material and tool use for the specified ceiling or wall system.
act_scope: Prepare mounting surfaces and supports; cut framing and tiles to fit; and install, align, secure, and seal suspended or directly mounted acoustical or decorative tile systems.

job_role_definition: Install drywall wall and ceiling systems, including supporting framing, to form interior surfaces.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain installation specifications and generate site measurements, layout marks, and level/plumb condition checks for the framing and interior-surface work.
interpret_scope: Translate specifications and measured site conditions into required dimensions, locations, clearances, and framing and panel-fit requirements.
decide_scope: Select the installation methods, work sequence, and materials or tools suited to the specified wall and ceiling system and site conditions.
act_scope: Prepare applicable existing surfaces; cut, assemble, and install framing, insulation barriers, trim, and drywall; form fixture openings, fasten and position panels, and trim joints to create the interior wall and ceiling surfaces.

job_role_definition: Install lath backing systems that provide a support base for plaster, fireproofing, or acoustical materials.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect and measure the structural framework and surface conditions, and assemble the required lath and fastening materials.
interpret_scope: Assess the framework, exposure conditions, surface geometry, and intended application to determine the backing-system requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate lath type, layout, and fastening approach for the required support base.
act_scope: Install and securely fasten metal or rockboard lath to walls, ceilings, or partitions to form the backing system.

occupation_name: Earth Drillers, Except Oil and Gas
job_role_definition: Drills and bores holes for construction, anchoring, grouting, foundation, and controlled-blasting operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain site requirements, proposed bore locations, rock or soil conditions, depth and alignment measurements, and ongoing equipment and drilling-condition readings.
interpret_scope: Assess site feasibility, geological and drilling conditions, and measurement results to determine hole requirements and operating implications.
decide_scope: Select drill and tooling, drill-and-blast layout, boring positions, operating settings, and any needed equipment or drilling adjustments.
act_scope: Mobilize, set up, stabilize, operate, flush, and adjust drilling equipment to drill or bore the specified construction, anchoring, grouting, foundation, and controlled-blasting holes, maintaining and recovering equipment as needed.

occupation_name: Earth Drillers, Except Oil and Gas
job_role_definition: Drills boreholes and recovers subsurface samples and geological information for exploration, testing, and environmental assessment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain site requirements and location information, verify borehole positions and depths, monitor drilling indicators, and collect core samples and observed formation data.
interpret_scope: Assess subsurface strata, ground conditions, equipment signals, and site constraints to determine drilling conditions and feasibility.
decide_scope: Select the drilling method, rig configuration, bits, operating settings, and any needed changes to equipment or drilling approach.
act_scope: Mobilize, set up, stabilize, operate, maintain, and adjust drilling equipment to complete boreholes, manage cuttings and cooling fluids, recover samples, and document drilling and geological results.

occupation_name: Earth Drillers, Except Oil and Gas
job_role_definition: Drills, develops, tests, and equips wells to provide usable groundwater access and pumping capability.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain site and client requirements, verify proposed bore locations, and gather drilling, geological, alignment, depth, equipment-condition, and pumping-test observations needed to produce a functioning well.
interpret_scope: Assess subsurface and drilling conditions, site feasibility, equipment status, and test results to determine formation characteristics and well performance.
decide_scope: Select the drilling method, tools, operating adjustments, bore disposition, and pumping-system configuration appropriate to the assessed conditions.
act_scope: Mobilize, set up, maintain, and operate drilling equipment to drill and develop the well, manage cuttings and borehole contingencies, install or fabricate casings, screens, pumps, and fixtures, and clean, rehabilitate, and prepare the completed water system for use.

job_role_definition: Teach economics courses in postsecondary institutions while supporting student learning and, where applicable, contributing scholarly research and academic service.
acquire_scope: Assemble economics course resources, obtain evidence of student learning through coursework and examinations, stay current with disciplinary literature, and gather scholarly sources and data for research.
interpret_scope: Assess student performance and needs, evaluate the effectiveness and currency of course content and instruction, and analyze research evidence to develop economic findings.
decide_scope: Set and revise course designs, instructional and assessment approaches, student guidance, research directions, and applicable academic-service priorities.
act_scope: Prepare course materials, deliver economics instruction and discussions, advise and supervise students, record academic results, publish scholarly findings, and carry out applicable departmental and institutional service.

job_role_definition: Research and analyze economic conditions, markets, and policies to develop forecasts, advice, recommendations, and reports.
acquire_scope: Obtain and compile economic, statistical, market, policy, resource, and documentary evidence relevant to the analysis.
interpret_scope: Analyze evidence with economic, mathematical, and statistical methods to explain conditions and estimate market, policy, litigation, and resource effects.
decide_scope: Formulate forecasts, economic advice, policy positions, guidelines, and recommendations to address economic questions or problems.
act_scope: Deliver the resulting forecasts, advice, recommendations, and research findings through reports, articles, consultations, public explanations, and testimony.

job_role_definition: Plan, coordinate, evaluate, revise, and prepare written material and publications for release.
acquire_scope: Gather submitted copy, news and reference materials, source information, proofs, and production requirements for publications.
interpret_scope: Evaluate content, audience relevance, factual accuracy, editorial quality, and proof errors to determine what revision or treatment is needed.
decide_scope: Set publication content, assignments, acceptance or revision recommendations, story emphasis and placement, and production priorities within editorial, deadline, and budget requirements.
act_scope: Write, revise, edit, approve, coordinate, and prepare copy, layouts, artwork, typesetting, and production work for publication release.

job_role_definition: Administer educational programs or functions not classified under another education administrator occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain program needs, requirements, resources, and operating information for the educational programs or functions administered.
interpret_scope: Assess that information to determine program status, needs, constraints, and implications.
decide_scope: Select priorities, plans, resource use, and administrative actions for the programs or functions.
act_scope: Administer the selected plans and actions to operate and deliver the educational programs or functions.

job_role_definition: Lead district-wide educational systems by establishing policy, coordinating programs and resources across schools, and supporting school administrators.
acquire_scope: Gather district performance, enrollment, attendance, personnel, financial, regulatory, facility, service, curriculum, and stakeholder information needed to guide educational systems.
interpret_scope: Assess educational programs, teaching practices, student outcomes, compliance requirements, and projected needs to identify effectiveness, gaps, and improvement priorities.
decide_scope: Set district standards, goals, policies, program changes, improvement plans, staffing actions, resource allocations, and facility or service priorities.
act_scope: Lead and coordinate implementation of district programs, personnel development and support, school operations, resources, compliance measures, and cross-school services.

job_role_definition: Lead an individual kindergarten through secondary school’s instructional programs, personnel, student services, operations, and community relationships.
acquire_scope: Gather student, instructional, personnel, operational, financial, compliance, and community information through records, observations, stakeholder conferences, and external-agency engagement.
interpret_scope: Assess student needs and performance, teaching and program effectiveness, staffing and facility requirements, and regulatory or safety implications.
decide_scope: Set school standards, goals, policies, improvement priorities, program changes, personnel actions, resource allocations, and partnership or facility recommendations.
act_scope: Lead and coordinate instructional programs, staff development and supervision, student services and discipline, school operations and activities, compliance measures, and community relationships.

job_role_definition: Lead institutional or academic-unit operations and oversee the delivery and quality of postsecondary education.
acquire_scope: Gather learning-outcome, operational, demographic, financial, personnel, curriculum, scheduling, and regulatory information needed to run the institution or academic unit.
interpret_scope: Assess educational quality, personnel performance, resource use, institutional conditions, and compliance requirements to identify needs and opportunities.
decide_scope: Set strategy, policies, budgets, staffing, curriculum, schedules, and improvement priorities for institutional and academic-unit operations.
act_scope: Lead personnel and operations, implement approved plans and academic arrangements, support educational delivery, maintain required reporting and compliance, and represent the institution.

job_role_definition: Build external support for the institution through promotion, partnerships, fundraising, alumni engagement, and funding development.
acquire_scope: Assemble research, operational, demographic, financial, funding-opportunity, and stakeholder information needed to build and manage external support.
interpret_scope: Assess stakeholder needs, funding opportunities, financial performance, operational evidence, and advancement activity results to identify implications for institutional support.
decide_scope: Set advancement priorities, partnership and fundraising approaches, budgets, staffing direction, and operating policies based on those assessments.
act_scope: Promote the institution, cultivate partnerships and alumni engagement, lead fundraising and grant development, oversee funded work, and direct the advancement operation.

job_role_definition: Direct enrollment and student-support services that facilitate access, progression, conduct, financial assistance, and campus participation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble applications, student records, registration and demographic data, misconduct reports, financial-aid and budget information, service-performance evidence, and stakeholder input needed to direct enrollment and student-support services.
interpret_scope: Assess student progress and needs, admission and aid eligibility, conduct information, registration trends, financial position, and service performance to identify implications for access, progression, support, and operations.
decide_scope: Select admission recommendations, aid recipients and distributions, responses to student conduct, staffing and budget allocations, service priorities, and enrollment, credit, and operating policies.
act_scope: Direct admissions, registration, career, financial-assistance, conduct, advising, and campus-participation services; counsel students, distribute aid, manage personnel and budgets, and carry out institutional coordination, outreach, and reporting.

job_role_definition: Teach and support postsecondary students in education-related subjects while contributing to academic program and scholarly responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Gather current disciplinary evidence, student work and progress information, instructional resources, and research data needed for teaching, advising, curriculum, and scholarly responsibilities.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and developmental needs, evaluate educational evidence and research findings, and derive conclusions from scholarly inquiry.
decide_scope: Set course content, instructional and assessment approaches, academic and career guidance, research directions, and revisions to curricula or teaching methods.
act_scope: Deliver instruction and learning discussions, provide student advising and supervision, communicate assessment outcomes, publish scholarly findings, and contribute to academic-program responsibilities.

occupation_name: Education and Childcare Administrators, Preschool and Daycare
job_role_name: Education and Childcare Administrators, Preschool and Daycare
job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate the educational and operational activities of preschool and childcare programs.
acquire_scope: Obtain program, child-progress, staffing, attendance, financial, regulatory, and community-demand information needed to operate preschool and childcare services.
interpret_scope: Assess child and program performance, enrollment needs, resource requirements, and regulatory obligations to identify operational and educational needs.
decide_scope: Set educational goals, policies, program offerings, instructional direction, staffing actions, funding allocations, and changes needed for compliant program delivery.
act_scope: Direct staff and program operations, implement educational and safety procedures, maintain required records and communications, and prepare requests for program funding.

occupation_name: Educational Instruction and Library Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Educational Instruction and Library Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Performs educational instruction or library work not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Gather learner, patron, collection, and subject-matter inputs needed to provide the applicable educational instruction or library service.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to determine instructional needs, information needs, or appropriate use of library resources.
decide_scope: Select the instructional approach, information guidance, or library-work course of action suited to the identified need.
act_scope: Deliver the applicable educational instruction or library service, including providing guidance and carrying out the selected work.

occupation_name: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
job_role_definition: Provides career and employment counseling that helps clients assess options, overcome barriers, develop vocational skills, and access education, services, and work opportunities.
acquire_scope: Gather clients’ employment and education histories, goals, interests, abilities, circumstances, and relevant occupational, training, service, and opportunity information.
interpret_scope: Evaluate client characteristics, assessment results, barriers, and occupational or educational information to identify vocational needs and feasible pathways.
decide_scope: Set counseling priorities and formulate career or employment plans, selecting suitable skill-building, education, support-service, referral, and placement options.
act_scope: Counsel and instruct clients, deliver career programs, connect them with education, support, and employment opportunities, and follow up on progress and unmet needs.

occupation_name: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
job_role_definition: Counsels and advises students on academic, career, and personal or social concerns through crisis support, guidance programs, referrals, and transition planning.
acquire_scope: Gather student concerns, goals, records, assessments, observations, and stakeholder input, together with information about educational, career, financial-aid, and support options.
interpret_scope: Assess students’ abilities, interests, progress, adjustment, and personal or behavioral barriers, identifying safety risks, unmet requirements, and additional support needs.
decide_scope: Select counseling priorities, educational or career plans, crisis responses, suitable programs and resources, and referrals or follow-up based on each student’s needs.
act_scope: Counsel students individually or in groups, deliver crisis and preventive guidance, support educational and career transitions, coordinate referrals, and monitor progress.

occupation_name: Electric Motor, Power Tool, and Related Repairers
job_role_name: Electric Motor, Power Tool, and Related Repairers
job_role_definition: Repair, maintain, or install electric motors, wiring, switches, power tools, and related electrical equipment.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain repair requirements from work orders, schematics, and service guides, and inspect, measure, and test motors, tools, wiring, switches, batteries, and related equipment for condition and performance.
interpret_scope: Diagnose faults, worn components, connection defects, overheating, and performance deviations from the inspection and test results.
