decide_scope: Determine the required repair, maintenance, adjustment, replacement, rewiring, rebuilding, installation, or battery-service work and the parts and specifications needed.
act_scope: Disassemble, lift, clean, machine, repair, rebuild, rewire, insulate, solder, assemble, align, lubricate, adjust, install, and configure electrical equipment and its components to restore specified operation.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, test, and oversee implementation of electrical equipment, components, and systems that meet technical, safety, cost, and customer requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements, site and operating data, stakeholder input, supplier-product information, and evidence from tests, inspections, surveys, and field observations needed to engineer electrical equipment, components, and systems.
interpret_scope: Analyze electrical-system data, calculations, complaints, and observed or measured results to identify performance, cost, efficiency, safety, and conformance findings.
decide_scope: Select design configurations, engineering standards, research approaches, materials and equipment specifications, corrective measures, project priorities, and implementation plans that satisfy technical, safety, cost, and customer requirements.
act_scope: Design, develop, document, and oversee the manufacture, construction, installation, integration, maintenance, and improvement of electrical equipment, components, and systems, including renewable-energy and control-system applications.

job_role_definition: Install, inspect, maintain, and repair electrical power transmission and distribution lines and associated equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain site conditions, equipment status, line clearances, electrical measurements, conductor identification, diagrams, specifications, and required materials for transmission and distribution line work.
interpret_scope: Evaluate inspections, tests, diagrams, and observed conditions to identify faults, defective equipment, connection requirements, insulation adequacy, and electrical or work-area hazards.
decide_scope: Determine safe isolation, grounding, access, work sequencing, crew coordination, and the repair, maintenance, or installation approach needed for the identified conditions.
act_scope: Safely isolate and access work areas and install, maintain, repair, connect, splice, protect, tension, replace, and position power lines, poles, cables, service equipment, and associated transmission and distribution components.

occupation_name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
job_role_name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
job_role_definition: Apply electrical and electronic engineering knowledge under engineering direction to design, build, test, maintain, modify, document, and support electrical and electronic equipment and systems.
acquire_scope: Obtain engineering instructions, requirements, diagrams, standards, components, operational records, and diagnostic measurements from equipment tests and inspections needed to design, build, support, and maintain electrical and electronic equipment and systems.
interpret_scope: Assess plans, specifications, codes, test results, equipment performance, malfunctions, and maintenance criteria to determine compliance, condition, functional deviations, and design-related issues.
decide_scope: Select components, repair or corrective actions, design or criteria revisions, configurations, quality procedures, and resource plans that meet functional specifications under engineering direction.
act_scope: Produce and maintain schematics, specifications, and work records; assemble, integrate, install, modify, maintain, and repair electrical and electronic equipment and systems; and provide engineering support, coordinate quality activities, and instruct operators.

job_role_definition: Assemble, modify, inspect, and prepare electrical or electronic equipment and components according to specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain required components, retrieve applicable specifications, drawings, and work orders, and inspect, test, or measure assemblies and circuits to generate conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Translate technical instructions and test observations into assembly requirements, operational assessments, and identification of defects or deviations.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate work sequence and corrective adjustment, repair, or component replacement needed to meet specifications and resolve production issues.
act_scope: Fabricate, clean, position, assemble, wire, install, adjust, repair, or replace electrical or electronic equipment and components to produce the specified finished condition.

job_role_definition: Prepare electrical-system drawings, wiring documentation, and layouts for installation, construction, maintenance, or repair.
acquire_scope: Gather project requirements, existing-facility information, site measurements, specifications, standards, and relevant design records for the electrical installation.
interpret_scope: Assess service needs, design concepts, dimensions, calculations, and compliance requirements to define accurate electrical drawing content.
decide_scope: Determine the detailed system layout, drawing approach, work sequence, and design adjustments needed to resolve project issues.
act_scope: Prepare, check, package, reproduce, and communicate electrical-system drawings, wiring documentation, connection specifications, and installation layouts.

job_role_definition: Prepare electronic schematics, printed-circuit-board layouts, and production drawings for fabrication, assembly, and testing.
acquire_scope: Retrieve project files, work orders, schematics, blueprints, specifications, and customer requirements, and obtain clarifications from engineering, vendor, and assembly personnel.
interpret_scope: Derive and verify drafting data by analyzing circuitry, component configurations, dimensions, tolerances, conductor paths, test requirements, and discrepancies in the design information.
decide_scope: Set the work sequence and drawing presentation method and determine required design modifications, layout conversions, and test-fixture details.
act_scope: Prepare, revise, package, reproduce, and communicate electronic schematics, printed-circuit-board layouts, fabrication and assembly drawings, and testing layouts or outputs for production use.

occupation_name: Electrical and Electronics Installers and Repairers, Transportation Equipment
job_role_name: Electrical and Electronics Installers and Repairers, Transportation Equipment
job_role_definition: Install, diagnose, repair, and maintain electrical and electronic systems and components on transportation equipment.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain malfunction descriptions, inspect and test transportation electrical and electronic systems, consult schematics and specifications, and gather the measurements and replacement materials needed for installation, diagnosis, repair, and maintenance.
interpret_scope: Analyze inspection, test, and schematic information to identify faults, determine system condition, and establish the parts and labor requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate repair, replacement, adjustment, installation, or maintenance approach and prepare the corresponding repair estimate.
act_scope: Install, modify, repair, rebuild, connect, and secure electrical and electronic components and wiring on transportation equipment, then reassemble and verify the completed work.

occupation_name: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Commercial and Industrial Equipment
job_role_name: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Commercial and Industrial Equipment
job_role_definition: Repair, test, adjust, install, and maintain commercial and industrial electrical and electronic equipment.
acquire_scope: Obtain service requirements and technical specifications, inspect and operate equipment, and gather diagnostic and functional-test readings on equipment and components.
interpret_scope: Analyze observations, test results, and operating information to identify malfunctions, defects, contributing causes, and required performance conditions.
decide_scope: Select the repair, adjustment, maintenance, calibration, installation, modification, or referral approach needed to restore, sustain, or extend proper equipment operation.
act_scope: Perform preventive maintenance and implement repairs, parts replacement, adjustments, calibration, setup, modification, installation, or referral of commercial and industrial electrical and electronic equipment.

occupation_name: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse, Substation, and Relay
job_role_name: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse, Substation, and Relay
job_role_definition: Inspect, test, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair electrical equipment and control systems in generating stations, substations, and in-service relay installations.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect equipment, circuits, cables, insulation, oil, and control systems; perform electrical and signal tests; and consult schematics, manuals, and technical personnel to assemble condition and fault evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze measurements, test results, diagrams, and system behavior to diagnose defects, assess performance and modification effects, and identify the sources of equipment or control-system problems.
decide_scope: Select the needed isolation, adjustment, maintenance, repair, replacement, or control-system corrective approach to restore safe and effective operation.
act_scope: Isolate defective equipment; construct and maintain relay and control systems; perform cleaning, adjustments, repairs, component replacements, cable work, and oil servicing; and communicate shutdowns and document completed work.

job_role_definition: Installs, maintains, tests, and repairs electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures so systems operate safely and conform to specifications and codes.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather job specifications, drawings, code requirements, site conditions, materials, tools, and inspection or test readings needed for electrical work.
interpret_scope: Analyze drawings, site conditions, and test results to locate faults, identify hazards, and determine installation, maintenance, or repair requirements.
decide_scope: Select compliant layouts, components, work methods, and repair priorities, including whether equipment can remain safely in operation.
act_scope: Install and connect conduit, wiring, equipment, and fixtures; test completed circuits; and maintain or repair systems to correct hazards and defects.

occupation_name: Electro-Mechanical and Mechatronics Technologists and Technicians
job_role_name: Electro-Mechanical and Mechatronics Technologists and Technicians
job_role_definition: Build, install, test, troubleshoot, maintain, and support the design and implementation of automated and electromechanical systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain design requirements and specifications, read technical drawings, inspect and measure parts, and collect diagnostic and performance-test data from electromechanical systems.
interpret_scope: Evaluate drawings, engineering designs, component conformance, test results, and fault indications to determine assembly requirements, system condition, and implementation feasibility.
decide_scope: Select assembly and diagnostic methods, equipment and components, implementation details, and corrective actions needed to meet functional and operational specifications.
act_scope: Fabricate, assemble, install, program, calibrate, repair, maintain, and help implement automated and electromechanical systems, and produce design documentation and report findings.

job_role_definition: Assemble, adjust, test, and prepare electromechanical equipment and devices to meet specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Read blueprints and specifications, select required components and materials, and inspect, measure, and test parts and completed units for fit, tolerances, and performance.
interpret_scope: Determine component requirements, assembly sequence, fit, and conformance by evaluating specifications, measurements, inspection findings, and test results.
decide_scope: Select needed alignment, adjustment, fitting, part-replacement, and preparation actions to bring equipment into specification.
act_scope: Assemble, connect, position, fasten, finish, lubricate, adjust, identify, and prepare electromechanical equipment and devices for shipment or use.

occupation_name: Electronic Equipment Installers and Repairers, Motor Vehicles
job_role_name: Electronic Equipment Installers and Repairers, Motor Vehicles
job_role_definition: Installs, diagnoses, and repairs communications, sound, security, and navigation equipment in motor vehicles.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather customer-reported symptoms, inspect vehicle electronic systems, and obtain test measurements and the equipment, components, and materials needed for installation or repair.
interpret_scope: Analyze inspections and electrical or electronic test results to identify malfunctions and determine the condition of communications, sound, security, or navigation equipment.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate installation, repair, replacement, wiring, fitting, and cost approach based on the diagnosed condition and vehicle requirements.
act_scope: Document diagnostic findings and install, modify, wire, connect, repair, replace, clean, and fit vehicle communications, sound, security, and navigation equipment and related components.

job_role_definition: Designs and develops electronic components and systems to meet technical, customer, cost, and operational requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather and clarify technical, customer, operational, cost, capacity, environmental, and material/equipment requirements, along with relevant performance and project information.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements and engineering evidence to assess feasibility, technical adequacy, compatibility, performance limitations, and opportunities to improve electronic components and systems.
decide_scope: Select system designs, component applications, testing and maintenance approaches, specifications, resource needs, budgets, and justified modifications that satisfy technical, customer, cost, and operational requirements.
act_scope: Design and develop electronic components and systems; produce specifications, procedures, schedules, cost and technical documentation; and coordinate their manufacture, installation, operation, maintenance, testing, and modification.

job_role_definition: Tests and validates electronic components and systems for performance, safety, quality, and conformance to requirements.
acquire_scope: Perform tests and inspections of electronic components and systems to obtain measurements, observations, and engineering-tool outputs needed to assess performance, safety, quality, and conformance.
interpret_scope: Analyze test and inspection evidence against requirements, specifications, safety standards, codes, and technical compatibility criteria to determine validation findings.
decide_scope: Select test approaches, acceptance criteria, preparation requirements, and conformance dispositions for the components and systems being validated.
act_scope: Document and communicate validation findings and conformance dispositions through technical records and reports.

occupation_name: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education
job_role_name: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education
job_role_definition: Teaches elementary students academic and social skills by planning, delivering, adapting, and evaluating instruction within a safe, orderly learning environment.
acquire_scope: Gather curriculum expectations, student work, assessment and developmental observations, and instructional resources needed for elementary teaching.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student understanding, behavior, development, and assessment results to identify progress, learning needs, and barriers.
decide_scope: Set learning objectives and select instructional, assessment, classroom-management, and individualized support approaches suited to curriculum and student needs.
act_scope: Deliver and adapt selected lessons and developmental activities, administer assessments, maintain a safe and orderly learning environment, implement student supports, and document and communicate results.

occupation_name: Elevator and Escalator Installers and Repairers
job_role_definition: Installs, assembles, wires, aligns, and commissions elevators, escalators, moving sidewalks, and dumbwaiters.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain installation drawings, components, tools, and specifications, and inspect and test installed equipment to gather connection, alignment, clearance, performance, and conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings and inspection and test evidence into required layouts, connections, alignments, clearances, operating findings, and code-conformance conclusions.
decide_scope: Choose installation equipment, component placement, adjustments, and corrective steps needed to achieve the specified installation.
act_scope: Install, assemble, wire, connect, secure, align, adjust, document, and commission elevators, escalators, moving sidewalks, and dumbwaiters.

occupation_name: Elevator and Escalator Installers and Repairers
job_role_name: Elevator and Escalator Service and Repair Technician
job_role_definition: Diagnoses, repairs, adjusts, and maintains installed elevators, escalators, moving sidewalks, and dumbwaiters.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect installed equipment and obtain operational, electrical, mechanical, alignment, and power-demand measurements needed to assess its condition.
interpret_scope: Diagnose malfunctions and determine whether equipment operation and condition conform to applicable safety and building requirements.
decide_scope: Select the needed repair, replacement, adjustment, maintenance, and testing approach for the identified condition.
act_scope: Repair, replace, adjust, maintain, and test installed elevators, escalators, moving sidewalks, and dumbwaiters, documenting completed checks and repairs.

job_role_definition: Determine, authorize, and maintain applicants' and recipients' eligibility for government assistance programs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather and verify applicants’ and recipients’ personal, financial, household, and claim information through interviews, records, references, investigations, and required reviews.
interpret_scope: Evaluate verified information against program requirements to establish eligibility status, continuing compliance, payment accuracy, and indications of fraud or abuse.
decide_scope: Determine eligibility and assistance amounts and select whether benefits should be granted, continued, modified, denied, terminated, or referred under program rules.
act_scope: Authorize and maintain benefit actions and payments, document and report case determinations, conduct required recertifications, and communicate requirements, procedures, rights, and outcomes to applicants and recipients.

job_role_definition: Prepare, preserve, restore, and present deceased persons for interment in conformity with sanitary and legal requirements.
acquire_scope: Receive and identify the deceased, observe the condition of the remains, obtain custody and case information, and assemble the sanitary, legal, and preparation inputs required for interment.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the condition of the remains and applicable sanitary, infectious-disease, transport, and presentation requirements to determine preparation needs.
decide_scope: Select the preservation, restorative, containment, and presentation procedures appropriate to the remains and required disposition.
act_scope: Perform sanitary embalming and body preparation, including cleansing, fluid treatment, evacuation, closure, restoration, cosmetic application, dressing, casketing, and required special handling for interment.

job_role_definition: Plan and direct emergency preparedness, disaster response, crisis management, recovery, and related training activities.
acquire_scope: Gather emergency-risk, regulatory, capability, resource, operational-status, and incident-impact information from partner agencies, facilities, assessments, surveys, inspections, and plan evaluations.
interpret_scope: Assess preparedness needs, response and recovery conditions, organizational plan adequacy, damage, and operational capabilities against emergency requirements.
decide_scope: Set emergency preparedness and recovery plans, response procedures, resource and coordination priorities, plan revisions, and training approaches.
act_scope: Direct disaster and crisis response and recovery operations; maintain and implement emergency plans and preparedness resources; and deliver public information and emergency training.

job_role_definition: Emergency Medical Technicians assess and stabilize sick or injured people in prehospital settings and transport or transfer them for continued care.
acquire_scope: Assess the scene and patient, elicit relevant history, measure vital signs, observe treatment responses, and receive necessary dispatch information.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the nature, severity, and progression of illness or injury and the patient’s response to emergency interventions.
decide_scope: Prioritize immediate medical needs and select basic emergency procedures, immobilization and transport priorities, and necessary team coordination.
act_scope: Provide emergency and life-support care while reassuring patients, immobilize and transport them safely, and document and communicate status for transfer.

job_role_definition: Provide immediate evaluation, treatment, stabilization, and disposition of patients with acute illness or injury.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document the acute history, prior-care information, examination findings, vital signs, pain or sedation status, diagnostic measurements and results, and ongoing observations of treatment response.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical findings, records, diagnostic results, and treatment response to diagnose acute conditions, determine their severity and likely course, and identify factors affecting management.
decide_scope: Set intervention and treatment priorities; select diagnostic studies, medications, procedures, monitoring adjustments, and the appropriate admission, observation, discharge, referral, or transition-of-care disposition.
act_scope: Provide immediate treatment, resuscitation, emergency procedures, and stabilization; direct the care team; and communicate the treatment plan and likely outcomes to patients, representatives, and other professionals.

job_role_definition: Support endoscopy procedures by maintaining sterile, functional equipment and assisting clinical staff with patient and procedural needs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Prepare procedure rooms; assemble endoscopic equipment, supplies, and monitoring materials; perform safety checks; and obtain patient inputs through monitoring-device placement and specimen collection.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment and instrument condition against procedural, manufacturer, and facility requirements to establish functional readiness.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate equipment disposition and procedural setup, including cleaning, calibration, maintenance, repair, or replacement needs.
act_scope: Clean, disinfect, calibrate, maintain, or repair endoscopic equipment; assist clinical staff during procedures; and position or transport patients as instructed.

job_role_definition: Conduct energy audits of buildings and systems to assess energy use and recommend feasible efficiency improvements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect building and process systems, measure and test energy performance, and gather field, usage, billing, rate, and occupancy-pattern data needed for the audit.
interpret_scope: Establish energy-use baselines and assess consumption patterns, system performance, air leakage, comparative performance, savings potential, technical feasibility, peak-demand opportunities, and relevant weatherization safety issues.
decide_scope: Select and prioritize feasible energy-efficiency measures, technologies, alternate energy sources, and improvement specifications that address the audit findings.
act_scope: Deliver the audit through energy-analysis reports, recommendations, and related customer explanations.

occupation_name: Energy Engineers, Except Wind and Solar
job_role_name: Energy Engineers, Except Wind and Solar
job_role_definition: Design, evaluate, and implement energy-related projects and programs to improve efficiency and reduce energy costs.
acquire_scope: Obtain energy-use, billing, meter, site-inspection, system, design, construction, and project-constraint inputs needed to assess efficiency opportunities and develop energy projects.
interpret_scope: Audit, model, analyze, verify, and evaluate energy data, systems, designs, technologies, and project performance to determine energy use, savings potential, costs, and efficiency implications.
decide_scope: Select and recommend efficiency strategies, project designs, fuels, energy purchasing terms, specifications, and conservation measures that meet site, budget, schedule, and regulatory requirements.
act_scope: Implement, direct, commission, and oversee energy-management and conservation projects, including configuring building-control routines and resolving energy-related design or construction issues.

job_role_definition: Construct, assemble, rebuild, and verify the operation of engines, turbines, and other industrial machines.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain assembly requirements and gather part measurements, clearances, and inspection and operating-test observations for engines, turbines, and industrial machines.
interpret_scope: Assess blueprints, specifications, measurements, and test results to determine fit, conformance, functioning, and the condition of parts or assemblies.
decide_scope: Plan assembly operations and select required adjustments, fabrication, repair, replacement, or rework actions.
act_scope: Construct, assemble, rebuild, fit, finish, fabricate, connect, align, and lubricate machine components and systems, and deliver operational and conformance findings for the completed equipment.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary engineering courses while supporting student learning, curriculum delivery, and associated scholarly and institutional responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Obtain current engineering literature, course and laboratory resources, student-performance evidence, and experimental or other research data needed for instruction and scholarship.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student performance and needs, derive conclusions from research evidence, and assess the effectiveness and relevance of courses, curricula, and instructional methods.
decide_scope: Select course content, teaching and assessment methods, curriculum revisions, student guidance, and research and funding strategies.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver courses, facilitate discussions, supervise student laboratory and research work, provide feedback and advising, implement curriculum revisions, maintain required student records, publish research findings, and submit funding proposals.

occupation_name: Engineering Technologists and Technicians, Except Drafters, All Other
job_role_name: Engineering Technologists and Technicians, Except Drafters, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide technical support and applied engineering services in engineering specialties not separately classified.
acquire_scope: Obtain technical requirements, engineering data, measurements, materials, and operational information needed to support applied engineering work.
interpret_scope: Analyze technical inputs to assess conditions, performance, specifications, and engineering issues within the applicable specialty.
decide_scope: Select technical priorities, methods, adjustments, and recommendations for addressing identified engineering needs.
act_scope: Implement selected technical methods and adjustments to deliver specialty-specific technical support and applied engineering services.

job_role_definition: Perform engineering work in disciplines not separately classified.
acquire_scope: Obtain technical requirements, constraints, measurements, material and system information, and applicable standards needed for the engineering work.
interpret_scope: Analyze the gathered information to determine engineering conditions, performance implications, feasibility, and technical findings.
decide_scope: Select technical approaches, specifications, priorities, and recommended resolutions appropriate to the engineering discipline.
act_scope: Develop, implement, and document the resulting engineering designs, processes, or other technical solutions.

occupation_name: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary English language and literature courses while supporting students and contributing to scholarship and institutional service.
acquire_scope: Assemble course texts, instructional resources, student work and records, disciplinary literature, and research evidence needed for teaching, advising, scholarship, and institutional service.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and academic needs, evaluate instructional and curricular effectiveness, and analyze scholarly evidence to develop findings and conclusions.
decide_scope: Set course content, learning activities, assessment approaches, advising guidance, research directions, and positions on teaching, research, or institutional matters.
act_scope: Teach and facilitate English language and literature learning in class and online, provide student advising and extra assistance, document and communicate assessments, publish scholarship, and participate in institutional academic service.

occupation_name: Entertainers and Performers, Sports and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Entertainers and Performers, Sports and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform entertainment, performance, sports, or related work not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the event, performance, sport, or related-work requirements, along with the materials, conditions, and cues needed to carry them out.
interpret_scope: Assess the applicable requirements, conditions, and incoming cues to determine their relevance to the work being performed.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate performance, participation, presentation, or related-work approach in response to those requirements and conditions.
act_scope: Carry out the entertainment, performance, sports, or related work that constitutes the occupational result.

occupation_name: Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide miscellaneous entertainment-attendant services not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information, materials, and access needed to provide the assigned miscellaneous entertainment-attendant service.
interpret_scope: Assess service needs, operating conditions, and participant requirements relevant to the assigned service.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate service actions and priorities within the assigned entertainment-attendant work.
act_scope: Provide the assigned miscellaneous entertainment-attendant service.

occupation_name: Entertainment and Recreation Managers, Except Gambling
job_role_name: Entertainment and Recreation Managers, Except Gambling
job_role_definition: Plans, directs, and coordinates entertainment or recreational programs, staff, customer services, and facility operations.
acquire_scope: Gather customer and employee feedback, program and financial records, staffing availability, and facility, equipment, and emergency-condition information needed to run programs and operations.
interpret_scope: Assess demand, service issues, operating performance, resource needs, and safety conditions to determine their implications for programs, staff, customers, and facilities.
decide_scope: Select program schedules, budgets, programming strategies, staffing and hiring arrangements, and responses to service, safety, and operational issues.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate recreational activities, staff work and training, customer communications and complaint resolution, facility operations, and immediate emergency care.

job_role_definition: Inspect and investigate pollution sources and enforce compliance with environmental laws and regulations.
acquire_scope: Gather compliance evidence through site inspections, observations, interviews, records and permit reviews, sampling and testing, complaint investigations, and follow-up monitoring.
interpret_scope: Assess field conditions, chemical handling, facility operations, labels, applications, measurements, test results, and regulatory requirements to determine compliance status and characterize violations.
decide_scope: Prioritize sites and reports for investigation and select enforcement, corrective-action, permit, program, or escalation recommendations based on the compliance assessment.
act_scope: Document and communicate findings and requirements, issue violation notices, coordinate compliance and enforcement activities, participate in enforcement proceedings, and explain required corrective measures.

job_role_definition: Conduct economic and quantitative analysis of environmental and natural-resource issues to inform policies, programs, and decisions.
acquire_scope: Collect environmental, economic, market, and resource data; establish data-collection methods; and gather inputs on policy, practice, and natural-resource conditions.
interpret_scope: Analyze relationships, trends, indicators, costs, benefits, and long-term resource effects, using economic, quantitative, and integrated environmental models to develop forecasts and assessments.
decide_scope: Formulate cost-effective environmental, natural-resource, sustainability, and business-practice policy or program recommendations, including research priorities and plans needed to produce them.
act_scope: Deliver economic and quantitative findings, forecasts, impact statements, and recommendations through technical documents, presentations, and policy-facing communication.

job_role_definition: Apply environmental engineering principles to collect and assess environmental data and support pollution-control, regulatory-compliance, and remediation projects under the direction of engineers or scientists.
acquire_scope: Collect, document, prepare, and quality-check environmental samples, field observations, equipment, process information, technical documents, permit information, and project resources needed for environmental work.
interpret_scope: Analyze and validate environmental, process, compliance, and pollutant-transport data to assess conditions, anomalies, impacts, treatment performance, and conformance with requirements.
decide_scope: Determine or recommend project work plans, activity schedules, compliance dispositions, pollution-control or remediation approaches, and corrective priorities under engineering or scientific direction.
act_scope: Conduct field and office environmental-quality work and implement project support activities, including operating and decontaminating equipment, maintaining process parameters, preparing reports and permit materials, assisting spill cleanup, and arranging hazardous-material disposal.

job_role_definition: Develops and administers engineering-based programs that help organizations satisfy environmental laws, permits, policies, and standards.
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain applicable laws, permits, plans, procedures, site observations, inspection findings, monitoring and sampling data, and compliance-program progress information.
interpret_scope: Assess environmental conditions, operational effectiveness, regulatory applicability, and investigation evidence to determine compliance status and engineering implications.
decide_scope: Set compliance-program objectives, priorities, controls, safety and quality procedures, remediation approaches, and resource plans.
act_scope: Develop, administer, coordinate, implement, document, and communicate engineering-based environmental compliance programs, including waste controls, required records, agency liaison, and workforce training.

job_role_name: Environmental Remediation and Pollution Control Engineer
job_role_definition: Designs and implements engineering solutions to prevent, control, monitor, or remediate environmental hazards and contamination.
acquire_scope: Obtain site, facility, contamination, regulatory, permit, safety, and project-performance inputs through records, inspections, monitoring, sampling, measurements, and material characterization.
interpret_scope: Evaluate environmental impacts, contaminant and operational conditions, monitoring results, regulatory applicability, and project status to determine hazard-control needs.
decide_scope: Select engineering controls, remediation or pollution-prevention approaches, project objectives, safety and quality procedures, compliance actions, and resource priorities.
act_scope: Design, document, coordinate, and implement selected environmental control, pollution-prevention, and remediation systems and programs, including directing installations and operations and delivering technical guidance.

job_role_definition: Plan, assess, and guide environmental restoration and natural-resource management projects to restore sites in compliance with environmental requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain site-condition, ecological, regulatory, design, geographic, cost, and field-compliance information through assessments, studies, inspections, data collection, and review of existing remediation designs.
interpret_scope: Analyze environmental conditions, damage, restoration needs, ecological impacts, feasibility, costs and benefits, and modeled site relationships to establish restoration findings and constraints.
decide_scope: Select compliant restoration, habitat, natural-resource management, mitigation, scheduling, budgeting, and permitting approaches and formulate recommendations for sites and landowners.
act_scope: Produce and communicate restoration plans, maps, diagrams, proposals, and required permit materials; provide technical direction and field guidance; and manage implementation compliance, including reporting plan deviations.

job_role_definition: Teach environmental science courses while supporting student learning, maintaining scholarly expertise, and carrying out associated academic responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Gather current environmental science knowledge, generate and obtain research evidence and data, assemble instructional and laboratory resources, and collect evidence of students’ learning, progress, and academic needs.
interpret_scope: Assess student performance and needs, synthesize disciplinary developments, analyze research evidence, and evaluate the effectiveness of course content and teaching methods.
decide_scope: Select course content, instructional and assessment approaches, student guidance, curriculum revisions, and research directions.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver environmental science instruction, facilitate and supervise classroom, laboratory, field, internship, and research learning, provide academic guidance, and disseminate scholarly findings.

occupation_name: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health
job_role_name: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health
job_role_definition: Performs field and laboratory monitoring, testing, inspection, and technical support to identify and help control environmental and health hazards.
acquire_scope: Collect and prepare environmental and health samples, inspect sites and facilities, investigate hazardous events, and set up, calibrate, and use monitoring and testing equipment to obtain reliable hazard and compliance evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze test results, observations, and environmental data to determine contaminant levels, exposures, hazardous conditions, environmental impacts, equipment performance, and compliance status.
decide_scope: Select monitoring and testing procedures, hazard-control recommendations, mitigation measures, treatment chemicals, compliance dispositions, and pollution-control or waste-management plans.
act_scope: Communicate technical findings and assistance, implement selected pollution-control and hazardous-waste programs, distribute approved plans or permits, and initiate warranted corrective or enforcement actions.

occupation_name: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
job_role_definition: Environmental Compliance and Regulatory Specialists assess environmental evidence and activities against requirements, then deliver permit dispositions, compliance findings, guidance, and regulatory responses.
acquire_scope: Gather environmental measurements, permit materials, applicable standards, and evidence from monitoring, audits, inspections, incidents, or suspected violations.
interpret_scope: Analyze environmental evidence and submissions to form compliance findings about impacts, hazards, deficiencies, violations, and conformity with applicable requirements.
decide_scope: Select permit dispositions, investigation priorities, corrective or enforcement responses, and recommendations for standards, policies, or regulatory cases.
act_scope: Process environmental permits, implement standards and regulatory responses, prepare technical legal materials, and communicate findings, guidance, coordination, or oversight to affected parties.

occupation_name: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
job_role_definition: Environmental Research and Assessment Scientists investigate environmental conditions and human impacts, producing scientific assessments and recommendations for prevention, mitigation, and management.
acquire_scope: Collect environmental samples, measurements, observations, project information, and regulatory context using study designs and data-collection methods appropriate to the investigation.
interpret_scope: Validate and synthesize environmental data to determine significance, pollution sources, causal relationships, impacts, and defensible scientific conclusions.
decide_scope: Select prevention, pollution-control, impact-mitigation, land-use, policy, environmental-management, and further research or monitoring recommendations.
act_scope: Produce and communicate research findings, environmental assessments, impact or accident reports, and scientific guidance to agencies, industry, programs, and the public.

job_role_definition: Investigate the distribution and determinants of disease and other health outcomes to guide prevention, control, research, and public-health action.
acquire_scope: Collect surveillance reports, study and questionnaire data, samples, and relevant public-health evidence on health outcomes and exposures.
interpret_scope: Analyze disease occurrence, transmission, causes, risk factors, interventions, and policy-relevant health issues to establish epidemiologic findings.
decide_scope: Set study methods and priorities and formulate evidence-based prevention, control, research, and public-health recommendations.
act_scope: Direct and evaluate public-health safety and surveillance programs, communicate findings and prevention guidance, and provide epidemiologic consultation.

job_role_definition: Monitor, investigate, and promote organizational compliance with equal opportunity laws, policies, and nondiscriminatory employment and contracting practices.
acquire_scope: Obtain complaint accounts through interviews and investigations, conduct surveys and compliance monitoring, and gather employment, contracting, job-description, selection, implementation, and legal or regulatory evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze complaints, practices, survey and statistical findings, contracts, job descriptions, and implementation impacts under equal opportunity requirements to identify discriminatory factors, compliance gaps, and corrective needs.
decide_scope: Select case dispositions, settlement terms, corrective-action recommendations, complaint-process revisions, and nondiscriminatory practice guidelines responsive to identified compliance needs.
act_scope: Document and report findings, facilitate dispute settlements, issue and coordinate complaint procedures and nondiscriminatory guidelines, and provide compliance information, technical assistance, training, and counseling.

job_role_definition: Engrave or etch designs, lettering, patterns, and markings onto workpieces and finish them to required specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare design references, specifications, measurements, workpieces, tools, and chemicals, and inspect proofs and worked surfaces for quality evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate design requirements and inspection evidence to identify required geometry, depth, uniformity, accuracy, and defects.
decide_scope: Determine the reproduction method, layout, machine settings, cutting dimensions, and any required corrective rework.
act_scope: Set up and operate engraving, cutting, etching, transfer, and finishing processes to produce and complete the specified designs, lettering, patterns, and markings.

occupation_name: Excavating and Loading Machine and Dragline Operators, Surface Mining
job_role_name: Excavating and Loading Machine and Dragline Operators, Surface Mining
job_role_definition: Operate or tend surface-mining machinery to excavate, load, and move loose materials safely and to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive movement and excavation instructions and plans, inspect machinery, and obtain layout, grade, level, and site-condition inputs needed for safe, specified work.
interpret_scope: Assess instructions, markings, measurements, ground conditions, and machine capabilities and limitations to determine their operational implications.
decide_scope: Select digging approaches, machine positioning, face-angle and operating adjustments, and required stability precautions for the assigned conditions.
act_scope: Set up, position, operate, tend, adjust, and maintain surface-mining machinery to excavate, load, move, place, break, or clear material and form required ramps or site features safely to specification.

occupation_name: Executive Secretaries and Executive Administrative Assistants
job_role_name: Executive Secretaries and Executive Administrative Assistants
job_role_definition: Provide high-level administrative support to executives and governing bodies by coordinating schedules, communications, information, meetings, and office operations.
acquire_scope: Receive and assemble correspondence, calls, requests, records, scheduling and travel requirements, meeting information, financial data, and research needed for executive, governing-body, and office support.
interpret_scope: Assess communications, submissions, policies, records, and operating practices to determine their significance, requirements, and implications for administrative work.
decide_scope: Set priorities and select routing, access, scheduling, travel, meeting, staffing, procedural, and workflow courses of action.
act_scope: Coordinate schedules, travel, meetings, communications, records, documents, financial administration, office services, staff support, and delegated representation to deliver high-level executive and governing-body support.

job_role_definition: Assess physiological fitness and design, implement, and evaluate exercise programs to improve health, rehabilitation, fitness, or physical performance.
acquire_scope: Obtain participant goals, medical history, performance requirements, and physiological measurements through safe, calibrated testing and appropriate diagnostic procedures.
interpret_scope: Assess fitness, health risk, rehabilitation or performance needs, and program-progress data to determine participants’ exercise status and needed changes.
decide_scope: Select individualized exercise prescriptions, activity recommendations, testing needs, and program adjustments consistent with participants’ goals and conditions.
act_scope: Implement and oversee exercise programs by instructing participants, demonstrating routines and equipment use, monitoring exercise, and providing appropriate care for physical distress.

occupation_name: Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors
job_role_definition: Plans and leads safe, adaptable exercise classes for groups of participants.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather participant capability, limitation, progress, exertion, and safety observations, and prepare the exercise space, music, and equipment needed for the class.
interpret_scope: Assess participant condition, technique, exertion, and progress to identify appropriate intensity, modifications, corrections, and safety concerns.
decide_scope: Select the class routine, movements, equipment use, alternatives, and real-time adjustments or emergency response appropriate for the group.
act_scope: Lead and demonstrate the exercise class, coach technique, breathing, exertion, and safe equipment use, enforce safety practices, and provide immediate injury care or referral when needed.

occupation_name: Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors
job_role_definition: Assesses individual clients and provides personalized exercise instruction and adaptive fitness programs.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather client histories, abilities, needs, physical conditions, exercise responses, and ongoing progress observations needed to tailor safe training.
interpret_scope: Assess client condition, technique, exertion, and progress to identify needs, limitations, skill issues, and fitness changes.
decide_scope: Develop and adjust individualized exercise programs, select corrective and safety measures, and determine appropriate injury treatment or referral.
act_scope: Deliver personalized exercise instruction and demonstrations, coach technique, breathing and exertion, enforce safe equipment use, and provide immediate first aid when needed.

occupation_name: Explosives Workers, Ordnance Handling Experts, and Blasters
job_role_name: Explosives Workers, Ordnance Handling Experts, and Blasters
job_role_definition: Plan, prepare, handle, and detonate explosives safely for demolition, material displacement, and related explosive operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect blast sites and formations; measure, bore, and prepare charge locations; and obtain, transport, store, and stage explosives, firing components, equipment, and operational communications.
interpret_scope: Assess site, hole, material, and safety conditions to determine charge requirements, validate placement and firing readiness, and confirm blast results.
decide_scope: Design drill-and-blast or perforating layouts, select charge types, quantities, depths, timing, and sequencing, and establish safe execution instructions.
act_scope: Prepare holes, explosives, primers, cords, guns, and firing systems; clear and protect blast areas; position explosive equipment; and initiate detonations to demolish, displace material, or perform related explosive operations.

job_role_definition: Perform extraction work not classified within a separately defined extraction occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare the site, materials, equipment, measurements, and operational information needed for the assigned extraction work.
interpret_scope: Assess material characteristics, site conditions, and operating information to determine their implications for extraction.
decide_scope: Select the safe and appropriate extraction method, work sequence, and adjustments for the assigned work.
act_scope: Perform the assigned extraction work and operate or apply the required tools, equipment, and procedures to deliver the extracted result.

occupation_name: Extruding and Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Extruding and Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and adjust extrusion or drawing machines to produce metal or plastic products that conform to specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications, select dies and machine components, prepare and load required metal or plastic materials, and measure, examine, and test product characteristics and defects.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, product measurements, inspections, and test results to determine conformity, process conditions, and equipment or tooling problems.
decide_scope: Determine setup procedures and select the required tooling, settings, corrective adjustments, die replacements, and minor maintenance actions to keep production within specification.
act_scope: Set up, start, operate, tend, adjust, maintain, and clean extrusion or drawing equipment to form, reel, or cut metal or plastic products to the specified shape, size, length, and weight.

occupation_name: Extruding and Forming Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Synthetic and Glass Fibers
job_role_name: Extruding and Forming Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Synthetic and Glass Fibers
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain machines that form continuous synthetic or glass filaments.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Load synthetic or glass-forming materials, prepare machine feed and finishing inputs, and observe operating conditions, gauges, controls, flow, and filament output for production inputs and abnormalities.
interpret_scope: Assess observed machine, flow, and filament conditions to identify processing defects, equipment malfunctions, and deviations from required operating specifications.
decide_scope: Determine whether to adjust feeds, controls, valves, or equipment; stop polymer or machine operation; initiate cleaning or maintenance; and communicate needed corrective adjustments.
act_scope: Set up, activate, operate, tend, adjust, stop, clean, maintain, and clear extruding and forming equipment to continuously produce synthetic or glass filaments.

occupation_name: Extruding, Forming, Pressing, and Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Extruding, Forming, Pressing, and Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend extruding, forming, pressing, and compacting machines to shape products in accordance with specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work-order requirements and required materials, and collect machine observations, production readings, tooling dimensions, product measurements, and samples needed to control the forming process.
interpret_scope: Compare observed machine conditions and tooling and product measurements with specifications to identify process conditions, malfunctions, and nonconforming output.
decide_scope: Select materials, tooling, setup parameters, synchronization, operating adjustments, and corrective or product-disposition responses needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Prepare and supply materials; set up, clean, operate, and adjust the machines; clear jams and remove defective output; unload and route formed products; and document or report production and quality results.

job_role_definition: Develop, grade, test, and prepare production-ready fabric and apparel patterns and layouts from design specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain design specifications, sketches, samples, fitting results, size references, and material-behavior inputs needed to develop production-ready patterns and layouts.
interpret_scope: Translate design and material inputs into required pattern-piece shapes, dimensions, grade relationships, joining details, and fabric quantities.
decide_scope: Select pattern construction and sizing adjustments, layout arrangements, and material-use approaches that meet the design while minimizing waste.
act_scope: Draft, grade, revise, test, mark, cut, print, and prepare pattern pieces, templates, layouts, and sewing-and-assembly specifications for production.

job_role_definition: Plans, directs, and coordinates facility operations, maintenance, and improvement projects to keep buildings and grounds safe, functional, compliant, and cost-effective.
acquire_scope: Gather facility condition, safety, maintenance, occupancy, project, schedule, and financial information needed to manage buildings, grounds, systems, and improvements.
interpret_scope: Evaluate facility performance, risks, compliance requirements, operational reports, and design proposals to identify maintenance, space, security, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set facility priorities, goals, budgets, schedules, and project or service plans, selecting resources and responses for operational, safety, and compliance needs.
act_scope: Direct facility operations, maintenance, repairs, space planning, and construction or renovation projects, coordinating staff and contractors to deliver safe, reliable facilities.

job_role_definition: Fell trees in controlled directions and perform associated processing of felled timber.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect candidate trees, site and weather conditions, equipment condition, and work-area hazards, obtain timber specifications, and measure felled timber to gather the inputs for controlled felling and processing.
interpret_scope: Evaluate tree defects, lean, terrain, hazards, and cut-log measurements to assess felling behavior, safety, and whether processed logs meet required quality and length.
decide_scope: Select trees and determine the intended fall direction, escape arrangement, cut geometry, and wedge or jack placement needed to minimize damage and control the fall.
act_scope: Prepare work and escape areas, mark unsafe trees, execute felling cuts and fall-control measures, retreat safely, and delimb, stabilize, and cut felled timber while maintaining needed cutting equipment.

job_role_definition: Family Medicine Physicians diagnose, treat, prevent, and monitor health conditions while coordinating comprehensive primary care across the lifespan.
acquire_scope: Elicit the patient’s history, perform a physical examination, and obtain relevant test results, prior records, and treatment-response information.
interpret_scope: Integrate symptoms, findings, records, and progress to determine diagnoses, health risks, preventive needs, and treatment effectiveness.
decide_scope: Select tests, preventive measures, treatments, monitoring plans, and referrals based on each patient’s needs across the lifespan.
act_scope: Provide or prescribe treatment and preventive care, perform appropriate office procedures, explain the care plan, and arrange monitoring, follow-up, and referrals.

occupation_name: Family and Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: Family and Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary family and consumer sciences courses while supporting students and fulfilling related faculty responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Gather current disciplinary and instructional sources, student work and records, student needs and goals, course resources, and colleague input needed for teaching, assessment, advising, supervision, and faculty responsibilities.
interpret_scope: Assess student performance and supervised work, and interpret student progress, needs, disciplinary developments, and instructional feedback to identify learning and curricular implications.
decide_scope: Select course content, instructional and assessment approaches, curricular revisions, learning resources, and appropriate academic, career, and supervisory guidance.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver family and consumer sciences instruction, facilitate learning activities, administer and grade assessments, advise and assist students, supervise student work, maintain required records, and carry out related faculty service.

occupation_name: Farm Equipment Mechanics and Service Technicians
job_role_name: Farm Equipment Mechanics and Service Technicians
job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, repair, and overhaul farm machinery, vehicles, and related agricultural equipment systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain condition and performance evidence from equipment examinations, operational tests, inspection information, customer reports, and electrical measurements.
interpret_scope: Determine the nature and location of mechanical, electrical, engine, irrigation, plumbing, and structural malfunctions and assess whether completed work restored serviceability.
decide_scope: Select the repair, maintenance, overhaul, adjustment, replacement, or fabrication approach and required parts for restoring equipment serviceability.
act_scope: Perform on-site or shop maintenance, dismantling, repair, replacement, fabrication, cleaning, lubrication, tuning, overhaul, reassembly, and adjustment of farm machinery, vehicles, and related agricultural equipment systems.

job_role_definition: Recruit, employ, support, and oversee temporary or seasonal agricultural workers for farm labor assignments.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain agricultural labor requirements, worker applications and availability, and the supplies, tools, transportation, and site information needed for assignments.
interpret_scope: Assess applicants' suitability and availability and evaluate workers' work status, needs, and assignment-site requirements.
decide_scope: Select workers and supervisory arrangements and determine their task assignments, work-site deployment, and support priorities.
act_scope: Recruit and employ seasonal agricultural workers; oversee their work; and provide wages, food, water, sanitation, tools, transportation, and direction to assignments.

job_role_definition: Educate and advise agricultural producers to improve farm production, management, and related practices.
acquire_scope: Gather producer concerns, farm observations and samples, requested technical information, and community needs relevant to production and management improvement.
interpret_scope: Assess farm and community information to diagnose production and management problems, evaluate practices and research findings, and determine their practical implications.
decide_scope: Select tailored recommendations, educational priorities, production targets, and problem-prevention approaches for producers and community programs.
act_scope: Educate and advise agricultural producers through classes, farm visits, demonstrations, materials, advocacy, and applied research communication to improve production, management, and related practices.

job_role_definition: Educate and advise individuals and families on household management and family well-being practices.
acquire_scope: Gather household, family, community-need, and service-outcome information, including relevant input from health and social-service professionals.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to identify household-management and family well-being needs and evaluate the effects of prior guidance.
decide_scope: Select appropriate educational content, practical advice, resources, and community-based approaches for the identified needs.
act_scope: Educate and advise individuals and families through classes, consultations, educational materials, and community activities on household-management and well-being practices.

occupation_name: Farmers, Ranchers, and Other Agricultural Managers
job_role_name: Farmers, Ranchers, and Other Agricultural Managers
job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate the production, workforce, resources, facilities, and commercial operations of agricultural establishments.
acquire_scope: Gather production, environmental, soil, animal-health, facility, financial, inventory, market, and regulatory information needed to run the agricultural establishment.
interpret_scope: Assess crop, plant, livestock, and fish condition; soil and environmental requirements; operational performance; and market and financial conditions to establish production and commercial implications.
decide_scope: Set production, breeding, growing, care, resource-allocation, safety, facility, purchasing, financing, and marketing plans, including responses to disease, pests, weather, fire, and other disruptions.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate agricultural production, environmental controls, workforce, facility upkeep and construction, procurement, records and required reporting, product sales and shipment arrangements, and operational standards.

occupation_name: Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse
job_role_name: Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse
job_role_definition: Performs hands-on crop and plant production from soil preparation and planting through cultivation, harvest, and post-harvest handling.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Observe plants, pests, weeds, soil, water, greenhouse conditions, maturity, and product quality, and gather materials needed for production and harvest.
interpret_scope: Assess plant health, growth, maturity, pest or disease signs, growing conditions, and harvested-product quality against production needs.
decide_scope: Choose cultivation treatments, irrigation or climate adjustments, harvest timing, and appropriate grading, handling, storage, or packing dispositions.
act_scope: Prepare soil, plant and tend crops, control growing conditions, harvest products, and grade, pack, move, or store them.

occupation_name: Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, and Aquacultural Animals
job_role_name: Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, and Aquacultural Animals
job_role_definition: Attend to farm, ranch, and aquacultural animals to support their health, husbandry, housing, and production.
acquire_scope: Observe animal condition, growth, grazing areas, and threats; inspect housing and equipment; and assemble feed, water, medicines, and other husbandry inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess animals’ health, physical condition, production status, and access to safe food, water, shelter, and care.
decide_scope: Determine feeding, treatment, grouping, movement, breeding, protection, sanitation, and maintenance actions needed for the animals and their facilities.
act_scope: Provide feed, water, treatment, routine animal care and production work; move, identify, and protect animals; and clean, maintain, repair, and operate their housing and equipment.

job_role_definition: Designs costumes that support the characters, period, and visual concept of film, television, or theatrical productions.
acquire_scope: Gather scripts, production input, and historical or stylistic clothing references needed for the production.
interpret_scope: Translate character, period, and visual-concept requirements into costume design requirements.
decide_scope: Select costume concepts, clothing and accessory approaches, and design plans for the production.
act_scope: Create costume designs that support the characters, period, and visual concept of the production.

job_role_definition: Designs apparel and accessories for consumer and retail markets from concept through samples and production specifications.
acquire_scope: Gather market, client and trend information, fabric and garment references, sample-fit observations, and material-performance evidence needed to develop apparel and accessories.
interpret_scope: Translate consumer and market inputs into design requirements and assess samples, fabrics, and adapted ideas for their intended aesthetic, fit, and use.
decide_scope: Choose the target market, product concept, styles, materials, construction methods, color schemes, and revisions that define each design.
act_scope: Produce and refine design drawings, patterns, mockups, samples, and complete production specifications while directing their development through final sample readiness.

job_role_definition: Take orders, prepare and serve quick-service food and beverages, process payments, and maintain customer service and dining areas.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain customer orders and payments, select the required food, beverage, packaging, and service-area supplies, and receive readiness and shortage information.
interpret_scope: Translate orders, special requests, payment details, and customer comments into accurate bills, preparation requirements, and service needs.
decide_scope: Determine order handling priorities, appropriate responses to customer concerns, and needed substitutions, replenishment, or kitchen notifications.
act_scope: Prepare, package, and serve quick-service food and beverages; process transactions; communicate with customers; and keep dining, service, kitchen, and equipment areas sanitary and ready for service.

job_role_definition: Erect and repair fences, gates, and related barriers by laying out sites, installing structural components, and finishing the completed enclosure.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain site utility information, specifications, measurements, layout references, and the materials needed to build or repair the enclosure.
interpret_scope: Assess site conditions, specifications, measurements, and alignment checks to determine required fence configuration and installation requirements.
decide_scope: Select the enclosure layout, component arrangement, repair approach, and suitable methods for preparing and securing the structure.
act_scope: Lay out and prepare sites, set and align posts, construct and install frames, fencing, gates, and related barriers, and complete necessary repairs and finishing work.

job_role_definition: Form fiberglass composite parts by preparing molds, applying and consolidating reinforced resin materials, curing, trimming, inspecting, and repairing the finished products.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Select the specified reinforcement, resin, catalyst, bracing, masking, and release materials, and obtain dimensional, visual, acoustic, thickness, density, and contour evidence from tooling and parts.
interpret_scope: Determine whether tooling and completed or repaired parts conform to specifications and identify defects or fit discrepancies from the inspection evidence.
decide_scope: Choose the appropriate layup, curing, trimming, and corrective repair course based on project requirements and identified defects.
act_scope: Prepare and mask molds, then apply, saturate, consolidate, reinforce, cure, trim, and repair fiberglass-resin materials to deliver conforming composite parts.

job_role_definition: Maintain, organize, retrieve, and track physical and electronic records using established filing systems.
acquire_scope: Gather incoming materials and record requests, and locate the physical or electronic records needed for maintenance or authorized retrieval.
interpret_scope: Read and assess materials, records, and file conditions to determine their applicable classification, indexing, placement, and maintenance status under established guidelines.
decide_scope: Select the prescribed filing, retention, transfer, destruction, or retrieval disposition and priority for records based on classification and maintenance requirements.
act_scope: Create, index, file, store, inspect, retrieve, copy, deliver, and track records and their movement so the filing system remains organized and accessible.

job_role_definition: Edit and assemble moving images and related sound elements into coherent final film or video productions.
acquire_scope: Review scripts and footage, verify timing identifiers, and obtain the picture, sound, music, and effect materials required for the production.
interpret_scope: Assess source and assembled material for narrative continuity, technical accuracy, dramatic effect, and needed corrections.
decide_scope: Select shots, cut points, sequence structure, editing approach, and the audio, music, graphic, and visual treatments that best complete the production.
act_scope: Edit, trim, assemble, and refine moving images with synchronized sound, graphics, effects, and titles into the coherent final film or video production.

job_role_definition: Perform financial clerical services not classified under a more specific financial clerk occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble the financial records, forms, transaction details, and related documentation needed for assigned clerical services.
interpret_scope: Review financial information to determine its relevance, completeness, accuracy, and required handling.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate clerical handling, routing, or follow-up for financial records and transactions.
act_scope: Perform the assigned financial clerical services and maintain the resulting records or transaction documentation.

job_role_definition: Examine financial institutions and regulated transactions to assess legal compliance, internal controls, and financial safety and soundness.
acquire_scope: Gather institutional financial, operational, governance, audit, systems, collateral, and transaction information through investigation, record review, inspection, and discussions with relevant parties.
interpret_scope: Analyze the evidence and applicable requirements to assess transaction legality, internal-control adequacy, regulatory compliance, and financial safety and soundness.
decide_scope: Determine examination findings and select recommendations, including corrective measures or approval or rejection of regulated applications, to address identified conditions.
act_scope: Deliver examination results by documenting and communicating findings, assessments, and recommendations in formal reports, supporting schedules, and examination meetings.

job_role_definition: Direct an organization's financial planning, liquidity, reporting, controls, capital financing, and investment oversight.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble cost, cash-flow, transaction, market, operational, risk, and financial-reporting inputs needed for planning, liquidity management, reporting, controls, financing, and investment oversight.
interpret_scope: Analyze financial, cost, market, transaction, and risk information to assess the organization's current and projected financial position, reporting requirements, control performance, and investment conditions.
decide_scope: Select financial plans, budgets, liquidity and capital-financing priorities, investment approaches, and changes to financial-control, reporting, accounting, collection, and asset-custody procedures.
act_scope: Direct financial operations and staff, manage cash and instrument flows, deliver required reports and investor communications, safeguard assets, and implement financial plans, controls, and procedures.

job_role_definition: Direct lending and credit operations, including credit decisions, loan processing, collateral controls, and collections.
acquire_scope: Obtain and review loan applications, customer information, collateral records, financial data, and collection-status information needed to operate lending and credit accounts.
interpret_scope: Assess application, financial, cost, collection, and control information to determine creditworthiness, outstanding exposure, operational status, and control needs.
decide_scope: Select credit approvals or denials, lending dispositions, collection priorities, and necessary collateral-custody or credit-control procedures.
