acquire_scope: Receive and count cash and gambling instruments, obtain customer identification, credit information, transaction documentation, and required signatures, and monitor jackpot signals.
interpret_scope: Validate age and credit references, calculate exchange and chip values, and audit and reconcile drawers and transaction records to identify balances and discrepancies.
decide_scope: Determine whether to authorize credit, check-cashing, exchanges, and payouts based on verified eligibility, available funds, and transaction controls.
act_scope: Complete authorized exchanges, sales, and jackpot payouts, supply shift banks, safeguard funds and instruments, and maintain transaction and reconciliation records.

job_role_definition: Operate regulated table games by conducting play, handling wagers and payouts, and serving patrons according to game rules.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect game equipment, open and reconcile table funds, exchange currency for chips, and receive, verify, and record wagers before and during play.
interpret_scope: Determine game outcomes and calculate players’ wins, losses, and corresponding payout amounts from dealt cards, game results, and wagers.
decide_scope: Select rule-governed resolutions for wager, play, and payout situations, including the applicable variation of a game’s rules.
act_scope: Conduct regulated table-game rounds by controlling play and equipment, dealing or otherwise running the game, announcing results, settling wagers, and serving patrons under game rules and procedures.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate casino gambling operations, including staffing, game integrity, customer service, financial controls, and operating policies.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather operational, staffing, customer, game-integrity, wagering, cash, credit, and expense information through table oversight, records, reports, and familiarity with games and house rules.
interpret_scope: Assess that information to identify service issues, improper play or rule violations, staffing gaps, and inaccuracies or risks in gaming and financial operations.
decide_scope: Set operating policies, game and credit terms, table limits, staffing and station plans, personnel selections, customer accommodations, and responses to identified operational issues.
act_scope: Direct casino operations by deploying and developing staff, enforcing rules and integrity measures, resolving customer issues, managing table and customer access, and carrying out financial-control actions.

job_role_definition: Provide gambling-related customer and operational services not covered by separately classified gambling service occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain customer requests, gambling-related operational information, and the materials needed to provide services outside separately classified gambling roles.
interpret_scope: Determine the relevant service need and operational status from the available customer and workplace information.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate service response or operational handling within the worker's assigned responsibilities.
act_scope: Provide the requested gambling-related customer or operational service.

occupation_name: Gambling Surveillance Officers and Gambling Investigators
job_role_name: Gambling Surveillance Officers and Gambling Investigators
job_role_definition: Monitor and investigate gambling operations to detect, document, and report regulatory violations, cheating, theft, and threats to gambling assets.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor gambling operations and functioning surveillance equipment, and retrieve live and recorded audio-video evidence and observation details concerning compliance, irregularities, and threats.
interpret_scope: Assess observed activities and surveillance footage to identify regulatory violations, cheating, theft, suspicious behavior, and threats to gambling assets.
decide_scope: Determine which identified matters warrant formal documentation and reporting as violations or suspicious incidents.
act_scope: Maintain surveillance observation logs, report identified matters verbally or in writing, and provide operational oversight or security coverage.

occupation_name: Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners
job_role_name: Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners
job_role_definition: Receive, record, validate, and settle patrons' wagers while supporting associated gambling-game operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect and record wagers, payments, tickets, cards, game-state observations, and equipment-condition information needed to conduct and settle gambling transactions.
interpret_scope: Validate wagers, assess equipment and rule compliance, determine game outcomes and amounts won or lost, and explain applicable rules and policies.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate handling and settlement of each wager, including whether to proceed with play, pay or move bets, retain stakes, or refer payouts.
act_scope: Conduct gambling games, exchange currency for gaming value, open and close game stations, announce results, execute settlements, and deliver gaming materials and funds to the appropriate participants or workers.

occupation_name: Gas Compressor and Gas Pumping Station Operators
job_role_name: Gas Compressor and Gas Pumping Station Operators
job_role_definition: Operate and regulate compressor and pumping-station equipment to transmit, compress, recover, and transfer gases and related materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor operating readings and gas flow, take and test gas samples, and obtain the measurements needed to control station performance and material transfers.
interpret_scope: Assess pressure, temperature, consumption-rate, and gas-quality measurements to identify operating conditions and deviations.
decide_scope: Select pressure settings, equipment adjustments, and problem responses needed to maintain specified station performance.
act_scope: Operate, start, regulate, connect, adjust, and maintain compressor, pumping, and auxiliary equipment to transmit, compress, recover, and transfer gases and related materials.

job_role_definition: Operate and monitor gas-processing and distribution systems to maintain safe flow, pressure, processing conditions, and product quality.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather operating readings, test samples, demand information, equipment-condition observations, and safety-relevant transport and storage information from processing and distribution systems.
interpret_scope: Assess operating, safety, and product-quality conditions by reviewing measurements and records to identify deviations, malfunctions, leaks, and causes of abnormal pressure or process performance.
decide_scope: Select process adjustments, equipment operating states, corrective responses, maintenance needs, and coordination priorities needed to keep gas operations within required conditions.
act_scope: Operate, start, shut down, and adjust processing and distribution equipment; carry out or arrange necessary equipment maintenance and direct associated operating work to sustain safe gas flow and quality.

job_role_definition: Cut, shape, drill, grind, and polish gems and diamonds to specified dimensions and quality standards.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine, sort, and precisely measure rough and in-process gems and diamonds, and prepare stones, holders, tooling, abrasives, and polishing compounds for the specified work.
interpret_scope: Assess stone characteristics and processing measurements to determine conformity with required dimensions, cut geometry, and quality standards.
decide_scope: Select the cut approach, shaping wheels, and processing materials that will produce the required stone form and quality.
act_scope: Secure stones and operate cutting, drilling, grinding, shaping, and polishing equipment to produce finished gems and diamonds to specification, maintaining the equipment for reliable operation.

job_role_definition: Identify, grade, value, and advise on gemstones based on their properties, quality, and intended use.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine gemstones with optical instruments and prescribed solution tests, and obtain relevant pricing and market inputs.
interpret_scope: Determine stone identity and properties, detect value-affecting characteristics, document clarity features, and assign quality grades under established systems.
decide_scope: Estimate gem value and select the most suitable gemstone use for the intended jewelry outcome.
act_scope: Deliver documented identification, grading, valuation, and use advice for gemstones.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and provide continuing medical care for adolescents and adults with acute, chronic, and complex internal health conditions.
acquire_scope: Collect, document, and monitor patient histories, examinations, records, test results, conditions, and treatment progress needed for acute, chronic, and complex internal-medicine care.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical evidence to diagnose straightforward, co-occurring, or obscure conditions; assess treatment response; and determine patient risk status.
decide_scope: Select or revise preventive and nonsurgical treatment plans, medications, therapies, referrals, and risk-reducing interventions, including recommendations for patients and consulting clinicians.
act_scope: Deliver and coordinate continuing comprehensive medical care by prescribing or administering treatment and immunizations, managing conditions, communicating findings and care instructions, and directing involved clinical staff.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate organization-wide or multi-department operations to achieve business and service objectives.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather performance, financial, demand, supplier, operational, staffing, and facility information needed to manage organization-wide or multi-department operations.
interpret_scope: Assess operating results, productivity, demand, resource needs, supplier performance, and improvement opportunities against business and service objectives.
decide_scope: Set operational goals, policies, budgets, priorities, prices or terms, staffing assignments, and coordinated plans for achieving objectives.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate operational, administrative, financial, staffing, commercial, supply, facility, and improvement activities to deliver organizational results.

job_role_definition: Assess inherited-condition risks and counsel patients, families, and healthcare providers to support informed genetic-health decisions and care.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient and family histories, medical records, laboratory and diagnostic information, and relevant genetic evidence needed for counseling.
interpret_scope: Analyze genetic and clinical information to assess inherited-condition risks, interpret test results, and identify psychosocial needs relevant to care.
decide_scope: Select or coordinate appropriate testing, care-plan, and specialist or community-referral recommendations based on assessed risks and patient circumstances.
act_scope: Counsel patients, families, and healthcare providers by explaining genetic conditions, inheritance, procedures, testing options, results, and their implications through discussions, educational materials, and consultation reports.

job_role_definition: Evaluates, diagnoses, and treats patients with inherited disorders and supports their clinical genetic management.
acquire_scope: Obtain and review patient, family, laboratory, diagnostic-test, and current genetic evidence needed to evaluate inherited disorders.
interpret_scope: Analyze clinical and family findings and interpret genetic testing to determine the genetic basis and diagnosis of a disorder.
decide_scope: Select appropriate treatment and ongoing clinical genetic management for the diagnosed condition.
act_scope: Provide treatment and carry out clinical genetic management for patients with inherited disorders.

job_role_definition: Conducts research to investigate, analyze, and communicate genetic mechanisms, inheritance, and biological traits.
acquire_scope: Obtain research inputs through literature review, sampling and family studies, genomic and laboratory testing, and accurate experimental records maintained with safe, reliable laboratory conditions.
interpret_scope: Analyze genetic and biological data, laboratory results, and experimental evidence to determine mechanisms of inheritance, gene regulation, and biological traits.
decide_scope: Select and refine research methods, sampling approaches, analytical protocols, and trait-modification or diagnostic approaches suited to the research objectives.
act_scope: Conduct genetic and genomic investigations and communicate defensible experimental findings through scientific presentations and publications.

job_role_definition: Measure, compute, validate, and maintain precise geodetic positions and control data for land, engineering, construction, and public-use applications.
acquire_scope: Conduct geodetic field surveys and assemble existing control, equipment, and survey measurements needed to establish precise land positions and control data.
interpret_scope: Compute, adjust, retrace, and validate coordinates, elevations, boundaries, and control networks for accuracy, continuity, and conformance with applicable specifications and standards.
decide_scope: Plan survey work and determine needed supplemental observations, data requests, or control-method and equipment changes based on assessed data quality.
act_scope: Establish and maintain precise geodetic positions and control records, and deliver compiled data and technical results for land, engineering, construction, and public-use applications.

job_role_definition: Study and interpret physical and human geographic phenomena through research, spatial analysis, teaching, and applied geographic services.
acquire_scope: Gather, measure, and retrieve physical, human, and spatial geographic data from fieldwork, observations, imagery, maps, censuses, and geographic databases.
interpret_scope: Analyze geographic distributions and the physical, economic, political, and cultural characteristics of places and populations to develop spatial findings.
decide_scope: Formulate geographic assessments, instructional content, and consulting recommendations that address research questions and applied client or public-sector needs.
act_scope: Deliver geographic results through maps, graphs, reports, presentations, teaching, consulting, and GIS support, including operating and maintaining the needed GIS resources.

occupation_name: Geographic Information Systems Technologists and Technicians
job_role_name: Geographic Information Systems Technologists and Technicians
job_role_definition: Build, maintain, analyze, present, customize, and support geographic information systems and geospatial data.
acquire_scope: Collect, integrate, convert, enter, and rescale geospatial, imagery, and related client-requirement inputs for GIS databases, analyses, and customized solutions.
interpret_scope: Assess geospatial data quality and documentation, interpret aerial imagery, and analyze spatial data, scientific problems, user needs, and application faults to determine their meaning.
decide_scope: Select database, application, analytical, cartographic, configuration, and upgrade approaches that meet GIS requirements and improve accessibility or usability.
act_scope: Build, maintain, customize, test, and troubleshoot GIS databases, models, applications, and procedures; deliver geospatial layers, maps, visualizations, reports, presentations, training, and technical support.

job_role_definition: Teach geography courses while supporting student learning, scholarship, and academic service responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Obtain geographic scholarship, spatial and other research evidence, instructional materials, student-performance evidence, and information needed for academic service.
interpret_scope: Analyze geographic evidence and student work, and evaluate learning outcomes, curricula, instructional methods, and academic issues.
decide_scope: Set research, instructional, curricular, student-advising, and academic-service priorities and recommendations.
act_scope: Prepare and teach geography courses, administer assessments, supervise and advise students, conduct and publish scholarship, and perform academic service.

job_role_definition: Assist geoscientists and engineers by collecting, testing, recording, and interpreting geological data for exploration, resource development, and site evaluation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble geological evidence and context through research, field and geophysical surveys, drilling and well logging, sampling, laboratory testing, measurements, imaging, and instrument setup and operation.
interpret_scope: Analyze, integrate, and visualize sample results, seismic records, and other geological data to characterize subsurface conditions, resources, environmental effects, and site suitability.
decide_scope: Select data-collection plans, equipment configurations, work priorities, and technical recommendations for exploration, resource development, or site evaluation.
act_scope: Implement collection plans by coordinating field operations, maintain and repair data-collection equipment, manage records, and deliver findings through logs, maps, cross-sections, and technical reports.

job_role_definition: Assesses geologic conditions and hazards to support construction, land use, environmental protection, waste management, and remediation decisions.
acquire_scope: Collect and review field, drilling, testing, geophysical, water-movement, construction-inspection, and documentary evidence on site geology, materials, and environmental conditions.
interpret_scope: Analyze geological, geochemical, geophysical, and geomechanical evidence to characterize subsurface conditions, contamination pathways, engineering constraints, and natural hazards.
decide_scope: Determine suitable sites, land-use and foundation constraints, waste or remediation approaches, hazard mitigations, and environmental protection recommendations.
act_scope: Deliver geologic maps, cross sections, technical reports, and applied advice that communicate the assessment for construction, land-use, environmental, waste-management, and remediation decisions.

job_role_definition: Identifies, evaluates, and supports the development of mineral, energy, and other subsurface resources.
acquire_scope: Plan and conduct field, drilling, survey, measurement, sampling, testing, and documentary research to assemble geological, geochemical, geophysical, environmental, and technical evidence on subsurface resources and development conditions.
interpret_scope: Examine, classify, analyze, and validate field, laboratory, mapping, well, borehole, aerial, and published evidence to characterize geology, assess resource and environmental conditions, and estimate prospective deposits or energy sources.
decide_scope: Select exploration targets, investigation approaches, resource-development and reclamation strategies, and technical recommendations based on the evaluated evidence.
act_scope: Deliver resource-identification and development support through geological maps, cross sections, charts, reports, mine-integrity monitoring, and operational advice for extraction and related resource-use activities.

job_role_definition: Investigates Earth materials, history, physical processes, and environmental change to produce scientific knowledge and analytical methods.
acquire_scope: Collect, measure, test, classify, and retrieve Earth-material, geophysical, field, laboratory, and published evidence relevant to Earth history, processes, and environmental change.
interpret_scope: Analyze geological, geochemical, geophysical, and historical evidence to develop findings, models, risk assessments, and explanations of Earth systems and environmental impacts.
decide_scope: Select research designs, analytical approaches, and scientifically supported methods or dispositions for investigating Earth processes and environmental questions.
act_scope: Conduct field and laboratory investigations, develop analytical software or methods, and communicate resulting scientific knowledge through maps, diagrams, reports, papers, conferences, and teaching.

job_role_definition: Manage the safe, efficient, and compliant operation and maintenance of geothermal power generation facilities and well fields.
acquire_scope: Monitor plant and well-field conditions, inspect equipment and sites, and assemble operating, maintenance, environmental, and compliance records required to manage geothermal generation.
interpret_scope: Evaluate operating data, inspections, logs, and site assessments to determine equipment condition, regulatory status, inefficiencies, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set operating and maintenance plans, schedules, budgets, repair and preventive-maintenance priorities, corrosion controls, process improvements, and required compliance actions.
act_scope: Direct and supervise safe plant and well-field operations, maintenance, repairs, corrosion mitigation, process improvements, condition communication, and regulatory compliance activities.

job_role_definition: Install, test, commission, and maintain geothermal heat-pump and ground-loop systems for residential and commercial heating and cooling.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain property and load inputs, water-source conditions, equipment and control observations, and pre-installation, post-installation, and operating measurements.
interpret_scope: Calculate thermal loads and assess site, source, equipment, control, and test evidence to establish system requirements, faults, and operating condition.
decide_scope: Select the suitable loop configuration, equipment, system layout, auxiliary provisions, and commissioning, repair, or maintenance actions.
act_scope: Construct and protect loop piping; install and integrate heat pumps, water-heating equipment, instrumentation, and controls; and flush, purge, commission, repair, and maintain completed systems.

job_role_definition: Operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain geothermal power-generation equipment and control systems to support reliable electricity production.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor plant and well-field conditions and collect operating measurements, control indications, equipment observations, and load requirements needed to sustain generation and equipment condition.
interpret_scope: Assess operating data and equipment behavior to identify performance deviations, malfunctions, and maintenance or protection needs.
decide_scope: Select operating adjustments and corrective, calibration, maintenance, protection, or corrosion-control responses required to maintain reliable generation.
act_scope: Operate and adjust generation and control equipment, correct faults, document work, and maintain, repair, calibrate, install, and protect plant electrical and control systems.

occupation_name: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
job_role_definition: Fabricates shaped glass tubing by heating, bending, joining, and assembling tubing to specification.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain the specified tubing, sketches, patterns, and fabrication requirements, and inspect, weigh, and measure workpieces to generate conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Translate fabrication requirements into required dimensions and shapes, and assess inspection evidence to identify conformance or repair needs.
decide_scope: Select glass type and quantity, forming layout and methods, and any corrective or repair action needed to meet the specification.
act_scope: Cut, uniformly heat, blow, bend, join, assemble, charge, and repair glass tubing to produce the specified finished shape.

occupation_name: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
job_role_definition: Forms glass articles by heating, blowing, and manually shaping glass to specified designs and dimensions.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain design inputs and the required glass or tubing, and inspect, weigh, and measure formed articles to collect specification and conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Translate sketches and design requirements into blueprint specifications and evaluate product measurements and observations to establish conformance.
decide_scope: Select the article design, glass type and quantity, forming sequence, and adjustments needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Heat, cut, blow, rotate, shape, bend, join, and finish glass to produce articles of the selected designs and dimensions.

occupation_name: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
job_role_definition: Completes glass products by operating equipment that cuts, grinds, drills, sands, bevels, decorates, washes, or polishes them.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain glass workpieces and specifications, and inspect, weigh, and measure finished products using appropriate instruments.
interpret_scope: Assess measurement and inspection results for conformance to product specifications.
decide_scope: Select finishing-machine settings, processing steps, and adjustments needed to achieve required finish and conformance.
act_scope: Operate and maintain equipment to cut, grind, drill, sand, bevel, decorate, wash, or polish glass products.

occupation_name: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
job_role_definition: Forms glass products in dies or molds by operating and adjusting presses and heating equipment.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Examine, weigh, and measure formed glass products to obtain evidence of dimensions, mass, surface condition, and other specified attributes.
interpret_scope: Compare product observations and measurements with specifications to assess conformance and identify process deviations.
decide_scope: Select the glass type and quantity and choose necessary press and oven settings or adjustments for the product and observed deviations.
act_scope: Prepare molds, heat glass uniformly to pliability, and set up, adjust, and operate presses and heating equipment to form products.

job_role_definition: Install, fit, seal, repair, replace, and finish glass, mirrors, and related frames, hardware, and enclosures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements and specifications, inspect and measure openings and surfaces, verify plumb, and assemble the glass, framing, hardware, sealants, and access equipment needed for the work.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings, specifications, site measurements, and surface conditions into required dimensions, fit, placement, and installation requirements.
decide_scope: Select the specified glass or mirror characteristics and determine the appropriate work procedure, framing arrangement, and access approach for installation, repair, replacement, or finishing.
act_scope: Cut, shape, finish, lift, fit, install, seal, secure, repair, replace, and complete glass, mirrors, frames, hardware, enclosures, films, stained-glass assemblies, and decorative glass finishes.

job_role_definition: Inspect government property, contractor-held assets, and products to verify compliance with contracts and regulations.
acquire_scope: Examine records and reports; inspect government property, contractor-held equipment and materials, and regulated products; and obtain required product samples for laboratory testing.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection, document, and test evidence to establish facts, detect discrepancies, and determine compliance with contracts, specifications, and regulations.
decide_scope: Select and formulate recommended legal or administrative action needed to protect government property and address identified noncompliance.
act_scope: Document and communicate inspection or investigation findings, compliance conclusions, and recommended actions through reports and correspondence.

job_role_definition: Investigate suspected violations involving government-regulated property, licenses, or permits and support resulting enforcement proceedings.
acquire_scope: Examine records and investigate allegations and special-license or permit applications to obtain, identify, and preserve documentary and case evidence, including observations of investigative compliance.
interpret_scope: Evaluate records, evidence, and investigative conduct to establish facts, identify discrepancies, substantiate violations or application findings, and assess compliance with constitutional requirements.
decide_scope: Formulate recommendations for appropriate legal or administrative action to protect government-regulated property and interests.
act_scope: Deliver investigative conclusions and enforcement support through reports, correspondence, coordination with law enforcement, and testimony in court or administrative proceedings.

job_role_definition: Grade, sort, classify, and prepare unprocessed agricultural products according to their physical characteristics and condition.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect agricultural products for color, species, dimensions, appearance, feel, smell, condition, quality indicators, foreign matter, and measured or estimated weight.
interpret_scope: Determine each product’s grade, classification, acceptability, and processing suitability from the observed characteristics and weight.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate grade grouping and disposition, including whether to retain, segregate, or discard products and foreign matter.
act_scope: Sort and prepare products by placing them in the designated containers, marking container grades, and recording required grade or identification information.

job_role_definition: Graphic Designers develop, refine, and deliver visual concepts, graphics, and layouts based on client objectives, audience needs, source materials, and production requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather client objectives, audience information, source imagery and copy, feedback, and relevant presentation or production requirements.
interpret_scope: Determine the communication intent, audience implications, visual opportunities, constraints, and improvements indicated by source materials, drafts, and feedback.
decide_scope: Select design concepts, visual hierarchy, imagery, typography, layout, revisions, and appropriate preparation for the intended medium.
act_scope: Create and refine static or motion graphics, illustrations, and layouts, then deliver final production-ready files and handoff instructions.

job_role_definition: Grind, sand, clean, deburr, and polish workpieces by hand or with hand-held power tools to achieve the required surface condition and finish.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain finishing requirements from blueprints, templates, and layouts, and gather dimensional measurements and visible surface-condition information from workpieces.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, measurements, defects, and finished surfaces to determine required conformance and whether the achieved finish is acceptable.
decide_scope: Choose abrasives, tools, material-removal extent, finishing sequence, and corrective treatment suited to the workpiece material, shape, and specified finish.
act_scope: Position and prepare workpieces and tools, then hand-grind, sand, clean, trim, scrape, deburr, file, polish, chemically treat, and adjust equipment as needed to produce the required surface condition and finish.

occupation_name: Grinding, Lapping, Polishing, and Buffing Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Grinding, Lapping, Polishing, and Buffing Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and adjust grinding and related machine tools to finish metal or plastic workpieces to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain product specifications from blueprints, work orders, and machining instructions, and measure incoming workpieces and reference dimensions needed for finishing.
interpret_scope: Assess machine-operation observations and finished-workpiece measurements to identify operating problems and determine conformance to specification.
decide_scope: Select required tooling and determine machine settings, indexing, operational sequence, and corrective adjustments for the specified finish.
act_scope: Set up, load, secure, and operate or tend grinding, lapping, polishing, buffing, and related equipment; position and feed materials, apply coolant or lubricant, adjust equipment, and restore machine function as needed to finish workpieces.

job_role_definition: Perform grounds maintenance work not separately classified within other grounds maintenance occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain site-condition information and the materials, tools, equipment, and protective inputs needed for the assigned grounds-maintenance work.
interpret_scope: Assess ground, vegetation, surface, equipment, and safety conditions to determine the maintenance needs of the site.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate maintenance approach, work sequence, and resource use for the identified grounds conditions.
act_scope: Perform the assigned grounds-maintenance work to maintain the site in acceptable condition.

job_role_definition: Provide salon beauty services centered on consulting with clients and cutting, coloring, treating, and styling hair.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Elicit clients’ requested hair outcomes and obtain the hair, scalp, and appearance observations needed to provide the service.
interpret_scope: Assess those observations to determine suitable hair treatments and styles for the client.
decide_scope: Select and recommend the hair-cutting, coloring, treatment, and styling approach that fits the client’s goals and characteristics.
act_scope: Safely perform the selected hair preparation, cutting, coloring, treatment, styling, and applicable hairpiece services, including sanitation of tools and work areas.

job_role_definition: Identify, contain, remove, process, transport, store, and dispose of hazardous or contaminated materials safely.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Locate and monitor hazardous or contaminated materials and conditions, and obtain the handling, containment, and destination information needed for safe removal.
interpret_scope: Assess monitoring results and material characteristics to classify contamination and determine its required handling and disposal category.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate containment, decontamination, processing, packaging, transport, storage, recycling, or disposal approach within required safety procedures.
act_scope: Build containment; remove, limit, clean, process, package, load, transport, store, secure, treat, and dispose of hazardous or contaminated materials, including emergency and specialized wastes.

job_role_definition: Plan, deliver, coordinate, and evaluate health education programs that address individual and community health needs.
acquire_scope: Gather community health-needs, service-availability, program-activity, performance, and stakeholder inputs through assessments, surveys, records, partnerships, and evaluation data collection.
interpret_scope: Assess health needs and program evidence to identify priority audiences, service gaps, educational requirements, and program performance findings.
decide_scope: Set health education goals, operational plans, policies, program approaches, and improvement priorities in coordination with community and health partners.
act_scope: Develop, coordinate, supervise, publicize, and deliver health education programs, training, guidance, and educational resources, and implement selected program improvements.

job_role_definition: Design, implement, evaluate, and improve health information systems and informatics practices that support nursing and health care delivery.
acquire_scope: Gather clinical, nursing, workflow, system-performance, technology, research, and regulatory inputs through stakeholder elicitation, data collection, literature review, and solution testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze care, nursing, and information-system data and assess technologies, workflows, usability, safety, privacy, security, and operational needs to identify problems and evaluate solution performance.
decide_scope: Select system designs, data structures, decision-support approaches, implementation or modification strategies, and privacy, confidentiality, security, and operating policies suited to health care delivery.
act_scope: Design, configure, implement, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve health information and telehealth solutions, and operationalize them through policies, stakeholder translation, consultation, training, and documentation.

occupation_name: Health Information Technologists and Medical Registrars
job_role_definition: Designs, evaluates, secures, and supports computerized healthcare information systems.
acquire_scope: Gather healthcare information-system requirements, record retrieval needs, operational and security data, and applicable privacy, security, legislative, and accreditation requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze system, database, and health-record information against performance, reliability, confidentiality, and compliance criteria to identify needs and assess system condition.
decide_scope: Select system and database designs, security and privacy controls, information-management approaches, and recommendations for improvements or upgrades.
act_scope: Design, operate, maintain, secure, and support healthcare information systems and record indexes, including maintaining procedures, codes, and queries and delivering security and privacy education.

occupation_name: Health Information Technologists and Medical Registrars
job_role_definition: Abstracts, classifies, maintains, and reports patient and disease information for clinical, administrative, and research use.
acquire_scope: Retrieve and compile patient medical records and related care, census, and disease data, obtaining clarification for missing, conflicting, or unclear documentation.
interpret_scope: Abstract and assess clinical documentation to determine the patient and disease information that should be represented in health records and reporting data.
decide_scope: Select the applicable standardized diagnostic classifications, codes, and diagnosis-related groups.
act_scope: Maintain secure health-information indexes, storage and retrieval records, and produce clinical, administrative, and research reports from the classified information.

job_role_definition: Teach and support postsecondary students in health-specialty disciplines through instruction, assessment, advising, curriculum development, and related faculty responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Gather current health-specialty knowledge, student learning evidence, and instructional materials needed to prepare and support courses.
interpret_scope: Assess student work, examinations, participation, and supervised practical work to determine learning progress and support needs.
decide_scope: Set course content, instructional methods, assessment approaches, and academic or career guidance based on disciplinary developments and student needs.
act_scope: Deliver and facilitate instruction, supervise laboratory, internship, research, and teaching activities, assess students, and provide academic and vocational advising.

occupation_name: Health Technologists and Technicians, All Other
job_role_name: Health Technologists and Technicians, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform specialized health technology or technical services not classified in another health technologist or technician occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information, materials, and measurements required for the particular specialized health technical service.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to establish findings or task-relevant technical meaning.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate technical approach, priorities, or disposition for the service.
act_scope: Perform the specialized health technology or technical service not classified in another health technologist or technician occupation.

occupation_name: Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors
job_role_definition: Applies engineering and industrial health principles to prevent workplace injuries, illnesses, hazards, and safety violations.
acquire_scope: Obtain workplace evidence through incident interviews, facility and equipment inspections, exposure and structural testing, and review of plans, programs, records, applicable requirements, industrial processes, and health and accident data.
interpret_scope: Determine incident causes, exposure and health risks, injury and illness patterns, the adequacy of safety programs and corrective actions, equipment and facility hazards, and the meaning and satisfaction of applicable safety requirements.
decide_scope: Select preventive and corrective controls, required changes, safety requirements, and technical recommendations for managing identified workplace hazards and health concerns.
act_scope: Implement selected hazard controls and safety-device installations, deliver safety training and technical guidance, report findings, explain applicable requirements, and write or revise safety regulations and codes.

occupation_name: Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors
job_role_definition: Applies engineering principles to ensure products and equipment are designed, tested, labeled, and standardized to minimize hazards to users.
acquire_scope: Obtain product designs, machinery plans and specifications, safety research, hazard information, and applicable regulations and industrial requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze the evidence to assess design safety, foreseeable misuse and health hazards, and conformance with safety requirements.
decide_scope: Determine needed hazard-detection, prevention, and elimination measures, including safety requirements, precautionary labeling content, and product-safety standards.
act_scope: Apply the selected measures by developing safety standards and usage labels and designing and building safety equipment.

occupation_name: Healthcare Diagnosing or Treating Practitioners, All Other
job_role_name: Healthcare Diagnosing or Treating Practitioners, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide healthcare diagnostic or treatment services within practitioner specialties not separately classified in O*NET.
acquire_scope: Obtain specialty-relevant patient histories, examination findings, observations, test results, and other clinical inputs needed to provide diagnostic or treatment services.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical findings and specialty-relevant information to form diagnostic conclusions and assess therapeutic implications.
decide_scope: Select an appropriate treatment approach, care plan, referral, or other clinical course within the practitioner specialty.
act_scope: Communicate diagnostic findings and deliver the selected treatment services and associated patient care within the practitioner specialty.

occupation_name: Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Provides healthcare practitioner or technical services not classified under another specific O*NET healthcare occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information, materials, measurements, and other inputs required for the particular healthcare practitioner or technical service being provided.
interpret_scope: Assess the obtained inputs to establish their task-relevant meaning for the particular service.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate service approach, priorities, or disposition based on that assessment.
act_scope: Provide the healthcare practitioner or technical service within the role's stated scope.

job_role_definition: Provide psychosocial support, counseling, advocacy, care coordination, and resource referrals to help patients and families cope with illness and access healthcare and related services.
acquire_scope: Gather psychosocial, medical, environmental, family, safety, and service-access information through interviews, records review, consultation, and progress monitoring.
interpret_scope: Assess patients’ and families’ needs, conditions, barriers, goals, coping, safety risks, and response to care.
decide_scope: Determine care, rehabilitation, discharge, treatment-plan adjustment, protective, advocacy, and referral priorities in coordination with patients, families, and relevant professionals.
act_scope: Provide counseling and family or group support, educate patients and families about symptoms and care options, advocate during crises, initiate protective measures, coordinate and follow through on care and rehabilitation, and arrange referrals and discharge services.

job_role_definition: Provide healthcare support services not classified in another specific healthcare support occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the patient, service, and material inputs required to provide the applicable healthcare support service.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to understand the immediate support needs and relevant service conditions.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate support-service priorities and method within the assigned work.
act_scope: Provide the applicable healthcare support service not classified in another specific healthcare support occupation.

job_role_definition: Evaluate hearing needs and provide, fit, maintain, and support hearing aids and related assistive listening devices for clients.
acquire_scope: Obtain hearing-history and ear-status inputs, administer hearing and related screening tests, and create or modify earmold and hearing-aid-shell impressions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate test, screening, and procedure results to assess hearing needs and related disabilities.
decide_scope: Select appropriate tests, hearing aids or assistive listening devices, fitting specifications, maintenance measures, and communication-support approaches.
act_scope: Provide, fit, adjust, maintain, and repair hearing and assistive listening devices; demonstrate and train their use; and counsel clients and families on communication strategies and hearing-loss effects.

occupation_name: Heat Treating Equipment Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Heat Treating Equipment Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, or tend thermal-processing equipment to heat treat metal or plastic objects to specified properties.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain processing requirements and gather temperature, timing, equipment-condition, appearance, and hardness evidence throughout processing.
interpret_scope: Assess process indicators and part appearance and hardness against specified material properties.
decide_scope: Select processing sequences, heat cycles, equipment settings, coils, and quenching media needed to achieve the required properties.
act_scope: Set up and operate thermal-processing equipment, mount and load stock, apply and adjust heating cycles, and remove, quench, or cool parts to achieve specified properties.

occupation_name: Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers
job_role_definition: Installs and commissions heating, air-conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration systems and their associated controls and components.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain installation requirements from plans, specifications, wiring diagrams, manufacturer guidance, site measurements, and electrical, system, and leak-test readings.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, layout conditions, and test results to determine component configuration, installation conformity, balance, and faults or leaks.
decide_scope: Select equipment placement, component arrangement, connections, control adjustments, and corrective actions needed to meet the specified installation and commissioning requirements.
act_scope: Install, mount, fabricate, connect, wire, align, adjust, and commission heating, air-conditioning, ventilation, refrigeration, heat-pump, dehumidification, air-purification, and associated control systems safely.

occupation_name: Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers
job_role_definition: Diagnoses, repairs, and maintains heating, air-conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather user-reported symptoms, inspect and test HVAC/R systems, electrical circuits, and piping for faults or leaks, and obtain the parts and materials needed for service.
interpret_scope: Evaluate test results, system condition, and user feedback to identify malfunctions, deficiencies, leaks, compliance issues, and maintenance needs.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate repair, replacement, control adjustment, preventive maintenance, or efficiency-improvement approach and recommend needed service.
act_scope: Safely repair, replace, install, adjust, overhaul, reclaim refrigerant from, and maintain heating, air-conditioning, ventilation, refrigeration, heat-pump, and air-purification equipment, then verify proper operation.

job_role_definition: Operates heavy trucks and tractor-trailers to transport and deliver loads while preparing the vehicle, trailer, and cargo for safe movement and handoff.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather assignment, shipping, route, and delivery information, and inspect the vehicle, trailer, cargo, safety equipment, and load documentation before and during transport.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle and load readiness, route and delivery requirements, cargo-handling needs, and changing travel conditions affecting safe completion.
decide_scope: Choose or adjust the route, vehicle and trailer setup, cargo-handling approach, and corrective actions needed to complete the delivery safely.
act_scope: Couple and position the tractor-trailer, secure the load, operate the vehicle to transport it safely, and complete the delivery handoff.

job_role_definition: Assist construction trades workers with general labor and support activities across construction projects.
acquire_scope: Obtain work instructions and assemble the materials, tools, and site inputs needed to assist construction trades workers.
interpret_scope: Understand assigned instructions, trade-worker needs, and relevant site conditions to carry out support work correctly.
decide_scope: Select the immediate work sequence and handling approach needed to complete assigned assistance safely and effectively.
act_scope: Perform general labor and support activities that enable construction trades workers to complete project work.

occupation_name: Helpers--Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, and Tile and Marble Setters
job_role_name: Helpers--Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, and Tile and Marble Setters
job_role_definition: Assist masonry, tile, and stone workers by handling materials and tools, preparing and cleaning work areas, and performing less-skilled installation and repair duties.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, transport, position, cut, mix, sequence, and organize the materials, tools, equipment, and prepared work surfaces needed for masonry, tile, and stone installation or repair.
interpret_scope: Read drawings or numbered sequences and assess material, installation, and surface conditions to determine applicable sizes, placement requirements, and defects.
decide_scope: Select adjustments to moving, mixing, grouting, grinding, polishing, or cleaning procedures based on installation and material requirements.
act_scope: Set up access structures and assist with installing, repairing, rebuilding, grouting, sealing, finishing, cleaning, removing, and correcting masonry, tile, and stone surfaces.

job_role_definition: Assist carpenters by preparing and handling materials, maintaining work areas, and performing supervised lower-skill construction and finishing work.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Select and transport required tools, equipment, and materials; obtain layouts, measurements, marks, and reference lines for supervised construction and finishing work.
interpret_scope: Assess measurements, reference points, fit, level, plumb, square, and surface condition to identify alignment, placement, and finishing requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the immediate supervised work sequence, positioning, adjustments, and handling approach needed to complete assigned work safely and accurately.
act_scope: Prepare and maintain the work area and physically assist with cutting, drilling, positioning, fastening, forming, bracing, installing, finishing, and covering construction materials.

job_role_definition: Assist electricians with the installation, maintenance, repair, and construction of electrical systems by preparing materials, performing semi-skilled support work, and maintaining work areas and equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, organize, transport, and examine the tools, materials, equipment, measurements, test readings, and site conditions needed for assigned electrical work.
interpret_scope: Use measurements, test readings, and observations to identify wiring faults and determine the condition and installation or repair needs of electrical components.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate materials, component disposition, and immediate work method or sequence for assigned installation, maintenance, repair, or construction support.
act_scope: Carry out assigned site preparation and semi-skilled installation, construction, maintenance, and repair work by fabricating, routing, connecting, positioning, securing, replacing, and finishing electrical components.

job_role_definition: Assist extraction craft workers by preparing, supplying, maintaining, and supporting equipment and work sites for excavation and boring operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, transport, unload, organize, and load materials and equipment; observe operating equipment; and collect geological matter needed to support excavation and boring work.
interpret_scope: Evaluate equipment observations and geological matter to identify problems and assess equipment, material, or site conditions.
decide_scope: Select equipment adjustments, maintenance responses, material preparations, and work-start timing needed to support extraction operations.
act_scope: Prepare, clean, and restore work sites; set up, adjust, maintain, repair, and dismantle equipment; signal workers; dig trenches; and provide physical assistance during excavation and boring.

job_role_definition: Assist installation, maintenance, and repair workers by furnishing materials, preparing work areas, and performing supporting equipment service tasks.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Assemble, transfer, supply, and order the tools, parts, equipment, and materials needed, and ready work stations and equipment for service work.
interpret_scope: Inspect, test, and observe machinery, equipment, components, and electrical systems to identify defects and verify safe, efficient operation.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate service adjustment, connection, replacement, repair approach, and required materials from work requirements and inspection findings.
act_scope: Assist installation, maintenance, and repair work by positioning equipment; installing, connecting, adjusting, servicing, fabricating, disassembling, and reassembling components; and cleaning, lubricating, or protecting equipment and work areas.

occupation_name: Helpers--Painters, Paperhangers, Plasterers, and Stucco Masons
job_role_name: Helpers--Painters, Paperhangers, Plasterers, and Stucco Masons
job_role_definition: Assist painters, paperhangers, plasterers, and stucco masons by preparing work areas and surfaces, handling tools and materials, and performing lower-skill support duties.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Gather, stage, and measure the tools, materials, chemicals, plaster, and access equipment needed to support surface-finishing work.
interpret_scope: Assess surface conditions and prescribed materials or treatment times to identify the required preparation steps.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate preparation method, tools, material quantities, and work sequence within prescribed requirements.
act_scope: Prepare and protect work areas and surfaces by cleaning, masking, patching, smoothing, stripping, erecting scaffolding, mixing and delivering plaster, handling supplies, and cleaning equipment.

job_role_definition: Assists pipefitters and steamfitters with fabricating, installing, and maintaining industrial and mechanical piping systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure piping runs; select and obtain the required pipe, fittings, tools, equipment, and materials; and prepare pipe surfaces and openings for fabrication or service.
interpret_scope: Determine required pipe dimensions, routing, fit, support locations, and the condition of piping components from measurements, layouts, and observed wear or damage.
decide_scope: Choose the appropriate pipe type and size, materials, tools, and fitting or replacement approach within the assigned piping work.
act_scope: Assist with fabricating, lifting, supporting, installing, connecting, bending, maintaining, cleaning, and removing industrial and mechanical piping, valves, assemblies, and steam traps.

job_role_definition: Assists pipelayers with excavating, placing, joining, and removing underground water and sewer pipe.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain tools, equipment, pipe, and materials, and take the measurements needed for underground water and sewer pipe work.
interpret_scope: Assess measurements, pipe condition, trench grade, and fit to establish requirements for cutting, placement, joining, or removal.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate pipe type, size, materials, tools, and work sequence for the assigned installation or removal.
act_scope: Excavate and grade ditches; cut, thread, assemble, lift, place, support, join, disassemble, and remove underground water and sewer pipe.

job_role_definition: Assists plumbers with installing, repairing, and supporting building plumbing fixtures and piping systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure pipe; obtain and transport the required tools, equipment, and materials; and locate leaks, breaks, or worn components.
interpret_scope: Assess measurements, routing conditions, and observed defects to determine fit, support, installation, and repair requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the appropriate pipe type and size, material use, and practical repair or replacement approach for the assigned plumbing work.
act_scope: Assist in installing, supporting, repairing, replacing, removing, and connecting building plumbing piping and fixtures, including cutting and assembling pipe and creating required openings and supports.

job_role_definition: Support production workers through routine material handling, machine assistance, product processing, inspection, packing, and work-area upkeep.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect and measure products, observe equipment operations, read gauges, and obtain counts and operating data needed to monitor production work.
interpret_scope: Determine product conformance, classification, and order completeness from observed characteristics and specifications, and recognize equipment malfunctions from operating conditions.
decide_scope: Select the prescribed routing or disposition of materials and products and whether equipment conditions require adjustment, stoppage, or notification.
act_scope: Supply, prepare, position, load, process, finish, identify, pack, store, and transfer materials and products; assist with operating and regulating equipment; report findings; and maintain equipment and work areas.

job_role_definition: Assist roofers with preparing work areas, handling materials and equipment, and performing supporting installation, repair, maintenance, and cleanup duties.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, move, hoist, and ready roofing materials, tools, access equipment, and heated tar, and inspect roof areas and completed work for condition and water intrusion.
interpret_scope: Identify worn, torn, or leaking roof areas and determine whether completed roofing is watertight.
decide_scope: Select immediate repair, maintenance, installation-support, and work-sequencing actions based on roof findings and assigned work.
act_scope: Prepare work areas and carry out assigned roof removal, installation, repair, maintenance, access setup, equipment upkeep, drainage clearing, and cleanup work in support of roofers.

job_role_definition: Maintain safe, serviceable roads, highways, runways, and rights-of-way through repair, clearing, seasonal operations, and upkeep of related infrastructure.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect road surfaces, drainage systems, structures, roadway markers, and roadside and seasonal conditions; measure installation locations; and assemble the materials and work-zone inputs required for maintenance.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection and measurement results to identify defects, obstructions, hazards, treatment needs, and installation accuracy.
decide_scope: Select and prioritize appropriate repair, clearing, seasonal-treatment, roadside-upkeep, roadway-feature, and work-zone traffic-control actions.
act_scope: Establish traffic control and perform pavement, shoulder, drainage, structural, roadside, snow-and-ice, and roadway-feature maintenance to keep roads, highways, runways, and rights-of-way safe and serviceable.

job_role_definition: Prepare and maintain tissue specimens and histological slides for microscopic examination and pathological diagnosis.
acquire_scope: Receive, identify, and assemble tissue specimens, processing materials, reagents, and functioning laboratory equipment required for histologic preparation.
interpret_scope: Assess specimen characteristics and processing or slide quality to determine their readiness and suitability for microscopic examination.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate tissue-processing, embedding, sectioning, freezing, staining, and preservation approach for each specimen.
act_scope: Process, embed or freeze, section, mount, stain, preserve, archive, and maintain the specimens, slides, and equipment needed to deliver diagnostic-ready histologic materials.

job_role_definition: Research, interpret, preserve, and communicate evidence-based accounts and materials concerning the past.
acquire_scope: Gather, interview for, and organize archival, published, visual, oral, biographical, and translated historical source materials needed for research and preservation work.
interpret_scope: Assess sources for authenticity and significance, trace historical development, and develop evidence-based accounts, findings, theories, and authenticity advice.
decide_scope: Select or pursue research topics and recommend historically appropriate collection, conservation, reconstruction, and exhibit actions.
act_scope: Preserve historical records and artifacts and communicate accurate historical materials through publications, exhibits, public programming, teaching, presentations, and consultation.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary history courses while conducting scholarship and contributing to student support, academic service, and institutional programs.
acquire_scope: Gather historical sources, current scholarship, student work and progress information, instructional resources, and institutional or disciplinary input needed for teaching, research, student support, and academic service.
interpret_scope: Analyze historical evidence and scholarly developments, assess student learning and research work, and evaluate course, curricular, and institutional needs.
decide_scope: Set research questions and scholarly positions; select course content, instructional methods, assessments, student guidance, and recommendations for academic and institutional matters.
act_scope: Teach and moderate postsecondary history courses, conduct and publish scholarship, assess and advise students, supervise student work, and carry out academic service and institutional-program responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Prepare, process, stain, and quality-check tissue specimens and slides for microscopic examination and pathological diagnosis.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble specimens, requisitions, reagents, and stains, and generate slide, specimen, and instrument evidence through testing, measurement, and microscopic examination.
interpret_scope: Evaluate tissue structures, cell components, test results, slide appearance, and instrument performance to establish specimen findings, preparation quality, and sources of error.
decide_scope: Select applicable processing, sectioning, staining, and histochemical protocols, determine slide dispositions, and choose corrections for preparation or equipment problems.
act_scope: Process, embed, section, stain, and otherwise prepare tissue specimens, implement selected corrections, and compile and distribute acceptable slides and related materials for examination and diagnosis.

job_role_definition: Operate or tend power-driven hoists and winches to lift, pull, position, and move loads and materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain load weight and size specifications and monitor operating signals, cable marks, gauges, and indicators needed to control the move.
interpret_scope: Assess the signals and equipment readings to determine load position, depth, movement, and operating condition.
decide_scope: Select loads within specified limits and choose the required movement, speed, and stopping or locking actions.
act_scope: Set up and tend hoisting equipment and auxiliaries, secure or release loads, coordinate loading and unloading, and operate hoists or winches to lift, pull, position, and move materials.

job_role_definition: Installs and commissions household appliances by fitting, connecting, adjusting, and testing them for use.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure installation locations, obtain the appliance and required connection materials, and observe and test its operation after installation.
interpret_scope: Evaluate fit, connection conditions, and post-installation test results to determine whether the appliance is correctly positioned and functioning.
decide_scope: Select the required installation adjustments, connection configuration, and any minor site modifications needed for safe, proper use.
act_scope: Assemble, fit, level, connect, adjust, and finish household appliances for use, then instruct customers on their operation and care.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses and repairs household electric and gas appliances to restore safe operation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Elicit malfunction symptoms, inspect and disassemble appliances as needed, consult technical documentation, and test electrical, gas, and operating conditions before and after repair.
interpret_scope: Determine the fault, leak, unsafe condition, or performance deficiency from observations, tests, diagrams, specifications, and measured pressure, flow, and flame conditions.
decide_scope: Select the safe repair approach, required parts and adjustments, emergency response, and whether repair or replacement is the appropriate recommendation.
act_scope: Repair, reassemble, adjust, clean, lubricate, and safely restore household electric and gas appliances, recover refrigerants when applicable, and communicate estimates, recommendations, and operating-care instructions.

job_role_definition: Provide in-home personal care and routine health support that helps patients safely manage daily living while following nursing or medical direction.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe patients’ condition, measure routine vital signs, and obtain prescribed-care instructions and the medications, meal items, and other materials required for in-home support.
interpret_scope: Identify meaningful changes, progress, problems, and routine support needs from patient observations and measurements.
decide_scope: Prioritize and organize daily personal-care, routine health-support, meal, exercise, and outing activities within prescribed nursing or medical direction.
act_scope: Deliver in-home personal care and routine health support through mobility, hygiene, meals, prescribed medications and treatments, exercises, companionship, instruction, household assistance, and accompanied trips, while documenting and reporting care and patient findings.

job_role_definition: Provide and coordinate comprehensive medical care for patients during their hospital stay.
acquire_scope: Obtain inpatient histories, examinations, monitoring findings, laboratory and imaging results, and consultation information needed to manage each hospitalization.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical information and test results to determine patients’ conditions, progress, and care needs.
decide_scope: Select diagnoses, medication and treatment regimens, admission and discharge plans, referrals, consultations, and care priorities.
act_scope: Provide continuous inpatient care and implement and coordinate the selected plan with care staff, specialists, patients, and primary care physicians, including discharge documentation.

occupation_name: Hosts and Hostesses, Restaurant, Lounge, and Coffee Shop
job_role_name: Hosts and Hostesses, Restaurant, Lounge, and Coffee Shop
job_role_definition: Welcome, seat, and assist patrons while coordinating reservations and the front-of-house dining experience.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain reservation requests, calls, inquiries, patron needs and feedback, and observe table availability, service status, and front-of-house readiness.
interpret_scope: Assess patron requirements, seating suitability, service balance, wait implications, and dining-area conditions.
decide_scope: Select reservation arrangements, table or waiting-area assignments, and priorities for coordinating service and addressing concerns.
act_scope: Record reservations; welcome, guide, and seat patrons; provide menus and establishment information; and coordinate with patrons and staff to maintain prompt, courteous service.

occupation_name: Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
job_role_name: Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
job_role_definition: Provide front-desk services that support guests throughout the reservation, arrival, stay, and departure process.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain reservation, availability, guest identity and payment details, account charges, guest requests or complaints, and incoming communications needed to serve guests.
interpret_scope: Verify payment eligibility and reconcile reservation, availability, charge, and account information to establish each guest's lodging and billing status.
decide_scope: Select room assignments, payment arrangements, guest-service responses, referrals, and appropriate arrangements for requested local services.
act_scope: Deliver front-desk service by registering and checking out guests, confirming reservations, issuing access and instructions, maintaining accounts and charges, collecting payment, communicating with guests and hotel staff, arranging requested services, and safeguarding valuables.

job_role_definition: Evaluates and improves workplaces, equipment, and work practices to reduce physical hazards, discomfort, and injury.
acquire_scope: Gather workplace, worker, incident, and exposure inputs through site inspections, observation, interviews, record review, and ergonomic measurements.
interpret_scope: Analyze work tasks, physical demands, anthropometric fit, hazards, and work-system performance to assess injury and discomfort risks and evaluate potential solutions.
decide_scope: Determine ergonomic priorities and recommend workplace, equipment, procedure, staffing, or training changes, including the resources needed to pursue them.
act_scope: Design, communicate, and help implement ergonomic improvements by modifying work arrangements or task sequences, training users, documenting findings, and representing end-user needs.

job_role_definition: Designs and evaluates products, interfaces, and complex systems to optimize human-system usability, safety, and performance.
acquire_scope: Gather user needs, work-activity observations, anthropometric and performance measurements, test evidence, and system or design information needed to assess human-system interaction.
interpret_scope: Analyze functional, task, usability, ergonomic, cognitive, statistical, and system evidence to determine human-performance implications, limitations, and opportunities for improvement.
decide_scope: Set human-factors requirements, evaluation methods, operating or training needs, and recommended design or system changes that optimize usability, safety, and performance.
act_scope: Design, evaluate, validate, and integrate human-factors solutions into products, interfaces, work systems, hardware, procedures, and cognitive aids, communicating resulting conclusions to project stakeholders.

occupation_name: Human Resources Assistants, Except Payroll and Timekeeping
job_role_name: Human Resources Assistants, Except Payroll and Timekeeping
job_role_definition: Maintains personnel records and provides administrative support for employee services, recruitment, benefits, onboarding, training, and related human resources activities.
acquire_scope: Collect, verify, and retrieve personnel, applicant, policy, benefits, assessment, and training information needed to maintain records and support employee services and recruitment.
interpret_scope: Review personnel files, applications, references, and assessment results to establish qualifications, eligibility, employment acceptability, and information responsive to authorized inquiries.
decide_scope: Select qualified applicants for referral and choose appropriate responses and processing steps under established procedures.
act_scope: Process and maintain personnel records and documents, provide policy and benefit assistance, communicate personnel information, and coordinate recruitment, onboarding, assessments, training, and reporting.

job_role_definition: Directs an organization's workforce planning, staffing, employee relations, personnel policies, and human resources programs.
acquire_scope: Gather workforce forecasts, vacancy and applicant information, personnel records and metrics, employee concerns, training needs, job data, and compensation, benefits, safety, and compliance requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess workforce and personnel data, applicant qualifications, employee-relations issues, exit feedback, job classifications, and policy, contract, and legal requirements to identify needs, causes, and implications.
decide_scope: Set workforce plans, staffing selections and placements, personnel-policy and program changes, compensation and benefits approaches, training and safety priorities, disciplinary dispositions, and personnel budgets.
act_scope: Direct and administer staffing, compensation, benefits, performance, employee-relations, training, labor-relations, safety, orientation, and employee-separation activities; advise managers, inform employees, resolve disputes, and represent the organization in personnel proceedings.

job_role_definition: Directs labor-management relations, including collective bargaining, contract administration, dispute resolution, and related proceedings.
acquire_scope: Gather labor-contract terms, employee and management concerns, dispute facts, staffing and disciplinary information, and relevant legislation, arbitration decisions, and industry developments.
interpret_scope: Assess contractual, legal, and factual implications for labor matters, including employee questions, grievances, disputes, discipline, and bargaining conditions.
decide_scope: Set labor-relations priorities, bargaining positions, contract-administration approaches, dispute dispositions, and the direction of related staff work.
