act_scope: Direct labor-management relations by negotiating and administering agreements, resolving work-related disputes, managing related personnel actions, coordinating staff, and representing the organization in hearings and investigations.

job_role_name: Employee Relations and HR Operations Specialists
job_role_definition: Employee Relations and HR Operations Specialists resolve workplace concerns and administer employment events by applying policies, maintaining records, and guiding employees and managers.
acquire_scope: Gather employee concerns, case facts, employment-event details, relevant records, and applicable policies, standards, or requirements needed for HR service delivery.
interpret_scope: Evaluate concerns and employment events against applicable policies and requirements to identify workplace issues, procedural needs, and implications for employees or managers.
decide_scope: Select case resolutions, employment-processing steps, and policy or management interventions appropriate to workplace issues and employee lifecycle events.
act_scope: Resolve employee relations matters, process and document employment actions, and implement policies through orientations, explanations, and manager guidance.

job_role_definition: Recruiters and Talent Acquisition Specialists attract, assess, and select qualified candidates, then facilitate hiring to meet organizational staffing needs.
acquire_scope: Gather staffing requirements, applications, profiles, and recruiting-market data; conduct interviews; and obtain assessment and background results.
interpret_scope: Evaluate candidate evidence against job, licensing, and selection requirements to determine qualifications and fit, and assess recruiting methods for effectiveness, validity, and conformity.
decide_scope: Select sourcing strategies, candidates for referral or hire, hiring dispositions, assessment methods, and warranted changes to selection criteria.
act_scope: Implement sourcing campaigns, coordinate assessments and checks, advise hiring managers, communicate job terms and dispositions, and process selected hires.

job_role_definition: Operate, monitor, inspect, maintain, and repair hydroelectric generating equipment and supporting plant infrastructure.
acquire_scope: Monitor equipment performance, inspect generating units and plant infrastructure, take operating readings, and obtain condition information needed to operate and maintain the facility.
interpret_scope: Assess operating data, inspections, and test results to identify deviations, equipment malfunctions, contamination risks, and maintenance or repair needs.
decide_scope: Determine required operating adjustments, equipment disposition, and maintenance or repair actions within operating specifications and issued load or switching orders.
act_scope: Operate and adjust generating, switching, and auxiliary equipment; carry out containment, preventive maintenance, installation, calibration, repair, replacement, and associated access and fabrication work to keep the plant infrastructure functional.

job_role_definition: Manage the safe, reliable, compliant, and efficient operation, maintenance, and improvement of hydroelectric power generation facilities.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Monitor and inspect generating, transmission, control, and facility equipment, and assemble operating, maintenance, safety, environmental, demand, and engineering information.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment and facility condition, operating performance, emergencies, operating-limit deviations, compliance, production needs, and improvement opportunities from operational and technical evidence.
decide_scope: Set operating and voltage schedules, production and maintenance plans, emergency and environmental-response priorities, operating procedures, upgrades, and improvement approaches that meet safety, reliability, compliance, efficiency, and service requirements.
act_scope: Operate or direct facility and substation operations; supervise maintenance, repair, commissioning, installation, upgrades, and environmental-response work; communicate emergencies; and document facility activities.

job_role_definition: Collect, maintain, analyze, quality-check, and report hydrologic and environmental data in support of water-resource studies and decisions.
acquire_scope: Collect environmental samples and hydrologic measurements, investigate water and cryosphere conditions, and maintain study equipment and records needed to produce reliable data.
interpret_scope: Quality-check and analyze hydrologic and ecological data, develop predictive models, and derive findings on water conditions, impacts, and project implications.
decide_scope: Select data-supported conclusions, alternatives, and recommendations for water-resource studies, complaints, conservation, and environmental-impact questions.
act_scope: Deliver validated data and real-time flood information, answer technical requests, and prepare reports, maps, tables, and other materials that communicate findings.

job_role_definition: Studies hydrologic systems and applies scientific findings to water-resource, environmental, infrastructure, and climate-related decisions.
acquire_scope: Obtain, measure, map, and validate hydrologic, hydrogeologic, water-quality, climate, and cryosphere observations using calibrated monitoring equipment and field samples.
interpret_scope: Analyze observations and predictive models to characterize hydrologic systems and assess water availability, hazards, water quality, environmental effects, and climate conditions.
decide_scope: Select investigation methods and determine scientifically supported recommendations, feasibility findings, and priorities for water-resource, environmental, infrastructure, and climate-related matters.
act_scope: Conduct hydrologic research, develop and apply prediction models, communicate findings through evaluations, maps, charts, and reports, and design or oversee hydrographic civil works when required.

job_role_definition: Administers water-resource permitting and compliance programs and provides technical guidance concerning regulated water activities.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble permit applications, site-plan materials, complaint details, field observations, and information on regulated well and water-alteration activities.
interpret_scope: Evaluate hydrologic, geologic, and code-related information to assess proposed activities, compliance conditions, abandoned-well sealing needs, and water-related conflicts.
decide_scope: Select recommended permit dispositions, required modifications, enforcement or investigative responses, conflict alternatives, and draft order provisions.
act_scope: Administer permitting, compliance, and abandoned-well programs by overseeing and enforcing regulated activities, preparing regulatory actions, communicating progress, and providing technical guidance.

job_role_definition: Apply industrial-ecology principles and analysis to assess and improve the environmental performance and resource efficiency of industrial, social, and natural systems.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain research, field, monitoring, incident, land- and water-use, industrial-practice, pollutant, material, energy, ecosystem, and regulatory information needed to evaluate interconnected systems.
interpret_scope: Apply flow, input-output, statistical, ecological, behavioral, energy, forecasting, and impact analyses to determine system relationships, environmental effects, hazards, liabilities, projected conditions, and program effectiveness.
decide_scope: Select environmentally sustainable alternatives, impact-reduction and pollution-control methods, resource-management plans, energy-investment scenarios, monitoring approaches, and recommendations that balance environmental and economic consequences.
act_scope: Deliver assessments and technical findings, redesign or translate systems into closed-loop eco-industrial practices, promote environmental management measures, and carry out protection, mitigation, restoration, and related applied projects.

job_role_definition: Applies engineering methods to measure industrial operations, develop production systems, and implement process, layout, equipment, and quality improvements.
acquire_scope: Gather process measurements and product test results, retrieve operating records and technical requirements, and observe workers, equipment, materials, and facilities.
interpret_scope: Analyze operational, quality, cost, and reliability evidence against technical and regulatory requirements to identify constraints, nonconformance, risks, and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Establish production standards and improvement priorities, then select methods, layouts, resource plans, controls, and corrective or preventive changes.
act_scope: Develop, implement, and verify industrial engineering solutions through production methods and layouts, process or equipment changes, and operating or quality-control programs.

job_role_definition: Designs and improves integrated production systems, workflows, layouts, and resource-use methods to increase industrial efficiency.
acquire_scope: Gather production schedules, specifications, orders, forecasts, operational-flow information, stakeholder requirements, and current cost and manufacturing records.
interpret_scope: Analyze production data, material and worker flows, costs, capacities, and statistical calculations to assess processes, resource needs, and efficiency constraints.
decide_scope: Select integrated production methods, operation sequences, utilization standards, layout approaches, and scheduling priorities that improve efficiency.
act_scope: Produce and maintain the resulting system designs, layouts, standards, analyses, and current engineering documentation, and adjust workflows and deliveries to carry out the selected approach.

job_role_definition: Develops and implements quality and reliability standards and controls for industrial products and processes.
acquire_scope: Obtain product specifications, engineering drawings, equipment-performance measurements, and quality and reliability data through sampling, measurement, inspection, and testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze product and process data, measurement-system performance, and nonconformities to assess quality, reliability, costs, and responsibility.
decide_scope: Establish quality and reliability standards and objectives, sampling and data-recording approaches, corrective-action plans, and dispositions for discrepant materials and defective parts.
act_scope: Coordinate and implement selected quality controls, corrective and material-disposition procedures, data-recording and reporting instructions, and worker-directed inspection and testing activities.

job_role_definition: Industrial Machinery Mechanics diagnose, repair, adjust, install, and verify industrial machinery to maintain or restore dependable operation.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect and test machinery, examine components, and gather operator reports, error messages, blueprints, manuals, and other diagnostic information.
interpret_scope: Evaluate equipment behavior, component condition, and test results to identify malfunctions, wear, installation requirements, and probable causes.
decide_scope: Select repair, replacement, adjustment, fabrication, programming, or installation actions and determine how restored operation will be verified.
act_scope: Disassemble and reassemble equipment, perform mechanical or control-system repairs and maintenance, and operate machinery to verify satisfactory performance.

job_role_definition: Plans, staffs, directs, and controls manufacturing operations and resources to deliver products meeting quantity, quality, cost, schedule, safety, and environmental requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather production orders and schedules, operational and quality data, resource and cost information, and current technical, safety, and environmental requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess schedules, tests, reports, and operating conditions to identify quality deviations, resource constraints, safety risks, maintenance needs, and production problems.
decide_scope: Set production standards, budgets, staffing, inventory, maintenance, and work priorities; choose corrective actions, operating procedures, and product or process improvements.
act_scope: Manage and direct manufacturing personnel, implement controls and normal or emergency procedures, and coordinate corrective work to meet production, quality, cost, schedule, safety, and environmental targets.

job_role_definition: Operate powered industrial trucks, tractors, and related equipment to load, transport, position, and unload materials within facilities and yards.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect loads, destinations, and handling requirements, and obtain material weight or production data when required for movement or release.
interpret_scope: Assess load accuracy, stability, clearance, and handling conditions to determine safe material movement requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate vehicle or handling approach, travel path, and placement or release sequence for the material.
act_scope: Operate powered industrial trucks, tractors, lifting devices, and related handling equipment to load, transport, position, stack, unload, or release materials within facilities and yards.

job_role_definition: Apply psychological principles, assessment, research, and consulting to improve personnel decisions, workforce development, and organizational effectiveness.
acquire_scope: Gather workforce, job, performance, assessment, organizational, and relevant research evidence through observation, interviews, tests, surveys, and studies.
interpret_scope: Analyze and interpret psychological measures, job requirements, workforce data, and research results to assess people, development needs, and organizational functioning.
decide_scope: Determine selection, placement, development, performance, and organizational-improvement recommendations, including appropriate assessment criteria and intervention approaches.
act_scope: Deliver and implement selection, training, development, change, coaching, career, and consulting interventions, and communicate findings and recommendations to organizational stakeholders.

job_role_definition: Conduct ground combat operations using weapons, field equipment, communications, defensive positions, explosives, and reconnaissance capabilities.
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain situational information, communications, weapons, field equipment, defensive materials, explosives, and reconnaissance inputs required for ground combat operations.
interpret_scope: Assess terrain, threats, friendly-force status, reconnaissance findings, communications, and equipment conditions to establish the operational situation.
decide_scope: Select immediate tactical priorities, positioning, defensive measures, target engagement, movement, and use of available combat resources.
act_scope: Conduct ground combat operations by maneuvering, communicating, employing weapons and explosives, operating field equipment, and establishing or defending positions.

job_role_definition: Direct, train, and lead infantry units in ground combat operations.
acquire_scope: Obtain operational information on the mission, terrain, opposing forces, unit status, personnel, equipment, and supplies needed to prepare and conduct infantry operations.
interpret_scope: Assess operational information to determine mission requirements, threats, terrain effects, unit readiness, and training needs.
decide_scope: Select training priorities, tactical plans, unit organization, deployments, and operational priorities for infantry missions.
act_scope: Direct, train, and lead infantry units in ground combat operations.

job_role_definition: Protects computer networks and information by assessing risks and planning, implementing, monitoring, and improving security controls and incident safeguards.
acquire_scope: Gather threat intelligence, system and access activity, security test results, user requirements, and evidence of control failures or procedural violations.
interpret_scope: Assess threats, vulnerabilities, access patterns, test findings, and violations to determine security risk, control effectiveness, and needed corrective action.
decide_scope: Select risk mitigations, access changes, control updates, and emergency or violation responses based on security needs and assessed exposure.
act_scope: Implement and update safeguards, regulate access, coordinate security plans and responses, and establish procedures and user awareness that protect information systems.

job_role_definition: Design, implement, assess, and oversee security controls, practices, and responses that protect information systems and data.
acquire_scope: Collect security-relevant evidence through system and network monitoring, vulnerability scans, penetration tests, control-performance measures, risk assessments, system tests, incident investigations, and user-reported problems.
interpret_scope: Evaluate evidence to determine vulnerabilities, intrusions, incident damage, control effectiveness, security-measure functioning, compliance status, and the causes of security or network problems.
decide_scope: Select security improvements, protective-control designs, standards and practices, safeguards, incident response and recovery strategies, and priorities for resolving security problems.
act_scope: Design, deploy, troubleshoot, and oversee security controls, threat-detection tools, safeguards, policies, response activities, staff security practices, supporting documentation, and user use of security products.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and deliver information technology projects within agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and stakeholder requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather stakeholder requirements, project performance and milestone data, risk and cost information, resource availability, and supplier or consultant options needed to plan and manage the project.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, progress, quality, risks, costs, staffing capacity, team performance, and project trends to determine their implications for scope, schedule, budget, and delivery.
decide_scope: Set and revise project objectives, implementation and communication plans, work structure, budgets, staffing, assignments, resource and vendor selections, risk responses, and corrective priorities.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate project personnel and stakeholder communications, manage execution against commitments, facilitate project work, secure needed resources, and deliver conforming project outputs.

occupation_name: Information and Record Clerks, All Other
job_role_name: Information and Record Clerks, All Other
job_role_definition: Maintain, process, and provide organizational information and records in clerical support functions not classified elsewhere.
acquire_scope: Obtain incoming records, information, updates, and requests needed to maintain, process, and provide organizational information and records.
interpret_scope: Review and classify record content and requests to determine accuracy, completeness, organization, and relevant information.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate handling, routing, priority, and record disposition for routine clerical support work.
act_scope: Maintain and process organizational records and provide requested information or records through clerical support functions.

occupation_name: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
job_role_name: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
job_role_definition: Inspect, test, sort, sample, and weigh materials or products to determine and document conformance with specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain specifications and procedures, select and position samples or items, and inspect, test, measure, weigh, and monitor materials, products, installations, work, and equipment to gather conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate observations and measurements against applicable specifications, standards, purchase orders, environmental requirements, and qualification criteria to calculate results, determine conformance, and assign grades or classifications.
decide_scope: Select acceptance or rejection dispositions, needed corrective actions or adjustments, and production problems requiring escalation.
act_scope: Document and communicate results and discrepancies, mark, sort, segregate, or discard items according to their disposition, and implement selected equipment, product, or process corrections.

occupation_name: Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform installation, maintenance, and repair work not classified in a more specific installation, maintenance, or repair occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain work requirements, equipment specifications, tools, replacement materials, and condition observations, tests, or measurements needed for installation, maintenance, or repair work.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment and site conditions and diagnostic evidence to determine installation requirements, maintenance needs, or the source and extent of faults.
decide_scope: Select the installation method, maintenance procedure, repair approach, materials, and work sequence needed to establish or restore acceptable operation.
act_scope: Install, maintain, adjust, and repair equipment or systems to place them in or return them to acceptable working condition.

job_role_definition: Develops, evaluates, and coordinates curricula, instructional materials, learning systems, and educational program standards.
acquire_scope: Gather learner and performance needs, instructional-effectiveness evidence, subject-matter input, requirements, costs, and information on instructional methods, materials, and technologies.
interpret_scope: Assess needs, learning outcomes, instructional effectiveness, feasibility, technological currency, and applicable educational requirements to identify curriculum and program implications.
decide_scope: Set objectives, standards, policies, curriculum and delivery approaches, material and technology selections, recommended changes, and associated resource priorities.
act_scope: Develop, adapt, evaluate, document, and coordinate curricula, instructional materials, learning systems, and educational program standards, including implementation guidance and authorized resources.

job_role_definition: Improves teaching practice by observing, advising, and training educators in instructional methods and technology.
acquire_scope: Observe educators’ instructional practice and gather relevant curriculum, materials, technology, and program requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess the observed practice and instructional context to identify teaching strengths, needs, and opportunities for improvement.
decide_scope: Select recommendations and development priorities for instructional methods, materials, technology use, and related procedures.
act_scope: Advise and train educators through coaching, workshops, and training on improved instructional practice and technology integration.

occupation_name: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
job_role_name: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
job_role_definition: Install and finish insulating materials in floors, ceilings, walls, and related structural spaces to control heat, cold, or moisture.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements, inspect structural spaces, and measure surfaces and openings for insulation coverage.
interpret_scope: Evaluate plans, space characteristics, and thermal or moisture-control requirements to determine the needed insulation performance and coverage.
decide_scope: Choose the insulation materials and installation, distribution, and finishing approach suited to the structure.
act_scope: Safely remove existing insulation when required; prepare surfaces; cut, load, install, distribute, regulate, secure, seal, and finish insulation in floors, ceilings, walls, and related spaces.

job_role_definition: Install, repair, and protect insulation on mechanical systems to control temperature and noise.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job requirements from blueprints and specifications, assess mechanical-system surfaces and conditions, and measure materials for the required coverage.
interpret_scope: Translate requirements, equipment use, location, surface shape, and material properties into installation-relevant dimensions and protection needs.
decide_scope: Select the insulation materials, quantities, and installation approach needed to control temperature and noise and protect the system.
act_scope: Prepare surfaces; cut, shape, fit, install, repair, seal, finish, and apply protective coverings to insulation on mechanical systems.

job_role_definition: Appraise vehicle damage and determine repair costs, total-loss status, and salvage value for insurance claim settlement.
acquire_scope: Inspect damaged vehicles and obtain repair-shop estimates, automotive cost references, market-value information, and independent appraisal evidence when needed.
interpret_scope: Assess the extent of vehicle damage and derive repair parts, labor, and salvage-value estimates from the collected evidence.
decide_scope: Determine whether repair is practical or the vehicle is a total loss, and select the repair-cost and settlement recommendation.
act_scope: Reconcile repair costs with repair facilities, arrange additional appraisal to resolve cost disagreements, and document estimates and recommendations for claim settlement.

occupation_name: Insurance Claims and Policy Processing Clerks
job_role_definition: Processes insurance claims by verifying claim information and coverage, maintaining records, calculating claim amounts, and routing or issuing payments.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain claim details and missing documentation from insured parties and records, retrieve relevant policy and claim-file information, and assemble complete claim forms.
interpret_scope: Verify claim information and policy coverage, assess document completeness, and calculate the applicable claim amount.
decide_scope: Determine the claim’s payment disposition, including whether it should be paid, routed for further investigation, or referred for appropriate next steps.
act_scope: Maintain accurate claim records, communicate claim status or procedural information, and route or issue authorized claim payments.

occupation_name: Insurance Claims and Policy Processing Clerks
job_role_definition: Processes insurance applications and policy transactions by verifying data, maintaining records, and administering issuance, modification, reinstatement, and cancellation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain applications, policyholder or agent correspondence, supporting policy documents, cancellation records, payment information, and rate-standard inputs needed for policy transactions.
interpret_scope: Verify application and policy data, assess requested changes and their effects, compare reinstatement information with applicable criteria, and calculate transaction-related amounts.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate policy disposition or adjustment, including whether a reinstatement meets the criteria for approval.
act_scope: Process and record policy issuance, modification, reinstatement, and cancellation; maintain policy records, submit required forms, collect initial premiums, and communicate transaction status.

job_role_definition: Sell and service insurance coverage by assessing client needs and risks, recommending policies, and coordinating placement, renewal, and related support.
acquire_scope: Develop prospects and obtain client, property, financial, existing-coverage, claim, and policy-completion information needed to place and service coverage.
interpret_scope: Assess client needs and insurance risks, evaluate coverage options and policy terms, calculate premiums, and determine applicable program requirements.
decide_scope: Design suitable coverage programs, select the insurer and policy arrangements, and establish premium-payment and renewal or policy-change recommendations.
act_scope: Present and sell coverage, submit and coordinate applications and binders, deliver and renew policies, support claims, and coordinate required policy and group-program administration.

job_role_definition: Insurance Underwriters evaluate insurance applications and related exposures to determine whether coverage is acceptable and establish risk-appropriate terms or reinsurance.
acquire_scope: Review applications, supporting documents, company exposure records, reference materials, and additional information obtained from relevant parties.
interpret_scope: Assess applicant and property risk, expected and catastrophic loss potential, and aggregated insurance exposure against underwriting policies.
decide_scope: Determine whether to accept or decline risk and select appropriate coverage values, rates, endorsements, or reinsurance.
act_scope: Issue and communicate underwriting dispositions, apply selected policy terms and ratings, and authorize reinsurance for high-risk policies.

job_role_definition: Gather, analyze, evaluate, and communicate intelligence to identify and anticipate criminal and security threats.
acquire_scope: Collect, retrieve, observe, intercept, translate, and validate intelligence from records, sources, interviews, surveillance, communications, and technical collection tools.
interpret_scope: Correlate and analyze intelligence to assess criminal and security activity, relationships, assets and financial flows, patterns, locations, group structures, and emerging threats.
decide_scope: Set intelligence collection priorities and develop threat-informed defense, tactical, and communications-interception plans.
act_scope: Deliver intelligence findings, threat assessments, forecasts, and visual analyses through reports, briefings, maps, charts, and coordinated information sharing.

job_role_definition: Plan, design, and furnish functional, aesthetically appropriate interior environments for clients.
acquire_scope: Elicit client goals, budget, functional and aesthetic constraints; research applicable accessibility, health, safety, sustainability, material, product, and technology requirements; and gather site, construction, and shop-drawing information.
interpret_scope: Assess client and environmental requirements, codes, spatial conditions, construction details, material suitability, and estimated quantities and costs to establish feasible design constraints.
decide_scope: Determine the practical, aesthetically appropriate, code-compliant spatial plan, layout, colors, materials, furnishings, accessories, and environmental features for the interior environment.
act_scope: Communicate and document the approved design through drawings and construction documents, advise clients, procure and arrange specified furnishings and finishes, coordinate delivery work, and verify construction conforms to the design.

job_role_definition: Convey spoken or signed messages between languages during live or consecutive communication.
acquire_scope: Obtain the speaker’s signed or spoken message and assemble relevant terminology, reference information, context, audience needs, and required communication conditions.
interpret_scope: Determine the intended meaning, content, context, style, and culturally or conceptually relevant implications of the message, resolving ambiguities or meaning conflicts.
decide_scope: Select the language, wording, signing, and audience-appropriate rendering that most faithfully conveys the intended message.
act_scope: Convey the selected rendering orally or through sign language in simultaneous or consecutive live communication while preserving confidentiality.

job_role_definition: Convert written material into another language while preserving its meaning, context, and intended effect.
acquire_scope: Assemble the source text, relevant terminology, reference material, and information about its content, context, intended audience, and required cultural setting.
interpret_scope: Determine the source material’s intended meanings, concepts, tone, and effects, resolving linguistic or cultural ambiguities that could alter them.
decide_scope: Select target-language wording, consistent terminology, and culturally appropriate adaptations that best preserve the original material’s meaning, context, and intended effect.
act_scope: Produce, proofread, edit, and revise the written translation, including localized software or technical documentation where required, while handling source information confidentially.

job_role_definition: Obtain, clarify, verify, and record information from individuals to complete forms, applications, questionnaires, or surveys.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Locate and contact respondents, explain the purpose and questions, and obtain needed personal, application, questionnaire, survey, record, or verification information through interviewing and related follow-up.
interpret_scope: Assess responses and supporting information for completeness, accuracy, validity, and inconsistencies, identifying data problems that require clarification.
decide_scope: Select appropriate follow-up questions, explanations, corrections, or dispositions needed to resolve incomplete, inconsistent, or invalid information.
act_scope: Assist respondents as needed and compile, code, record, and submit the clarified information to complete the required forms, applications, questionnaires, or surveys.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and oversee investment strategies and operations for pooled client assets.
acquire_scope: Gather market, company, industry, investment-performance, investor-objective, and regulatory information needed to manage pooled assets within applicable requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze research, valuations, forecasts, portfolio performance, risks, regulatory developments, and prospective opportunities to assess fund positioning and compliance.
decide_scope: Set fund policies and strategies, choose investments and portfolio mixes, prioritize opportunities, and select trades and execution approaches consistent with client goals and risk limits.
act_scope: Manage the fund by implementing investment strategies, executing or directing trades, overseeing investment operations and valuation controls, and communicating required investment and regulatory information to investors and regulators.

occupation_name: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
job_role_name: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
job_role_definition: Keep buildings and their immediate grounds clean, safe, orderly, and usable through custodial care and related minor upkeep.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect building and grounds conditions, obtain cleaning and maintenance supplies and equipment, and assemble specified cleaning solutions and materials.
interpret_scope: Assess cleanliness, safety, infestation, upkeep, and repair conditions to identify work needs and hazards.
decide_scope: Set work priorities and select appropriate custodial, grounds-care, minor-upkeep, safety, or escalation responses under required procedures.
act_scope: Clean, service, secure, and maintain buildings and immediate grounds through waste removal, surface and floor care, seasonal clearing, pest control, minor repairs, and reporting of major repair needs.

occupation_name: Jewelers and Precious Stone and Metal Workers
job_role_definition: Designs, fabricates, finishes, adjusts, and repairs jewelry and other precious-metal articles.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain metals, gems, reference information, stakeholder requirements, measurements, and condition evidence needed to design, fabricate, adjust, or repair precious-metal articles.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, material properties, dimensions, workmanship, and finished-piece conformance to determine design and repair needs.
decide_scope: Select or modify designs, specifications, materials, and fabrication or rework methods for each article.
act_scope: Design, model, cast, form, cut, join, set, engrave, plate, finish, adjust, repair, and inspect jewelry and other precious-metal articles.

occupation_name: Jewelers and Precious Stone and Metal Workers
job_role_definition: Grades gemstones and determines their appraised market value.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine gemstones and obtain relevant physical observations, price-guide information, and current market data.
interpret_scope: Classify gemstone color, perfection, cut quality, and rarity, then estimate market value from those findings and market evidence.
decide_scope: NA — The role produces classifications and valuation conclusions rather than selecting a course of action.
act_scope: Deliver the gemstone grade and estimated market value as the appraisal result.

job_role_definition: Preside over legal proceedings and administer justice by applying law, resolving disputes, and issuing judicial rulings and orders.
acquire_scope: Obtain and review pleadings, motions, legal authorities, testimony, allegations, documentary evidence, jury findings, and other case-record inputs needed to adjudicate matters.
interpret_scope: Assess the facts, evidentiary record, and governing law to determine issues such as legal relevance, admissibility, liability, probable cause, and the merits of claims or charges.
decide_scope: Select procedural and substantive dispositions, including evidentiary and hearing rulings, case outcomes, remedies, sentences, warrants, restrictions, and custody or property determinations.
act_scope: Preside over and regulate proceedings, instruct and guide participants, and formally deliver, document, and enforce judicial rulings, orders, opinions, and other adjudicative outcomes.

job_role_definition: Assist judges by researching case-related legal issues, analyzing filings, and preparing judicial legal work product.
acquire_scope: Research applicable legal authorities and case materials, review filings and records, monitor legal developments, and obtain information from court proceedings needed for matters before the court.
interpret_scope: Analyze filings, authorities, arguments, and records to identify issues, grounds for relief, legal implications, and effects of changes in law.
decide_scope: Select recommended legal conclusions, dispositions, orders, and case-management priorities for judges’ consideration.
act_scope: Prepare and refine briefs, memoranda, statements of issues, and draft judicial opinions or decisions, and communicate legal and procedural guidance.

job_role_definition: Teach kindergarten students foundational academic and social skills while supporting their development and managing the classroom learning environment.
acquire_scope: Gather curriculum requirements, information from families and colleagues, and observations, assignments, tests, and records concerning each child's learning, behavior, development, and wellbeing, while preparing the learning materials and spaces needed for instruction.
interpret_scope: Assess evidence about children's academic progress, social development, adjustment, health, and developmental needs to identify strengths, difficulties, and required support.
decide_scope: Set instructional objectives and select, adapt, sequence, and prioritize lessons, classroom expectations, interventions, referrals, and individualized supports in response to children's needs.
act_scope: Teach foundational academic, social, self-care, and developmental skills through instruction, reading, demonstration, play, and experiential activities; maintain a safe, orderly classroom; and deliver targeted guidance and extra help.

job_role_definition: Resolve labor-management issues by negotiating and administering labor agreements, handling grievances and disputes, and advising on labor relations compliance and policy.
acquire_scope: Gather stakeholder positions, grievance facts, contract and workforce records, legal precedents, and hearing evidence relevant to labor-management matters.
interpret_scope: Assess complaint viability, construe agreement terms, and evaluate compliance, bargaining risk, and operational effects.
decide_scope: Select bargaining strategies, proposed resolutions or alternatives, dispute procedures, disciplinary dispositions, and compliance or policy advice.
act_scope: Draft and negotiate labor agreements, mediate disputes, present bargaining or arbitration positions, and communicate or implement labor-relations requirements.

occupation_name: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
job_role_name: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
job_role_definition: Manually move and handle freight, stock, equipment, and other materials in logistics, production, and general labor settings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work assignments and material or equipment requirements, and identify the freight, stock, tools, and handling inputs involved.
interpret_scope: Determine each item's destination, condition, identification, handling requirements, and protection needs from instructions and the material itself.
decide_scope: Select the handling sequence, placement, lifting or moving method, and protective measures needed to move materials safely and appropriately.
act_scope: Load, unload, transport, position, store, sort, identify, package or repackage, secure, rig, and guide materials and handling equipment to complete their movement and protect inventory.

job_role_definition: Plan, design, and oversee the implementation of functional, aesthetic, and sustainable outdoor land areas for client projects.
acquire_scope: Obtain client requirements and project constraints, inspect sites, and assemble information on land conditions, features, water systems, materials, costs, and applicable development context.
interpret_scope: Assess site, drainage, soil, structural, environmental, aesthetic, and cost information to determine the conditions and opportunities shaping a functional, sustainable landscape.
decide_scope: Select the landscape concept, planting, land-feature integration, water-conservation systems, sustainable materials, specifications, and implementation approach that meet project objectives.
act_scope: Produce and communicate plans, drawings, specifications, estimates, and visual representations, then oversee construction quality and provide follow-up consultation as the landscape develops.

job_role_definition: Groundskeeping Workers maintain landscaped grounds by caring for vegetation and turf, controlling debris and seasonal hazards, and servicing irrigation and outdoor features.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect grounds, vegetation, turf, soil, irrigation, and outdoor features, and assemble the tools and materials needed for maintenance.
interpret_scope: Assess plant and turf condition, water and soil needs, overgrowth, debris, damage, and seasonal hazards affecting grounds quality and usability.
decide_scope: Select and prioritize vegetation care, grounds cleanup, and feature or seasonal maintenance methods suited to identified conditions.
act_scope: Maintain usable, orderly grounds using appropriate hand or powered equipment to care for vegetation and turf, clear debris or snow, and service outdoor features.

job_role_definition: Landscape Installation Workers create planned outdoor landscapes by preparing sites, installing plants and turf, and constructing associated functional or decorative features.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Gather landscape plans, site information, plant and construction materials, and the hand or powered equipment needed for installation.
interpret_scope: Read designs and assess terrain, soil, drainage, placement requirements, and material needs to translate plans into workable site layouts.
decide_scope: Choose installation sequence, site-preparation methods, material placement, and appropriate tools or equipment while addressing field conditions.
act_scope: Prepare sites, place and support living materials, and build associated decorative, drainage, irrigation, border, or structural features according to design.

occupation_name: Lathe and Turning Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Lathe and Turning Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend lathe and turning machines to shape metal or plastic workpieces to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job specifications, tooling instructions, material requirements, dimensional measurements, and operating-condition observations from drawings, orders, instrument checks, and machine monitoring.
interpret_scope: Determine required dimensions and machine settings and assess workpiece conformance and operating conditions using specifications, material properties, shop mathematics, measurements, and observations.
decide_scope: Select tooling, operational sequence, cutting parameters, workholding, attachments, and corrective adjustments needed to maintain specified tolerances.
act_scope: Set up, load, align, program, operate, tend, adjust, and maintain the lathe or turning machine to shape metal or plastic workpieces to specification.

job_role_definition: Identifies and removes stains through individualized solvent, chemical, and mechanical treatments.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect stained articles and obtain fabric, dye, stain, and color-condition evidence through sight, touch, and sample testing.
interpret_scope: Assess the article’s material and condition to identify stain sources, color imperfections, and special-treatment needs.
decide_scope: Select the individualized spotting procedure, solvents, and treatment sequence appropriate to the fabric and stain.
act_scope: Position articles and remove stains through selected solvent, bleaching, steaming, flushing, neutralizing, scrubbing, and drying treatments.

job_role_definition: Restores, changes, or removes the color of textile articles using dyes and bleaching treatments.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Identify textile fabrics, original dyes, article conditions, and target color samples through inspection and testing.
interpret_scope: Assess the identified materials and color requirements using dye and bleaching properties to determine their treatment implications.
decide_scope: Select the dyeing, bleaching, or color-stripping treatment and its chemical formulation for the article.
act_scope: Prepare and apply dye, bleaching, and related chemical treatments by mixing solutions and processing articles to restore, change, or remove color.

job_role_definition: Operates laundry and dry-cleaning equipment to clean, dry, finish, and prepare textile articles.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Receive, identify, inspect, and count textile articles and obtain the chemicals and other materials needed for processing.
interpret_scope: Classify articles by material, color, condition, soiling, and applicable cleaning and handling requirements.
decide_scope: Select lot assignments, treatment methods, machine settings, additives, and finishing approaches appropriate to the articles.
act_scope: Mark and process articles by preparing solutions; loading, operating, regulating, unloading, and maintaining equipment; drying, finishing, pressing, folding, hanging, wrapping, or packaging the cleaned items.

job_role_definition: Teach law courses to postsecondary students, including assessing learning and supporting associated faculty responsibilities.
education_most_common_level: First Professional Degree - awarded for completion of a program that: requires at least 2 years of college work before entrance into the program, includes a total of at least 6 academic years of work to complete, and provides all remaining academic requirements to begin practice in a profession.
acquire_scope: Gather current legal scholarship and instructional resources, and obtain student work, examination responses, attendance, and advising information needed for teaching and assessment.
interpret_scope: Assess students’ understanding and progress, identify their instructional or advising needs, and synthesize legal developments and research evidence for course and scholarly work.
decide_scope: Determine course content, instructional methods, learning activities, assessment standards, feedback, academic or career guidance, and revisions to curriculum or research direction.
act_scope: Deliver law instruction through lectures, discussions, and case exercises; administer and record assessments; advise and supervise students; and carry out associated faculty scholarship and collaborative responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Litigation Lawyers advise and represent clients in civil or criminal disputes by preparing cases, negotiating resolutions, and conducting proceedings and appeals.
acquire_scope: Gather client and witness accounts, documentary and other evidence, case records, governing legal authorities, and relevant specialist input.
interpret_scope: Analyze facts, legal data, precedents, statutes, rulings, and regulations to assess claims, defenses, procedural implications, and probable case outcomes.
decide_scope: Determine whether to initiate, defend, settle, or appeal a matter, and select case strategy, arguments, motions, settlement posture, and trial approach.
act_scope: Advise clients, seek negotiated resolutions, and conduct proceedings and appeals by filing briefs and presenting arguments, evidence, and witness examinations before tribunals.

job_role_definition: Provides legal advice and develops, documents, negotiates, or implements transactions, estate matters, and legal-policy frameworks for individuals and organizations.
acquire_scope: Gather client objectives and facts, governing legal authorities, public records, existing instruments, and specialist input relevant to the matter.
interpret_scope: Analyze authorities, records, facts, and proposed terms to determine legal rights, obligations, ownership, liability, risk, enforceability, and resulting legal conclusions.
decide_scope: Select the advice, structure, terms, negotiation positions, or estate and policy courses that address the client’s objectives.
act_scope: Deliver counsel; draft, review, and negotiate legal instruments; and implement transactional, estate, or policy arrangements for clients and organizations.

job_role_definition: Lay out, mark, position, and fit metal or plastic workpieces for fabrication, welding, and assembly.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and verify blueprints, templates, specifications, workpieces, layout surfaces, and dimensional and alignment measurements needed to prepare fabrication work.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings, templates, material properties, heat effects, and measured conditions into layout dimensions, reference geometry, fit requirements, and conformance findings.
decide_scope: Determine the layout approach, reference points, template configuration, and sequence and locations of cutting, forming, drilling, welding, and assembly operations.
act_scope: Prepare templates and layout surfaces; mark workpieces; and lift, position, align, fit, brace, and where required attach parts for fabrication, welding, and assembly.

job_role_definition: Provide specialized administrative support in legal settings by preparing documents and managing communications, records, schedules, billing, and case-related information.
acquire_scope: Collect case records, meeting and call information, correspondence, billing inputs, and legal-source materials needed to support legal matters.
interpret_scope: Proofread legal materials and assess retrieved legal authorities and case information for relevance, completeness, and usable organization.
decide_scope: Set administrative priorities, appointment times, and appropriate routing or submission arrangements for legal communications and materials.
act_scope: Prepare and process legal documents, forms, memoranda, invoices, correspondence, filings, records, schedules, and case-file updates to provide specialized legal administrative support.

job_role_definition: Provide legal support services not classified within other specific legal support occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain and organize the legal, factual, procedural, or administrative inputs required for the particular legal support service assigned.
interpret_scope: Assess the gathered inputs to identify their relevance, completeness, status, or implications for the assigned support service.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate support approach, work sequence, and disposition of issues within the assigned service.
act_scope: Carry out the assigned legal support service and produce its required work product or assistance.

job_role_definition: Develop, deliberate on, and enact laws, policies, budgets, and other governmental actions as elected officials.
acquire_scope: Obtain constituent and stakeholder testimony, subject-matter and current-affairs information, agency and fiscal evidence, proposal texts, colleague positions, and expected voting support relevant to governmental matters.
interpret_scope: Analyze public concerns, proposed measures, agency performance, fiscal evidence, broader implications, competing interests, and likely legislative support.
decide_scope: Reconcile competing interests and select positions, priorities, negotiating terms, recommendations, appointments, amendments, budget or policy provisions, and formal dispositions through votes.
act_scope: Draft and advocate proposals, conduct procedural debate, formally present recommendations and positions, make selected appointments, and carry enacted governmental actions into effect.

job_role_definition: Administer library collections and services that enable patrons to locate, borrow, and use information resources.
acquire_scope: Gather patron requests, circulation and collection data, stakeholder and vendor input, and search for resources needed to manage collections and provide library services.
interpret_scope: Determine patrons’ information needs, assess resource relevance and collection or access issues, and classify materials using established schemes.
decide_scope: Select collection additions and dispositions, service offerings, policies, priorities, budgets, and operational responses based on assessed needs and resources.
act_scope: Provide lending, reference assistance, instruction, programs, and interlibrary loans, and implement catalog records, access tools, collection changes, and daily service operations.

job_role_definition: Manage audiovisual and instructional media collections, equipment, and access services for educational or organizational users.
acquire_scope: Gather user needs, evaluative sources, holdings, circulation and inventory data, and equipment-condition information required to manage media resources and access services.
interpret_scope: Assess resource and training-aid suitability, determine subject classifications, and diagnose equipment, hardware, or software problems.
decide_scope: Select resources for acquisition, materials and aids for instructional needs, and corrective actions for technical problems.
act_scope: Order and catalog resources, maintain collection and equipment records and inventories, set up and operate audiovisual equipment, resolve technical problems, and train faculty and media staff.

job_role_definition: Provide clerical circulation, patron assistance, materials handling, and operational support to keep library services and collections accessible and organized.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather patron requests and registration details, receive and inspect returned or new materials, locate requested items, and retrieve the patron, circulation, catalog, availability, and overdue records required for service.
interpret_scope: Determine patron needs and eligibility, material identity, availability, condition, due or overdue and fee status, and the content-based classification or catalog meaning of collection items.
decide_scope: Select appropriate assistance or referral, substitute materials, circulation and reserve dispositions, collection placement and repair handling, and responses to operational or patron problems under established procedures.
act_scope: Provide clerical circulation and patron assistance, update access and collection records, organize and preserve materials, and maintain safe, usable library facilities and equipment.

job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary library science courses while supporting students and contributing to related faculty responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Gather current library science knowledge, student work and progress information, instructional resources, and evidence for scholarly inquiry and faculty responsibilities.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning, synthesize subject developments and research evidence, and identify students’ academic and career-support needs.
decide_scope: Set and revise curriculum, instructional and assessment approaches, learning resources, academic guidance, research directions, and faculty-related priorities.
act_scope: Deliver and facilitate in-person or online library science instruction, communicate assessments and advice, supervise student work, conduct and disseminate scholarship, and carry out related faculty responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Assist patrons and librarians by providing circulation, reference, collection-processing, and routine library operational services.
acquire_scope: Obtain patron requests and account details, search reference and bibliographic sources, inspect materials and equipment, and gather circulation, collection, cost, and operational information needed to provide library services.
interpret_scope: Evaluate search results against patron needs, determine the subjects, bibliographic identity, and condition of materials, and assess account, equipment, or conduct issues requiring response or referral.
decide_scope: Select appropriate resources and referrals, classification numbers and headings, circulation or account dispositions, repair or replacement responses, and measures for resolving equipment problems or disruptions.
act_scope: Complete circulation and account transactions, communicate reference findings and provide resource assistance, process and organize collection materials and interlibrary loans, maintain records and equipment, fulfill material orders, and carry out routine library operations.

occupation_name: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
job_role_name: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
job_role_definition: Provide licensed practical nursing care by monitoring, treating, and assisting patients under appropriate clinical supervision.
acquire_scope: Observe patients; obtain vital signs, intake and output, specimens and routine test results; receive requests for assistance; and document and communicate relevant condition and care information.
interpret_scope: Assess patient needs, responses, adverse reactions, dietary requirements, and intervention outcomes from the collected clinical information.
decide_scope: Prioritize patient needs and select or modify appropriate practical-nursing interventions, escalation, and assistance within the established care plan and clinical supervision.
act_scope: Deliver prescribed medications, treatments, personal care, mobility and comfort assistance, and procedure preparation; use and maintain required equipment safely; explain care; and direct assigned nursing assistants.

job_role_definition: Conduct specialized life-science work not separately classified within O*NET.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble biological materials, observations, measurements, and other inputs required for specialized life-science work.
interpret_scope: Analyze life-science inputs to establish task-relevant findings, classifications, or explanations.
decide_scope: Select study, analysis, or technical courses of action based on the findings.
act_scope: Implement the selected courses of action and deliver the resulting specialized life-science work products.

occupation_name: Life, Physical, and Social Science Technicians, All Other
job_role_name: Life, Physical, and Social Science Technicians, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide technical support for life, physical, or social science work not classified in a more specific technician occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain, prepare, and organize the materials, instruments, records, measurements, or other inputs needed to support assigned life, physical, or social science work.
interpret_scope: Process observations, test outputs, or collected records into technically usable findings, quality assessments, or documented results.
decide_scope: Select task methods, sequencing, and corrective actions within assigned technical-support responsibilities.
act_scope: Perform the technical procedures, equipment operation, sample or data handling, and documentation that support the assigned scientific work.

occupation_name: Lifeguards, Ski Patrol, and Other Recreational Protective Service Workers
job_role_name: Lifeguards, Ski Patrol, and Other Recreational Protective Service Workers
job_role_definition: Monitor recreational areas and protect participants through hazard prevention, rescue, emergency care, and safety assistance.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Patrol and observe assigned recreational areas and participants, inspect facilities and safety equipment, and test water conditions to obtain current safety inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess observed conditions, behavior, equipment and facility status, water results, and injuries to identify hazards, distress, infractions, and needed care.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate preventive warning, safety assistance, rescue method, emergency-care response, or emergency escalation for identified conditions.
act_scope: Protect participants by communicating safety precautions and warnings, assisting safe equipment use, maintaining safe recreational conditions, conducting rescues and underwater recoveries, administering emergency care, and contacting emergency medical personnel when needed.

job_role_definition: Transport merchandise, packages, or materials between specified locations in light trucks or vans, including associated pickup and delivery service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Verify cargo against shipping papers, obtain route directions and delivery documentation, and inspect vehicle, supplies, equipment, and relevant cargo measurements for readiness.
interpret_scope: Assess cargo, vehicle, road, traffic, and delivery-status information to identify routing, safety, mechanical, or service implications.
decide_scope: Choose compliant routes, driving adjustments, delivery sequencing, and responses to vehicle, traffic, delay, accident, or repair conditions.
act_scope: Load, transport, and unload merchandise, packages, or materials; complete pickup and delivery transactions; maintain required cargo and vehicle records; communicate conditions; and carry out needed vehicle upkeep or emergency repairs.

job_role_definition: Programs and operates lighting-control systems to execute planned lighting effects during productions.
acquire_scope: Obtain production lighting requirements and conduct tests of equipment function and planned lighting effects.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements and test results against the lighting design to identify needed control settings and corrections.
decide_scope: Select fixture brightness, color, cue settings, and control adjustments that will realize the planned effects.
act_scope: Program or load the lighting console and operate its controls to execute the planned effects throughout productions.

job_role_definition: Sets up, connects, focuses, maintains, tests, and dismantles production lighting equipment and associated rigging.
acquire_scope: Gather production lighting requirements and inspect the location’s structural and electrical layout, equipment condition, and wiring safety to establish setup inputs.
interpret_scope: Evaluate those requirements and site, safety, and equipment observations to determine feasible, safe lighting configurations and identify faults requiring major repair.
decide_scope: Select equipment placement, rigging and connection arrangements, fixture settings, effects, and maintenance or repair dispositions that meet the production requirements.
act_scope: Load, position, rig, connect, focus, configure, test, maintain, and dismantle production lighting equipment and associated rigging.

occupation_name: Loading and Moving Machine Operators, Underground Mining
job_role_name: Loading and Moving Machine Operators, Underground Mining
job_role_definition: Operate underground loading and moving machinery to gather, load, convey, and position mined material for transport.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain operating instructions and route, signal, marking, material-level, loading-specification, and equipment-safety information needed to move mined material underground.
interpret_scope: Assess travel paths, material quantities and loading progress, signals and markings, and equipment conditions to determine safe, compliant operating status.
decide_scope: Select machine movements, loading and discharge timing, car positioning, and any required stoppage, clearance, or equipment-service response.
act_scope: Operate, position, and control underground loading, shuttle-car, and conveyor equipment to gather, load, convey, discharge, and position mined material, while maintaining safe operating access and equipment.

job_role_definition: Process loan applications and transactions by collecting and verifying applicant information, preparing and maintaining documentation, communicating decisions and terms, and supporting closing and account servicing.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain applicant financial and personal data, credit and reference information, collateral values, closing materials, and account-payment information required for loan processing and servicing.
interpret_scope: Verify application, closing, and account information; calculate and correct loan amounts, payments, interest, and costs; and assess compliance with repayment terms.
decide_scope: Formulate underwriting recommendations and select credit-limit or overdue-account extension actions.
act_scope: Prepare, record, maintain, and assemble loan and closing documentation; communicate application outcomes and loan terms; and carry out closings, insurance arrangements, payment acceptance, and account servicing.

job_role_definition: Originate loans by advising applicants, assembling applications, recommending suitable financing, and approving or referring requests.
acquire_scope: Gather applicant goals, application details, credit histories, financial statements, property information, and supporting documentation needed to assemble and verify loan requests.
interpret_scope: Assess applicants’ financial condition, credit, property evaluations, eligibility, and projected payment obligations to determine loan feasibility and fit.
decide_scope: Select suitable financing recommendations and determine whether to approve within authority or refer the request for further approval.
act_scope: Advise applicants on available financing and terms, prepare complete and accurate applications and loan files, submit them for review as needed, and communicate the resulting disposition.

job_role_definition: Maintain loan accounts and address delinquent debt through account review, borrower contact, repayment arrangements, and collection escalation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and verify loan-file, account-status, billing, debt-balance, and borrower financial information needed to service accounts and address delinquencies.
interpret_scope: Assess account records, billing accuracy, delinquency status, debt amounts, available repayment funds, payoff timing, and the substance of borrower complaints.
decide_scope: Select complaint resolutions, repayment priorities and arrangements, and the appropriate disposition of delinquent accounts, including collection referral or write-off consideration.
act_scope: Maintain and recategorize loan accounts, prepare payment schedules, communicate with borrowers, issue collection correspondence, establish repayment arrangements, provide financial guidance, and escalate unresolved accounts for collection.

job_role_definition: Assess borrower risk and loan documentation to approve applications or recommend lending decisions under established credit standards.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble applicants’ credit histories, financial statements, property evaluations, and complete loan-file documentation needed for underwriting.
interpret_scope: Assess financial condition, credit, collateral, eligibility, and agreement completeness against established credit standards and policy.
decide_scope: Determine loan feasibility and select approval, recommendation, or referral for applications outside authorized limits.
act_scope: Formally issue or route the lending disposition and update the associated credit and loan records.

occupation_name: Locker Room, Coatroom, and Dressing Room Attendants
job_role_name: Locker Room, Coatroom, and Dressing Room Attendants
job_role_definition: Provide patrons with personal items, assigned facilities, and related support services in locker rooms, dressing rooms, and coatrooms.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive patron requests and claim checks, check the availability and condition of facilities, items, linens, equipment, and supplies, and observe facility use and safety conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess patron needs, match claims to stored possessions, evaluate facility and item availability, and identify rule violations, hazards, complaints, and emergencies.
decide_scope: Select facility and storage assignments, items to issue, supply replenishment needs, room-condition adjustments, and appropriate responses to service, safety, or emergency situations.
act_scope: Provide access to assigned facilities, store and return possessions, issue requested items, explain services and policies, assist patrons, maintain clean and stocked spaces, enforce order, escalate problems, and carry out emergency procedures.

job_role_definition: Make keys and install, open, rekey, maintain, and repair locks, door hardware, and access-control systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect locks, door hardware, vehicles, and access-control equipment and obtain the key codes, existing configurations, measurements, parts, access requirements, and key-control records needed for service.
interpret_scope: Determine key specifications, lock combinations and operating mechanisms, system conditions, faults, and the implications of access and master-key requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate keying, opening, rekeying, repair, replacement, hardware, or access-control configuration to meet the service need.
act_scope: Cut keys; open locks and vehicles; rekey, maintain, and repair locking devices; establish master-key systems; and install locks, door hardware, alarms, and electronic access systems.

job_role_definition: Install, open, repair, adjust, and refinish safes, vault doors, and related secure-storage equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain installation blueprints and examine the secure-storage equipment, its lock or door configuration, condition, and finish requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess the equipment’s construction, malfunction or access condition, and restoration needs to determine the work required.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate opening, installation, repair, adjustment, and refinishing approach and sequence.
act_scope: Install safes, vault doors, and deposit boxes; open safe locks by drilling when required; and repair, adjust, and refinish secure-storage equipment.

job_role_definition: Operate locomotives safely to transport passengers or freight and support train movements under railroad operating rules.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain operating instructions and movement information, and inspect and monitor locomotive, train, loading, brake, supply, signal, track, and control-status inputs needed for safe movement.
interpret_scope: Determine the meaning of railroad rules, orders, signals, communications, instrument readings, observed conditions, and equipment indications for the current movement.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate train-handling, stopping, routing, coordination, or emergency response under applicable operating and safety rules.
act_scope: Operate locomotive controls and carry out authorized mainline and yard movements, coordinating with train personnel and responding to unsafe conditions or breakdowns.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate the guest services, staffing, finances, facilities, and related operations of lodging establishments or departments.
acquire_scope: Gather guest and client requests, reservation and payment information, revenue and expenditure records, staffing applications and performance observations, and facility, supply, service, and event requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess financial performance, guest-service issues, staffing effectiveness, facility condition, and event needs against operational standards, policies, and budgets.
decide_scope: Set rates, budgets, fund allocations, operating policies, staffing and hiring arrangements, service recoveries, accommodation dispositions, procurement needs, and event plans.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate guest, front-office, facilities, financial, staffing, marketing, and event operations by scheduling and training staff, maintaining lodging services, processing guest business, arranging services, and resolving operational issues.

job_role_definition: Inspect, grade, measure, mark, and document logs or pulpwood to determine their volume, condition, disposition, and marketable value.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect logs or pulpwood for physical characteristics and defects and obtain dimensional, weight, and load measurements needed for grading and valuation.
interpret_scope: Apply established criteria and conversion information to determine condition, grade, volume, and marketable value.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate disposition of substandard or special-grade material, including return, regrading, recutting, or alternate processing.
act_scope: Mark material to communicate grade or species and document the resulting grades, measurements, volumes, values, and load information.

job_role_definition: Operate specialized logging machinery to fell, process, move, load, and support the handling of timber and logging sites.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect logging equipment and gather site conditions, timber specifications, log characteristics, and measurements needed for the work.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment readiness and terrain and timber conditions, classify logs under applicable standards, and calculate wood quantities.
decide_scope: Select safe machine positioning, routes, work sequences, and timber processing and handling approaches.
act_scope: Operate and maintain logging machinery to fell and process trees, move and load timber, and build, repair, or clear logging access areas.

job_role_definition: Perform logging work not classified under a more specific logging occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain site conditions, work instructions, equipment, and materials needed for the assigned logging work.
interpret_scope: Assess the gathered conditions and instructions to understand the requirements and safe execution of the assigned logging work.
decide_scope: Select the work sequence, methods, and immediate adjustments required to complete the assigned logging work.
act_scope: Perform the assigned logging work that is not classified under a more specific logging occupation.

job_role_definition: Analyze, coordinate, and improve the acquisition, movement, allocation, support, delivery, and disposal of products and resources throughout their life cycles.
acquire_scope: Gather customer requirements, inventory and availability data, technical source data, performance results, lifecycle information, subcontractor proposals, and design-change inputs for logistics operations.
interpret_scope: Analyze demand, service performance, costs, technical data, lifecycle risks, repair and maintenance needs, and design impacts to assess logistics requirements and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Select resource allocations, logistics support plans, movement redesigns, project priorities and schedules, subcontractor specifications, and recommended lifecycle actions.
act_scope: Coordinate and direct the acquisition, movement, allocation, support, delivery, protection, and lifecycle disposition of products and resources, implementing approved improvements and communicating plans and results.
