job_role_definition: Analyze and support logistics and supply-chain operations to improve product flow, cost, service, capacity, and efficiency.
acquire_scope: Track product, inventory, warehouse, carrier, vendor, rate, schedule, cost, capacity, environmental, and industry information while maintaining the logistics data and records needed for analysis.
interpret_scope: Calculate performance measures and analyze logistics data, procedures, and models to assess flow, service, cost, capacity, reliability, demand, inventory, environmental impact, and operational efficiency.
decide_scope: Choose and recommend process improvements and operating courses for inventory, sourcing, packaging, transportation, routing, scheduling, carrier selection, and capacity use.
act_scope: Report findings, maintain logistics models and pricing resources, establish operating procedures, and implement selected routing, scheduling, capacity, and process adjustments.

job_role_definition: Design and analyze logistics systems, facilities, processes, and technologies to improve supply-chain efficiency, capacity, cost, service, and environmental performance.
acquire_scope: Gather logistics operating data, requirements, constraints, audit evidence, site and process observations, stakeholder input, technology information, and environmental or transportation reports needed to evaluate supply-chain operations.
interpret_scope: Analyze logistics performance, costs, capacity, flows, forecasts, technology use, feasibility, service needs, compliance requirements, and environmental impacts to identify improvement opportunities and produce findings, estimates, and scenario-based assessments.
decide_scope: Select the logistics strategies, facility concepts, supply-chain configurations, technology approaches, and operating priorities that best meet cost, service, capacity, and environmental objectives.
act_scope: Deliver the selected logistics designs, solutions, specifications, metrics, analytical tools, procedures, documentation, and facility or process plans.

job_role_definition: Plan and direct programs, policies, personnel, investigations, and controls to prevent theft, fraud, inventory shrinkage, safety incidents, and other asset losses.
acquire_scope: Gather loss, inventory, cash, safety, surveillance, audit, procedural, and investigation evidence through records review, site visits, monitoring, audits, interviews, and coordination with relevant external parties.
interpret_scope: Analyze evidence to identify theft, fraud, shrinkage, safety, compliance, security, and process-control patterns, causes, and resource needs.
decide_scope: Select loss-prevention strategies, controls, investigative dispositions, crisis recommendations, staffing and deployment plans, and improvements to programs, procedures, scheduling, and training.
act_scope: Direct and administer loss-prevention programs, controls, personnel, investigations, audits, surveillance, and security measures; train personnel, advise operations, coordinate cases, and maintain activity records.

occupation_name: Low Vision Therapists, Orientation and Mobility Specialists, and Vision Rehabilitation Therapists
job_role_definition: Helps people use their remaining vision more effectively through assessment, environmental adaptations, and low-vision devices and technology.
acquire_scope: Assess remaining vision, functional abilities, daily-life demands, goals, and progress, and obtain the low-vision devices and technology needed for intervention.
interpret_scope: Determine how visual impairment affects daily living, communication, literacy, mobility, and other client functioning by evaluating assessment and test findings.
decide_scope: Develop and adjust collaborative rehabilitation and instructional plans, including environmental adaptations, device choices, referrals, and coordinated client solutions.
act_scope: Deliver low-vision rehabilitation by adapting environments, providing devices and technology, training clients in their use and self-advocacy, and educating relevant support groups.

occupation_name: Low Vision Therapists, Orientation and Mobility Specialists, and Vision Rehabilitation Therapists
job_role_definition: Teaches people with visual impairments to orient themselves and travel safely and independently using mobility techniques and aids.
acquire_scope: Assess functional vision, mobility, physical and cognitive abilities, goals, and progress through observation, travel exercises, and relevant tests.
interpret_scope: Evaluate assessment and progress evidence to determine mobility needs, barriers, capabilities, and training outcomes.
decide_scope: Select individualized instructional plans, mobility techniques and aids, plan adjustments, referrals, and coordinated supports.
act_scope: Teach and reinforce safe, independent orientation and travel skills, including sensory use, cane and mobility-aid use, real or simulated travel, self-advocacy, and documented follow-up.

occupation_name: Low Vision Therapists, Orientation and Mobility Specialists, and Vision Rehabilitation Therapists
job_role_definition: Teaches adaptive daily-living, communication, literacy, and technology skills that enable people with visual impairments to function independently.
acquire_scope: Observe and test clients’ functional vision, daily-living, communication, literacy, technology, physical, cognitive, and social-emotional functioning; elicit personal goals; monitor progress; and obtain relevant specialist input.
interpret_scope: Determine how visual impairment affects independent functioning and derive rehabilitation needs and instructional targets from assessment and progress evidence.
decide_scope: Collaboratively select and revise individualized rehabilitation and instructional plans, including communication methods, adaptive equipment, referrals, and coordinated services.
act_scope: Teach adaptive daily-living, sensory, self-advocacy, communication, literacy including Braille, and technology skills, and provide related consultation, support, and education to clients’ families, teachers, and collaborating specialists.

job_role_definition: Feed materials into, remove products from, and support the safe operation of production machinery and equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain required materials and ingredients, and inspect, weigh, measure, or observe materials, products, machinery, and work-area conditions to gather production and safety evidence.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection, measurement, and observation results to identify defects, specification deviations, and improper or unsafe operating conditions.
decide_scope: Determine needed operating responses, including whether to start, stop, adjust, or regulate material flow through equipment.
act_scope: Feed, load, add, transfer, remove, identify, package, stack, and route materials and products; operate controls and conveyors; and maintain equipment and work areas for safe functioning.

job_role_definition: Machinists plan, set up, and perform precision machining to fabricate, modify, assemble, or repair parts, instruments, and machine tools to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather drawings, samples, specifications, materials, tooling, machine-condition observations, and precision measurements needed for machining or repair work.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings, samples, and specifications into dimensional, material, and operational constraints; diagnose machine or part defects; and assess completed work for conformance.
decide_scope: Select the machining sequence, methods, setups, programs, tooling, operating parameters, and corrective adjustments needed to produce conforming work.
act_scope: Program, set up, and operate machine tools; machine and fit precision components; and inspect or test finished parts, instruments, and repairs.

job_role_definition: Perform magnetic resonance imaging examinations by preparing and monitoring patients, operating MRI equipment, and producing diagnostic-quality images.
acquire_scope: Obtain the examination order, patient history and safety-screening information, equipment-performance status, physiologic and patient-monitoring data, and prescribed magnetic resonance images.
interpret_scope: Assess patient safety and readiness, equipment and monitoring findings, and acquired image quality against examination requirements.
decide_scope: Select imaging protocols, coils, positioning and support approaches, and any repetitions, modifications, or technical corrections needed for a safe, diagnostic-quality examination.
act_scope: Prepare, instruct, position, and support the patient; administer prescribed contrast; configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot equipment; and preserve and communicate examination images and procedure outcomes.

job_role_definition: Maintain private households and commercial interiors in a clean, orderly, and adequately supplied condition.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect interiors, furnishings, linens, supplies, and property conditions, and assemble the cleaning materials, equipment, and replacement items needed for assigned areas.
interpret_scope: Assess cleanliness, sanitation needs, supply levels, and observed damage, hazards, or found property to establish the condition and service needs of each area.
decide_scope: Prioritize cleaning, disinfection, replenishment, waste handling, and condition reporting, and select appropriate methods and precautions.
act_scope: Clean, disinfect, polish, vacuum, and wash interior areas and furnishings; remove waste; replenish and organize linens and amenities; arrange furnishings; and report property issues or found articles.

occupation_name: Mail Clerks and Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service
job_role_definition: Prepare, receive, sort, route, and dispatch mail and parcels for an organization's internal and external delivery needs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and collect incoming and outgoing mail and parcels, verify addressing, condition, recipient authorization, and record the measurements and routing details needed for handling.
interpret_scope: Assess destination, item type, mailing requirements, and weight or rate information to determine the applicable routing and postage requirements.
decide_scope: Select the sending method, delivery service, and handling disposition for mail and parcels under established procedures.
act_scope: Prepare, seal, wrap, label, meter, sort, transfer, release, and dispatch mail and parcels for internal and external delivery.

occupation_name: Mail Clerks and Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service
job_role_definition: Operate, monitor, adjust, and service machinery used to process, sort, print, prepare, and package mailings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Read production orders, assemble mailpieces and supplies, measure item weights, and observe machine operation and output condition.
interpret_scope: Derive job requirements, determine needed postage from weights and rates, assess mailpiece processability, and identify malfunctions or output defects.
decide_scope: Select job setups, routing dispositions, and corrective adjustments needed to process each mailing properly.
act_scope: Operate and tend mail-processing machinery, including setting up, monitoring, adjusting, clearing, and replenishing it, and manually or mechanically prepare, route, finish, and package mailings.

job_role_definition: Perform routine preventive maintenance and repair on machinery to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain work-order and specification requirements, inspect and test machinery and parts, observe operating performance, and assemble the needed parts, tools, supplies, and prepared repair materials.
interpret_scope: Determine maintenance and repair needs by assessing machine operation, test results, damaged parts, defective areas, and production specifications.
decide_scope: Select the required preventive-maintenance or repair approach, including the parts, adjustments, and corrective work needed to restore safe, efficient operation.
act_scope: Perform preventive maintenance and repairs by cleaning, lubricating, dismantling, replacing or repairing components and linings, reassembling, adjusting, operating, and verifying machinery, while maintaining the work area and maintenance records.

job_role_definition: Maintain and repair building structures, building systems, machinery, and equipment through broad multi-craft maintenance work.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect, operate, test, measure, and consult technical documentation to obtain condition, fault, dimensional, and repair-input information, and obtain needed parts, supplies, and equipment.
interpret_scope: Diagnose mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, and equipment conditions; assess dimensional requirements; and develop repair-cost estimates from the gathered evidence.
decide_scope: Determine corrective and preventive-maintenance approaches, including repair layouts, component adjustments or replacements, efficiency improvements, and purpose-built repair aids.
act_scope: Perform preventive maintenance and execute multi-craft repair, adjustment, fabrication, installation, alignment, component cleaning, lubrication, and replacement work on building structures, systems, machinery, equipment, and boilers.

job_role_definition: Designs, applies, maintains, and documents makeup and related effects that create performers' required appearances for productions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather production, character, performer-skin, visual-reference, venue, lighting, and continuity information, and obtain the cosmetics, prosthetic materials, wigs, and related supplies required.
interpret_scope: Assess production and environmental requirements, reference imagery, performer skin characteristics, and scene changes to determine the appearance and effect requirements for each character.
decide_scope: Develop makeup and effects plans, choose colors, materials, prosthetic approaches, continuity methods, and character hair requirements, and allocate them within budget constraints.
act_scope: Create, apply, replicate, adjust, maintain, remove, and document character makeup and related effects, including prostheses and wigs, while preparing performers and supplies for safe production use.

job_role_definition: Study organizational operations and design, recommend, document, and support changes to systems and procedures that improve efficiency and effectiveness.
acquire_scope: Gather and organize operational evidence from records, forms, reports, interviews, on-site observations, and consultations with personnel, management, and users.
interpret_scope: Analyze organizational functions, workflows, information flows, resources, and proposed changes to identify problems, findings, and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Select study approaches and design, evaluate, approve, or recommend changes to systems, procedures, forms, reports, records management, equipment, layouts, and implementation methods.
act_scope: Document and communicate findings and recommendations, prepare manuals, train workers, implement records-management practices, and coordinate with personnel to support successful operation of changes.

job_role_definition: Manage organizational functions, resources, or activities in managerial occupations not classified separately.
acquire_scope: Obtain operational, resource, financial, and personnel information needed to oversee the organizational function, resources, or activities assigned.
interpret_scope: Assess organizational conditions, performance, constraints, and resource needs from the information obtained.
decide_scope: Set priorities and select plans, resource allocations, and managerial actions for the assigned organizational responsibilities.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate the assigned organizational functions, resources, or activities to carry out the selected plans.

job_role_definition: Provide cosmetic care for clients' fingernails and toenails, including shaping, treatment, polishing, enhancement, and decoration.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Elicit the client’s desired appearance and care needs, observe the condition of the nails and surrounding skin, and assemble the required sanitized implements and products.
interpret_scope: Assess the observed nail, cuticle, and skin conditions and translate the client’s preferences into cosmetic-care requirements.
decide_scope: Select suitable nail-care, enhancement, color, and decoration techniques and recommend appropriate aftercare and products.
act_scope: Deliver sanitary fingernail and toenail care by preparing, shaping, smoothing, treating, polishing, strengthening, extending, whitening, massaging, and decorating as selected.

occupation_name: Manufactured Building and Mobile Home Installers
job_role_name: Manufactured Building and Mobile Home Installers
job_role_definition: Moves, installs, connects, tests, and services mobile homes and prefabricated buildings.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain work-order and customer information, technical references, and condition evidence by inspecting and operationally testing building components, utility connections, appliances, fixtures, and fit-related systems.
interpret_scope: Determine the nature and extent of damage, operating condition, faults, leaks, connection problems, and repair needs from inspection and test results.
decide_scope: Select needed parts, estimate costs, and plan the repair, installation, connection, and work procedures required for the unit.
act_scope: Prepare units for transport; move and set up manufactured buildings; install and connect components and utility systems; and perform structural, exterior, plumbing, gas, electrical, hardware, fit, and finish repairs.

job_role_definition: Manufacturing Engineers design, integrate, troubleshoot, and improve manufacturing systems and processes to achieve capable, efficient, cost-effective, and sustainable production.
acquire_scope: Gather product designs and specifications, process and equipment data, operating evidence, and cost, quality, capacity, and environmental requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze manufacturability, process capability, failures, bottlenecks, resource use, costs, and environmental impacts to identify causes, constraints, and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Select process, product, tooling, equipment, layout, tolerance, testing, or sustainability changes and establish implementation priorities and performance requirements.
act_scope: Implement selected process, equipment, layout, tooling, and producibility improvements, and transfer them through technical procedures, guidance, and training.

job_role_definition: Designs, evaluates, tests, and coordinates the operation, installation, maintenance, and repair of marine machinery and shipboard engineering systems.
acquire_scope: Gather engineering requirements, regulatory constraints, equipment condition and operating observations, prior-work and cost records, and evidence from inspections, tests, trials, and compliance monitoring of marine machinery and shipboard systems.
interpret_scope: Analyze design, environmental, operational, performance, inspection, trial, and test evidence to assess feasibility, equipment condition, system performance, safety, cost soundness, and conformance with applicable standards.
decide_scope: Select system arrangements and design changes, test conditions and sequences, repair and maintenance specifications, schedules, estimates, and coordination priorities that satisfy safety, operational, budget, and contractual requirements.
act_scope: Produce engineering designs, layouts, drawings, plans, specifications, and reports, and coordinate or oversee the operation, installation, maintenance, and repair of marine machinery and shipboard engineering systems.

job_role_definition: Designs and evaluates vessel hulls, structures, arrangements, and overall characteristics for safe, efficient, and economical performance.
acquire_scope: Gather and establish design requirements, regulatory constraints, prior-work cost evidence, and model-basin, dock, and sea-trial data for vessel characteristics and proposed changes.
interpret_scope: Analyze feasibility and vessel stability, structure, weight, vibration, buoyancy, environmental, operational, and trial-performance evidence to assess safety, efficiency, economy, and standards conformance.
decide_scope: Set vessel characteristics, hull form, arrangements, test conditions, design modifications, and cost-conscious repair or alteration provisions based on the assessments.
act_scope: Produce and communicate complete hull, superstructure, interior, layout, drawing, specification, estimate, schedule, and technical-report deliverables, and oversee prototype construction and testing.

occupation_name: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
job_role_definition: Researches markets, consumers, competitors, and trends to produce evidence-based findings and forecasts.
acquire_scope: Obtain market, consumer, satisfaction, competitor, program-performance, sales, and industry-trend data through surveys, existing sources, trade literature, and coordinated field collection.
interpret_scope: Analyze the evidence to produce findings and forecasts about demand drivers, market position, consumer and employee sentiment, competitor activity, marketing effectiveness, and market and sales trends.
decide_scope: Select research designs, data-collection methods, and sources appropriate to the research objectives.
act_scope: Deliver findings and forecasts in clear written and graphical reports.

occupation_name: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
job_role_definition: Plans and evaluates marketing and advertising strategies to improve product positioning and promotion.
acquire_scope: Obtain marketplace information and generate marketing-performance measurements and advertising-needs evidence through designed identification procedures.
interpret_scope: Derive findings about marketplace position, program effectiveness, and advertising needs from the collected evidence.
decide_scope: Select procedures for identifying advertising needs and formulate proposals concerning promotion, distribution, design, pricing, and product positioning.
act_scope: Provide management with marketplace findings, strategy evaluations, and marketing and advertising proposals.

job_role_definition: Plans and directs market-led product, pricing, promotion, and distribution strategies to generate profitable demand, satisfy customers, and achieve organizational objectives.
acquire_scope: Gathers market research, customer and buyer insights, sales forecasts, competitive trends, product information, and financial or sustainability data relevant to marketing choices.
interpret_scope: Assesses demand, market opportunities, customer needs, competitive conditions, product viability, and financial implications against organizational objectives.
decide_scope: Selects target markets and integrated product, pricing, promotion, and distribution strategies, prioritizing profitable growth and customer satisfaction.
act_scope: Directs marketing policies, campaigns, product-development input, distribution arrangements, and staff execution, coordinating internal and external partners to deliver the chosen strategy.

job_role_definition: Diagnose and treat mental and emotional disorders through psychotherapy grounded in marriage and family systems.
acquire_scope: Gather client and family histories, symptoms, feelings, behaviors, relationship dynamics, observations, test results, progress indicators, and relevant collateral information through interviews, discussion, testing, observation, follow-up, and professional consultation.
interpret_scope: Diagnose mental and emotional disorders, assess family-system and parenting patterns, evaluate treatment progress and client adjustment, and form clinical or custody-related conclusions from the evidence.
decide_scope: Select individualized psychotherapy and posttreatment plans, care priorities, coordinated services or referrals, and any custody or visitation recommendations warranted by the case.
act_scope: Deliver family-systems psychotherapy and practical guidance, build constructive coping and relationship skills, coordinate continuing support, document care, and communicate evaluations or testimony to the relevant recipients.

job_role_definition: Provide therapeutic massage and related client care to relieve pain, support recovery, and promote wellness.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Elicit clients’ health histories, pain or stress concerns, and goals; examine soft-tissue condition, joint function, strength, and range of motion; and obtain pertinent input from other care professionals.
interpret_scope: Relate reported concerns, physical findings, and professional input to clients’ therapeutic needs, limitations, and likely response to massage care.
decide_scope: Select individualized treatment plans, including massage methods, adjunctive techniques, complementary aids, self-care guidance, care coordination, or referral when indicated.
act_scope: Prepare a sanitary treatment setting and needed oils or aids, deliver massage and adjunctive treatments, provide selected postural or rehabilitative guidance, and document the care provided.

job_role_definition: Perform material-moving work not classified under a more specific material-moving occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the materials to be moved and the applicable destination, handling, and safety requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess material characteristics and movement conditions to determine handling constraints.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate handling method, equipment, and movement sequence.
act_scope: Move, position, load, unload, or otherwise handle materials as required.

job_role_definition: Develop, select, test, and improve materials and related manufacturing processes to meet product performance, quality, and cost requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble material-performance, deterioration, failure, quality-test, processing, design-specification, and cost data through testing, monitoring, modeling, and technical review.
interpret_scope: Evaluate those inputs to determine material behavior, quality, failure causes, process effects, and fit with required performance, cost, and product specifications.
decide_scope: Select materials, alloy treatments, fabrication and joining methods, process controls, and project recommendations that best meet design and economic objectives.
act_scope: Develop, modify, and improve materials, fabrication procedures, manufacturing processes, and related plant or equipment designs, while directing laboratory and production work.

job_role_definition: Research, develop, test, and recommend materials and processing methods to achieve required properties and performance.
acquire_scope: Gather material, product, supplier, user, customer, process, and performance-requirement information and obtain experimental measurements, samples, and model inputs.
interpret_scope: Analyze material structures, properties, processing responses, failures, and test results to establish feasibility, conformance, performance, and causes of deficiencies.
decide_scope: Select experimental approaches, material compositions or combinations, processing methods, specification changes, and material recommendations suited to required applications and environments.
act_scope: Conduct research, experiments, testing, modeling, and process oversight to develop and validate materials and processing methods, and deliver technical findings through reports, manuals, proposals, and publications.

job_role_definition: Perform mathematical science work not classified within a separately defined mathematical science occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the mathematical problem, relevant data, assumptions, constraints, and available methods needed for the assigned mathematical science work.
interpret_scope: Analyze the problem and inputs to establish their mathematical meaning, structure, validity, and implications.
decide_scope: Select an appropriate mathematical approach, model, proof strategy, or analytical course for the assigned work.
act_scope: Carry out the selected mathematical work and deliver its resulting analysis, model, solution, or other mathematical output.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary mathematical science courses and support students' academic learning and progress.
acquire_scope: Assemble current mathematical knowledge, instructional materials, student work, attendance, grades, and student questions or academic information needed for teaching and support.
interpret_scope: Assess students' mathematical understanding, performance, learning needs, and academic progress from their work, participation, and advising interactions.
decide_scope: Select course content, materials, assessment approaches, instructional methods, curriculum revisions, and academic guidance responsive to course and student needs.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver mathematical science instruction, facilitate learning activities, administer and grade assessments, maintain required student records, and advise and assist students.

job_role_definition: Develop and apply mathematical, computational, and modeling methods to solve practical problems across scientific, engineering, business, and other fields.
acquire_scope: Obtain and organize problem requirements, relevant data, domain knowledge, and modeling assumptions needed to formulate practical quantitative problems.
interpret_scope: Analyze data, assumptions, mathematical relationships, numerical results, simulations, and coded-information structures to determine their implications for the problem.
decide_scope: Select and refine appropriate mathematical, statistical, computational, or encryption-related methods, models, assumptions, and solution approaches.
act_scope: Develop, compute, test, and apply models and computational methods to produce and communicate practical problem solutions.

job_role_definition: Conduct fundamental research to develop and extend mathematical principles, relationships, and knowledge.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain relevant mathematical knowledge, definitions, prior results, and candidate assumptions for fundamental research.
interpret_scope: Analyze formal assumptions, quantities, magnitudes, forms, and logical consequences to identify meaningful mathematical relationships and findings.
decide_scope: Select promising research directions, assumptions, and proof or investigation approaches for extending mathematical knowledge.
act_scope: Develop and establish new mathematical principles and relationships, and disseminate the resulting research through scholarly reports, publications, and presentations.

occupation_name: Meat, Poultry, and Fish Cutters and Trimmers
job_role_name: Meat, Poultry, and Fish Cutters and Trimmers
job_role_definition: Cut, trim, inspect, portion, and prepare meat, poultry, and seafood for processing, packaging, or sale.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain specified meat, poultry, seafood, or carcasses and generate condition and weight inputs through inspection and measurement.
interpret_scope: Assess product condition and specifications to identify defects and determine preparation, cut, trim, and portion requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate product disposition and processing, trimming, removal, portioning, or packaging course.
act_scope: Transform products into specified processing, retail, or ready-to-heat forms through cutting, trimming, cleaning, deboning, grinding, portioning, ingredient application, and containerizing, sealing, and tagging.

job_role_definition: Install, service, and repair automatic, hydraulic, garage, and related mechanical door systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect and measure site and door-system conditions, review blueprints and schematics, perform operational tests, and obtain the components, replacement parts, and materials required for the work.
interpret_scope: Assess site suitability and determine the condition, fault, wear, fit, and operating requirements of mechanical door systems and their controls.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate door configuration and the installation, adjustment, repair, replacement, or fabrication method and components for the identified conditions.
act_scope: Install, wire, assemble, secure, adjust, service, fabricate, and repair automatic, hydraulic, garage, and related mechanical door systems, including their tracks, springs, openers, safety devices, and activating mechanisms.

job_role_definition: Prepare detailed drawings, models, and specifications for machinery, mechanical components, and systems.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble specifications, sketches, design requirements, material dimensions, and consultation input needed to document mechanical equipment, components, and systems.
interpret_scope: Analyze design data and functional relationships, including calculated dimensions and production or operating constraints, to establish technically accurate drafting requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate mechanical layout, views, detailing approach, material identifiers, and revisions for the required documentation.
act_scope: Prepare, annotate, and revise detailed mechanical drawings, three-dimensional models, blueprints, and specifications that communicate component and system designs.

job_role_definition: Apply mechanical engineering principles to support the design, fabrication, testing, adjustment, and documentation of machinery and equipment under engineering direction.
acquire_scope: Obtain engineering instructions, drawings, specifications, and operating requirements, and set up and conduct inspections, tests, monitoring, and measurements to collect performance, reliability, dimensional, failure, energy, and cost data.
interpret_scope: Apply mechanical engineering principles to derive requirements from technical documents and assess capacities, dimensions, performance, stress response, failures, energy needs, costs, and test results against specifications and objectives.
decide_scope: Select design configurations, fabrication and assembly requirements, test and inspection plans, equipment adjustments, and recommended corrective or test-method changes under engineering direction.
act_scope: Prepare designs, layouts, specifications, sketches, schedules, records, and technical documentation; fabricate, assemble, disassemble, and adjust mechanical systems, components, tooling, and equipment; and provide related technical support.

job_role_definition: Mechanical Design and Development Engineers create, evaluate, validate, and refine mechanical designs, then support their translation into manufacturable, functioning solutions.
acquire_scope: Gather customer requirements, specifications, drawings, operating data, cost and maintenance constraints, research findings, and test evidence relevant to mechanical design.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements and evidence to determine design feasibility, performance, failure causes, manufacturability, sustainability, operating effects, and modification needs.
decide_scope: Select design concepts, components, specifications, manufacturing methods, test approaches, and modifications that best satisfy project requirements and constraints.
act_scope: Produce detailed mechanical designs, models, specifications, and test methods; direct drafting and production transition; and implement installation support and selected corrective modifications.

job_role_name: Mechanical Equipment Operations and Maintenance Engineers
job_role_definition: Mechanical Equipment Operations and Maintenance Engineers ensure mechanical equipment and systems are installed, operated, maintained, repaired, and improved to meet technical requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather technical drawings, specifications, operating and performance data, failure evidence, process conditions, and customer or user requirements for mechanical equipment.
interpret_scope: Evaluate equipment condition, performance, efficiency, and feasibility against requirements, diagnosing malfunctions and identifying operational, maintenance, safety, or design implications.
decide_scope: Select equipment configurations, operating and maintenance procedures, priorities, schedules, and remedial or improvement actions that best satisfy performance and safety requirements.
act_scope: Oversee and technically support equipment installation, operation, maintenance, repair, testing, and improvement, coordinating personnel and resolving malfunctions to achieve specified performance.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, test, and improve integrated mechanical, electronic, and automated control systems.
acquire_scope: Obtain system requirements, operating constraints, current-process information, and material and component options, and generate performance evidence through modeling, simulation, testing, and system monitoring.
interpret_scope: Analyze system behavior, existing procedures, and modeled, simulated, test, and monitoring results to assess design feasibility, cost, performance, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Select system architectures, materials, components, control approaches, design changes, and process improvements that meet assessed requirements and constraints.
act_scope: Produce detailed mechanical, electronic, software, and automated-control designs and documentation; implement, calibrate, and improve selected solutions; and deliver technical guidance.

job_role_definition: Direct broadcast programming by planning schedules, coordinating programming personnel and resources, and ensuring broadcasts meet operational, quality, and regulatory requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain program content and legal clearances, scheduling and audience inputs, operational advisories, and broadcast-performance information needed to direct programming.
interpret_scope: Assess programming, program logs, transmissions, and broadcast output for suitability, accuracy, schedule adherence, quality, and regulatory conformance.
decide_scope: Select programming and coverage, set broadcast and staff schedules, allocate resources, and determine needed programming, production, promotion, and compliance changes.
act_scope: Direct personnel and broadcast execution, prepare and deliver on-air material, coordinate departments and remote operations, and implement selected programming changes.

job_role_definition: Manages the personnel, facilities, policies, and departmental coordination supporting radio and television production.
acquire_scope: Gather production requirements, staffing availability, facility and equipment needs, broadcast conditions, and policy or regulatory inputs from production, engineering, operations, and promotions staff.
interpret_scope: Assess broadcast compliance, technical-control and production needs, resource constraints, and cross-departmental impacts on radio and television production.
decide_scope: Set technical policies, assign and schedule personnel and studio resources, coordinate departmental priorities, and determine needed staff training and production support.
act_scope: Manage technical-production personnel and facilities, train staff on production equipment, liaise across departments, monitor broadcasts, and coordinate delivery of programming and on-air promotions.

job_role_definition: Directs and executes the technical and visual presentation of live or recorded radio and television productions.
acquire_scope: Test and configure production equipment, and obtain live visual feeds and technical input on lenses, filters, graphics, and effects needed for the presentation.
interpret_scope: Monitor program images and production conditions to assess source quality, shading, composition, and the visual effect of available treatments.
decide_scope: Determine technical direction for camera adjustments and the appropriate source, transition, graphic, or visual treatment within production direction.
act_scope: Direct camera and video staff and operate production equipment to switch, transition, and deliver the technical and visual presentation of live or recorded radio and television productions.

occupation_name: Media and Communication Equipment Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Media and Communication Equipment Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform media and communication equipment work not classified in another specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the equipment, materials, requirements, and operating information needed for the assigned media or communication equipment work.
interpret_scope: Assess the obtained requirements and equipment information to establish the condition and needs relevant to the assigned work.
decide_scope: Select an appropriate course of action for the assigned media or communication equipment work.
act_scope: Perform the selected media or communication equipment work and deliver the resulting operation or service.

occupation_name: Media and Communication Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Media and Communication Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform media and communication work not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble the information, materials, and communication inputs required for the unspecified media or communication work.
interpret_scope: Analyze those inputs to establish their relevant meaning, audience implications, and task requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate communication approach, priorities, and course of action for the work.
act_scope: Perform and deliver the resulting media or communication work.

job_role_definition: Construct, fit, maintain, and repair prosthetic, orthotic, and other medical supportive devices to prescribed patient requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain prescriptions and specifications, take patient measurements and casts or impressions, and gather the materials, tools, templates, and test measurements needed to fabricate, fit, maintain, or repair prescribed supportive devices.
interpret_scope: Translate prescribed requirements and patient dimensions into device specifications, and assess alignment, movement, biomechanical stability, fit, and appearance requirements from measurements and testing.
decide_scope: Select fabrication materials, component dimensions and configurations, and the adjustments or repair modifications needed to meet prescribed patient requirements.
act_scope: Construct, assemble, shape, pad, finish, color-match, fit, adjust, maintain, and repair prosthetic, orthotic, and other supportive devices, and instruct patients in their use.

job_role_definition: An Administrative Medical Assistant receives patients and coordinates appointments, referrals, records, forms, and routine communications supporting orderly medical-office services.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain patient identity, requests, appointment needs, referral requirements, and relevant medical or insurance information from patients, records, and facilities.
interpret_scope: Determine administrative requirements, scheduling constraints, record needs, and routing implications for each patient visit, test, admission, or inquiry.
decide_scope: Select appointment times, referral or inquiry routing, required forms and record updates, and appropriate follow-up priorities within established office procedures.
act_scope: Greet and register patients, schedule visits or external services, update records and forms, and communicate arrangements to patients and facilities.

job_role_definition: Provides outpatient clinical support by preparing patients, obtaining routine measurements and specimens, performing directed diagnostics and treatments, and assisting examinations.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather patient histories and vital signs, collect specimens, and prepare rooms, instruments, and diagnostic equipment for clinical care.
interpret_scope: Check patient information, measurements, specimen or test outputs, and care instructions for completeness, abnormalities, and required visit support.
decide_scope: Prioritize and sequence assigned preparation, specimen, testing, treatment, education, and examination-support activities within established procedures.
act_scope: Deliver examination assistance, routine diagnostic and specimen services, and directed treatments and patient education while maintaining infection control and clinical records.

job_role_definition: Design and calculate safe, effective radiation treatment plans for cancer patients in collaboration with the radiation oncology team.
acquire_scope: Obtain prescribed treatment requirements, simulation and imaging data, and localization information needed to plan external-beam or brachytherapy treatment.
interpret_scope: Delineate tumors and critical structures and calculate or verify dose distributions, treatment delivery parameters, and relevant radiation measurements.
decide_scope: Select the technical treatment configuration, including radiation fields, beam-modifying and immobilization requirements, and dose delivery approach that meets prescribed objectives while limiting normal-tissue exposure.
act_scope: Develop, document, quality-check, and transfer the treatment plan and reference data, and prepare required delivery-modifying or positioning devices.

job_role_definition: Prepare, sterilize, inspect, stock, and distribute healthcare equipment and supplies for safe clinical use.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain supply requests and inventory information, and perform equipment inspections, operating checks, and sterilization tests needed to verify readiness for clinical use.
interpret_scope: Assess inventory status, supply currency, equipment condition and operation, and sterilization results against prescribed standards.
decide_scope: Determine processing, removal from use, defect escalation, replenishment, and distribution priorities for equipment and supplies.
act_scope: Clean, disinfect, sterilize, assemble, stock, document, maintain processing equipment, report defects, and distribute healthcare equipment and supplies for safe clinical use.

job_role_definition: Test, maintain, troubleshoot, repair, install, and evaluate medical and electromedical equipment for safe and reliable operation.
acquire_scope: Gather equipment histories, technical specifications, environmental and user-use observations, diagnostic measurements, installation requirements, and needed repair-part information.
interpret_scope: Analyze test results, equipment condition, hazards, technical requirements, and calculated load or space needs to diagnose faults and assess serviceability, compliance, and suitability.
decide_scope: Select maintenance, repair, replacement, disposition, installation, modification, and equipment-selection actions based on the assessment and applicable requirements.
act_scope: Perform and document preventive service, repairs, calibration, installation, modification, and final operational verification, and demonstrate proper equipment operation and maintenance to personnel.

job_role_definition: Classify patient diagnoses, procedures, and services into standardized healthcare codes for reimbursement, reporting, and analysis.
acquire_scope: Abstract relevant patient documentation, consult classification references, and obtain clarifications for missing, conflicting, or unclear clinical information.
interpret_scope: Determine the coding-relevant meaning of documented diagnoses, procedures, services, and disease processes under applicable classification rules.
decide_scope: Select the standardized diagnosis, procedure, service, and diagnosis-related group classifications that best represent the patient record.
act_scope: Enter and assign the selected codes and diagnosis-related group to deliver a coded record for reimbursement, reporting, and analysis.

job_role_definition: Compile, maintain, secure, review, retrieve, and release patient health records and related documentation.
acquire_scope: Obtain, enter, transcribe, scan, classify, and retrieve patient health information and related documentation for complete, usable records.
interpret_scope: Review record content for completeness, accuracy, documentation status, and regulatory compliance.
decide_scope: Determine required record corrections, indexing or filing treatment, and whether requested information may be released under applicable requirements.
act_scope: Compile, maintain, secure, store, update, retrieve, and authorizedly release patient health records and related documentation.

job_role_definition: Conduct biomedical research to understand disease and improve human health through the development and evaluation of medical knowledge, methods, and treatments.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare biological samples, experimental materials, measurements, and observational data through safe laboratory and field research on disease, physiology, exposures, and treatments.
interpret_scope: Analyze experimental, sample, and health-process evidence to determine disease mechanisms, toxicity, microorganisms, treatment effects, and the performance of medical methods.
decide_scope: Set research questions, study designs, protocols, dosages, immunization methods, and development priorities for medical applications and health standards.
act_scope: Direct and conduct biomedical studies, develop and evaluate medical methodologies and procedures, and communicate resulting medical knowledge through publications, presentations, and professional advice.

job_role_definition: Provide administrative and clerical support in medical settings by coordinating patient communications, appointments, records, billing, and office documentation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain patient intake and insurance details, practitioner orders and recorded instructions, incoming calls and messages, and the records and billing information needed for medical-office administration.
interpret_scope: Assess the purpose, completeness, and administrative requirements of patient requests, clinical orders, correspondence, and financial information.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate staff recipient, appointment or procedure arrangement, record handling, and communication or billing disposition based on the assessed information.
act_scope: Coordinate patient communications and appointments, route and transmit records and messages, maintain and prepare medical-office documentation, and complete claims, invoices, billing, and financial records.

job_role_definition: Transcribe, edit, and prepare dictated healthcare documentation accurately for inclusion in patients' medical records.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Receive dictated material and retrieve relevant patient-record information, terminology references, and clarifications needed to prepare the documentation.
interpret_scope: Review dictated and transcribed content to resolve medical terminology, abbreviations, inconsistencies, and errors for accuracy, clarity, and record consistency.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate report content and whether information should be included, excluded, or corrected.
act_scope: Transcribe, edit, format, enter, maintain, and return complete healthcare documentation for physician review and inclusion in patient medical records.

job_role_definition: Perform routine laboratory testing and related specimen, equipment, quality, and reporting work to support disease diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.
acquire_scope: Collect and prepare patient specimens, reagents, and control materials; ready laboratory equipment; and generate analytical, microscopic, hematologic, transfusion, and microbiological test evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate test measurements, cell and microorganism observations, and quality-control results to identify abnormalities and assess validity and conformity to specifications.
decide_scope: Select whether results are reportable or require repeat or confirmatory work, corrective quality measures, or consultation on abnormal findings.
act_scope: Document and issue validated laboratory findings and communicate abnormal results for diagnostic consultation.

job_role_definition: Perform complex diagnostic laboratory testing on biological specimens to support disease diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare biological specimens, cultures, media, slides, and reagents, and generate analytical, microscopic, cellular, microbial, calibration, and quality-control measurements and observations.
interpret_scope: Evaluate test and quality-control data to determine result accuracy, normal or abnormal characteristics, cell morphology, blood group and compatibility, and microbial identity.
decide_scope: Select testing methods and conditions, culture harvest timing, result disposition, and any repeat-testing or corrective course based on specimen requirements, findings, and quality controls.
act_scope: Document and communicate laboratory findings and implement equipment maintenance, quality-assurance, and other corrective actions required for reliable testing.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate the operations, resources, programs, and services of health care organizations or medical units.
acquire_scope: Obtain operational, financial, staffing, utilization, facility, regulatory, technological, and stakeholder information needed to manage health care operations, resources, programs, and services.
interpret_scope: Analyze organizational activity, performance, resource use, risks, service needs, and compliance conditions to assess operational status and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set objectives, policies, budgets, service rates, staffing and scheduling priorities, resource allocations, and plans for programs, changes, and facility improvements.
act_scope: Direct personnel and fiscal operations while implementing and coordinating health services, programs, procedures, staffing, training, communications, reporting, and operational changes.

job_role_definition: Plan, coordinate, and oversee meetings, conventions, and events to meet client and participant requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather client, participant, site, supplier, regulatory, financial, and event-performance information needed to prepare and run meetings, conventions, and events.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, facilities, providers, costs, compliance conditions, participant feedback, and event results to determine their implications for event delivery.
decide_scope: Set the event scope, format, program, agenda, budget, services, suppliers, contracts, speakers, promotional approach, and corrective priorities.
act_scope: Coordinate and oversee event staff, registrations, permits, facilities, logistics, services, communications, financial administration, and live operations to deliver compliant events and resolve issues.

job_role_definition: Counsel individuals, groups, and families to improve mental and emotional health and address behavioral, relational, and life-adjustment problems.
acquire_scope: Elicit and gather confidential client, family, behavioral, risk, medication, and treatment-progress information through interviews, observation, assessments, records, and necessary care coordination.
interpret_scope: Assess clients’ mental and physical condition, relationships, suicide risk, needs, and progress to form clinical understanding of the problems and treatment response.
decide_scope: Select and revise individualized treatment, safety, transition, referral, and service-coordination plans in response to clinical assessment and changing client status.
act_scope: Deliver individual, group, and family counseling, crisis intervention, skills guidance, advocacy, referrals, and planned therapeutic activities to improve mental and emotional health and address behavioral, relational, and adjustment problems.

occupation_name: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
job_role_name: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
job_role_definition: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers assess client needs and provide counseling, treatment coordination, and recovery support to clients and families.
acquire_scope: Gather client histories, symptoms, risks, strengths, barriers, progress, records, family input, professional observations, and resource information through interviews and assessments.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clients’ mental, physical, relational, and socioeconomic conditions to identify treatment needs, safety concerns, recovery barriers, and progress toward goals.
decide_scope: Formulate and revise treatment goals, counseling approaches, care priorities, referrals, and coordinated support plans based on assessed needs and treatment response.
act_scope: Deliver individual, group, and family counseling and education; coordinate treatment, referrals, and practical supports; and provide crisis, adherence, and recovery support.

job_role_definition: Plan, create, install, and maintain commercial merchandise displays that attract customers and support promotions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather promotion, inventory, product, placement, floor-plan, design-specification, and display-material inputs through consultation and retrieval of merchandise, props, and plans.
interpret_scope: Translate campaign, product, space, and customer-appeal requirements into workable display concepts, layouts, sketches, and visual treatments.
decide_scope: Choose the merchandise emphasis, timing and placement, and the themes, colors, lighting, props, signage, and implementation approach for each display.
act_scope: Construct, install, arrange, label, rotate, decorate, photograph, and maintain commercial merchandise and window displays, including their components and mannequins.

occupation_name: Metal Workers and Plastic Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Metal Workers and Plastic Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform miscellaneous metalworking and plastic-working jobs not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain job requirements, relevant material inputs, measurements, tools, and equipment needed for miscellaneous metalworking and plastic-working jobs.
interpret_scope: Translate job requirements and measurements into the specifications and condition assessments relevant to the work.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate work sequence, methods, tooling, and adjustments to meet the job requirements.
act_scope: Perform the required miscellaneous metalworking and plastic-working operations and complete the resulting workpiece or service.

job_role_definition: Operate and tend metal-refining furnaces to melt, refine, and transfer molten metal that meets production specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Prepare and weigh furnace inputs, draw molten-metal samples, and observe gauges, metal properties, furnace operation, and equipment condition.
interpret_scope: Assess material quality, process status, temperature conditions, developing operational problems, and furnace or equipment defects and wear.
decide_scope: Determine charge composition, heat and cooling adjustments, impurity treatments, corrective maintenance responses, and when metal is ready for discharge or transfer.
act_scope: Charge and fire furnaces, regulate heating and cooling, treat and skim molten metal, coordinate furnace repairs, and discharge or transfer metal to complete refining.

job_role_definition: Read utility meters and record consumption data while addressing routine access, service, and meter issues encountered on assigned routes.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Travel assigned routes to obtain and record utility-meter consumption readings, verify anomalous readings, inspect meters and access conditions, and maintain current address and meter-location information.
interpret_scope: Assess readings and inspections to identify abnormal consumption, likely causes of fluctuations, unauthorized connections, defects, damage, and access or service problems.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate routine response to identified access, service, meter, and customer-service issues, including whether to arrange access, refer the matter, or perform authorized field service.
act_scope: Submit collected consumption information and carry out the selected routine response by communicating access or meter problems, arranging return access, answering or directing customer inquiries, connecting or disconnecting service, and performing minor meter maintenance or repairs.

job_role_definition: Provide microbiological analysis and interpretation to support disease diagnosis, treatment, infection control, and public-health protection.
acquire_scope: Prepare and maintain microbial cultures and use laboratory instruments to obtain test measurements from human, water, food, environmental, and related biological specimens.
interpret_scope: Analyze microbial, cellular, tissue, pathogen, and toxin characteristics and test results to identify organisms, assess disease and contamination relationships, and determine relevant findings.
decide_scope: Formulate technical recommendations for diagnosis, treatment, infection control, epidemic control, and public-health protection from the analytical findings.
act_scope: Deliver microbiological laboratory services and communicate findings and recommendations through technical reports to health departments, environmental health programs, and physicians.

job_role_definition: Investigate microorganisms and develop microbiological knowledge, products, and processes for scientific, health, environmental, and industrial applications.
acquire_scope: Collect and prepare specimens, cultures, reagents, and experimental measurements using controlled media, microscopy, analytical instruments, and other specialized laboratory equipment.
interpret_scope: Analyze microbial, chemical, cellular, tissue, pathogen, and toxin observations to identify and classify microorganisms and determine their growth, structure, functions, and effects on health, disease, and organic matter.
decide_scope: Select research conclusions, control approaches, and evidence-based recommendations, including the designs and applications of microbiological products and processes.
act_scope: Conduct microbiological investigations and develop and document new knowledge, contamination-detection methods, preservation or sterilization procedures, and microorganism-derived products.

job_role_definition: Researches, designs, develops, fabricates, and tests MEMS devices, processes, and applications.
acquire_scope: Obtain requirements and material, supplier, and fabrication inputs, and generate simulation, experimental, characterization, inspection, qualification, process-monitoring, life-test, and field-trial data for MEMS devices and processes.
interpret_scope: Analyze modeled, experimental, inspection, and field data to determine design behavior, process capability, feasibility, performance, reliability, yield, quality, and conformance to requirements.
decide_scope: Select and refine MEMS concepts, designs, materials, packaging, fabrication methods, test criteria, process controls, and research, development, production, or deployment plans within applicable constraints.
act_scope: Create engineering layouts, schematics, specifications, and control documentation; develop production processes and tooling; and fabricate, assemble, demonstrate, and deploy MEMS prototypes, devices, and applications.

occupation_name: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
job_role_name: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
job_role_definition: Teach academic subjects to middle school students while supporting their learning, development, conduct, and progress.
acquire_scope: Assemble curriculum-aligned instructional materials and classroom resources, and gather evidence of students’ learning, behavior, development, needs, and progress through observation, assignments, assessments, and communication.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student work, assessment results, and observed academic, behavioral, social, developmental, and health-related information to identify progress, strengths, needs, and problems.
decide_scope: Set instructional objectives and select lesson structures, teaching adaptations, behavioral responses, interventions, and student-support priorities based on curriculum requirements and identified needs.
act_scope: Teach academic subjects; conduct and supervise learning activities; maintain an orderly, safe learning environment; provide targeted help and guidance; and communicate and document student progress.

job_role_definition: Provide prenatal, childbirth, newborn, postpartum, and related reproductive health care.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain reproductive and health histories and gather maternal, fetal, newborn, and gynecologic inputs through examinations, monitoring, testing, specimens, records, and assessment of birth-site readiness.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical findings and records to determine pregnancy dating, maternal, fetal, newborn, postpartum, and reproductive health status, including complications and urgent conditions.
decide_scope: Develop and revise individualized midwifery and contingency care plans, selecting interventions, treatments, referrals, preventive recommendations, and needed resources.
act_scope: Deliver prenatal, childbirth, newborn, postpartum, and related reproductive health care through labor support and delivery assistance, clinical treatment and emergency care, procedures, counseling, education, and care coordination.

occupation_name: Military Enlisted Tactical Operations and Air/Weapons Specialists and Crew Members, All Other
job_role_name: Military Enlisted Tactical Operations and Air/Weapons Specialists and Crew Members, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform enlisted military tactical operations or air and weapons specialist or crew-member duties not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain operational orders, mission information, status reports, equipment, weapons, and other materials needed for assigned tactical, air, weapons-specialist, or crew-member duties.
interpret_scope: Assess mission information, environmental conditions, equipment status, and tactical developments to determine their operational meaning.
decide_scope: Select immediate task priorities, procedures, responses, and resource use within assigned duties and operational direction.
act_scope: Perform assigned enlisted tactical operations or air, weapons-specialist, and crew-member duties, including operating, employing, maintaining, and coordinating required equipment and actions.

occupation_name: Military Officer Special and Tactical Operations Leaders, All Other
job_role_name: Military Officer Special and Tactical Operations Leaders, All Other
job_role_definition: Lead specialized or tactical military operations not classified under a separately listed officer occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain operational intelligence, mission requirements, force status, terrain, resource information, and changing conditions needed to lead specialized or tactical operations.
interpret_scope: Assess the operational situation, threats, capabilities, constraints, and likely consequences indicated by the available information.
decide_scope: Select mission priorities, tactical plans, force employment, and operational adjustments needed to achieve the objective.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate specialized or tactical military operations by issuing orders and overseeing their execution.

occupation_name: Milling and Planing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Milling and Planing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend milling and planing machines to shape metal or plastic workpieces to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work orders and dimensional requirements, prepare workpieces and materials, and take alignment and in-process or finished-part measurements.
interpret_scope: Read specifications and drawings, calculate required dimensions, tolerances, and angles, and assess measurements and machine operation against required tolerances.
decide_scope: Choose tooling, attachments, materials, machining sequence, cutter settings, and corrective adjustments needed to produce the specified workpiece.
act_scope: Install or make required cutting tools or templates, secure and align workpieces, set up and run milling or planing equipment, regulate coolant, feed material or cutters, and replace or sharpen worn tools to shape parts to specification.

job_role_definition: Install, relocate, dismantle, align, and maintain industrial machinery and heavy equipment so it operates to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain drawings, specifications, replacement materials, condition observations, and dimensional, level, alignment, and operating-test measurements for machinery and equipment work.
interpret_scope: Evaluate drawings, measurements, test results, and equipment symptoms to determine installation requirements, operating condition, faults, and departures from specification.
decide_scope: Select the work sequence, positioning and support approach, repair or replacement method, required adjustments, and fabrication or modification needed to restore or establish specified operation.
act_scope: Install, relocate, dismantle, support, assemble, fasten, connect, align, adjust, repair, lubricate, fabricate, and machine industrial machinery and heavy equipment to specification.

occupation_name: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers
job_role_definition: Characterizes subsurface conditions and mineral deposits to evaluate resources, development sites, and geological constraints on mining.
acquire_scope: Obtain maps, deposit and drilling records, site observations, and mine-condition data needed to characterize subsurface conditions and mineral deposits.
interpret_scope: Determine deposit location, size, accessibility, contents, value, profitability potential, and geological constraints, and assess resource and development-site potential from the assembled evidence.
decide_scope: NA — The central function produces geological assessments rather than selecting a recommendation, plan, disposition, or course of action.
act_scope: Prepare technical reports communicating geological characterizations and evaluations to mining, engineering, and management personnel.

occupation_name: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers
job_role_definition: Plans, designs, develops, and improves mining operations and systems for safe, economical, and environmentally sound mineral extraction.
acquire_scope: Examine deposit, map, drilling, mine-condition, production, cost, equipment, environmental, and air-quality information, including inspections and experiments, to establish operating constraints and opportunities.
interpret_scope: Assess deposit characteristics, accessibility, value and profitability, operational performance, safety conditions, and environmental effects to define engineering requirements and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Select mine locations, extraction and production methods, operating plans, schedules, resource and equipment configurations, and safety, pollution-control, reclamation, and process solutions.
act_scope: Design, develop, implement, monitor, direct, and improve mining operations, facilities, equipment, material-handling and treatment systems, construction, and technical operating outputs for mineral extraction.

occupation_name: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers
job_role_definition: Protects mine workers by identifying hazards and designing, implementing, and coordinating mine safety controls and programs.
acquire_scope: Inspect mine areas, structures, equipment, working conditions, and air quality to obtain evidence of unsafe conditions and toxic-gas exposure.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection and air-test findings to identify hazards and prepare technical safety reports for mining, engineering, and management personnel.
decide_scope: Determine appropriate hazard controls and recommend corrective measures, including ventilation and protective or rescue provisions.
act_scope: Design, implement, coordinate, and maintain mine safety programs, protective and rescue equipment, and safety devices to protect workers.

occupation_name: Mixing and Blending Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Mixing and Blending Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and monitor mixing or blending machinery to produce materials that meet specified requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications, measure and assemble required materials, and collect process and product samples and operating data.
interpret_scope: Assess work requirements, equipment conditions, and material or product characteristics against specifications and safety standards.
decide_scope: Select machine setup, operating adjustments, mixing duration, and the point to stop or transfer the mixture based on production requirements and observed results.
act_scope: Set up, load, operate, tend, monitor, clean, maintain, and clear mixing, blending, and material-transfer equipment to produce and move conforming materials.

occupation_name: Mobile Heavy Equipment Mechanics, Except Engines
job_role_name: Mobile Heavy Equipment Mechanics, Except Engines
job_role_definition: Diagnoses, maintains, repairs, and overhauls mobile mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical equipment systems, verifying restored condition and operating performance.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect and operate equipment, measure component condition and system performance, consult technical specifications, and obtain repair-specific parts and materials.
interpret_scope: Identify defects, wear, misalignment, and mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, or electrical malfunctions, determining their causes and required corrective work.
decide_scope: Select maintenance, repair, adjustment, or overhaul actions; determine parts, tools, and methods; and establish disassembly, reassembly, and testing sequences.
act_scope: Dismantle and service equipment; repair, replace, fit, fabricate, or align components; then reassemble, adjust, and test for specified performance.

job_role_definition: Fabricate, assemble, test, and refine metal or plastic working models and prototypes to engineering specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain engineering specifications and developmental input, select and prepare materials, and lay out and measure reference dimensions for model or prototype work.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings and test or inspection measurements into required dimensions, fabrication requirements, conformance findings, and developmental problems.
decide_scope: Determine material, equipment, machining and assembly sequences, tooling or fixture approaches, and needed part rework or product modifications.
act_scope: Fabricate, program and operate equipment for, assemble, wire, test, finish, refine, and document metal or plastic working models and prototypes to specification.

job_role_definition: Construct precision wooden models, patterns, templates, molds, mock-ups, and jigs from specifications for product and production use.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
