acquire_scope: Obtain specifications and design clarification, select suitable wooden stock, and assemble the precision measuring and layout inputs needed for the work.
interpret_scope: Translate drawings, specifications, and in-process measurements into required dimensions, contours, shapes, and production requirements.
decide_scope: Determine part layouts, construction and assembly methods, machine setups and adjustments, and the sequence for producing each required model, pattern, template, mold, mock-up, or jig.
act_scope: Lay out, cut, shape, assemble, verify, identify, finish, and deliver precision wooden models, patterns, templates, molds, mock-ups, jigs, and necessary work aids for product and production use.

job_role_definition: Poses as a subject for paintings, sculptures, photographs, and other forms of artistic expression.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive artists’ or photographers’ direction and the visual requirements for the intended artistic work.
interpret_scope: Translate the requested subject, composition, and visual effect into pose and appearance requirements.
decide_scope: Select body position, expression, styling, and responsive adjustments for the requested artistic result.
act_scope: Prepare the required appearance and pose, maintaining the selected position and expression while coordinating with the creative team.

job_role_definition: Models apparel, accessories, or other merchandise for buyers, advertising, photography, filming, and promotional appearances.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain creative requirements, production direction, garments, accessories, and relevant appearance or camera information for each engagement.
interpret_scope: Assess the intended merchandise presentation and the implications of direction, garment characteristics, camera techniques, and facial features for the required look.
decide_scope: Choose suitable interpretive poses and, where applicable, accessory selections or presentation adjustments to achieve the required look.
act_scope: Maintain presentation readiness, prepare personal appearance and merchandise, coordinate with the production team, and deliver the required presentation through posing and promotional appearances.

occupation_name: Molders, Shapers, and Casters, Except Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Molders, Shapers, and Casters, Except Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Form and finish nonmetal and nonplastic products by preparing molds and materials, casting or shaping products, and completing cured pieces.
acquire_scope: Obtain product specifications and assemble material measurements, dimensional readings, and visual observations needed for forming and checking pieces.
interpret_scope: Determine production requirements and assess measurement and inspection evidence to identify conformance, inaccuracies, or defects.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate mold configuration, processing settings, and corrective or finishing actions for the specified product.
act_scope: Construct and condition molds; prepare, place, distribute, cure, and release materials; and assemble, trim, repair, mark, and finish the resulting pieces.

occupation_name: Molding, Coremaking, and Casting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Molding, Coremaking, and Casting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, or tend molding, coremaking, and casting machines to produce conforming metal or thermoplastic parts and products.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Retrieve production specifications and gather required materials, tooling, and process fluids while observing machine operation and obtaining gauge readings and dimensional and surface inspection results.
interpret_scope: Assess operating conditions and inspection results against specifications to identify conformance, defects, jams, malfunctions, and process deviations.
decide_scope: Select the production sequence, setup, tooling, process settings, adjustments, and corrective responses required for each molding, coremaking, or casting run.
act_scope: Install and prepare molds, dies, tooling, and workpieces; load and process materials; regulate and operate equipment; perform routine equipment care; and cool, remove, trim, and identify completed parts.

job_role_definition: Research cellular molecules and organelles to understand cell function and organization and develop biological applications.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare biological materials, reagents, equipment outputs, assay measurements, and experimental records needed to investigate cellular molecules, organelles, function, and organization.
interpret_scope: Analyze molecular and cellular experimental data to determine mechanisms, cell characteristics, research findings, and the suitability of methods, supplies, and technologies.
decide_scope: Select experimental designs and adjustments, research priorities, laboratory procedures, and scientific approaches for disease-model evaluation and biological applications.
act_scope: Conduct and oversee molecular and cellular experiments, develop assays, procedures, databases, and biological applications, and communicate the resulting scientific findings.

job_role_definition: Arrange and direct funeral and disposition services, including care of remains, coordination of service details, and support for bereaved families.
acquire_scope: Gather decedent, family, legal, disposition, benefit, and service-logistics information, including required documentation and available arrangements.
interpret_scope: Assess family wishes, bereavement needs, legal and disposition requirements, benefit eligibility, and practical service constraints.
decide_scope: Select and agree the funeral, burial, cremation, or shipment plan, including service details, timing, providers, transportation, and needed participants.
act_scope: Care for and transport remains, complete and coordinate the selected arrangements, prepare service sites, direct funeral and disposition services, and support bereaved families.

job_role_definition: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain film projection and related sound equipment to deliver high-quality theater presentations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect films, projection and sound equipment, and presentation controls; assemble and connect the required film, auxiliary equipment, and venue inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment condition and live picture and sound quality to identify setup, operating, maintenance, or repair needs.
decide_scope: Select adjustments, operating coordination, projector transfers, and the appropriate response to equipment faults to maintain the presentation.
act_scope: Set up, operate, monitor, adjust, clean, maintain, repair, rewind, and prepare projection and related sound equipment to deliver theater presentations.

job_role_definition: Operate motor vehicles in transportation roles not classified under a separate motor vehicle operator occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the vehicle, route, operational instructions, required materials, and relevant traffic and condition information for the assigned transportation service.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle status, road and environmental conditions, route constraints, and operating information as they affect safe completion of the assignment.
decide_scope: Select driving maneuvers, routing adjustments, and operating responses needed to complete the assigned transportation service.
act_scope: Operate the motor vehicle to carry out the assigned transportation role safely and effectively.

job_role_definition: Repair, maintain, adjust, and test inboard and inboard-outboard motorboat engines and related mechanical and electrical systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect and disassemble engines and related systems, and obtain operational test observations and measurements from motors, boats, and test equipment.
interpret_scope: Diagnose defective parts and system malfunctions by assessing mechanical, electrical, cooling, vibration, smoke, misfiring, and performance evidence.
decide_scope: Select the needed maintenance, repair, replacement, adjustment, alignment, wiring, or part-rework approach to restore proper operation.
act_scope: Perform the selected maintenance, repairs, replacements, adjustments, reassembly, mounting, alignment, wiring, and part rework on engines and related boat systems.

job_role_definition: Operate and oversee small motor-driven vessels to transport passengers, vehicles, or goods safely along intended routes.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain navigational indications, depth and hazard information, and the vessel, crew, passenger/cargo, fuel, supply, and equipment inputs needed for a safe voyage.
interpret_scope: Assess navigational aids, water depth, hazards, vessel condition, loading conditions, and emergencies to determine their operational implications.
decide_scope: Select courses, maneuvers, safety responses, crew assignments, and readiness actions, including needed repairs, fuel, and supplies.
act_scope: Operate and oversee the vessel to transport passengers, vehicles, or goods safely, including steering, docking, loading direction, crew direction, emergency operations, and necessary vessel upkeep.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, repair, overhaul, and test motorcycles and similar motorized two-wheeled vehicles.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer-reported symptoms and collect vehicle-condition, alignment, pressure, movement, function, and performance evidence through inspection, listening, gauges, and testing before and after service.
interpret_scope: Diagnose malfunctions, damage, wear, and performance deficiencies and assess whether completed work restored proper operation.
decide_scope: Select the necessary maintenance, adjustment, repair, replacement, overhaul, restoration, or accessory-installation work and required parts.
act_scope: Perform the selected tire service, adjustments, disassembly, repair, replacement, engine overhaul, frame restoration, reassembly, and accessory installation to return the motorcycle to proper condition.

occupation_name: Multiple Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Multiple Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and make routine adjustments to multiple cutting or forming machine tools or robots that produce metal and plastic workpieces.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications, workpiece and operating measurements, machine-condition observations, and the stock, tooling, fluids, and reference marks required to produce the workpiece.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, calculated settings, measurements, and machine observations to determine required operating parameters, workpiece accuracy, and routine faults.
decide_scope: Select the operational sequence, tooling, fluids, machine settings, and routine corrective disposition needed to meet the specified workpiece requirements.
act_scope: Set up, program where applicable, operate, tend, adjust, maintain, and clear multiple machine tools or robots, including finishing workpieces and making routine repairs.

job_role_definition: Assesses, restores, and preserves museum objects through conservation treatment, preventive care, testing, and research.
acquire_scope: Examine objects, review documentation, and conduct chemical, physical, and conservation research tests to obtain evidence on condition, materials, history, and preservation needs.
interpret_scope: Assess that evidence to determine an object's age, composition, original appearance, deterioration, treatment need, and conservation requirements.
decide_scope: Select safe, effective treatment and preventive-preservation methods, storage procedures, research directions, and referral or preservation recommendations when specialized work is needed.
act_scope: Clean, repair, restore, reassemble, fabricate needed components, and preserve objects through conservation treatment or directed preservation work.

job_role_definition: Documents, handles, stores, transports, and installs museum objects while supporting collections, exhibitions, and public programs.
acquire_scope: Obtain object images, field and condition observations, collection and inventory records, and the materials needed for storage, transport, installation, display, and access.
interpret_scope: Identify and classify objects, evaluate their condition and status, and assess storage, transport, installation, display, and access requirements from observations and records.
decide_scope: Select registration assignments and plans for object handling, packing, storage, transport, placement, mounting, exhibit setup, corrective work, and public-program delivery.
act_scope: Register objects, update collection records, and report findings; safely prepare, store, transport, arrange, mount, and install objects and exhibits; correct setup problems; and conduct tours and educational courses.

job_role_definition: Create, arrange, adapt, and notate original music for performance, recording, and commercial media.
acquire_scope: Gather creative source material and project requirements by consulting producers or directors and reviewing scripts, films, environmental sounds, and musical resources.
interpret_scope: Evaluate those inputs, musical ideas, sounds, performer capabilities, and dramatic or commercial context to establish the intended musical effect, mood, style, and practical constraints.
decide_scope: Select the musical form, melodic, harmonic, rhythmic, tempo, tonal, instrumental, vocal, balance, and adaptation choices that will achieve the intended result.
act_scope: Create, arrange, adapt, complete, and notate music and performer parts for performance, recording, and commercial media, coordinating final scores and producing recordings when required.

job_role_definition: Plan, organize, rehearse, and lead musical ensembles and performances to achieve an intended artistic interpretation.
acquire_scope: Study musical scores and gather information on ensemble capabilities, performer suitability, resources, and performance requirements.
interpret_scope: Develop an artistic interpretation of the music and assess how ensemble characteristics affect balance, preparation, and presentation.
decide_scope: Select repertoire and performers, determine member placement, and set rehearsal and performance plans to realize the intended interpretation.
act_scope: Arrange and lead rehearsals and performances, using direction and coordination to shape ensemble execution and achieve the desired musical effects.

job_role_definition: Plan, provide, coordinate, and evaluate evidence-based music therapy interventions to improve clients' physical, psychological, cognitive, or behavioral functioning.
acquire_scope: Gather client histories, diagnostic information, observations, interviews, and responses to music experiences, including relevant treatment-team input.
interpret_scope: Assess and synthesize client functioning, needs, strengths, progress, treatment outcomes, and risks to form therapy findings.
decide_scope: Set and coordinate treatment goals and recommendations; select, adapt, and sequence evidence-based music therapy approaches, materials, and session plans, including treatment continuation or termination.
act_scope: Deliver and adapt music therapy interventions through facilitated music experiences, performance, improvisation, and therapeutic communication; respond to emergencies and document and communicate treatment plans, findings, and progress.

job_role_definition: Repairs, restores, adjusts, and finishes musical instruments to maintain their function, sound quality, and condition.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect and play instruments to obtain condition, sound-quality, and defect evidence, and prepare the repair materials needed for the work.
interpret_scope: Assess defects and tonal or intonation conditions and determine the level of restoration required to meet functional, sound-quality, and condition needs.
decide_scope: Select the repair, restoration, adjustment, part-replacement, and finishing approach needed for the instrument.
act_scope: Disassemble and reassemble instruments; repair, replace, or fabricate components; and perform structural, mechanical, tonal, and finish work to restore required function, sound quality, and condition.

job_role_definition: Evaluates and adjusts the pitch and intonation of musical instruments to achieve the required sound.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Play or strike instruments and obtain pitch, tone, and sound-quality readings using tuning references and measurement devices.
interpret_scope: Assess the measured and heard sounds to determine pitch, intonation, tonal quality, and any defects relative to the required sound.
decide_scope: Select the tuning corrections and adjustment sequence needed to achieve the required pitch and intonation.
act_scope: Adjust instrument string tensions with hand tools to deliver the required sound.

job_role_definition: Perform instrumental music as a soloist or ensemble member for live, recorded, and broadcast productions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare repertoire, scores or parts, instructions, and ensemble cues by listening, learning, memorizing, and rehearsing music.
interpret_scope: Read and understand musical notation, recorded references, harmony, melody, rhythm, and other performance cues in relation to the assigned piece.
decide_scope: Choose stylistic treatment, phrasing, timing, and appropriate real-time adjustments or improvisations for the performance.
act_scope: Practice and play the instrument as a soloist or ensemble member to deliver live, recorded, broadcast, and accompanying musical performances.

job_role_definition: Perform vocal music as a soloist or group member for live, recorded, and broadcast productions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare musical selections, lyrics, notation, accompaniment, performance cues, and role or production context through study, listening, practice, and rehearsal.
interpret_scope: Derive the intended musical, textual, stylistic, and dramatic meaning of the material, including pitch, rhythm, harmony, phrasing, and ensemble cues.
decide_scope: Choose the vocal, expressive, stylistic, and in-the-moment performance adjustments that realize the music appropriately for the production.
act_scope: Perform vocal music as a soloist or group member, with or without accompaniment, in live, recorded, and broadcast productions.

job_role_definition: Provide in-home care that safeguards and supports children's daily physical, emotional, social, and intellectual development.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain care supplies and food, gather children’s schedules and parent guidance, and observe their behavior, health, routines, and developmental indicators.
interpret_scope: Assess observations and parent information to identify children’s health, safety, developmental, behavioral, and routine-care needs.
decide_scope: Set appropriate care priorities, routines, boundaries, activities, discipline approaches, and responses to health or safety concerns.
act_scope: Provide supervision and hands-on care by maintaining a safe environment, meeting daily health and nutrition needs, teaching and modeling skills, conducting age-appropriate activities, assisting with homework and transport, coordinating care with parents, completing child-related household tasks, and responding to emergencies.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, test, and support nanoscale materials, devices, systems, and their production processes.
acquire_scope: Gather nanoscale material, process, application, customer-use, and production requirements, and generate characterization, imaging, force-measurement, research, and test evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze nanoscale experimental and production evidence to assess material, device, system, and environmental-performance behavior.
decide_scope: Select nanosystem designs, applications, material-processing methods, test approaches, production equipment, and improvements that meet performance, durability, toxicity, efficiency, and waste-reduction objectives.
act_scope: Design, develop, synthesize, prototype, reengineer, and support nanoscale materials, devices, systems, and production processes, including delivering technical guidance and coordinating implementation.

job_role_definition: Supports nanoengineering work by implementing, operating, testing, characterizing, documenting, and improving processes that produce or modify nanoscale materials, devices, and systems.
acquire_scope: Prepare materials and controlled conditions, calibrate equipment, and obtain process, functional, dimensional, imaging, emission, and other characterization measurements and engineering data for nanoscale materials, devices, and systems.
interpret_scope: Evaluate measurement and test data to characterize material, device, process, performance, and environmental properties against applicable specifications or experimental objectives.
decide_scope: Select experimental, processing, testing, and method-improvement approaches, including appropriate process adjustments and specifications, in collaboration with engineering personnel.
act_scope: Operate, monitor, maintain, and repair production, processing, testing, and assembly equipment; implement improved nanoscale methods; and deliver required production, process-transfer, and technical documentation while maintaining cleanroom, safety, and waste-control conditions.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate scientific research, development, technical operations, and associated staff and resources.
acquire_scope: Obtain scientific and operational evidence, project status, stakeholder requirements, resource and budget information, workforce capability information, and applicable regulatory inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess research, testing, operational, financial, and workforce information to determine project progress, technical implications, compliance needs, and organizational capability.
decide_scope: Set scientific and technical goals and select project and testing plans, policies, staffing actions, resource allocations, expenditures, and implementation priorities.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate research, development, and technical operations; hire, supervise, and develop staff; administer resources and budgets; implement work standards; and communicate proposals, findings, specifications, and project status.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent patients' health conditions through naturopathic medical care.
acquire_scope: Elicit and document patient symptoms, histories, and records; perform examinations, physiological tests, screenings, and specimen collection; and obtain or arrange relevant diagnostic studies.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical histories, examination findings, laboratory and imaging results, and physiological measurements to diagnose conditions and assess health risks.
decide_scope: Develop preventive and therapeutic care plans, including naturopathic regimens, diagnostic testing, referrals, and use of permitted medicines or procedures.
act_scope: Deliver naturopathic care by educating patients, prescribing or dispensing medicines, administering therapies and preventive services, performing indicated manual, wound, and minor surgical treatments, and coordinating referred care.

job_role_definition: Administer and maintain an organization's networked computing infrastructure to ensure its availability, security, performance, and recoverability.
acquire_scope: Monitor and test systems, networks, security controls, backups, and voice services, and collect user needs, configurations, logs, and performance and maintenance data needed to administer the infrastructure.
interpret_scope: Diagnose system and network faults, evaluate performance and capacity trends, assess security and recovery conditions, and translate user needs and technical evidence into infrastructure requirements.
decide_scope: Select repairs, replacements, configuration adjustments, security measures, recovery responses, and current or future infrastructure changes.
act_scope: Administer, configure, secure, support, repair, back up, recover, and routinely operate the organization's networked computing infrastructure and associated email, protection, and voice services.

job_role_definition: Conducts and documents electroneurodiagnostic studies to provide physicians with technical information about brain, sleep, and nervous system function.
acquire_scope: Collect relevant patient information and obtain the anatomical measurements, electrode locations, and equipment readiness needed for neurodiagnostic testing.
interpret_scope: Evaluate recordings and evoked responses, distinguish physiologic findings from artifacts or interference, and synthesize the resulting technical data into findings.
decide_scope: Select and tailor study protocols, montages, equipment settings, and corrective actions to obtain valid brain, sleep, and nervous-system data.
act_scope: Prepare and reassure patients, place electrodes, perform and monitor electrodiagnostic and intraoperative studies, document recordings, and deliver technical reports to physicians.

job_role_definition: Monitors neurophysiologic signals during surgery to alert the surgical team to changes that may indicate threatened nervous system function.
acquire_scope: Obtain relevant patient information, prepare and position electrodes, configure and calibrate recording and stimulation equipment, and collect continuous intraoperative neurophysiologic measurements.
interpret_scope: Assess recorded signals, evoked responses, and external artifacts to identify clinically meaningful changes from baseline.
decide_scope: Determine whether an observed change indicates threatened nervous system function and requires escalation to the surgical team.
act_scope: Conduct and maintain intraoperative monitoring, correct technical malfunctions or recording interference, and promptly alert the surgical team to concerning changes.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, manage, and treat nonsurgical disorders of the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document neurological histories, examinations, neuroimaging, laboratory findings, and diagnostic-procedure results, including information needed to monitor treatment effects.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical, laboratory, imaging, and electrophysiological findings to diagnose neurological disorders, assess prognosis and treatment effects, and determine brain death when indicated.
decide_scope: Select individualized nonsurgical treatment, supportive-care, referral, and care-coordination plans based on diagnoses, patient condition, risks, benefits, and costs.
act_scope: Manage and treat neurological disorders through medication and specialized therapies, patient and family counseling, communication with clinicians, and delivery of coordinated ongoing care.

job_role_definition: Evaluates, diagnoses, and treats cognitive and behavioral effects of neurological conditions and supports patients, families, and care teams.
acquire_scope: Obtain comprehensive histories, interviews, observations, self-reports, rating-scale results, and neuropsychological test and baseline measurements across cognitive, behavioral, and sensorimotor functioning.
interpret_scope: Integrate assessment evidence to characterize cognitive and behavioral functioning, monitor change or recovery, and determine the effects of neurological, developmental, substance-related, infectious, or toxic conditions.
decide_scope: Formulate diagnoses and select individualized treatment, rehabilitation, monitoring, and communication priorities based on the clinical assessment.
act_scope: Deliver neuropsychological evaluations and clinical reports; implement treatment and rehabilitation; and counsel, educate, and consult with patients, families, and care teams.

job_role_definition: Studies the relationships among brain function, cognition, and behavior through neuropsychological research.
acquire_scope: Gather current scientific knowledge, methods, and study data relevant to brain function, cognition, behavior, and neuropsychological disorders.
interpret_scope: Analyze research evidence to determine relationships among brain function, cognition, behavior, and neuropsychological disorders.
decide_scope: Select research questions, methodological approaches, and investigative priorities for the study.
act_scope: Produce and communicate findings on relationships among brain function, cognition, behavior, and neuropsychological disorders.

job_role_definition: Open and service customers' financial accounts by explaining available services, obtaining required information, and processing related transactions and records.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer identity, application, credit, account, and transaction information, together with required funds, fees, and supporting records.
interpret_scope: Assess customer needs and account-service requirements, reconcile customer and institutional records, and identify transaction or record discrepancies.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate service, account-processing path, correction, referral, or transaction disposition based on the customer’s needs and applicable records.
act_scope: Explain and provide financial account services; open and maintain accounts; process related records, applications, deposits, payments, transfers, currency transactions, teller transactions, and safe-deposit access.

job_role_definition: Produces analysis, opinion, commentary, columns, or reviews about news and current events.
acquire_scope: Gather and select news developments, current issues, and relevant personal experience as material for commentary, columns, and reviews.
interpret_scope: Analyze events and issues to form grounded explanations, assessments, and opinions.
decide_scope: Choose the editorial angle, conclusions, and points to emphasize in each piece of commentary or analysis.
act_scope: Produce and deliver written, online, scripted, live, or recorded analysis, opinion, commentary, columns, and reviews.

job_role_definition: Presents and coordinates news coverage for broadcast audiences.
acquire_scope: Obtain news and information from available sources for broadcast coverage.
interpret_scope: Analyze incoming news and information to establish accurate, broadcast-ready meaning and context.
decide_scope: Coordinate coverage and determine the sequencing and framing of stories, segments, live transmissions, and commentary.
act_scope: Anchor the program by presenting news stories, introducing recorded or live reports, and delivering live or recorded commentary to broadcast audiences.

job_role_definition: Researches, investigates, and delivers factual news stories for publication or broadcast.
acquire_scope: Develop story inputs by pursuing assignments and leads, researching records and background, cultivating sources, conducting interviews and observations, and capturing relevant audio, video, or photographs.
interpret_scope: Assess gathered reporting to establish accurate context, isolate pertinent facts and details, and identify errors or gaps requiring correction.
decide_scope: Choose which news subjects and evidence to pursue and determine the story’s priorities, emphasis, length, format, and most pertinent material.
act_scope: Create, edit, package, transmit, and report factual written, broadcast, and visual news stories for publication or broadcast.

job_role_definition: Test materials, components, structures, and vehicles using non-destructive methods to identify defects and document results in accordance with applicable requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Calibrate and operate visual, radiographic, ultrasonic, thermal, penetrant, and other non-destructive examination equipment to obtain measurements, observations, and images from materials, components, structures, and vehicles.
interpret_scope: Analyze examination outputs to identify and map defects, assess material properties, and evaluate findings against applicable codes, standards, specifications, and procedures.
decide_scope: Select the non-destructive testing method, equipment configuration, and examination approach appropriate to the object and applicable requirements.
act_scope: Document the methods and processes used and deliver reports of the resulting findings.

job_role_definition: Research, design, test, oversee, and improve nuclear systems and processes for safe energy production, facility operation, and radioactive-waste management.
acquire_scope: Gather operational, accident, environmental, experimental, equipment-performance, regulatory, and current technical evidence through monitoring, testing, studies, consultation, and research.
interpret_scope: Analyze and model the evidence to assess safety and compliance, environmental effects, fuel and equipment behavior, operational performance, and the suitability of technical approaches.
decide_scope: Select research parameters, design requirements and approaches, operational and environmental plans, preventive or corrective measures, and emergency dispositions, including shutdowns when warranted.
act_scope: Produce and improve designs for nuclear equipment, facilities, fuel cycles, and waste-management systems; oversee construction and direct compliant operations, maintenance, research, and remediation; and deliver operational instructions, technical findings, recommendations, and environmental reports.

job_role_definition: Perform diagnostic, therapeutic, and tracer procedures using radiopharmaceuticals and radioisotope equipment while maintaining patient and radiation safety.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories and prescriptions; prepare and verify radiopharmaceuticals, specimens, equipment, dosages, and safety conditions; administer diagnostic tracers; and generate imaging, physiologic, assay, and radiation-use data.
interpret_scope: Process imaging, cardiac-function, assay, dosage, and procedure data into quality-assessed study results and records for clinical interpretation.
decide_scope: Select procedural approaches, acquisition or treatment parameters, and patient or radiation-field positioning based on patient history, prescribed care, and quality and safety findings.
act_scope: Administer prescribed therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals or radiation, position and assist patients during treatment, communicate procedures and precautions, deliver processed study outputs, and carry out radiation-safe material storage and disposal.

job_role_definition: Monitor radiation and radioactive contamination to protect people, facilities, and the environment and support safe decontamination and waste handling.
acquire_scope: Measure personnel, area, equipment, material, and environmental radiation and contamination, including collecting samples and setting up, testing, calibrating, and maintaining monitoring and sampling equipment for reliable readings.
interpret_scope: Analyze samples and detector readings to determine radiation types, intensities, contamination levels, exposure status, safe exposure durations, and proximity to prescribed limits.
decide_scope: Select appropriate initial responses to abnormal conditions and determine or recommend decontamination procedures suited to the equipment and contamination.
act_scope: Brief and instruct personnel on radiation conditions and safety procedures, communicate approaching limits, carry out initial responses and decontamination, contain radioactive waste for shipment or disposal, and document results and methods.

job_role_definition: Operate and control nuclear reactor systems safely, maintaining normal plant operations and responding to operational abnormalities.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor and inspect reactor, turbine, boiler, auxiliary, radiation-containment, and equipment conditions; obtain operating, surveillance-test, and radiological measurements; and record pertinent operating data.
interpret_scope: Assess system indications and test results for normal operation, equipment malfunctions, loading effects, radiation or containment conditions, and causes of operational abnormalities.
decide_scope: Select corrective operating responses and priorities for abnormalities or hazards, including authorizing safe equipment status changes and maintenance clearances.
act_scope: Operate and adjust reactor and plant equipment, execute startup, shutdown, emergency, fuel-handling, and equipment-isolation procedures, and direct coordinated actions to maintain safe plant operation.

job_role_definition: Operate, test, maintain, and support nuclear or accelerator equipment to keep facilities and experiments functioning safely and reliably.
acquire_scope: Monitor reactor, accelerator, and support-system instruments and conduct surveillance and equipment tests to obtain operating-condition and safety data.
interpret_scope: Assess test, monitoring, and calculated operating-factor results to identify proper performance, inefficiencies, hazards, and maintenance or repair needs.
decide_scope: Determine equipment disposition, including maintenance isolation, repair or upgrade needs, and support-system readiness.
act_scope: Operate, maintain, modify, repair, upgrade, and safety-tag nuclear or accelerator equipment while following operational, environmental, radiation, and personnel-safety procedures.

job_role_definition: Monitor and control radiation and contamination hazards to protect personnel, facilities, and the environment.
acquire_scope: Measure radiation and contamination conditions and collect environmental or material samples needed to characterize hazards.
interpret_scope: Evaluate radiation type, intensity, radioactivity, contamination extent, and operating factors from measurements and test results.
decide_scope: Select or recommend protective controls and decontamination procedures appropriate to the assessed hazard and affected equipment or area.
act_scope: Apply radiation-protection procedures, operate and verify monitoring equipment, direct personnel away from hazardous areas, and carry out decontamination.

job_role_definition: Administer anesthesia and deliver perioperative anesthesia care by assessing patients, managing anesthesia and physiologic status, and overseeing recovery.
acquire_scope: Conduct pre-anesthetic screening and review diagnostic information, obtain consent, prepare and verify anesthesia equipment and supplies, and gather continuous physiologic and arterial-status measurements.
interpret_scope: Assess patient history, examinations, test results, and intraoperative and recovery responses to determine anesthetic risk, physiologic status, and complications.
decide_scope: Develop and adjust anesthesia and recovery care plans, including the selection of anesthetic techniques, medications, fluids, monitoring, corrective treatment, consultation, and discharge disposition.
act_scope: Administer anesthesia and perioperative treatments, establish vascular access and regional techniques, manage airway and physiologic status including emergencies, and provide post-anesthesia recovery care.

job_role_definition: Provide comprehensive primary, reproductive, pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum, and newborn care for women and families.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient histories, symptoms, examination findings, fetal and newborn measurements, and diagnostic test information across primary, reproductive, pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum, and newborn care.
interpret_scope: Assess maternal, fetal, and newborn health by interpreting examinations, monitoring findings, and diagnostic or laboratory results.
decide_scope: Determine individualized care plans, diagnostic testing, medication and family-planning options, referrals, and escalation or emergency responses.
act_scope: Deliver primary, reproductive, prenatal, intrapartum, postpartum, and newborn care, including examinations, childbirth care, procedures, stabilization, patient education, and care coordination.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and manage patients' acute, chronic, and preventive health care needs.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories, symptoms, examinations, diagnostic-test findings, medication and risk information, and follow-up observations needed to assess acute, chronic, and preventive care needs.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical findings, test results, treatment responses, and adverse drug reactions to establish diagnoses and assess patients' health status and risks.
decide_scope: Select individualized treatment, medication, diagnostic, preventive, behavioral, follow-up, consultation, and referral plans based on patient needs and applicable standards.
act_scope: Deliver and manage care through prescribing, procedures, treatment implementation, patient education and counseling, care coordination, follow-up scheduling, and complete clinical documentation.

job_role_definition: Provide basic direct patient care and support under the direction of licensed nursing staff.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain care directions and dietary constraints; observe patients and collect, measure, record, and communicate vital signs, intake/output, specimens, symptoms, concerns, and other condition information.
interpret_scope: Determine patients’ immediate care, comfort, mobility, dietary, emotional-support, and escalation needs from their condition, communications, observations, and prescribed restrictions.
decide_scope: Prioritize responses and select the appropriate basic assistance, preparation, positioning, transport, or directed care action within the nursing care plan.
act_scope: Deliver basic direct care and support by assisting with hygiene, eating, elimination, mobility, exercise, repositioning, transfers, transport, preparation, and directed treatments or clinical-care activities.

job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary nursing students in classroom and clinical settings while supporting nursing education programs.
acquire_scope: Gather current nursing knowledge, student learning and clinical-performance evidence, identified education needs, and the instructional materials and clinical-training resources required for courses.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student coursework, examinations, and clinical work to determine learning progress and education needs.
decide_scope: Plan and revise curricula, course content, instructional methods, assessments, learning materials, and student academic or career guidance based on those findings.
act_scope: Deliver classroom and clinical instruction, facilitate discussions, demonstrate and supervise patient care, administer assessments, advise students, maintain required student records, and coordinate clinical training arrangements that support nursing education programs.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses, treats, and helps prevent diseases and disorders of the female reproductive system.
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain reproductive-health histories, examination findings, test results, treatment responses, and other clinical information needed for patient assessment.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical records, examination findings, test results, and progress information to diagnose female reproductive disorders and assess treatment effectiveness.
decide_scope: Select preventive, therapeutic, follow-up, referral, and care-coordination plans based on the patient’s condition and response to care.
act_scope: Deliver and coordinate specialized treatment and preventive care, communicate procedures and results, and provide patient and community guidance on reproductive health.

job_role_definition: Provides medical and surgical care during pregnancy, childbirth, and the postpartum period.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document maternal and fetal histories, examinations, monitoring findings, test results, and consultation input throughout prenatal, childbirth, and postpartum care.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical records, examinations, tests, and ongoing maternal-fetal status to diagnose conditions and evaluate treatment progress.
decide_scope: Determine preventive, therapeutic, procedural, referral, and care-coordination plans needed to protect maternal health and achieve safe delivery and recovery.
act_scope: Provide and coordinate medical and surgical care, including counseling, medications and therapies, delivery procedures, and postpartum treatment.

job_role_definition: Evaluate workplace hazards and develop and administer programs and controls that protect worker health and safety and ensure regulatory compliance.
acquire_scope: Inspect workplace conditions, equipment, practices, hazardous-waste sites, and safety resources; investigate incidents and complaints; collect or arrange analysis of environmental and hazardous-material samples; and assemble incident, exposure, and hazardous-material records.
interpret_scope: Assess inspections, sample results, ventilation and other environmental conditions, incident patterns, and health information to identify hazards, causes, exposure concerns, and compliance gaps.
decide_scope: Determine appropriate protective, remedial, monitoring, emergency, and compliance measures, including when unsafe work must be suspended and which controls should be recommended.
act_scope: Develop, maintain, coordinate, and administer health, safety, hygiene, medical-monitoring, chemical-information, emergency-response, and waste-handling controls; deliver safety instruction; institute measures with relevant specialists; and document compliance findings.

job_role_definition: Collect workplace hazard data and implement, monitor, and support programs that protect workers from occupational health and safety risks.
acquire_scope: Collect and verify workplace hazard, exposure, equipment, compliance, health-incident, and site-condition information through inspections, testing, sampling, records review, interviews, and equipment preparation.
interpret_scope: Assess hazard, exposure, illness-relatedness, safety-equipment condition, and compliance information to determine workplace health and safety risks and whether protections meet applicable standards.
decide_scope: Determine corrective measures, safety-equipment requirements, program actions, emergency-drill plans, and dispositions of reported dangerous work conditions based on assessed risks.
act_scope: Implement, monitor, document, and support worker-protection programs by providing and maintaining protective equipment, training and advising personnel, conducting drills, verifying protective practices, and assisting emergency operations when needed.

job_role_definition: Assess clients and deliver therapeutic interventions that develop or restore daily living, work, school, and independent functioning.
acquire_scope: Obtain client histories, medical information, functional observations, progress measures, and the therapy materials or adaptive equipment needed to assess and treat daily living, work, school, and independent functioning.
interpret_scope: Evaluate physical, mental, cognitive, perceptual, and functional abilities and progress to identify limitations, capabilities, and rehabilitation needs.
decide_scope: Set realistic rehabilitation goals and select, coordinate, and recommend therapeutic activities, adaptive equipment, environmental changes, and work or school supports suited to each client's capabilities.
act_scope: Deliver and adjust occupational therapy programs and skill-building activities, train caregivers, and assist clients with functioning in daily living, work, school, and independent settings.

job_role_definition: Provide closely supervised support for occupational therapy services through delegated patient assistance, treatment activities, and routine operational duties.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe and document patients’ participation, progress, attitudes, attendance, abilities, and physical needs; assist with assessments and tests; and prepare treatment areas, supplies, equipment, and patients for delegated services.
interpret_scope: Relate observations and assessment results to patients’ functional skills, capacities, progress, and response to treatment for reporting to the supervising therapist.
decide_scope: Choose immediate delegated activity arrangements, patient work assignments, and equipment or environmental adaptations within the established therapy program.
act_scope: Provide supervised patient assistance, transport, instruction, demonstrations, and activity supervision; implement delegated treatment activities; adjust assistive devices and environments; and maintain safe, infection-controlled therapy operations.

job_role_definition: Assist occupational therapists in delivering treatment that helps clients improve or restore daily functioning and independence.
acquire_scope: Observe and measure clients’ daily-living abilities, therapy performance, behavior, and progress, and assemble the client information, equipment, and materials needed for treatment.
interpret_scope: Evaluate functional capacities and treatment responses to identify progress, needs, barriers, and whether interventions are achieving intended results.
decide_scope: Select suitable therapy activities, treatment modifications, adaptive solutions, and care-plan recommendations based on clients’ needs, capabilities, and progress.
act_scope: Implement treatment plans, deliver functional-skills and emotional-coping instruction, assist with daily activities, fabricate or modify adaptive solutions, encourage clients, and communicate findings to clients, families, and the care team.

job_role_definition: Perform varied clerical and administrative support services that keep an office's information, communications, documents, supplies, and routine operations organized.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and retrieve office communications, documents, records, requests, transaction details, payments, and supply-status information; collect and organize materials and data needed for routine office support.
interpret_scope: Review, compute, verify, proofread, and reconcile records, forms, correspondence, and other office information to establish accurate content and respond to inquiries.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate routing, response, scheduling, document handling, supply replenishment, and resolution of routine office-operating issues.
act_scope: Maintain filing, inventory, mailing, and database systems; communicate and route information; prepare, process, distribute, and mail documents and payments; operate office equipment; arrange appointments; and carry out routine office errands and transactions.

job_role_definition: Operate office reproduction and document-processing machines to produce and finish document work.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job specifications, prepare originals and master materials, load required media, and observe machine operating conditions for document production.
interpret_scope: Verify completed documents and operating results for correct order, completeness, legibility, and production quality.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate production setup and make operating adjustments or repair dispositions needed to meet the job requirements.
act_scope: Operate reproduction, scanning, document-processing, and finishing equipment to produce, assemble, identify, store, and deliver completed document work.

occupation_name: Office and Administrative Support Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Office and Administrative Support Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide office and administrative support services not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble the information, documents, materials, and requests needed to provide assigned office and administrative support services.
interpret_scope: Organize and assess incoming information and requests to determine their administrative relevance, completeness, and handling needs.
decide_scope: Prioritize requests and select appropriate administrative handling, routing, or follow-up within assigned responsibilities.
act_scope: Provide the requested office and administrative support services, including preparing, coordinating, maintaining, and communicating administrative work products.

job_role_definition: Operates an online retail business by managing merchandise, storefronts, marketing, customer transactions, order fulfillment, and business administration.
acquire_scope: Source merchandise and operating services and assemble market, product, customer, order, inventory, website-use, payment, shipping, and financial inputs for the online retail business.
interpret_scope: Evaluate market and product viability, storefront-use and search results, transaction and fulfillment conditions, and sales, revenue, expense, and inventory information to establish their business implications.
decide_scope: Select merchandise, prices, listing placement, inventory replenishment, marketing and business approaches, technical arrangements, and appropriate order dispositions.
act_scope: Operate the online storefront by creating and publishing listings and customer-facing materials, maintaining accounts and policies, promoting products, processing transactions and orders, fulfilling physical or digital deliveries, communicating with customers, and administering the business and its safeguards.

occupation_name: Operating Engineers and Other Construction Equipment Operators
job_role_name: Operating Engineers and Other Construction Equipment Operators
job_role_definition: Operate and maintain powered construction equipment to excavate, move, grade, compact, demolish, and prepare sites or materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work requirements, plans, reference markers, crew signals, utility locations, fuel status, equipment and site observations, and any required atmospheric readings.
interpret_scope: Assess the gathered information to identify equipment readiness, site hazards and operating constraints, and the required excavation, material-handling, grading, compaction, demolition, or site-preparation result.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate equipment configuration, attachments, operating approach, movement sequence, and hazard-avoidance measures for the assigned work.
act_scope: Set up, operate, maneuver, and control powered construction equipment and attachments to excavate, move, grade, compact, demolish, and prepare sites or materials, while maintaining equipment and coordinating movements with the crew.

job_role_definition: Use mathematical models, data analysis, and optimization methods to help organizations evaluate operational problems and make better decisions.
acquire_scope: Define information needs and obtain, observe, validate, and experimentally generate operational data, model-test evidence, and relevant research inputs.
interpret_scope: Conceptualize operational problems, represent systems and constraints in mathematical or simulation models, and analyze evidence and alternatives to assess model adequacy and operational implications.
decide_scope: Select appropriate analytical methods and identify the recommended plans, solutions, controls, or priorities that best meet organizational objectives.
act_scope: Deliver findings and recommendations through reports and presentations, develop operational methods, procedures, schedules, and networks, and support implementation through collaboration and staff instruction.

job_role_definition: Fabricates, finishes, inspects, assembles, adjusts, and repairs prescription eyewear and other precision optical elements to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain prescriptions and work orders and gather precision measurements and condition evidence from optical materials, damaged eyewear, and completed work.
interpret_scope: Determine required optical-element specifications and assess measured materials, coatings, alignment, and finished lenses for defects and conformance.
decide_scope: Select suitable lens blanks, molds, tools, processing methods, and corrective adjustments to meet the specifications.
act_scope: Set up and operate finishing, grinding, polishing, edging, and coating equipment; fabricate, assemble, adjust, clean, and repair prescription eyewear and precision optical elements.

job_role_definition: Assist ophthalmologists by performing clinical eye testing, patient care, procedure support, and related ophthalmic services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient histories, postoperative status, and ocular evidence through visual, pressure, refractive, motility, field, depth-perception, corneal, lens-power, and anatomical testing and measurement.
interpret_scope: Assess refractive conditions and translate ocular test results into clinically useful findings for ophthalmic care.
decide_scope: Select appropriate testing methods and sequences and determine patient-guidance or follow-up actions within established clinical procedures.
act_scope: Deliver ophthalmic patient care by administering medications, assisting with procedures and contact-lens use, instructing patients, and preparing and maintaining safe instruments and equipment.

job_role_definition: Perform ophthalmic clinical testing, patient care, procedure support, and staff oversight to assist ophthalmologists in diagnosing and treating eye conditions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories and postoperative status, prepare and maintain sterile ophthalmic equipment, and perform ocular examinations, measurements, imaging, and specialized tests that generate diagnostic findings.
interpret_scope: Assess refractive status and interpret ocular examination and test findings to characterize visual function, eye abnormalities, and condition severity.
decide_scope: Determine refractive corrections and triage priority or disposition based on the patient’s assessed condition.
act_scope: Deliver ophthalmic patient care by administering medications, educating patients, assisting with ophthalmic procedures, and supervising or instructing ophthalmic staff.

job_role_definition: Produce specialized diagnostic images of ocular structures to document and evaluate eye conditions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Generate ocular image data through fluorescein angiography, clinical photography, and computed-tomography imaging while obtaining the indication and patient inputs needed for acquisition.
interpret_scope: Assess the resulting image data and technical quality to determine whether the required ocular structures and abnormalities are adequately documented.
decide_scope: Select the imaging modality, views, contrast procedure, acquisition settings, and images needed for the diagnostic record.
act_scope: Finalize and deliver the selected ocular image set for documentation and clinical evaluation.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, medically manage, and surgically treat eye disorders while providing comprehensive vision care.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document ocular and medical histories, perform comprehensive visual-system examinations, and perform or order diagnostic and clinical tests.
interpret_scope: Evaluate examination and test findings to determine the nature, extent, severity, and risks of eye disorders and vision needs.
decide_scope: Formulate treatment, surgical, vision-correction, follow-up, referral, and care-coordination plans based on the patient's condition, goals, and expected benefits and risks.
act_scope: Deliver comprehensive vision care by prescribing and administering therapies or corrective lenses, performing ophthalmic and laser surgery, providing postoperative care and consultation, and educating patients on healthy vision.

job_role_definition: Fit, dispense, adjust, and support prescribed eyewear and contact lenses to meet clients' vision, comfort, and style needs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and verify prescriptions and prior records, assess clients’ visual and style requirements, take facial and optical measurements, and secure the frames and lens materials needed for dispensing.
interpret_scope: Evaluate prescription, measurement, and use-requirement information to determine fitting parameters and confirm that completed lenses meet specifications.
decide_scope: Select and recommend the frames, lenses, coatings, and fabrication specifications that best meet the client’s vision, comfort, fit, and style needs.
act_scope: Prepare and carry out eyewear fabrication and assembly, fit and adjust or repair eyewear, dispense prescribed eyewear and contact lenses, and instruct clients in their use and care.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, manage, and treat eye and visual-system conditions while prescribing and providing vision correction and rehabilitative care.
acquire_scope: Perform ocular examinations and testing with observation, instruments, and pharmaceutical agents to obtain visual-function and eye-health findings.
interpret_scope: Assess examination and test findings to diagnose eye and visual-system diseases, abnormalities, and functional limitations.
decide_scope: Develop treatment and management plans, including corrective prescriptions, medications, therapeutic procedures, and referrals for additional medical care.
act_scope: Deliver prescribed eye and vision care by supplying, fitting, and adjusting vision aids; treating conditions and foreign bodies; providing perioperative care, patient counseling, vision therapy, and low-vision rehabilitation.

job_role_definition: Perform surgical and related treatment of diseases, injuries, defects, and functional or aesthetic conditions affecting the oral and maxillofacial regions.
acquire_scope: Obtain clinical evidence about oral and maxillofacial conditions, including wisdom-tooth position, and assemble relevant treatment-planning input from collaborating professionals.
interpret_scope: Assess the evidence to identify current or prospective oral and maxillofacial problems and characterize the condition to be treated.
decide_scope: Select and coordinate an appropriate surgical or related treatment plan, including the indicated procedure and anesthetic approach.
act_scope: Administer anesthesia and deliver surgical, emergency, reconstructive, infection, mucosal, functional, and aesthetic treatment of oral and maxillofacial diseases, injuries, defects, and conditions.

job_role_definition: Receive, enter, verify, and coordinate customer orders while providing order-related information and service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive customer order details, specifications, billing information, complaints, and relevant inventory, prior-order, and shipment-status records.
interpret_scope: Verify order completeness and correctness, determine item availability and outgoing-work compliance with specifications, and calculate applicable merchandise and shipping charges.
decide_scope: Select suitable merchandise or services, resolve order discrepancies or complaints, and determine fulfillment, packing, labeling, and shipment-handling actions.
act_scope: Enter and maintain order and transaction records; prepare order documents; coordinate preparation, shipment, tracing, and payment processing; and provide customers with order information and updates.

job_role_definition: Transport patients, equipment, and supplies within healthcare facilities while providing associated patient-handling and environmental support.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and verify transport requests, patient needs, destinations, and the condition, availability, and handling requirements of patients, equipment, supplies, specimens, linens, and waste.
interpret_scope: Assess mobility, positioning, safety, sanitation, urgency, and handling requirements from requests and observed conditions.
decide_scope: Select safe transfer, transport, positioning, cleaning, containment, routing, prioritization, and emergency-response approaches consistent with facility procedures.
act_scope: Carry out assigned transport and delivery, provide physical patient handling and urgent support, and maintain safe, sanitary, and ready care environments through cleaning, disinfection, linen and waste handling, and supply placement.

job_role_definition: Diagnose and treat tooth, jaw, and dental-facial misalignments to restore function and improve appearance.
acquire_scope: Examine patients and assemble diagnostic histories, images, models, measurements, and treatment records concerning tooth, jaw, and dental-facial alignment.
interpret_scope: Assess diagnostic evidence to identify tooth, jaw, and dental-facial misalignments and their functional and aesthetic implications.
decide_scope: Develop and communicate an orthodontic treatment plan, including appliance approach, sequencing, coordination with other services, and estimated cost.
act_scope: Design or fabricate, fit, adjust, and maintain orthodontic appliances; document care and instruct patients and clinical personnel in carrying out treatment.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and surgically manage musculoskeletal conditions to restore or preserve patients' function.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble the patient’s history, examination findings, surgical-risk information, laboratory results, diagnostic images, and operative-condition inputs needed for musculoskeletal care.
interpret_scope: Diagnose musculoskeletal conditions and assess the clinical findings, test results, operative necessity, and surgical risk in relation to preserving or restoring function.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate treatment, surgical procedure, perioperative regimen, care referral, and operative priorities for the patient’s condition.
act_scope: Deliver medical and perioperative treatment and perform or assist with musculoskeletal surgery, coordinating the operative team and maintaining sterile operating conditions to correct, repair, prevent, or treat disease and injury.

job_role_definition: Diagnose and provide nonsurgical treatment for binocular vision, ocular motility, and related visual-system disorders.
education_most_common_level: Post-Baccalaureate Certificate - awarded for completion of an organized program of study; designed for people who have completed a Baccalaureate degree but do not meet the requirements of academic degrees carrying the title of Master.
acquire_scope: Conduct patient examinations and tailored visual-function testing, measurements, screenings, and ophthalmic diagnostic procedures to obtain clinical evidence about binocular vision, ocular motility, and related disorders.
interpret_scope: Analyze examination findings and diagnostic results, including information obtained with other eye-care specialists, to diagnose and assess visual-system disorders.
decide_scope: Develop nonsurgical treatment plans and determine when referral or coordinated management with other practitioners is appropriate.
act_scope: Provide prescribed nonsurgical interventions and patient or family instruction to treat and manage diagnosed visual disorders.

job_role_definition: Designs, fits, adapts, and manages orthotic devices that support or correct patients’ musculoskeletal function.
acquire_scope: Examine, interview, and measure patients; obtain prescribing and clinical information; and create casts and other fitting inputs for orthotic management.
interpret_scope: Assess patients’ musculoskeletal needs and fit-affecting factors, and evaluate device fit, function, comfort, and performance.
decide_scope: Determine orthotic specifications and design, including the appropriate materials, components, adjustments, repairs, and modifications in consultation with prescribers.
act_scope: Fabricate or oversee fabrication of orthoses; fit, test, adjust, repair, and manage them for patients; instruct patients in use and care; and maintain treatment records.

job_role_definition: Designs, fits, adapts, and manages prosthetic devices that replace patients’ missing limbs or other body parts.
acquire_scope: Obtain prescriptions and clinical input, examine, interview, and measure patients, and create fitting casts and other construction inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess patients’ anatomical needs, functional requirements, and fit-affecting factors, and evaluate device performance and comfort.
decide_scope: Determine device specifications and design, including appropriate materials and components, in coordination with prescribing clinicians.
act_scope: Fabricate or direct fabrication of prosthetic devices; fit, test, adjust, repair, and modify them; instruct patients in use and care; and maintain care records.

occupation_name: Outdoor Power Equipment and Other Small Engine Mechanics
job_role_name: Outdoor Power Equipment and Other Small Engine Mechanics
job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, repair, and overhaul small engines and the equipment they power.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer problem descriptions and inspect, test, dismantle, and measure engines and equipment to identify malfunctions, defective or missing parts, and required service inputs.
interpret_scope: Diagnose the condition and causes of engine and equipment faults from test results, inspections, and component measurements.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate repair, maintenance, overhaul, replacement, adjustment, and estimated cost of service.
act_scope: Maintain, repair, overhaul, machine, adjust, replace, reassemble, install, and verify small engines and the equipment they power.

occupation_name: Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders
job_role_name: Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders
job_role_definition: Operate or tend packaging and filling machinery to prepare products for storage or shipment while maintaining production and quality standards.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Prepare and replenish products, packaging materials, containers, labels, and machine feeds, while obtaining production counts and operational and quality observations.
interpret_scope: Assess product weights, measurements, packaging condition, machine performance, and line conditions for conformity and emerging defects or malfunctions.
decide_scope: Determine required machine settings, flow adjustments, rejection dispositions, and responses to jams, defects, or equipment faults.
act_scope: Operate, regulate, reset, clean, and make minor adjustments to packaging and filling equipment; package, label, secure, unload, and prepare finished products for storage or shipment.

job_role_definition: Pack and prepare products and materials by hand for storage, shipment, or customer delivery.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, sort, and position products, materials, containers, and orders, retrieve packing requirements, and examine, measure, weigh, and count items to generate packing and quality evidence.
interpret_scope: Assess observations and measurements against order, quality, and packing specifications to identify conforming, completed, or defective items.
decide_scope: Select the packing configuration, labeling, processing route, and disposition appropriate to each order and inspection finding.
act_scope: Clean and prepare containers and materials, assemble and pad containers, load and fill packages, seal and label them, document completion, and route packages or rejected items to their required destination.

job_role_definition: Prepare structural surfaces and apply protective or decorative finishes to buildings, equipment, bridges, and other structures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work requirements, inspect and measure structural surfaces, and assemble the finishes, tools, access equipment, and protective materials needed for the work.
interpret_scope: Assess surface condition, substrate, finish specifications, desired appearance, and measurements to establish preparation requirements and material and cost estimates.
decide_scope: Choose suitable finish materials, colors, additives, application methods, access arrangements, and surface-treatment sequence based on the work requirements and conditions.
act_scope: Protect surrounding areas, establish safe access, remove obstructions and existing finishes, repair, clean, smooth, prime, seal, waterproof, apply and polish protective or decorative finishes, and complete specified decorative details.

job_role_definition: Apply and finish protective or decorative coatings on manufactured articles.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Read job orders and inspect workpieces and finished surfaces to obtain specifications, surface conditions, and evidence of finish conformance or defects.
interpret_scope: Assess workpiece and finished-surface conditions against specifications to identify preparation, finish, or defect-correction needs.
decide_scope: Determine the coating procedure, materials, and corrective treatment required for each workpiece.
act_scope: Prepare workpiece surfaces and coating substances, apply protective or decorative coatings, facilitate their setting or hardening, remove excess material, and retouch defective areas.

occupation_name: Paper Goods Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Paper Goods Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, adjust, and maintain machinery that converts paper or paperboard into finished goods.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work-order specifications and production materials, and observe machine operation and completed goods for condition, defects, and flow problems.
interpret_scope: Assess production observations and finished-work checks against specifications to identify quality deviations, jams, and mechanical malfunctions.
decide_scope: Select machine setups, operating settings, corrective adjustments, and maintenance or part-replacement actions needed to meet production requirements.
act_scope: Set up, operate, tend, regulate, adjust, and repair converting equipment; load and route paperboard and process materials; and cut, mark, and move finished goods through production.

job_role_definition: Install decorative wall and ceiling coverings by preparing surfaces and applying, aligning, trimming, and finishing wallpaper or fabric.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure surfaces, review work requirements, inspect substrate and finished-covering conditions, and assemble the covering sections, adhesive, tools, and access equipment needed for installation.
interpret_scope: Assess substrate readiness and determine whether the installed covering meets alignment, pattern-match, seam, and finish requirements.
decide_scope: Determine the layout, material placement, and surface-treatment and adhesion approach appropriate to the covering and substrate conditions.
act_scope: Remove existing finishes as needed; clean, repair, seal, and condition wall or ceiling surfaces; and apply, align, smooth, trim, and finish decorative wallpaper or fabric.

job_role_definition: Litigation Paralegals develop and organize case materials, legal documents, evidence, and procedural preparations that support lawyers in litigation.
acquire_scope: Gather case facts, client and professional accounts, public records, legal authorities, case documents, and potential evidence needed for litigation.
interpret_scope: Analyze facts, evidence, legal authorities, and procedural requirements to identify case issues, relevant precedent, document needs, and trial implications.
decide_scope: Select relevant authorities and evidence, determine drafting and document-organization approaches, and prioritize filing, witness, and trial-preparation steps.
act_scope: Draft, edit, and file litigation documents; organize case files and exhibits; and coordinate witnesses and preparations for hearings or trial.

job_role_definition: Supports lawyers in transactional and estate matters by researching facts and law, gathering client and property information, and preparing legal instruments and closings.
acquire_scope: Gather client and professional input, matter and property records, title information, and relevant legal authorities needed for transactional and estate work.
interpret_scope: Analyze factual, property, title, and legal information to derive relevant findings, document requirements, identified issues, and readiness for estate planning or transactions.
