decide_scope: Select required document content and revisions and the procedural steps for preparing estate plans, transactions, and real-estate closings.
act_scope: Prepare, edit, and review wills, contracts, affidavits, correspondence, and closing documents, and assist with real estate closings and estate-planning deliverables.

job_role_definition: Provide advanced prehospital emergency assessment, treatment, and stabilization for sick or injured patients.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient history, emergency circumstances, vital signs, clinical observations, and treatment-response information through assessment, monitoring, equipment use, and coordination with responders and treatment personnel.
interpret_scope: Assess the nature, extent, and changing significance of illness or injury to determine the patient's prehospital condition and response to care.
decide_scope: Prioritize and select the appropriate emergency procedures, interventions, and care sequence, while directing coordinated team interventions.
act_scope: Provide and document advanced prehospital treatment, life support, pharmacological, cardiac, intravenous, and invasive interventions; stabilize, comfort, and transfer care for sick or injured patients.

job_role_definition: Plan and deliver interpretive and educational programs that help park visitors and students understand a park's natural, historical, and scientific features.
acquire_scope: Research, survey, interview specialists, and gather park records, photographs, and observations needed to accurately represent natural, historical, and scientific features.
interpret_scope: Synthesize park evidence into accurate, audience-appropriate explanations, stories, and educational content for visitors and students.
decide_scope: Select program subjects, schedules, formats, activities, curricula, and presentation approaches in coordination with park staff.
act_scope: Create and deliver interpretive programs, field trips, talks, events, displays, publications, and visitor information that educate park visitors and students.

job_role_definition: Operates and tends self-parking, vehicle-storage, or vehicle-inventory areas without primarily providing valet service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and record vehicle-location tags, payments, and customer requests; inspect vehicles; and patrol the facility to obtain current condition, occupancy, and safety information.
interpret_scope: Calculate applicable parking charges and assess vehicle condition, available-space use, and observed safety or assistance needs.
decide_scope: Determine vehicle-location guidance, space assignments and traffic direction, facility access status, and whether motorist assistance or emergency authorities are needed.
act_scope: Operate the parking, vehicle-storage, or vehicle-inventory area by issuing location tags and tickets, collecting and reconciling fees, locating or delivering vehicles or giving retrieval instructions, directing and assisting customers, maintaining orderly usable spaces and stored vehicles, and carrying out safety responses.

job_role_definition: Takes custody of customers’ vehicles and provides vehicle parking, retrieval, and handoff services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive vehicles, keys, customer identification and retrieval requests; inspect and record vehicle condition; and observe space availability and access conditions.
interpret_scope: Match customers, tags, keys, and vehicles, and assess vehicle condition, lot status, and safety-relevant conditions for service.
decide_scope: Select appropriate parking locations, retrieval order, vehicle-routing actions, and any necessary response to unsafe or access-limiting conditions.
act_scope: Take custody of vehicles, issue and manage identification tags, park and retrieve vehicles, maintain usable parking access, and complete customer handoffs.

job_role_definition: Patrol assigned areas and enforce parking regulations by identifying violations, issuing citations, and coordinating related vehicle actions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Patrol assigned areas, observe parking conditions and vehicles, mark and revisit time-limited vehicles, and retrieve registration, permit, dispatch, and complaint information needed to document potential violations.
interpret_scope: Assess observed conditions and gathered records against parking regulations to determine whether a violation, permit issue, vehicle status, or contested citation is valid.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate enforcement disposition, including a warning or citation, complaint routing, and whether a vehicle requires booting, towing, or other related action.
act_scope: Issue and record enforcement notices, communicate with dispatch and the public, arrange and direct authorized vehicle actions, and substantiate contested citations at hearings.

job_role_definition: Sell spare and replacement parts and equipment by identifying suitable products, processing orders and payments, and maintaining parts availability.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer requests, part samples and measurements, and catalog, price, inventory, shipping, and order-status information needed to supply replacement parts and equipment.
interpret_scope: Determine required part specifications, compatibility, condition, availability, and feasible alternatives from customer descriptions, inspections, measurements, and reference information.
decide_scope: Select the suitable part, substitution or modification advice, fulfillment method, and disposition of defective returns or unavailable items.
act_scope: Sell and explain parts and equipment; prepare and process orders, payments, exchanges, and refunds; fulfill, ship or deliver orders; and maintain accurately identified, available stock.

job_role_definition: Ensure passengers can board, travel, and disembark safely and receive needed travel assistance and information.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Conduct pre-departure equipment safety checks and obtain passenger needs, travel requests, ticket and reservation details, and boarding and disembarking counts.
interpret_scope: Assess passenger needs and travel, reservation, and safety-check information to establish safe, appropriate movement and seating requirements.
decide_scope: Determine or coordinate seating arrangements and the appropriate timing for passenger movement and departure-related signals.
act_scope: Enable safe boarding, travel, and disembarkation by assisting passengers, securing them, operating doors, signaling operators, communicating travel and safety information, and responding to passenger requests or concerns.

job_role_definition: Assist patients in navigating health care services, understanding policies, resolving care-related concerns, and accessing appropriate resources.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Interview patients or representatives and gather care-concern details, inquiries, payment information, and current policy, service, and community-resource information.
interpret_scope: Assess patients' care-related needs and concerns, financial circumstances, and the applicability of relevant policies, procedures, services, and resources.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate staff members, health care services, resources, complaint disposition, or applicable sliding-scale charge for each case.
act_scope: Explain policies and services, coordinate communications, connect patients with selected services or resources, and direct and follow up on inquiries and complaints through resolution.

job_role_definition: Create, machine, fit, assemble, verify, repair, and finish foundry patterns, core boxes, match plates, and related tooling for casting production.
acquire_scope: Obtain work orders, drawings, specifications, sample parts or mockups; select pattern materials; and gather dimensional measurements needed to produce and verify casting tooling.
interpret_scope: Derive required tooling geometry, dimensions, fit, production requirements, and conformance findings from drawings, models, specifications, and measurements.
decide_scope: Determine the tooling design, material use, machining program, and operating sequence required to make, modify, or restore the specified patterns and related tooling.
act_scope: Lay out, machine, construct, fit, assemble, repair, identify, seal, paint, clean, and finish foundry patterns, core boxes, match plates, fixtures, jigs, and related casting tooling, including creating required computer models.

job_role_definition: Plan, construct, finish, maintain, and provide wooden patterns and related tooling used to form sand molds for castings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather specifications, drawings, casting-defect feedback, reference tooling, lumber, and dimensional measurements from stock, workpieces, and completed patterns.
interpret_scope: Translate specifications, calculations, defect feedback, and measurement results into required pattern geometry, dimensions, machine setups, mold-release sections, material quantities, and conformance findings.
decide_scope: Select lumber, construction and assembly details, sectioning, machining and finishing methods, and corrective changes for the required tooling.
act_scope: Lay out, machine, shape, assemble, fit, finish, identify, correct, repair, store, and issue wooden patterns, models, templates, jigs, molds, and related tooling for casting operations.

occupation_name: Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators
job_role_name: Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators
job_role_definition: Operate paving, surfacing, and tamping equipment to place, finish, and compact materials on roads and other paved surfaces.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain paving materials, equipment attachments, grade and layout specifications, and site-condition information needed to prepare and operate paving, surfacing, tamping, and related equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess material distribution, surface grade, flow, temperature, equipment condition, and paving results to determine whether placement, finishing, compaction, or equipment operation meets job requirements.
decide_scope: Select machine settings, operating adjustments, material-flow and temperature controls, equipment configurations, and coordination actions needed to achieve the required pavement or surface result.
act_scope: Set up, maintain, transport, and operate paving, surfacing, tamping, and related equipment to place, spread, finish, compact, cut, clean, reinforce, joint, curb, or remove paved-surface materials and manage work-zone traffic.

job_role_definition: Calculate, process, reconcile, and report employee payroll while maintaining related compensation records.
acquire_scope: Assemble and verify employee time, production, employment, compensation, deduction, benefit, tax-rule, and payroll-account inputs required for payroll processing and reconciliation.
interpret_scope: Calculate wages and deductions, assess payroll records and account balances for discrepancies, and determine the amounts and records required for accurate payroll and reporting.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate correction, retroactive adjustment, record update, and reporting or filing treatment for identified payroll conditions.
act_scope: Process and issue payroll and earnings statements, post and maintain compensation records, reconcile payroll to accounts, and prepare required payroll reports and tax filings.

job_role_definition: Collect, verify, and maintain employee attendance, work-time, and leave records used for time reporting and payroll.
acquire_scope: Collect timecards, time sheets, and related employee attendance, work-time, production, leave, and payroll inputs for each reporting period.
interpret_scope: Reconcile submitted time and leave information to determine accurate hours worked, attendance status, balances, and pay adjustments.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate record corrections or adjustments needed to resolve identified discrepancies.
act_scope: Complete, post, and maintain the attendance, work-time, leave, and adjustment records used for time reporting and payroll.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, plan, perform, and oversee surgical treatment for fetuses, infants, children, and adolescents with congenital conditions, diseases, and injuries.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories, specialist input, examinations, preoperative and postoperative test findings, surgical-risk information, and the sterile operative resources required for treatment.
interpret_scope: Diagnose congenital conditions, diseases, and injuries and assess clinical status, surgical risk, test results, and recovery findings.
decide_scope: Determine whether intervention is indicated and select the surgical procedure, perioperative treatment plan, follow-up actions, or referral needed for each patient.
act_scope: Perform indicated pediatric and fetal operations, including transplantation when needed, and oversee coordinated perioperative and postoperative care by directing clinical staff and communicating treatment and recovery information to parents or guardians.

job_role_definition: Provide preventive, diagnostic, and therapeutic medical care for infants, children, and adolescents.
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain pediatric histories, examination findings, growth and developmental measures, diagnostic-test information, and follow-up condition data.
interpret_scope: Assess growth, development, illness, injury, test results, and treatment progress to establish or update clinical findings and diagnoses.
decide_scope: Select preventive, diagnostic, therapeutic, follow-up, referral, and coordinated-care plans appropriate to each child's condition and development.
act_scope: Deliver and coordinate preventive and therapeutic care, including treatment, vaccination, therapeutic procedures, counseling, care-program implementation, and communication of findings and plans to patients and caregivers.

job_role_definition: Evaluate information-system security by simulating cyberattacks to identify, document, and help mitigate exploitable weaknesses.
acquire_scope: Gather stakeholder context, cyber-threat intelligence, system and network information, and observable security conditions needed to assess exposure.
interpret_scope: Analyze audit, assessment, forensic, and test evidence to determine exploitable weaknesses, attack paths, and their security implications.
decide_scope: Select testing approaches, priorities, and mitigation recommendations suited to the identified weaknesses and environment.
act_scope: Conduct authorized simulated attacks and security tests, document and communicate findings, and help implement or verify corrective security measures.

job_role_definition: Provide individualized personal care and daily-living support that enables clients with disabilities or illness to live safely and participate in daily life.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe clients’ condition and daily-living needs, obtain relevant health measurements and medication information, and gather inputs needed for communication, nutrition, and ongoing care.
interpret_scope: Assess condition changes, functional needs, and adjustment to daily life to determine the support required.
decide_scope: Select day-to-day care priorities and contribute to continuing-service plans, including whether condition changes should be escalated.
act_scope: Provide individualized personal care and daily-living assistance, including household, nutritional, mobility, social, communication, transportation, and instructional support; document services and report findings.

occupation_name: Personal Care and Service Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Personal Care and Service Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Provide personal care or personal services not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the person’s service needs, relevant preferences, and the materials required to provide the personal care or service.
interpret_scope: Assess the gathered needs and circumstances to determine the task-relevant care or service requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate manner, sequence, and boundaries for providing the requested personal care or service.
act_scope: Provide the personal care or personal service.

job_role_definition: Advise clients by developing, implementing, and maintaining financial plans and related strategies to help them achieve their financial objectives.
acquire_scope: Elicit and assemble clients’ financial circumstances, objectives, risk tolerance, records, changes, and relevant market, product, tax, and benefit information.
interpret_scope: Analyze client and market information to assess needs, plan fit, investment compatibility, performance, projections, and whether changing circumstances require reassessment.
decide_scope: Develop and prioritize financial-plan strategies, including debt-payoff approaches and recommendations for cash management, insurance, investments, and other measures aligned with clients’ objectives.
act_scope: Advise and educate clients, implement and maintain agreed financial plans and portfolios, coordinate implementation assistance, and administer client accounts and authorized disbursements.

job_role_definition: Manage personal-service operations not classified in a more specific personal service management occupation.
acquire_scope: Gather operational information, service requirements, staffing and resource availability, and customer or client needs required to manage personal-service operations.
interpret_scope: Assess operational conditions, service performance, resource use, and customer or client needs to identify issues and requirements for acceptable service delivery.
decide_scope: Set operational priorities and select service, staffing, resource-allocation, and corrective-action plans for the personal-service operation.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate the personal-service operation, implement selected plans, and deliver or ensure delivery of its services.

job_role_definition: Inspects infested premises and plans and performs chemical, fumigation, baiting, or trapping treatments to control pests and prevent recurrence.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect premises and assemble site reports, diagrams, measurements, damage evidence, infestation indicators, access conditions, and treatment constraints.
interpret_scope: Determine pest sources, infestation extent, property effects, accessible treatment locations, and factors affecting elimination and recurrence prevention.
decide_scope: Choose treatment and prevention methods, determine required quantities and target priorities, and establish safe execution plans.
act_scope: Prepare and secure treatment areas, apply pesticides, fumigants, baits, or traps, direct treatment execution, and provide prevention recommendations.

occupation_name: Pesticide Handlers, Sprayers, and Applicators, Vegetation
job_role_name: Pesticide Handlers, Sprayers, and Applicators, Vegetation
job_role_definition: Prepare and apply chemical treatments to control pests and diseases affecting lawns, trees, shrubs, and crops.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Prepare the required treatment inputs by mixing prescribed pesticides, herbicides, or fungicides and filling sprayer tanks with water and chemicals.
interpret_scope: Assess plant diseases and relevant site, weather, terrain, obstruction, and distribution conditions to establish treatment requirements.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate treatment, application formula, equipment configuration, and coverage approach for the identified infestation and site conditions.
act_scope: Set up, operate, direct, and maintain spraying equipment to apply treatment at the required coverage, including coordinating vehicle movement where used.

job_role_definition: Plans and oversees drilling, completion, stimulation, testing, and abandonment activities throughout well construction and closeout.
acquire_scope: Direct and monitor well tests, surveys, inspections, equipment checks, and sampling, and compile drilling, completion, stimulation, production, and site-condition records needed across well construction and closeout.
interpret_scope: Evaluate drilling, testing, survey, inspection, and operating information to assess well performance, completion status, extraction requirements, equipment suitability, and operating problems.
decide_scope: Select well drilling, completion, stimulation, testing, environmental-control, equipment, and abandonment plans and resolve resulting technical and operational priorities.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate drilling, completion, stimulation, equipment operations, environmental controls, well abandonment, and site restoration.

job_role_definition: Optimizes producing wells and associated field operations to maintain safe, efficient oil and gas output.
acquire_scope: Monitor and record production, drilling, well-test, survey, equipment-performance, safety, and operating-condition data needed to manage producing wells and field operations.
interpret_scope: Analyze production and testing information, equipment performance, and operating problems to identify recovery opportunities, operational constraints, causes, and safe operating conditions.
decide_scope: Select well rework, modification, stimulation, completion, recovery-treatment, equipment, environmental-control, and field-work plans that sustain safe, efficient output.
act_scope: Direct, supervise, and coordinate implementation of selected well and field-operation changes, maintenance, equipment, and controls, and communicate technical findings to relevant personnel.

job_role_definition: Evaluates petroleum reservoirs, well locations, and recovery strategies to maximize technically and economically viable resource extraction.
acquire_scope: Obtain reservoir, drilling, completion, testing, survey, sample, cost, and production data needed to characterize resources and extraction conditions.
interpret_scope: Analyze and model reservoir behavior, well potential, economic value, and recovery-process findings to assess technically and economically viable extraction options.
decide_scope: Select well locations, supplementary recovery approaches, and field drilling, recovery, and treatment plans that maximize viable resource extraction.
act_scope: Deliver the selected engineering recommendations and plans, communicate their technical basis, and direct and monitor well completion and evaluation work.

occupation_name: Petroleum Pump System Operators, Refinery Operators, and Gaugers
job_role_definition: Measure, sample, test, calculate, and document petroleum quantities and quality in tanks and product transfers.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain representative petroleum samples and temperature, gauge, meter, flow, tank-level, and operating readings while monitoring transfer routing, equipment condition, and safe compliant operations.
interpret_scope: Analyze samples and readings to determine petroleum quantity, flow, quality, grade, and contamination measures, and calculate transfer, receipt, delivery, and test values.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate measurement, sampling, testing, and calculation method and timing for the tank or product transfer being assessed.
act_scope: Verify meter routing and operation and compile and document the resulting operating data, calculations, test results, and laboratory findings.

occupation_name: Petroleum Pump System Operators, Refinery Operators, and Gaugers
job_role_definition: Control pumping, manifold, and pipeline systems to move petroleum products among processing, storage, and shipping units.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor process instruments, meters, tank levels, pipelines, equipment condition, and field conditions to obtain flow, routing, integrity, and safety inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to determine product movement status, meter accuracy, system capacity, equipment problems, contamination risk, and unsafe conditions.
decide_scope: Plan and prioritize product routes, pumping sequences, cross-unit synchronization, corrective responses, and shutdown arrangements based on system interconnections and capacities.
act_scope: Operate pumps, manifolds, valves, and automated controls to move petroleum products, coordinate execution with other operators, and perform or arrange necessary securing, spill-control, cleaning, inspection, lubrication, and repair work.

occupation_name: Petroleum Pump System Operators, Refinery Operators, and Gaugers
job_role_definition: Operate and regulate petroleum refining or treating units to produce products that meet process specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor process instruments and obtain operating readings, specifications, schedules, logs, test results, and laboratory recommendations needed to run refining or treating units.
interpret_scope: Assess process conditions and product-quality evidence against required specifications to identify deviations and required operating adjustments.
decide_scope: Determine equipment-control settings, response priorities, and shutdown or project coordination needed to maintain compliant production.
act_scope: Operate and regulate processing and auxiliary units, product flows, valves, pumps, and compressors, while maintaining unit readiness through necessary equipment, cleaning, and housekeeping work.

job_role_definition: Provides medication therapy by evaluating prescriptions and regimens, dispensing or compounding verified medications, and counseling patients and healthcare professionals.
acquire_scope: Obtain prescriptions, patient medication and clinical information, product-quality evidence, and the ingredients or products needed to fulfill therapy.
interpret_scope: Evaluate prescription accuracy and suitability, medication identity and quality, and patient-specific interactions, adherence, risks, and therapeutic response.
decide_scope: Determine prescription disposition and fulfillment method, resolve medication-related problems, and select counseling, monitoring, consultation, or referral actions.
act_scope: Prepare and dispense verified medications with appropriate packaging and labeling, and provide counseling, therapeutic consultation, condition-management support, or referrals.

job_role_definition: Support pharmacy operations by assisting customers, handling prescriptions and sales, and maintaining medication and merchandise inventory under pharmacist or supervisor direction.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and assemble prescriptions, customer requests, transaction and insurance details, pharmaceutical supplies, merchandise, and inventory observations needed for pharmacy support.
interpret_scope: Evaluate prescription and insurance details, calculate copayments, and assess customer needs and stock records and condition to identify referrals, expirations, shortages, or discrepancies.
decide_scope: Select inquiry referrals, merchandise guidance, inventory notifications, storage and special-handling methods, and replenishment priorities under pharmacist or supervisor direction.
act_scope: Assist customers; complete sales and claims; prepare labels and records; compound, package, and deliver pharmaceutical products; and store, restock, and maintain merchandise, supplies, equipment, and work areas.

job_role_definition: Prepare, package, label, record, and support the dispensing of medications under a pharmacist's direction.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Receive prescription and refill requests, assemble patient medication, inventory, supply, and coverage information, and obtain medications and sterile supplies maintained in suitable condition.
interpret_scope: Verify prescription, patient, inventory, and transaction information for completeness and accuracy, including identifying outdated stock, shortages, or matters requiring referral.
decide_scope: Determine routine stock replenishment, disposition of incomplete or discrepant requests, and when to refer medication questions or exceptions to the pharmacist or supervisor.
act_scope: Prepare, compound, count, package, label, record, and route prescribed medications and related sterile preparations for dispensing while maintaining required storage, equipment, and inventory controls.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary philosophy, religion, and theology while supporting students and contributing to scholarship and academic service.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain subject scholarship, research evidence, instructional resources, and information on student progress, needs, and academic-service matters.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and advisee needs, analyze scholarly evidence, and evaluate curriculum, course content, and instructional effectiveness.
decide_scope: Set research, publication, course, curriculum, instructional, assessment, advising, and academic-service priorities and select appropriate materials and methods.
act_scope: Teach and moderate philosophy, religion, and theology courses; assess and support students; conduct and publish scholarship; and carry out academic administration and service.

job_role_definition: Collects and handles blood and other specimens from patients or donors while supporting identification, safety, testing, transport, and recovery procedures.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain patient or donor identifiers, requisitions, histories, vital signs, timed specimens, test measurements, and observations, and assemble sterile collection materials.
interpret_scope: Evaluate identity and requisition matches, specimen integrity, test findings, and patient or donor condition for collection and handling requirements.
decide_scope: Select donor disposition, collection method and timing, specimen-handling plan, and any safety or recovery response.
act_scope: Explain and carry out the selected procedures, process, label, document, and transport specimens, communicate results, monitor recovery, and maintain equipment and biohazard controls.

job_role_definition: Create and deliver photographs that meet client, assignment, documentary, commercial, scientific, or personal imaging needs.
acquire_scope: Obtain assignment requirements, subject and location conditions, light and distance measurements, and the cameras, media, equipment, backgrounds, and materials needed for the imaging work.
interpret_scope: Assess assignment needs, scene conditions, technical measurements, and captured images to determine their visual and technical suitability.
decide_scope: Select the intended image treatment, composition, subjects, lighting, equipment, exposure and focus settings, specialized techniques, and final images to use.
act_scope: Set up and operate photographic equipment, direct capture setup as needed, create photographs, and process, edit, format, and deliver finished photographic images and related visual outputs.

occupation_name: Photographic Process Workers and Processing Machine Operators
job_role_name: Photographic Process Workers and Processing Machine Operators
job_role_definition: Develops, processes, reproduces, inspects, and prepares photographic images and film using digital, chemical, and machine-based methods.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work-order requirements and photographic inputs, load and digitize images or film, and prepare the materials and processing solutions required for production.
interpret_scope: Assess images, film, and processed output for defects, density, color, fading, and retouching or restoration needs.
decide_scope: Select images, reproduction methods, process settings, materials, equipment, and any corrections, reprints, or retouching required to meet specifications.
act_scope: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain processing and reproduction equipment to develop, print, transfer, enlarge, restore, and prepare photographic images and film for customer delivery.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, test, and transition light-based technologies and systems to meet product, application, and production requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather product, application, production, and performance requirements; research developments and uses; and obtain measurements from photonic component, system, prototype, fiber-link, and equipment testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, research, and test results to assess feasibility, functionality, limits, optimization opportunities, and suitable light-based applications.
decide_scope: Select photonic applications, system and component architectures, materials, device designs, and production approaches that satisfy the identified requirements.
act_scope: Design, develop, integrate, fabricate, troubleshoot, validate, document, and transition photonic products, devices, sensing or imaging systems, and manufacturing technologies into production, including providing production expertise and training.

job_role_definition: Build, test, maintain, calibrate, and support the development and production of photonic and fiber-optic equipment and components.
acquire_scope: Prepare prototype and test apparatus and obtain and record photonic test, failure-analysis, diagnostic, and metrology data.
interpret_scope: Analyze test, failure, process, and metrology data to assess component, device, equipment, and production-process performance.
decide_scope: Select equipment, repair, calibration, and process adjustments and recommend design or material changes to improve performance, cost, or processing time.
act_scope: Build, assemble, splice, terminate, fabricate, process, calibrate, repair, and maintain photonic and fiber-optic components, devices, equipment, fixtures, and prototypes under required environmental and safety conditions, and document procedures and results.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, medically manage, and direct rehabilitation for patients with disabling conditions to maximize function and independence.
acquire_scope: Obtain clinical histories and standardized pain measures; examine mobility, strength, communication, cognition, and functional work capacity; and perform electrodiagnostic testing to characterize disabling conditions.
interpret_scope: Synthesize examination, pain, functional, and electrodiagnostic findings to diagnose disabling or performance-related conditions, assess functional limitations, and evaluate response to pain treatment.
decide_scope: Select medical-management approaches and comprehensive immediate and long-term rehabilitation plans, including indicated therapies, specialist services, orthotic or prosthetic applications, and adaptive equipment.
act_scope: Provide medical management and direct, prescribe, and coordinate rehabilitation services to improve patients' function, independence, and community reintegration.

job_role_definition: Conduct specialized physical-science work not classified under a separate physical scientist occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare the observations, measurements, samples, materials, and technical information required for specialized physical-science work.
interpret_scope: Analyze the collected inputs to establish scientifically relevant findings, relationships, explanations, or conclusions.
decide_scope: Select appropriate scientific methods, investigative priorities, recommendations, and courses of action based on the analysis.
act_scope: Deliver the resulting scientific findings, technical outputs, recommendations, or services and implement selected courses of action.

job_role_definition: Support physical therapy staff by preparing treatment areas and assisting patients with delegated routine care and therapy activities under close supervision.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain delegated care instructions and patient information, assemble required treatment equipment and supplies, and gather patient measurements and observations of treatment responses.
interpret_scope: Evaluate patient measurements, responses, progress, and supportive-device fit to identify treatment-relevant findings.
decide_scope: Select immediate delegated adjustments to patient positioning, safeguarding, equipment setup, or supportive-device fit within directed care.
act_scope: Prepare, sanitize, and maintain treatment areas and equipment; transport, position, secure, assist, motivate, and safeguard patients during delegated therapy activities; and document care and report findings.

job_role_definition: Assist physical therapists by delivering prescribed therapeutic treatments, supporting patient mobility and exercise, and monitoring patient progress.
acquire_scope: Obtain prescribed treatment information and assemble patient measurements, observed treatment responses, progress details, and equipment readiness needed to deliver therapy safely.
interpret_scope: Assess measurements and observed responses to determine patient progress, treatment effects, mobility needs, and safe use of therapeutic equipment or supportive devices.
decide_scope: Select immediate treatment adjustments, assistance levels, and patient-safety actions within the prescribed therapeutic plan, and communicate findings for treatment planning or modification.
act_scope: Deliver prescribed therapeutic exercises, mobility training, manual and modality treatments, respiratory and wound care, patient and caregiver instruction, and safe patient transfers and equipment use.

job_role_definition: Physical Therapists assess and diagnose movement-related impairments, then plan, deliver, and monitor rehabilitation to improve function, manage pain, and prevent disability.
acquire_scope: Review referrals and records, examine the patient, and measure and record movement, strength, sensation, functional capacity, pain, and treatment response.
interpret_scope: Analyze examination findings, history, and treatment response to determine the physical therapy diagnosis, prognosis, progress, and findings requiring outside referral.
decide_scope: Establish an informed, collaborative plan by selecting goals, interventions, education, referrals, and timing for modification, reevaluation, follow-up, or discharge.
act_scope: Deliver, supervise, and document selected rehabilitation through therapeutic exercise, manual or physical-agent techniques, device fitting, and patient or family instruction.

job_role_definition: Provide physician-supervised diagnostic, treatment, procedural, and patient-care services.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document patient histories, physical-examination findings, clinical observations, and diagnostic-test information needed for care.
interpret_scope: Evaluate examination and diagnostic findings to identify deviations from normal and form tentative diagnoses.
decide_scope: Select diagnostic testing, patient-management, treatment, and therapy plans within physician-supervised care.
act_scope: Deliver prescribed treatment and patient-care services through medication prescribing, therapeutic procedures, counseling, rounds, and assistance during complex procedures.

job_role_definition: Provide physician services in medical specialties not separately classified.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories, examination findings, diagnostic results, and other clinical information needed to provide physician services.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical information to determine the patient's condition, risks, and relevant medical findings.
decide_scope: Select appropriate diagnostic, treatment, preventive-care, referral, and follow-up plans within the applicable medical specialty.
act_scope: Deliver physician services by communicating and carrying out the selected medical care, including treatment and ongoing management.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses disease by examining specimens and laboratory results and communicating findings to treating clinicians.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient specimens and generate or assemble microscopic, laboratory, molecular, genetic, and other diagnostic test results required for evaluation.
interpret_scope: Examine specimens and analyze test findings to derive diagnoses and characterize abnormalities, disease processes, causes, and clinical significance.
decide_scope: Select additional tests or diagnostic approaches and formulate recommendations when consultation is required.
act_scope: Produce pathology reports and directly communicate diagnostic findings, conclusions, and recommendations to treating clinicians.

job_role_definition: Determines the cause and manner of death through autopsy and medicolegal investigation.
acquire_scope: Conduct autopsies and assemble relevant laboratory and medicolegal case findings needed to investigate a death.
interpret_scope: Analyze autopsy observations, laboratory results, and investigative information to establish medically and forensically supported explanations of the death.
decide_scope: Select the cause and manner of death findings to be formally attributed to the case.
act_scope: Deliver the completed medicolegal determination through the required case conclusion and documentation.

job_role_definition: Conduct research on physical phenomena to develop, test, and apply physical theories and methods.
acquire_scope: Generate and assemble observations, measurements, experimental test results, simulated data, and other research inputs needed to investigate physical phenomena.
interpret_scope: Analyze empirical and modeled data using complex calculations and mathematical formulation to characterize phenomena, evaluate theories, and derive physical conclusions and laws.
decide_scope: Select research approaches, experimental and simulation designs, instrumentation or procedures, and applications of physical theories suited to the problem.
act_scope: Develop selected physical methods, instrumentation, or procedures, apply theories and methods to scientific and technical problems, and communicate research findings.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary physics while conducting and funding original research and contributing academic and professional service.
acquire_scope: Gather current physics scholarship, research observations and literature, student work and learning records, instructional and laboratory resources, funding requirements, and information relevant to academic and professional service.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student learning and advising needs, analyze research evidence and developments in physics, and assess teaching, research, and institutional issues.
decide_scope: Determine course content and instructional methods, assessment and supervision approaches, research and funding directions, and recommendations or priorities for academic and professional service.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver physics instruction, facilitate discussions, supervise laboratory and research work, guide students, publish findings, submit funding proposals, and carry out academic and professional service responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary physics courses and support student learning through assessment, advising, laboratory supervision, and academic service.
acquire_scope: Assemble current physics knowledge, course and laboratory materials, student performance evidence through assignments, examinations, and observation, and information relevant to students’ academic and career needs.
interpret_scope: Evaluate and classify student understanding and laboratory performance, identify learning needs, and assess the effectiveness and currency of course content and instruction.
decide_scope: Select course content, instructional methods, assessment designs, feedback, laboratory requirements, academic guidance, and academic service actions.
act_scope: Deliver physics instruction and discussions, provide feedback and guidance, supervise student teaching, research, internships, and laboratory work, maintain required records and laboratory equipment, and carry out academic service.

job_role_definition: Operate pile-driving equipment to install pilings that support foundations and structures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Conduct pre-operational equipment checks and obtain the operating-condition information needed to prepare pile-driving equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess check results and driving progress to determine whether equipment is functioning properly and pilings are reaching required depth.
decide_scope: Select the necessary equipment settings, pile positioning adjustments, and driving actions to install each piling safely and to specification.
act_scope: Position leads, pilings, and hammers; operate hoisting and hammer controls to drive pilings; and clean, lubricate, and refill equipment to keep it operational.

job_role_definition: Lay, align, connect, seal, and repair underground pipe systems for sewers, drains, and water mains.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain route and grade requirements from plans, locate existing pipes requiring repair or replacement, and take alignment, elevation, slope, and trench-base measurements.
interpret_scope: Assess plans, site conditions, and measurement results to identify required pipe placement, grade deviations, and repair or replacement needs.
decide_scope: Select the installation or repair sequence, pipe alignment, jointing or sealing method, and placement of connections or auxiliary lines.
act_scope: Excavate, grade, and compact trenches; cut, position, lay, connect, seal, modify, repair, cover, and backfill underground sewer, drain, and water-main pipe systems.

occupation_name: Plant and System Operators, All Other
job_role_name: Plant and System Operators, All Other
job_role_definition: Operate and monitor industrial plants or systems not classified in a more specific plant and system operator occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain operating information by monitoring the plant or system and its operating condition.
interpret_scope: Assess monitored information to determine the plant or system's operating status and identify deviations.
decide_scope: Select operating responses or adjustments needed to address identified conditions.
act_scope: Operate and adjust the industrial plant or system to deliver its intended process or service.

job_role_definition: Apply plaster and specialty finish materials to interior building surfaces to produce smooth, textured, acoustic, or ornamental finishes.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain finish specifications and assemble the plaster, specialty materials, tools, and access equipment required for the designated interior surfaces.
interpret_scope: Assess surface conditions, coverage requirements, and finish specifications to establish preparation, quantity, and material-consistency requirements.
decide_scope: Select the materials, application sequence, access arrangement, and finish technique needed to achieve the required smooth, textured, acoustic, or ornamental result.
act_scope: Protect and prepare the work area and surfaces, establish access, and produce the specified finish by mixing, applying, texturing, curing, spraying, or molding or installing plaster and specialty materials.

job_role_definition: Install exterior stucco, cementitious coverings, and exterior insulation finish systems that protect and finish building façades.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain project requirements and required stucco, cementitious, insulation, reinforcing, protective, and access materials, and examine façade and surrounding site conditions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate façade conditions and installation requirements to estimate material quantities, coating thickness, access constraints, and preparation needs.
decide_scope: Select the materials, application sequence, finish method, and protective and access arrangements for the installation.
act_scope: Protect and prepare the work area, set up access and reinforcement, mix and apply exterior stucco or insulation finish systems, create the specified texture, cure the finish, and clean the site.

occupation_name: Plating Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Plating Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend plating equipment to apply protective or decorative metal coatings to metal or plastic products.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain production requirements and collect part, material, solution, equipment, process, and coating-thickness observations needed to run the plating process.
interpret_scope: Assess part characteristics, machine and solution condition, process readings, and finished-coating measurements to determine required parameters and conformance.
decide_scope: Select the plating setup and process parameters, and determine corrective, stopping, or release actions when operating or quality conditions depart from requirements.
act_scope: Prepare, load, mask, position, plate, rinse, dry, finish, and transfer workpieces while setting up, operating, tending, adjusting, cleaning, and maintaining the plating equipment.

job_role_definition: Install, modify, test, and repair mechanical, process, heating, cooling, and other non-plumbing pipe systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain specifications and site measurements, inspect structures and installed systems, and collect pressure-test observations needed to install, modify, test, and repair pipe systems.
interpret_scope: Determine work details, site constraints, system condition, and leak locations from drawings, codes, inspections, measurements, and test results.
decide_scope: Plan system layouts, installation or repair sequence, shutdowns, and the required pipe sizes, materials, supports, and controls.
act_scope: Isolate, fabricate, assemble, install, secure, modify, maintain, and repair non-plumbing pipe systems and their components, including supports and controls.

job_role_definition: Install, maintain, and repair water, sanitary, drainage, and fixture plumbing systems in buildings.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain work specifications and codes, inspect and measure structures and existing plumbing, and test systems to gather evidence about site conditions, system performance, leaks, and defects.
interpret_scope: Assess drawings, site conditions, measurements, test results, and defects to determine installation requirements, obstructions, material and labor estimates, and causes of plumbing failures.
decide_scope: Choose pipe-system layouts, work sequences, pipe sizes and materials, repair or replacement dispositions, and necessary isolation and safety measures in accordance with specifications.
act_scope: Isolate services and lay out, fabricate, install, secure, connect, modify, maintain, and repair building water, sanitary, drainage, and fixture plumbing systems and associated equipment.

job_role_definition: Install, test, maintain, and repair fire-sprinkler piping systems for building fire protection.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Review applicable drawings, codes, and specifications; survey and measure structures and installation conditions; and obtain pressure-test and inspection observations from sprinkler piping systems.
interpret_scope: Determine installation requirements, site constraints, system condition, and the location or cause of leaks or defects from the collected information.
decide_scope: Select compliant pipe, fittings, supports, and controls, and establish the system layout, installation sequence, and repair approach.
act_scope: Install, secure, connect, and commission fire-sprinkler piping and controls, and isolate, repair, replace, and restore system components as needed.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, prevent, and treat diseases, injuries, and deformities of the foot and ankle through medical, corrective, and surgical care.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories and perform foot and ankle examinations while gathering relevant imaging and laboratory findings.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical findings to diagnose foot and ankle diseases, injuries, and deformities and recognize signs of systemic disorders.
decide_scope: Select preventive, medical, corrective, surgical, rehabilitative, prosthetic, or referral plans suited to the patient's condition.
act_scope: Deliver the selected care by prescribing and performing treatments, surgery, mechanical or physical modalities, corrective casting or strapping, fitting prosthetic appliances, and instructing patients in foot care.

job_role_definition: Creates original prose, dramatic, humorous, and other written works for publication or performance.
acquire_scope: Research factual information and authentic detail, and obtain project requirements and revision feedback from clients, editors, publishers, directors, or producers.
interpret_scope: Synthesize research, source material, project requirements, and feedback into an understanding of the factual context, expressive possibilities, audience needs, and creative constraints.
decide_scope: Choose the subject matter, form, themes, narrative or expressive elements, project structure, organization, and revisions suited to the intended work.
act_scope: Create and revise original prose, dramatic, humorous, or other written material, then prepare it in the required format and submit it for publication or performance.

job_role_definition: Writes and adapts lyrics for musical compositions and performances.
acquire_scope: Obtain creative briefs, collaborator input, and the musical and performance requirements that constrain the lyrics.
interpret_scope: Develop themes, narrative elements, emotional expression, and musical implications into a coherent lyrical direction.
decide_scope: Choose the subject matter, form, project arrangement, and revisions that best express the intended material within musical constraints.
act_scope: Write, adapt, format, and refine lyrics for musical compositions and performances in collaboration with relevant contributors.

job_role_definition: Creates original poetry for publication or performance.
acquire_scope: Research factual and authentic detail and obtain editorial, client, publisher, or producer input relevant to the work.
interpret_scope: Assess research, experiences, and feedback to develop meaningful themes, imagery, voice, and other poetic material.
decide_scope: Choose the poem’s subject, form, organization, and revision approach in light of its intended expression and release.
act_scope: Write and revise original poetry, prepare it for publication or performance, submit it to publishers or producers, and deliver readings when applicable.

job_role_definition: Collects, documents, preserves, and presents physical evidence from crime and accident scenes for investigations and legal proceedings.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Survey scenes and related physical items, photograph and diagram conditions, locate trace evidence, and recover latent prints and other materials using appropriate collection methods.
interpret_scope: Examine and process recovered materials and scene findings to determine their evidentiary characteristics and significance.
decide_scope: Select collection locations, processing methods, preservation measures, and evidence handling priorities appropriate to the scene and investigation.
act_scope: Document, package, store, retrieve, transfer, and present preserved physical evidence and its collection records for investigative and legal proceedings.

job_role_definition: Captures, compares, classifies, and maintains fingerprints to establish or verify identity.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Capture usable fingerprint impressions and retrieve the fingerprint records needed for identity work.
interpret_scope: Compare and classify fingerprint patterns to determine whether impressions correspond to an existing record and derive an identity finding.
decide_scope: NA — no separate recommendation, plan, priority, disposition, or course-of-action selection is required.
act_scope: Deliver the identity finding and file and maintain the resulting fingerprint records.

job_role_definition: Patrol officers maintain public safety and order by responding to incidents, investigating suspected violations, protecting people and property, and enforcing laws.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe assigned areas, receive complaints and emergency requests, question involved people, and collect relevant incident, traffic, and scene evidence.
interpret_scope: Assess reported and observed conditions to identify hazards, emergencies, suspicious activity, offenses, accident causes, and applicable legal violations.
decide_scope: Determine response priorities, legal or protective dispositions, appropriate charges, and whether aid, traffic control, citation, custody, or referral is warranted.
act_scope: Secure scenes, protect or aid people, control traffic or crowds, pursue or restrain suspects and make arrests when warranted, and document or testify about incidents.

job_role_definition: Teach and assess postsecondary political science courses while supporting students and contributing to the academic work of the institution.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain current political science knowledge, instructional resources, student work and performance information, and evidence for scholarly inquiry.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student learning, analyze disciplinary research and teaching evidence, and identify students’ academic or career-support needs.
decide_scope: Set course content, instructional and assessment methods, grades and feedback, research directions, and academic recommendations or institutional responses.
act_scope: Teach and moderate courses, communicate assessments and advice, supervise student work, conduct and publish research, and perform assigned academic service.

job_role_definition: Study and analyze political systems, public policy, and political behavior to produce research, interpretations, forecasts, and advice.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain current evidence on political systems, public policy, behavior, legislation, and relevant political, economic, and social conditions from documentary, interview, polling, and statistical sources.
interpret_scope: Analyze and evaluate evidence to develop and test political theories, explain policies and public issues, assess programs, and derive findings and trend forecasts.
decide_scope: Select research questions, analytical priorities, conclusions, recommendations, and the policy positions or courses of action to communicate.
act_scope: Produce and disseminate research, forecasts, policy analyses, legislative and governmental materials, commentary, and advice to relevant audiences.

job_role_definition: Provide postal counter, mail acceptance, mail handling, and related customer services at post offices.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive customer mail, payment, service requests, recipient signatures, and address or claim information; inspect, weigh, and identify mail characteristics, destination, condition, and applicable service needs.
interpret_scope: Determine mailing costs, postage sufficiency, mailability and regulatory compliance, routing classification, and the information needed to explain postal procedures or process service issues.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate postal service, postage, handling, routing, customer guidance, referral, or disposition for accepted, delivered, undelivered, or problem mail.
act_scope: Provide counter and customer services by accepting, registering, certifying, insuring, canceling, sorting, bagging, transporting, storing, releasing, and processing mail and related transactions, records, claims, and post office boxes.

job_role_definition: Sort, deliver, collect, and account for mail along assigned postal routes while providing related customer service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and scan route mail and gather address, delivery, customer-request, and route-condition information needed for handling.
interpret_scope: Read addresses, labels, instructions, receipts, customer requests, and route conditions to establish each item's status, destination, handling requirements, and relevant service information.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate handling or delivery disposition, such as sequencing, delivery, hold, redirection, return, notice, or reporting of unusual circumstances.
act_scope: Sort and bundle mail, perform scheduled route delivery and collection, complete accountable-item and payment transactions, provide related customer service, and maintain and transfer required records, receipts, and funds.

occupation_name: Postal Service Mail Sorters, Processors, and Processing Machine Operators
job_role_name: Postal Service Mail Sorters, Processors, and Processing Machine Operators
job_role_definition: Prepare, sort, process, route, and handle incoming and outgoing USPS mail for distribution.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive, open, unload, and stage mail and containers; inspect mail for readable addresses, postage, documentation, condition, and address-correction information needed for processing.
interpret_scope: Determine each item's destination, processability, routing classification, and need for special handling from its address, markings, condition, and routing schemes.
decide_scope: Select the prescribed routing, sorting method, handling disposition, and corrective action for mail that is irregular, redirected, or cannot be processed normally.
act_scope: Operate sorting equipment and clear jams, manually sort and direct mail, prepare and label routed bundles, distribute and transport mail, cancel postage, and rewrap damaged parcels for distribution.

job_role_definition: Direct the operations, workforce, customer service, administration, and support services of one or more postal facilities.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather operational, attendance, customer, workforce, labor, service-requirement, and purchasing information needed to run postal facilities.
interpret_scope: Assess facility performance, staffing needs, employee performance, customer complaints, labor issues, and applicable service and regulatory requirements.
decide_scope: Set operational priorities, staffing schedules, personnel actions, complaint dispositions, labor-dispute terms, management selections, and purchasing choices.
act_scope: Direct postal-facility operations and support services, implement staffing and personnel actions, train employees and managers, resolve complaints, negotiate labor disputes, submit operational reports, and requisition supplies.

job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary students in academic subjects not separately classified.
acquire_scope: Assemble subject-matter materials, learning resources, course requirements, and evidence of students' preparation and performance from observations, assignments, and assessments.
interpret_scope: Assess students' understanding, performance, and learning needs in relation to academic objectives.
decide_scope: Select instructional approaches, content emphasis, assignments, and feedback needed to advance student learning.
act_scope: Deliver academic instruction, facilitate learning activities, and provide feedback to postsecondary students.

job_role_definition: Manufacture ceramic, pottery, and stoneware products by forming, finishing, glazing, firing, and preparing clay ware.
acquire_scope: Prepare and assemble clay, glazes, tools, and equipment, and obtain measurements, test-fire results, defect observations, and equipment-condition readings needed to produce ceramic ware.
interpret_scope: Assess clay response, measurements, ware condition, test-fire results, and equipment indicators to determine form accuracy, defects, and expected firing and glaze outcomes.
decide_scope: Select ware designs, decorative treatments, and wheel, drying, trimming, glazing, and firing settings needed to achieve the required forms, sizes, colors, and textures.
act_scope: Form, shape, finish, dry, glaze, fire, and prepare ceramic, pottery, and stoneware products using wheels, tools, drying equipment, and kilns.

job_role_definition: Operate and support molten-metal pouring and casting processes to produce castings or ingots.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain specified metal and flux, prepare and inspect molds, cores, and pouring equipment, and gather temperature, visual, and sample-based process inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess metal temperature and condition, sample results, mold readiness, flow, fill level, and solidification against casting requirements.
decide_scope: Select heating, equipment-positioning, flow-regulation, cooling, replenishment, cleaning, and corrective actions needed to keep the casting process within specifications.
act_scope: Melt and pour metal, operate and position casting equipment, prepare, cool, extract, finish, identify, and move castings or ingots, and maintain usable forms and equipment.

job_role_definition: Coordinate, regulate, and control the reliable distribution of electricity or steam through utility systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Monitor, inspect, and compile control-board, equipment, circuit, load, weather, system-map, and operating-condition inputs needed to maintain distribution reliability.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment condition, circuit and connection status, demand, forecasts, and load or equipment requirements to determine operating needs and detect defects or emerging disruptions.
decide_scope: Select control settings, energy-schedule execution, switching orders, personnel directions, and contingency routing that maintain service while safely isolating work or affected areas.
act_scope: Operate and adjust distribution and auxiliary equipment, regulate power or steam flows, implement schedules and switching, direct operating personnel, and reroute service during emergencies.

job_role_definition: Control, operate, monitor, and maintain power-generating and auxiliary equipment to produce electric power.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor plant, generation, transmission, well-field, and emissions equipment; inspect status records and personnel reports; and obtain instrument readings, samples, and electrical test results needed to sustain safe power production.
interpret_scope: Assess operating and test data to identify equipment condition, performance deviations, faults, facility-function issues, and regulatory conformance.
decide_scope: Determine required operating setpoints, generation and load adjustments, sequencing, corrective responses, maintenance actions, and emergency staffing or standby-generator deployment.
act_scope: Control, start, stop, regulate, and coordinate generating, auxiliary, distribution, fuel-gas, and emissions equipment; place emergency generation online; and perform necessary preventive maintenance and minor repairs to produce electric power.

job_role_definition: Apply geospatial data and precision-farming technologies to support site-specific agricultural management decisions and field-equipment implementation.
acquire_scope: Collect georeferenced soil, field-boundary, yield, monitor, remote-sensing, weather, and crop-condition inputs, including establishing spatial sampling locations.
interpret_scope: Integrate and analyze spatial, imagery, and equipment-monitor data to map field variability, productivity, soil and crop conditions, and treatment needs.
decide_scope: Develop site-specific crop, seeding, input, pest-treatment, and environmental-management recommendations from the spatial analysis.
act_scope: Configure, calibrate, maintain, and program precision-farming guidance, sensing, planting, and application equipment to carry out the site-specific management plan.

occupation_name: Precision Instrument and Equipment Repairers, All Other
job_role_name: Precision Instrument and Equipment Repairers, All Other
job_role_definition: Repair and maintain specialized precision instruments and equipment not classified in other repairer occupations.
acquire_scope: Gather technical specifications, service history, tools and replacement parts, and obtain condition and performance evidence through inspection, measurement, and testing.
interpret_scope: Assess condition and performance evidence to identify faults, wear, calibration needs, and required service.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate repair, adjustment, calibration, maintenance, or part-replacement approach.
act_scope: Repair, adjust, calibrate, and maintain specialized precision instruments and equipment to restore proper operation.

job_role_definition: Prepare, proof, and process text, images, page files, and printing plates for print production.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, store, retrieve, and assemble original text, graphics, images, fonts, specifications, and plate materials required for print production.
interpret_scope: Check files, images, proofs, unexposed and finished plates, and color and dimensional measurements to identify completeness, flaws, fidelity, and print-quality requirements.
decide_scope: Select page composition adjustments, image scaling and color-processing settings, and plate types appropriate to the production specifications and press run.
act_scope: Arrange and modify page content, generate and proof production files, set scanning and exposure controls, produce printing plates, print plate proofs, and maintain the production equipment needed to deliver conforming prepress output.

job_role_definition: Instruct and care for preschool-aged children through developmentally appropriate learning activities that promote social, physical, and intellectual growth.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather information on each child’s development, behavior, health, needs, interests, progress, and family priorities, and assemble safe, age-appropriate learning materials and activity resources.
interpret_scope: Assess observations, developmental measures, and family or staff input to understand children’s learning, social, physical, health, and support needs.
decide_scope: Set learning objectives and behavioral procedures, and select, adapt, coordinate, and prioritize instruction, care routines, environments, activities, and additional support for individual children and the class.
act_scope: Deliver developmentally appropriate instruction and play-based activities; supervise and care for children’s safety, nutrition, hygiene, routines, and access; maintain an orderly learning environment; and communicate children’s progress and needs with families and relevant staff.

occupation_name: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
job_role_name: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
job_role_definition: Presses, shapes, and finishes textile, garment, and related-material articles by hand or machine.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect articles and work orders and measure relevant dimensions to obtain evidence about fabric properties, condition, existing pleats, spots, specifications, and finished dimensions.
interpret_scope: Assess observed properties, conditions, specifications, and measurements to identify finishing needs and determine conformance to standards.
decide_scope: Choose the appropriate spot treatment, pressing or shaping method, protective measures, equipment configuration, and operating settings for each article.
act_scope: Prepare and position materials, operate and maintain pressing equipment, apply selected treatments and hand or machine finishing methods, and cool or route finished articles.

job_role_definition: Promote health and prevent disease, injury, and disability through population health programs, risk assessment, and preventive clinical practice.
acquire_scope: Collect patient occupational and environmental histories and assemble surveillance, screening, laboratory, vital-record, epidemiologic, and community-resource information on preventable health risks.
interpret_scope: Assess individual and population risk patterns, disease and injury investigations, behavioral causes, health-service needs, and intervention effectiveness from the assembled evidence.
decide_scope: Select and recommend preventive priorities, risk-reduction measures, interventions, program designs, service-delivery improvements, and resource coordination for targeted populations.
act_scope: Deliver preventive clinical practice and direct, implement, manage, coordinate, evaluate, communicate, educate, train, and report on population-health and prevention programs.

job_role_definition: Bind, finish, inspect, and prepare printed products using hand methods or production machinery.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job requirements, assemble printed materials and finishing supplies, and monitor operations and examine product samples for production and quality-control evidence.
interpret_scope: Determine setup needs, equipment condition, defects, and quality conformance from job requirements, operating evidence, and product examinations.
decide_scope: Select binding, finishing, and restoration methods, equipment setups and adjustments, and corrective actions needed to meet job requirements.
act_scope: Set up, operate, adjust, and maintain finishing equipment; perform hand or mechanized binding, trimming, specialty finishing, and book repair; and pack completed products for shipment.

job_role_definition: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain printing presses to produce printed materials that meet job specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine job specifications, obtain print files and required paper, plates, and inks, and collect press, environmental, and in-process sample information.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, proofs, samples, material checks, and operating indications to determine print quality, press condition, and sources of variance.
decide_scope: Select press settings, setup tolerances, production adjustments, and corrective responses needed to meet the job specifications.
act_scope: Set up, load, configure, start, operate, adjust, clean, and perform minor maintenance on the press to produce conforming printed materials.

job_role_definition: Gather, analyze, document, and present information or evidence concerning individuals, organizations, suspected misconduct, and unlawful acts for clients.
acquire_scope: Obtain case-relevant information and evidence through record research, background and financial reviews, interviews, surveillance, undercover inquiries, and coordination with relevant officials.
interpret_scope: Assess and corroborate collected facts, observations, records, and transactions to identify persons, misconduct, criminal activity, financial status, stolen funds, shortages, and other case findings.
decide_scope: Determine investigative priorities, lines of inquiry, and the appropriate disposition or communication of substantiated findings.
act_scope: Document investigations in reports or case summaries and present or communicate evidence and findings to clients, appropriate personnel, and at hearings or trials.

occupation_name: Probation Officers and Correctional Treatment Specialists
job_role_definition: Assess incarcerated offenders and coordinate their rehabilitation, institutional placement, and preparation for release.
acquire_scope: Collect and maintain offender background, case, progress, legal, treatment, and community-service information needed to assess rehabilitation, placement, and release preparation.
interpret_scope: Assess offenders’ rehabilitation needs, behavioral contributors, progress, and suitability for institutional placement or release.
