decide_scope: Develop rehabilitation plans and select recommendations for institutional placement, treatment, release suitability, and postrelease support.
act_scope: Coordinate treatment and community services, communicate release requirements, assist with legal and social-service matters, and prepare rehabilitation, placement, progress, and release materials.

occupation_name: Probation Officers and Correctional Treatment Specialists
job_role_definition: Supervise offenders serving probation, parole, or other community-based sentences while enforcing release conditions and supporting rehabilitation.
acquire_scope: Obtain and document offender background, supervision-contact, field-check, substance-test, and alleged-violation evidence needed to monitor release and prepare case information.
interpret_scope: Assess that evidence to determine offenders' compliance, progress, risks, needs, and factors relevant to rehabilitation, court proceedings, and release conditions.
decide_scope: Select rehabilitation goals, required services, community-service placements, sentencing recommendations, and appropriate remedial, court, or case-routing responses.
act_scope: Communicate and enforce release requirements, implement rehabilitation plans and selected responses, coordinate approved services, and deliver case reports and court testimony.

job_role_definition: Compile and maintain purchasing records to prepare, process, track, and support orders for materials and services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain requisitions, inventory movement and availability data, supplier and bid information, purchasing rules, order-status records, shipment details, and invoices required to process materials and service orders.
interpret_scope: Verify requisition, shipment, invoice, and purchasing-record accuracy; compare supplier offers and order costs; and assess inventory sufficiency, delivery issues, and contractor performance.
decide_scope: Select suppliers or bids, determine necessary replenishment and buying actions, and recommend order, delivery, or contract changes when warranted.
act_scope: Prepare, issue, track, and update purchase orders and purchasing records; coordinate and resolve deliveries; receive and route charges; process bill approval and payment; and provide order and purchasing-rule information to requesters and suppliers.

job_role_definition: Directs the creative and technical realization of stage, screen, broadcast, or recorded productions.
acquire_scope: Research scripts and production subjects, gather production constraints and creative inputs, and obtain rehearsal, recording, and work-in-progress material for review.
interpret_scope: Develop those inputs into a coherent dramatic and technical understanding of scenes, performances, production requirements, and conformance to applicable production and broadcast standards.
decide_scope: Select the directing approach and approve the shot design, pacing, script revisions, locations, equipment, and creative elements needed for the production.
act_scope: Direct performers, broadcasts, recordings, and technical crews through rehearsal and production, and shape recorded material into the intended sequences.

job_role_definition: Develops, organizes, staffs, finances, and manages productions through completion and distribution.
acquire_scope: Assemble scripts, source material, production documentation, rights, financing information, candidate talent, and progress, budget, schedule, and market inputs.
interpret_scope: Evaluate content, production requirements, personnel suitability, operational progress, financial constraints, and distribution prospects.
decide_scope: Select material to produce and determine creative, staffing, budget, schedule, financing, contractual, marketing, and distribution directions.
act_scope: Secure rights and financing, staff and organize the production, coordinate and manage its work through completion, and carry out marketing and distribution arrangements.

job_role_definition: Perform production work not classified under a more specific production occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the materials, specifications, tools, and production inputs required for the assigned production work.
interpret_scope: Determine the applicable work requirements and evaluate production conditions, materials, and outputs against them.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate work sequence, adjustments, and disposition of production issues within the assigned work.
act_scope: Perform the assigned production work and complete the resulting product or production operation.

job_role_definition: Coordinate production schedules, resources, and material flows to keep manufacturing and shipping commitments on track.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect and verify schedules, work orders, forecasts, staffing, production progress, inventory use, supplier shipment details, and process or product conformance information.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, priorities, production and shipping status, material availability, capacity, costs, and deviations from schedules or specifications.
decide_scope: Set production commitments, material and personnel priorities, and schedule revisions needed to address demand, shortages, backlogs, changes, and other disruptions.
act_scope: Coordinate personnel, suppliers, customers, and departments; requisition and route materials; arrange supply delivery or distribution; and issue updated production schedules or work orders to maintain production and shipping commitments.

job_role_definition: Plan, coordinate, and oversee projects to deliver agreed results within scope, schedule, resource, budget, and quality requirements.
acquire_scope: Elicit project requirements and objectives, obtain project updates and resource commitments, and gather milestone, cost, schedule, quality, and issue information.
interpret_scope: Assess project needs, progress, budget performance, quality adherence, risks, and causes of schedule or delivery problems.
decide_scope: Set or revise project plans, schedules, staffing and duty assignments, resource and vendor choices, priorities, and corrective changes.
act_scope: Coordinate project activities and stakeholders, facilitate resolution and communication, maintain required project records and reports, and submit conforming deliverables to clients.

job_role_definition: Detect, mark, and verify corrections to errors in proofs and copy before publication or production.
acquire_scope: Read proofs and copy, compare them with original or related records, and gather authoritative references, specifications, and manuscript context needed for review.
interpret_scope: Identify typographic, grammatical, punctuation, spelling, factual, consistency, and layout-conformance errors or omissions and determine whether prior corrections are complete.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate correction, query, or disposition for each identified issue in consultation with applicable editorial direction.
act_scope: Mark or record corrections using publishing conventions, communicate required changes to the responsible parties, and deliver the verified proof or copy for publication or production.

occupation_name: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
job_role_definition: Manage the property operations, finances, compliance, and member governance of homeowner or condominium associations on behalf of their boards.
acquire_scope: Gather property-condition observations, financial and operating records, member concerns, contractor bids, service needs, and applicable compliance information.
interpret_scope: Assess property conditions, costs, financial status, bids, complaints, violations, and regulatory or legal issues to establish their operational significance.
decide_scope: Set management priorities and recommend or select budgets, maintenance plans, contract terms, purchases, payment actions, and resolutions for association governance.
act_scope: Administer association operations, finances, records, contracts, staff and service providers; carry out maintenance and compliance actions; and manage board and member governance processes.

occupation_name: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
job_role_definition: Direct the financial, operational, leasing, maintenance, acquisition, and development activities of commercial, industrial, or residential real estate.
acquire_scope: Assemble property financial and operating records, inspection findings, market and tenant information, contractor bids, compliance requirements, and acquisition or development data needed to manage the portfolio.
interpret_scope: Assess property condition, operating and financial performance, tenant eligibility and complaints, market rents, regulatory obligations, and the feasibility of acquisition or development opportunities.
decide_scope: Set property priorities, budgets, leasing and service terms, staffing and contractor selections, maintenance and capital-project plans, problem resolutions, and acquisition, sale, financing, or development courses.
act_scope: Direct property operations, leasing, collections and payments, maintenance and construction work, staff and service providers, stakeholder communications, contracts, negotiations, and property transactions to deliver financially sound, compliant real estate performance.

job_role_definition: Diagnose and rehabilitate patients’ oral function, health, and appearance through the design, placement, adjustment, and maintenance of dental and maxillofacial prostheses.
acquire_scope: Examine oral and maxillofacial conditions and obtain jaw and tooth measurements, impressions, and relevant clinical input for prosthetic and restorative care.
interpret_scope: Assess the findings to diagnose oral disease, functional impairment, facial pain or jaw-joint problems, and aesthetic or structural needs.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate coordinated treatment approach and prosthesis or restorative design, including specifications, modifications, and follow-up care.
act_scope: Rehabilitate oral function, health, and appearance by designing or overseeing fabrication, placing, fitting, adjusting, maintaining, repairing, and performing indicated prosthetic, restorative, and cosmetic treatments.

job_role_definition: Provide protective services not classified within a more specific protective-service occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain situational information, protective requirements, and the personnel, locations, or assets requiring protection.
interpret_scope: Assess conditions, threats, vulnerabilities, and protective needs from the available information.
decide_scope: Select protective priorities, precautions, responses, and escalation actions appropriate to the situation.
act_scope: Provide the required protective service by carrying out protective measures and responding to identified risks or incidents.

job_role_definition: Assist psychiatric patients with daily care, safety, emotional support, and treatment-related activities under nursing and medical direction.
acquire_scope: Collect patient histories, observations, vital signs, specimens, and care-related information through admission interviews, routine checks, and ongoing monitoring.
interpret_scope: Recognize changes in patient behavior, condition, progress, needs, or risk of harm from observations and recorded information.
decide_scope: Select immediate care, supervision, safety, and escalation priorities within nursing and medical direction.
act_scope: Provide directed personal, emotional, rehabilitative, treatment, and activity support; maintain patient safety, restrictions, and the care environment; and communicate and document care.

job_role_definition: Provide direct therapeutic, personal-care, monitoring, and treatment support to individuals with mental, emotional, cognitive, intellectual, or developmental conditions under clinical direction.
acquire_scope: Obtain and record patient histories, physical measurements, medication information, and ongoing observations of behavior and well-being.
interpret_scope: Assess collected information to identify changes in mental, emotional, physical, behavioral, safety, and independence-related needs.
decide_scope: Select immediate patient-support, engagement, safety, and reporting priorities within prescribed clinical procedures.
act_scope: Deliver prescribed therapeutic sessions, personal care, wellness and independence instruction, treatment assistance, medication support, transport, and protective interventions.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent mental, emotional, and behavioral disorders through psychiatric evaluation, counseling, and medical care.
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain psychiatric, medical, social, collateral, and diagnostic information needed to evaluate patients and monitor care.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical information, test findings, and treatment outcomes to determine the nature, extent, and course of mental, emotional, or behavioral disorders.
decide_scope: Formulate diagnoses and individualized treatment plans, including the appropriate mix of psychiatric, medical, and preventive care in coordination with relevant professionals.
act_scope: Deliver psychiatric care by prescribing, directing, or administering treatment; counseling patients; and communicating conditions and treatment with patients’ authorized supports.

job_role_definition: Provide psychological services and expertise in specialties not classified elsewhere among psychologists.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information and materials required to provide the specialty psychological service or expertise.
interpret_scope: Analyze the obtained inputs to develop specialty psychological findings, assessments, or explanations.
decide_scope: Select appropriate recommendations or a service approach based on the psychological findings.
act_scope: Deliver the specialty psychological service or expertise, including communicating findings and recommendations.

job_role_definition: Teach psychology at the postsecondary level while supporting students and contributing to research, academic service, and program administration.
acquire_scope: Gather psychological scholarship, student work and progress information, instructional and program requirements and resources, and research data needed for teaching, advising, scholarship, and academic administration.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and advising needs, analyze research evidence, and evaluate courses, curricula, instructional methods, and departmental or institutional matters.
decide_scope: Select instructional and curricular approaches, formulate student recommendations, set research directions, choose resources, and determine departmental or institutional courses of action.
act_scope: Deliver psychology instruction and course materials, communicate grades and guidance, supervise student academic and applied work, publish scholarship and submit funding proposals, maintain required records, and implement academic service and program-administration actions.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate public relations programs that build and maintain an organization’s or client’s public image and relationships with key audiences.
acquire_scope: Gather audience, client, media, stakeholder, organizational, and social, economic, and political information needed to shape public relations programs and communications.
interpret_scope: Assess audience needs, relationship conditions, external trends, public-image implications, and the consistency of advertising and promotion with public relations objectives.
decide_scope: Set public-information policies, communication strategies, audience approaches, crisis plans, program priorities, budgets, and the allocation of staff and external resources.
act_scope: Direct staff and agencies and implement public relations programs through crisis communications, organizational identity and content, audience and media engagement, information responses, internal and consumer relations, and special events.

job_role_definition: Promote and protect clients' or organizations' public image through strategic communications, media relations, stakeholder engagement, and public-facing campaigns.
acquire_scope: Gather organizational objectives and promotional needs, public and stakeholder concerns, media inquiries, and market or public-opinion research findings relevant to public image and campaigns.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to identify perception trends, audience interests, communication needs, reputational issues, and the implications for public-facing messaging.
decide_scope: Select public-relations strategies, communication programs, campaign approaches, messaging priorities, spokesperson responses, and incident-response actions that promote or protect the client's or organization's image.
act_scope: Deliver strategic communications through media responses and releases, web and social content, publications, speeches, stakeholder relationships, coaching, public events, and coordinated promotional campaigns.

job_role_definition: Receives public safety calls, assesses incidents, and provides callers with instructions, information, or referrals.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive public-safety calls and alarms, elicit incident and location details, and retrieve relevant secure records and response-area information.
interpret_scope: Assess the reported incident, determine its location and service-area status, and interpret map and system information into caller-relevant findings.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate instructions, information, or referral based on the assessed incident and available information.
act_scope: Deliver emergency medical guidance, directions, information, or referrals to callers and create the required call record.

job_role_definition: Dispatches emergency resources and maintains operational communications with responding personnel during incidents.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive emergency calls and alarms, monitor incident and responder status, retrieve relevant records, and maintain the secure operational information needed for dispatch communications.
interpret_scope: Assess reported and developing incidents by determining their location, service-area coverage, response needs, available units, and pertinent situational information.
decide_scope: Set incident priorities and select the appropriate response resources and routing in accordance with established procedures.
act_scope: Dispatch selected resources, sustain two-way operational communications and required notifications, document incident activity, and keep dispatch communications equipment operational.

job_role_definition: Operate and tend pumps, manifolds, vessels, and related equipment to safely transfer and regulate bulk materials through processing, storage, and shipping systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain transfer requirements and operating orders, and gather equipment, vessel, flow, pressure, temperature, inventory, and material-condition readings and test results.
interpret_scope: Assess operating and material readings against required levels and specifications to identify transfer conditions, capacity constraints, and abnormalities.
decide_scope: Plan material routes, quantities, timing, and flow adjustments through interconnected pumps, manifolds, vessels, and storage or shipping units.
act_scope: Connect and operate transfer equipment, coordinate and regulate material flows, tend storage and auxiliary units, add or blend materials as required, and maintain equipment for safe operation.

occupation_name: Purchasing Agents, Except Wholesale, Retail, and Farm Products
job_role_name: Purchasing Agents, Except Wholesale, Retail, and Farm Products
job_role_definition: Procures organizational goods and services by evaluating requirements and supply options, negotiating purchases, and managing supplier fulfillment and performance.
acquire_scope: Gather requisitions, specifications, inventory needs, supplier and market information, bids, proposed terms, and delivery or performance records.
interpret_scope: Assess requirements, supplier capabilities, prices, risks, regulatory compliance, and contract or delivery performance to identify viable options and procurement problems.
decide_scope: Select suppliers, quantities, prices, terms, purchasing strategies, and corrective actions that balance quality, cost, availability, and operational requirements.
act_scope: Solicit bids, negotiate and place purchases, administer supplier contracts, monitor fulfillment, and resolve quality, delivery, or performance failures.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate organizational purchasing, supplier contracting, and related personnel, systems, budgets, and policies.
acquire_scope: Obtain supplier, market, delivery, cost, availability, requisition, receipt, claim, specification, budget, and purchasing-operation information needed to manage purchasing and contracting.
interpret_scope: Assess supply conditions, purchasing requirements, bid specifications, costs, claims, operational records, and purchase-order and contract conformance to determine procurement implications.
decide_scope: Set purchasing and contract policies, sourcing and savings strategies, budgets, specifications, bid awards, supplier terms, claim dispositions, staffing, and operational priorities.
act_scope: Execute and oversee purchasing, supplier contracting, bid and order processing, claim settlements, personnel direction and training, purchasing-system administration, budget control, reporting, and surplus disposition.

job_role_definition: Conduct and evaluate laboratory and product-quality testing to determine whether materials and products meet established specifications and regulatory requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and inspect materials and samples, perform visual and laboratory tests, calibrate equipment, validate or transfer analytical methods, monitor test execution, and capture records to generate reliable quality evidence.
interpret_scope: Analyze and trend internal and contract-laboratory data, compare findings with specifications, control limits, methods, and regulatory requirements, and assess deviations, failures, questionable results, and testing compliance.
decide_scope: Select recommendations for data release, responses to quality problems, corrective actions, and the adoption or improvement of analytical methods and procedures.
act_scope: Issue documented quality findings, reports, protocols, and regulatory data, and maintain equipment, safe laboratory conditions, and current quality-control procedures for compliant testing.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate quality assurance and control systems for production, laboratory, supplier, and regulatory compliance activities.
acquire_scope: Obtain quality inputs by directing sampling, testing, inspections, defect and test-data tracking, and collection of product, supplier, regulatory, client, and technical requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess test results, production and system performance, defects, audit findings, quality trends, and regulatory documentation to determine conformance, risks, root causes, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set or approve quality plans, specifications, critical control points, sampling and testing methods, procedures, equipment choices, corrective recommendations, and production dispositions, including halting production for serious defects.
act_scope: Direct, coordinate, document, communicate, and maintain production, laboratory, supplier, and regulatory quality systems, including implementing inspection criteria and instructing staff and vendors.

job_role_definition: Deliver prescribed radiation therapy safely and accurately while supporting patients throughout treatment.
acquire_scope: Review treatment prescriptions, diagnoses, identity and charts; obtain patient-condition, anatomy, treatment-area, side-effect, and delivered-dose information; and prepare, verify, and configure treatment equipment, devices, and materials.
interpret_scope: Determine treatment readiness and technical requirements by reconciling clinical and prescription information, calculating delivered doses, evaluating equipment status, and assessing patient reactions.
decide_scope: Select immediate treatment disposition, needed control or setup adjustments, escalation for unusual reactions, and appropriate follow-up care within the prescribed plan.
act_scope: Accurately position and support patients, deliver prescribed radiation with required protection practices, document treatment, provide treatment-related education and reassurance, and carry out follow-up care.

job_role_definition: Design, implement, integrate, and support RFID systems for tracking goods and shipments.
acquire_scope: Gather operational requirements, site conditions, existing infrastructure and processes, RFID performance-test results, simulation outputs, supply-chain data, standards, and current technology information needed to develop and support tracking systems.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, site evidence, system behavior, RFID readability, supply-chain data, architectural compliance, and modeled configurations to determine feasible designs, integration needs, implementation constraints, performance findings, and support issues.
decide_scope: Select RFID technologies, tags, placement locations, configurations, integration approaches, and project-specific solutions that meet tracking requirements.
act_scope: Design, program, integrate, install, maintain, document, and support RFID systems, including preparing operating procedures and training users.

occupation_name: Radio, Cellular, and Tower Equipment Installers and Repairers
job_role_definition: Installs, diagnoses, calibrates, tests, and repairs mobile and stationary radio communications equipment and systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain equipment condition and performance inputs by inspecting malfunctions and measuring batteries, emergency-transmitter readiness, signal characteristics, capacity, interference, and delay.
interpret_scope: Diagnose defects and assess measured radio-system performance against required operating condition.
decide_scope: Select the needed installation configuration, component or connection remedy, and calibration or control adjustments.
act_scope: Install and mount mobile or stationary radio systems; connect power; replace and repair parts, wiring, and circuits; and calibrate, align, adjust, charge, and verify equipment for proper operation.

occupation_name: Radio, Cellular, and Tower Equipment Installers and Repairers
job_role_definition: Installs, tests, maintains, and repairs antennas and related transmission equipment at communications tower sites.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work specifications and site access, and collect alignment, installation-condition, grounding, and transmission-performance measurements needed for tower equipment work.
interpret_scope: Assess drawings, specifications, inspections, and test measurements to determine equipment configuration, alignment, functionality, and faults.
decide_scope: Select the required installation, adjustment, maintenance, repair, replacement, and corrective actions based on site requirements and findings.
act_scope: Install, connect, position, align, test, maintain, repair, or replace antennas, transmission equipment, grounding, cabling, and tower lighting at communications tower sites.

job_role_definition: Produce diagnostic medical images and support imaging procedures while ensuring patient safety, care, and image quality.
acquire_scope: Obtain examination requests, patient histories and condition information, and prepare patients, imaging rooms, equipment, protocols, contrast agents, and other procedure inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess examination requirements, patient status and reactions, equipment performance, and acquired image quality for diagnostic adequacy and safe continuation.
decide_scope: Select positioning, imaging sequences, exposure and equipment settings, protective measures, additional views, and whether images require repetition or escalation.
act_scope: Position and care for patients; operate imaging, mobile, fluoroscopic, and archiving equipment; produce and process diagnostic images; and assist with imaging procedures while applying safety protections.

job_role_definition: A Diagnostic Radiologist evaluates medical images with relevant clinical information and delivers documented diagnostic findings and recommendations to clinicians.
acquire_scope: Retrieve current and prior imaging, relevant patient history, the clinical question, and image-quality information.
interpret_scope: Analyze imaging in clinical context to determine adequacy, findings, diagnosis or differential, diagnostic significance, and urgency.
decide_scope: Select whether additional imaging, consultation, or follow-up is needed and formulate the recommended next steps and communication priority.
act_scope: Direct necessary additional imaging, issue comprehensive interpretive reports, and communicate significant findings and recommendations to clinicians or patients.

job_role_definition: An Interventional Radiologist diagnoses disease from medical images and plans, directs, and performs minimally invasive image-guided procedures and related care.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient histories, clinical questions, prior studies, current images, and intraprocedural observations needed for image-based diagnosis and intervention.
interpret_scope: Correlate imaging and procedural findings with clinical context to determine diagnosis, treatment target, technical feasibility, procedural risks, and signs of complications.
decide_scope: Select the treatment plan, access route, procedural technique, safety precautions, monitoring approach, and responses to complications.
act_scope: Deliver image-guided care by counseling patients, directing and performing procedures with selected safeguards, and managing complications; document and communicate findings and outcomes.

job_role_definition: A Nuclear Medicine Radiologist diagnoses disease through nuclear imaging and plans or delivers radionuclide procedures and treatments with appropriate quality and radiation safeguards.
acquire_scope: Review procedure requests, clinical histories, prior studies, images, and quality data needed for nuclear medicine evaluation and care.
interpret_scope: Evaluate nuclear images, physiologic findings, clinical context, and procedure quality to determine diagnosis, significance, and therapeutic implications.
decide_scope: Select nuclear medicine procedures and dosages and establish treatment and radiation-safety plans.
act_scope: Direct or perform radionuclide procedures, prepare and administer prescribed doses, and deliver documented interpretations, consultations, and patient counseling.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, maintain, repair, and overhaul rail cars and their mechanical, structural, electrical, and interior components to restore safe operation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect rail cars and components, test mechanical and electrical systems, take required measurements, and use repair specifications and condition records as inputs.
interpret_scope: Diagnose defects, wear, damage, and operating faults from inspections, tests, measurements, and specifications.
decide_scope: Determine the needed maintenance, repair, replacement, adjustment, fabrication, or overhaul work to restore safe operation.
act_scope: Perform scheduled maintenance and carry out the selected disassembly, removal, repair, replacement, fabrication, installation, alignment, adjustment, cleaning, finishing, and reassembly of rail-car mechanical, structural, electrical, and interior components.

job_role_definition: Perform rail transportation work not classified in another specific rail transportation occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information, materials, equipment, and operating inputs required for the assigned rail transportation work.
interpret_scope: Assess the condition, status, and operational meaning of the inputs relevant to the assigned work.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate work approach, priorities, and operational response within the assignment.
act_scope: Perform the assigned rail transportation work not classified in another specific rail transportation occupation.

occupation_name: Rail Yard Engineers, Dinkey Operators, and Hostlers
job_role_name: Rail Yard Engineers, Dinkey Operators, and Hostlers
job_role_definition: Operate locomotives within rail yards and similar facilities to switch, position, and service rail cars and locomotives safely.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain switching orders and crew information, and inspect signals, track, rolling stock, locomotive condition, and operating gauges for movement and service inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess the condition and safety implications of received instructions, signals, track, equipment, and train-car connections.
decide_scope: Determine the safe immediate movement sequence, routing, and handling needed to switch, position, or service the assigned cars and locomotives.
act_scope: Operate locomotives and yard-control equipment to move, couple, uncouple, secure, route, spot, and deliver cars and locomotives for assigned switching or service.

occupation_name: Rail-Track Laying and Maintenance Equipment Operators
job_role_name: Rail-Track Laying and Maintenance Equipment Operators
job_role_definition: Operate specialized equipment and perform associated work to lay, repair, align, and maintain railroad track, ballast, and related components.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect track sections and obtain condition observations, alignment, level, and gauge indications, work specifications, and the materials, tools, equipment, and rail components needed for track work.
interpret_scope: Assess detected damage and measurement indications to determine track, ballast, switch, rail, tie, joint, and equipment conditions relative to required specifications.
decide_scope: Select the needed repair, replacement, adjustment, alignment, ballast-treatment, or equipment-maintenance approach and its operating settings.
act_scope: Operate track-laying and maintenance equipment and perform associated cutting, drilling, fastening, welding, grinding, lifting, cleaning, ballast, lubrication, protection, and repair work to lay, restore, align, and maintain track and related components.

occupation_name: Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operators and Locomotive Firers
job_role_definition: Supports safe locomotive operation by observing signals and track conditions, monitoring instruments, inspecting and servicing engines, and operating locomotives when required.
acquire_scope: Observe signals, track and train conditions, inspect locomotives, tracks, and cars, check operating gauges and onboard supplies, and obtain fuel and lubricants needed for safe service.
interpret_scope: Verify signal meanings and assess observed equipment, track, supply, and instrument conditions to identify obstructions, defects, unsafe operation, and service needs.
decide_scope: Determine required servicing or repair disposition and the appropriate operational response to detected unsafe or abnormal conditions.
act_scope: Prepare and service locomotives by warming, fueling, and lubricating engines, arrange needed repairs, and operate locomotives in emergencies and required yard or industrial movements.

occupation_name: Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operators and Locomotive Firers
job_role_name: Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operator
job_role_definition: Controls and coordinates train and railcar movements through switching, coupling, braking, signaling, inspection, and related safety work.
acquire_scope: Receive switching and track-assignment instructions, observe crew signals, and inspect rail equipment and brake performance to obtain movement and safety-condition inputs.
interpret_scope: Determine required movement conditions and assess inspection and brake-test results to identify equipment defects and service needs.
decide_scope: Select movement-control actions and equipment dispositions based on assignments, signals, and observed conditions.
act_scope: Coordinate and physically control safe railcar and train movements by signaling, switching, coupling, connecting air hoses, setting and controlling brakes, making minor repairs, and placing emergency warnings.

job_role_definition: Coordinate train crews and the safe movement and operation of passenger or freight trains.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain dispatch instructions, route, schedule, cargo, car-destination, time, and train-condition information through records, communications, monitoring, and inspections.
interpret_scope: Assess operating, routing, consist, cargo, timing, and safety conditions, including rail obstructions and defective or improperly sealed cars.
decide_scope: Select safe train-movement commands, route alternatives, car handling and removal dispositions, and crew priorities in response to operating conditions.
act_scope: Coordinate and direct train crews and engineers to move and operate passenger or freight trains safely, execute car changes and emergency protections, and document operational incidents.

job_role_definition: Coordinate railroad-yard traffic, switching operations, and crews assembling, separating, and routing trains.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive dispatcher instructions and operational problem reports; review schedules, switching orders, waybills, and shipping records; and monitor track availability, car contents, destinations, and equipment condition.
interpret_scope: Assess the resulting traffic, cargo, train-configuration, track-capacity, and equipment-status information to identify operational constraints and safe movement requirements.
decide_scope: Develop and prioritize yard movement, switching, routing, train make-up or break-up, and crew-work plans that accommodate scheduled inbound and outbound traffic.
act_scope: Coordinate and direct crews and engineers in switching, coupling, uncoupling, assembling, separating, and moving cars; operate switches and signals; maintain required car-placement records; and oversee equipment inspection and maintenance.

job_role_definition: Manage and improve rangelands to sustain forage, livestock, wildlife, and compatible land uses.
acquire_scope: Measure and monitor vegetation, soils, forage plants, grazing patterns, range practices, and site conditions relevant to sustained rangeland use and protection.
interpret_scope: Assess range condition, forage capacity, plant suitability, and threats from erosion, fire, pests, poisonous plants, and competing land uses.
decide_scope: Set grazing use, conservation, protection, improvement, and land-use plans, standards, specifications, and negotiated management arrangements suited to site and stakeholder objectives.
act_scope: Administer grazing use and compliance, coordinate rangeland management, advise users, and carry out or direct treatments, revegetation, and range improvements that sustain forage, livestock, wildlife, and compatible uses.

job_role_definition: Operate real estate brokerages and oversee the listing, negotiation, financing, rental, and closing of property transactions for clients.
acquire_scope: Obtain property, owner, buyer, tenant, market-comparison, financing, title, contract, and regulatory information needed to operate the brokerage and handle property transactions.
interpret_scope: Assess property value and income potential, competitive pricing, financing options, legal and environmental requirements, transaction status, and the quality of related professional work.
decide_scope: Select listing, pricing, negotiation, financing, rental, closing, compliance, and brokerage-operating priorities and direct agents accordingly.
act_scope: Secure listings, market and show or rent properties, broker negotiations, arrange title and financing work, oversee contract fulfillment and closings, and operate the real estate office.

job_role_definition: Represent clients in renting, buying, or selling real property and guide transactions from marketing and advising through negotiation and closing.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Elicit clients’ property, rental, financial, and credit needs; gather listing, market, comparable-sale, property-condition, title, construction, financing, and transaction-status information.
interpret_scope: Assess property suitability, condition, value, pricing, title and financing eligibility, and explain market, property, financing, maintenance, and legal implications to clients.
decide_scope: Recommend listing price, property and construction options, marketing and presentation measures, financing or mortgage terms, and negotiation positions and transaction arrangements that serve clients’ objectives.
act_scope: Market and list properties, arrange and conduct viewings and inspections, present and negotiate offers, prepare and execute transaction documents, coordinate required parties and closing, and complete rentals or leases.

job_role_definition: Serve as an establishment's initial point of contact by receiving and directing people and communications, providing information, and performing related customer-service and administrative support.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive visitors, calls, messages, inquiries, payments, orders, and appointment requests, and retrieve current availability, service, and record information needed to handle them.
interpret_scope: Identify visitors' purposes and callers' needs, screen communications, assess complaints, and analyze available information to determine accurate answers or applicable terms.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate destination, recipient, appointment or resource allocation, response, complaint disposition, and routing for each request or communication.
act_scope: Greet and direct people, provide and transmit information, operate communications, schedule and update calendars, record payments and records, and complete related correspondence, mail, enrollment, and order-processing support.

job_role_definition: Plan, lead, and support safe recreational programs and facilities that engage participants according to their needs and interests.
acquire_scope: Obtain participant preferences, stated goals, progress observations, and feedback, along with information on staff, facilities, equipment, supplies, schedules, and operating conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess participant and group needs, progress toward goals, program outcomes, staff performance, facility conditions, complaints, and safety concerns.
decide_scope: Select activity plans, program balance, participant goals and accommodations, staff assignments, facility schedules, maintenance priorities, resource allocations, and responses to complaints or emergencies.
act_scope: Deliver and promote recreational programs, visits, outings, and events; prepare activity spaces and equipment; instruct and encourage participants; coordinate staff and facility operations; and enforce safety and emergency procedures, including first aid.

occupation_name: Recreation and Fitness Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_name: Recreation and Fitness Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
job_role_definition: Teach recreation, leisure, and fitness studies at the postsecondary level while fulfilling related faculty responsibilities in student support, research, service, and administration.
acquire_scope: Generate and gather student learning evidence, disciplinary and research evidence, instructional resources, student advising information, and institutional inputs needed for teaching and faculty responsibilities.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and needs, synthesize disciplinary and research evidence, and evaluate curricula, instruction, and institutional matters.
decide_scope: Select course content and instructional methods, assign grades, determine student guidance, and set research, service, and administrative plans or recommendations.
act_scope: Prepare and deliver instruction, communicate evaluations, advise and supervise students, publish research findings, and carry out faculty service and administrative responsibilities.

job_role_definition: Use medically approved recreation interventions to assess, treat, and support the rehabilitation and well-being of patients.
acquire_scope: Obtain patient medical, personal, and team information and observe and document participation, reactions, and progress during recreational therapy.
interpret_scope: Assess patients’ capabilities, needs, interests, and therapeutic progress to determine the meaning of their responses to intervention.
decide_scope: Develop, evaluate, and adjust individualized treatment and discharge plans with the treatment team to support rehabilitation, community integration, and ongoing well-being.
act_scope: Deliver medically approved recreational therapy programs by leading and instructing tailored activities, counseling patients, and building leisure and health-promoting skills.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, inspect, maintain, repair, and overhaul recreational vehicles and their mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, climate-control, and interior systems.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain repair requirements from customers and work orders, inspect vehicle systems, and test components and completed repairs to gather condition and performance evidence.
interpret_scope: Diagnose the nature and extent of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, climate-control, and interior-system faults from inspections and test results.
decide_scope: Select the necessary adjustments, repairs, maintenance, overhauls, parts, costs, and work procedure based on diagnosed conditions and technical references.
act_scope: Maintain, adjust, repair, replace, overhaul, and refinish recreational-vehicle systems and structures, restoring them to proper operation.

job_role_definition: Supervise and coordinate recycling collection, processing, compliance, logistics, planning, and outreach programs for municipal governments or private firms.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather service requests, material-flow records, facility observations, ordinance-violation information, and operational, financial, and community-recycling needs data.
interpret_scope: Assess service needs, material and facility conditions, safety, quality and ordinance compliance, operational performance, and recycling opportunities.
decide_scope: Set recycling plans, goals, budgets, contracts, routes, schedules, storage and shipment arrangements, and resource assignments to meet service and program requirements.
act_scope: Supervise and train personnel; coordinate collection, processing, handling, and shipment activities; enforce compliance; and deliver outreach and funded recycling programs.

job_role_definition: Collects, sorts, loads, and transports recyclable materials from designated pickup locations to recycling facilities using manual or automated collection equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtains assigned pickup information, suitable collection vehicles and containers, and recyclable materials presented at curbside or construction sites.
interpret_scope: Assesses material types, pickup conditions, container requirements, and collection-equipment condition to identify safe sorting, loading, and transport needs.
decide_scope: Selects collection sequence, material segregation, container placement, loading method, and responses to access or equipment problems.
act_scope: Operates collection vehicles and equipment to collect, sort, load, and deliver recyclable materials to designated facilities.

job_role_definition: Prepares discarded materials and products for recycling by separating recoverable streams, removing hazardous substances, and processing materials into recyclable outputs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive mixed recyclable materials and discarded products, and inspect them for composition, condition, contamination, and hazardous substances.
interpret_scope: Determine each item's material type, grade, recoverability, contamination, and hazardous-substance handling needs.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate separation, hazard-removal, cleaning, and mechanical processing route for each material stream.
act_scope: Separate and clean recoverable materials, extract hazardous chemicals, and crush, grind, or bale outputs for recycling.

job_role_definition: Build, reline, repair, and cure refractory linings and related heat-resistant components in industrial heat-processing equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure equipment surfaces and assemble specified refractory materials, mixtures, components, and handling inputs for the lining work.
interpret_scope: Determine lining dimensions, material quantities, and the extent of wear or damage from the gathered measurements and observed condition.
decide_scope: Select the repair, replacement, construction, and curing approach appropriate to the required refractory lining or component.
act_scope: Remove failed linings; build, reline, repair, spray, mold, jacket, transfer, and cure heat-resistant linings and related components.

job_role_definition: Collect and transport refuse and recyclable materials from customer containers to disposal or processing sites.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect the collection truck, check road, weather, site, container, and material conditions, and obtain assigned route and pickup information needed for safe collection.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle, route, site, container, and material information to identify readiness, access, safety, delay, equipment, and material-acceptance issues.
decide_scope: Select safe route or collection adjustments and determine the disposition of problem containers, equipment defects, and operational disruptions.
act_scope: Drive assigned routes; collect, load, compact, transport, and unload refuse and recyclable materials; report or document operational and container issues; and refuel, replenish fluids, and clean the truck.

job_role_definition: Provides community-based nursing care and preventive health services by assessing needs, coordinating care, educating populations, and implementing health-improvement programs.
acquire_scope: Gather individual, family, and community health information, environmental observations, care histories, and input from healthcare and community partners.
interpret_scope: Assess health status, risks, service needs, and community patterns to identify care, prevention, education, infection-control, and referral requirements.
decide_scope: Develop and prioritize nursing care, health education, community improvement, infection-control, and referral plans with patients, families, groups, and partners.
act_scope: Deliver and document nursing care, first aid, immunizations, education, referrals, and coordinated programs that protect individual and community health.

job_role_definition: Provides and coordinates direct nursing care by assessing needs, planning and adapting care, delivering interventions, monitoring responses, and educating patients and families.
acquire_scope: Elicit patient histories and symptoms, examine patients, measure vital signs, and obtain test results, environmental observations, treatment-response observations, and input from families and the care team.
interpret_scope: Evaluate assessment findings and care responses to identify health problems, safety risks, progress, complications, and unmet patient needs.
decide_scope: Set nursing priorities and care plans, select or adjust interventions and diagnostic follow-up, and determine coordination, delegation, referral, or escalation.
act_scope: Administer medications and nursing treatments, perform or assist with procedures and rehabilitation, carry out urgent responses to deterioration, educate patients and families, and coordinate and document care.

job_role_definition: Leads nursing unit operations and quality improvement by supervising personnel, coordinating care, and maintaining safe, effective clinical practices.
acquire_scope: Gather observations and records on patient care, staff performance, infection control, and unit resource and training needs.
interpret_scope: Evaluate unit evidence to identify care-quality, safety, workforce capability, infection-control, and operational gaps.
decide_scope: Set unit priorities and plans for care quality, workforce performance, infection control, and resource management.
act_scope: Direct nursing personnel and unit operations, coordinate care-quality and infection-control measures, and document outcomes while developing staff.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate regulatory strategy, submissions, compliance systems, and agency engagement for an organization's products and operations.
acquire_scope: Obtain and maintain regulatory requirements, agency updates, product and complaint information, compliance documentation, and environmental or industry trend evidence relevant to the organization’s products and operations.
interpret_scope: Assess regulatory requirements, submitted and product-facing materials, complaints, operational practices, and emerging policy trends to determine compliance status, implications, and potential impacts.
decide_scope: Set regulatory strategy, submission and implementation plans, compliance policies and procedures, priorities, resource allocations, and regulatory positions for products and operations.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate regulatory submissions, agency responses and representation, compliance documentation and systems, regulatory guidance, and audit, inspection, recall, and complaint-resolution activities.

job_role_definition: Coordinates regulatory submissions and internal compliance processes to obtain and sustain organizational and product conformity with applicable requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain current laws, guidance, standards, product and clinical evidence, quality and safety information, and records, samples, metrics, audit findings, and inspection observations needed to support conformity.
interpret_scope: Assess applicable requirements and changes, scientific and technical evidence, product materials, safety events, protocols, and operational practices for compliance implications.
decide_scope: Select regulatory pathways, required submissions and documentation, compliance dispositions, procedural changes, complaint outcomes, and recall or withdrawal actions.
act_scope: Coordinate, prepare, submit, maintain, and follow up on regulatory filings, reports, technical files, compliance records, policies, training, inspections, and selected corrective or market actions.

job_role_definition: Assess client needs and deliver coordinated rehabilitation counseling, planning, and employment support that promotes clients' independence and employability.
acquire_scope: Elicit clients’ goals and options; assemble interview, educational, medical, diagnostic, and professional input; and document progress, contacts, and placement conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess clients’ abilities, needs, eligibility, employment barriers, progress, and placement adequacy from the assembled information.
decide_scope: Select individualized rehabilitation goals, service plans, employment strategies, and adjustments to address identified needs and barriers.
act_scope: Deliver coordinated rehabilitation counseling and employment support by implementing plans with clients, families, professionals, employers, and community resources, including placements, job coaching, and assistive accommodations.

job_role_definition: Position and secure steel bars, rods, cables, and mesh in concrete forms to reinforce concrete structures.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain reinforcement requirements from blueprints, sketches, or instructions and assemble the specified steel bars, rods, cables, mesh, wire, blocks, and tools.
interpret_scope: Read the requirements to determine the required quantities, dimensions, shapes, spacing, and placement locations of reinforcement.
decide_scope: Select the specific reinforcement pieces and preparation needed to meet the determined layout and fit.
act_scope: Cut, bend, weld, fit, position, space, support, and fasten reinforcement within concrete forms to reinforce the structure.

job_role_definition: Provide religious services and support not classified in another religious-worker occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain the information, religious materials, and practical resources required to provide the requested religious services and support.
interpret_scope: Assess the gathered information and circumstances to identify the religious-service and support needs to be addressed.
decide_scope: Select the service or support approach, content, priorities, and arrangements appropriate to the identified needs.
act_scope: Deliver the selected religious services and support.

job_role_definition: Analyze remote sensing and geospatial data and develop methods and applications that address scientific and practical problems.
acquire_scope: Assemble, organize, document, and integrate remote-sensing imagery, geospatial sources, and corroborating field or climatic measurements needed for scientific and applied investigations.
interpret_scope: Analyze, format, and assess remote-sensing and geospatial data to derive reliable spatial findings, including environmental-change impacts and issue-specific patterns.
decide_scope: Select project objectives, data-collection, analysis, display, equipment, and methodological approaches, including directions for new analytical techniques or sensor systems.
act_scope: Process imagery into geospatial products, implement databases and artifact-correction or analytical routines, conduct application research and fieldwork, and communicate project results.

job_role_definition: Implement, operate, evaluate, and improve the hardware and software systems used to collect and process remote sensing data.
acquire_scope: Gather project requirements, technical literature, research findings, and data-quality, equipment-performance, and system-test evidence needed to operate, evaluate, and improve remote-sensing collection and processing systems.
interpret_scope: Assess collection quality, system performance, test results, research findings, and technical developments to identify operational needs and opportunities for hardware, software, sensor, or analytical improvements.
decide_scope: Select collection, analysis, display, implementation, maintenance, enhancement, and acquisition approaches, including when procedural or equipment changes are warranted.
act_scope: Implement, operate, maintain, install, direct, and enhance remote-sensing data collection and processing hardware and software, including developing improved sensors and analytical techniques.

job_role_definition: Collect, process, validate, and deliver remotely sensed geospatial data and imagery to support scientific and applied mapping projects.
acquire_scope: Determine project needs and required sensing, verification, and geospatial inputs; calibrate and operate collection equipment to gather remotely sensed and ground-reference data while monitoring collection quality.
interpret_scope: Process, correct, enhance, integrate, validate, and assess remotely sensed imagery and geospatial data so it is accurate and fit for mapping and applied scientific use.
decide_scope: Select project approaches, sensing and processing resources, image displays and categories, processing routines, and necessary collection corrections to meet required outputs.
act_scope: Produce and deliver usable geospatial imagery and data products, including mosaics, databases, technical documentation, reports, and project communications for mapping, environmental, and other applied uses.

occupation_name: Reservation and Transportation Ticket Agents and Travel Clerks
job_role_definition: Process and assist transportation passengers at terminals with boarding, baggage, accessibility, and departure information.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain passenger travel documents, baggage and cargo details, baggage-status records, and terminal arrival and departure updates.
interpret_scope: Determine passenger destinations and boarding eligibility and assess baggage records to establish the location or status of delayed, lost, or misdirected baggage.
decide_scope: Assign boarding passes and select passenger directions, loading locations, and baggage-recovery actions.
act_scope: Check and route baggage or cargo, assist passengers requiring special boarding or disembarking support, communicate terminal departure information, and carry out baggage recovery.

occupation_name: Reservation and Transportation Ticket Agents and Travel Clerks
job_role_definition: Arrange, document, sell, and provide information about transportation, lodging, and related travel services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather travelers’ requirements and preferences and obtain current schedules, availability, rates, accommodation details, travel requirements, and service information.
interpret_scope: Assess the fit of available transportation, lodging, and related services to travelers’ needs, including applicable connections, requirements, fares, and fees.
decide_scope: Select and structure suitable routes, itineraries, accommodations, reservations, and related travel-service recommendations.
act_scope: Arrange and confirm travel services, assign available space, prepare and issue travel documents and invoices, process payment, and provide travel information, document assistance, and reservation updates.

job_role_definition: Coordinate residential life, resident support, safety, conduct, programming, and facility operations in dormitories, group homes, and similar resident facilities.
acquire_scope: Gather resident observations, concerns, progress and case information, health and counseling context, facility conditions, and operational resource needs through rounds, meetings, and coordination with residents and staff.
interpret_scope: Assess resident behavior, safety and security conditions, interpersonal and personal needs, rule-related concerns, and maintenance requirements to determine their significance.
decide_scope: Select resident-support and counseling plans, educational programming, conflict-resolution approaches, disciplinary or corrective dispositions, emergency escalation, facility repair referrals, and operational priorities.
act_scope: Coordinate and deliver residential life services by maintaining safe, orderly facilities; counseling and mediating with residents; enforcing conduct standards; providing first aid; coordinating programs and staff; and arranging needed maintenance and support.

job_role_definition: Assess, treat, monitor, and educate patients with breathing and cardiopulmonary disorders using respiratory care therapies and equipment.
acquire_scope: Obtain prescriptions and patient history, measure and observe cardiopulmonary status and treatment responses, and conduct respiratory and cardiac function testing while preparing safe, functioning treatment equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess respiratory and cardiopulmonary condition, test findings, and physiological responses to identify treatment needs, progress, and adverse reactions.
decide_scope: Determine the ordered therapy's appropriate type, method, duration, precautions, medication parameters, and needed treatment-setting changes, escalating concerning findings as appropriate.
act_scope: Deliver and adjust respiratory therapies and airway or emergency interventions, monitor patients during care, document and communicate care information, and educate patients and families in treatment and disease management.

job_role_definition: Protect retail assets by preventing, detecting, investigating, and responding to theft, fraud, security risks, and related losses.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain evidence and operational inputs through surveillance, incident and background inquiries, inventory records, store audits, security inspections, system tests, and compliance monitoring.
interpret_scope: Analyze observations, records, and investigative evidence to determine theft or fraud findings, shortages, safety and security risks, and control or procedural deficiencies.
decide_scope: Select case dispositions, response and enforcement priorities, and loss-reduction recommendations involving controls, processes, equipment, and fraud prevention.
act_scope: Implement and oversee loss-prevention measures, apprehend shoplifters and respond to critical incidents, document and report findings, train personnel, and coordinate enforcement and legal proceedings.

job_role_definition: Serves retail customers by identifying needs, recommending and explaining merchandise, and completing purchases or exchanges.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather customer needs, merchandise availability and characteristics, and current pricing, promotion, transaction, and store-policy information.
interpret_scope: Assess merchandise suitability for the customer, applying product, quantity, cost, availability, and transaction terms to the requested purchase or exchange.
decide_scope: Select recommendations and sourcing options, determine applicable quantities, prices, or exchange terms, and choose a transaction course.
act_scope: Explain and demonstrate merchandise, help customers evaluate and obtain selected items, and complete sales or exchanges through documentation, payment, packaging, and purchase arrangements.

job_role_definition: Set up, operate, inspect, and repair rigging systems to safely move, position, support, or secure heavy loads and equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain load, equipment, site, route, support-point, and rigging-condition information needed to prepare safe lifting, movement, positioning, support, or securement.
interpret_scope: Assess load behavior, clearances, support capacity, rigging condition, and test results to determine the requirements and safety of the rigging arrangement.
decide_scope: Select the rigging gear, attachment methods, suspension configuration, movement sequence, and corrective repair or adjustment needed for the work.
act_scope: Set up, inspect, test, operate, repair, and dismantle rigging; attach, move, position, support, anchor, load, or secure heavy equipment and loads, including controlled maneuvering and worker direction.

job_role_definition: Design, develop, integrate, test, and support robotic systems and applications that deliver automated capabilities.
acquire_scope: Gather requirements, research findings, sensor and system data, and component, interface, performance, and cost inputs for robotic systems and applications.
interpret_scope: Analyze sensor and test data, feasibility, system performance, and mechanical or software faults to assess robotic-system behavior and needs.
decide_scope: Select and approve robotic-system architectures, designs, configurations, control approaches, tooling, integration plans, and corrective actions.
act_scope: Design, program, build, integrate, test, install, calibrate, maintain, debug, document, and support robotic systems and applications that deliver automated capabilities.

job_role_definition: Build, install, program, test, troubleshoot, and maintain robotic equipment and related automated production systems.
acquire_scope: Inspect installation sites and robotic systems, conduct performance tests, and obtain service histories, specifications, fault data, and component information needed for installation, programming, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
interpret_scope: Analyze installation conditions, system behavior, test measurements, faults, efficiency, and reliability to assess equipment status and identify causes of performance problems.
decide_scope: Select system configurations, robot motions, control settings, calibration and maintenance approaches, and corrective repairs that meet production, safety, and quality requirements.
act_scope: Build, assemble, install, wire, program, calibrate, repair, and maintain robotic equipment and related automated production systems.

job_role_definition: Separate dimension-stone blocks and slabs from quarry masses by locating natural grain, marking and preparing cuts, and splitting or cutting stone.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect quarry stone to obtain natural grain patterns and dimensional requirements for the intended blocks or slabs.
interpret_scope: Determine the likely splitting behavior of the stone from its grain patterns.
decide_scope: Select cut and split outlines and the appropriate separation method for the required stone sections.
act_scope: Mark and prepare the selected outlines, drill or groove the stone as needed, place wedges or explosive charges, and cut or split blocks and slabs from quarry masses.

occupation_name: Rolling Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_name: Rolling Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend rolling machines that form, flatten, temper, or reduce metal and plastic materials to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain rolling orders, blueprints, schedules, material and product measurements, machine-cycle and equipment-condition observations, gauge readings, and tooling data required to form materials to specification.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, measurements, indicators, and operating conditions to determine conformance and identify defects, jams, and setup or process deviations.
decide_scope: Select rolling sequences, draft space, roll speeds, tooling, setup parameters, and corrective adjustments needed to achieve the specified form, thickness, and temper.
act_scope: Install and position tooling and auxiliary equipment, set machine components, feed materials, operate and regulate rolling equipment, apply coolants and lubricants, and trim or finish workpieces to specification.

job_role_definition: Install and verify roof-support bolts to stabilize underground mine roofs for safe mining operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Check bolting equipment, test for methane, observe roof conditions, drill test holes, measure installed-bolt tension, and assemble the specified support materials and requirements.
interpret_scope: Evaluate equipment, atmospheric, roof, test-hole, and bolt-tension evidence to identify hazards and determine support adequacy.
decide_scope: Select bolt placement and support configuration and determine whether to proceed, adjust the installation, or remove loose rock.
act_scope: Position bolting machinery and temporary supports, provide ventilation, drill roof holes, install and tighten bolts and trusses, remove loose rock, and dust treated rock to stabilize the mine roof.

job_role_definition: Install, repair, and weatherproof roofing systems and related rooftop components to protect structures from the elements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect roof conditions and rooftop interfaces and obtain required measurements, specifications, materials, and components.
interpret_scope: Assess defects, exposure conditions, and roof geometry to identify repair needs and estimate material and labor requirements.
decide_scope: Select the repair procedure, roofing-system configuration, and sequence of weatherproofing work suited to the structure.
act_scope: Establish safe roof access, clear and prepare surfaces, and install, repair, finish, and weatherproof roofing systems, related rooftop components, and specialized roof assemblies.

occupation_name: Rotary Drill Operators, Oil and Gas
job_role_name: Rotary Drill Operators, Oil and Gas
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and oversee rotary drilling equipment and crews to drill oil and gas wells or obtain core samples.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain drilling-site, equipment, depth, pressure, fluid-circulation, progress, and core-sample inputs needed to conduct the drilling operation.
interpret_scope: Assess drilling progress, borehole depth, subsurface strata, drilling-fluid condition, and equipment performance from operational observations and samples.
decide_scope: Select drilling parameters, drill bits, corrective measures, and crew work priorities based on operating conditions and formation characteristics.
act_scope: Set up, operate, adjust, maintain, and repair rotary drilling and fluid systems; direct crews; handle drill pipe and casing; and recover downhole equipment to drill wells or obtain core samples.

job_role_definition: Perform general oilfield labor to assemble, maintain, move, and support equipment and work sites.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Gather requested tools, components, materials, and work instructions, and inspect flow lines, equipment, and work areas for leaks, damage, and site conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection and detector observations to locate leaks and determine the condition of equipment, lines, and work sites.
decide_scope: Select the immediate repair, assembly, movement, or site-support steps needed to address observed conditions and requested field work.
act_scope: Assemble, install, maintain, repair, relocate, and supply oilfield equipment and lines, and clean, build, or prepare work sites.

job_role_definition: Perform deck operations, watchstanding, vessel handling, cargo support, and shipboard upkeep under vessel officers.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe navigational hazards, aids, water depth, courses, weather, access, and the condition of cargo, tow, deck, lifesaving, rigging, and vessel-handling equipment needed for assigned operations.
interpret_scope: Assess observations and measurements to determine navigational safety, course accuracy, operational status, access security, and maintenance or emergency needs.
decide_scope: Select immediate execution priorities and safe operating responses within assigned courses, procedures, and officers’ directions.
act_scope: Carry out watchstanding, steering and signaling, mooring and towing, cargo transfer and handling, equipment and lifesaving operations, deck upkeep and repairs, crew direction, and operational recordkeeping.

job_role_definition: Support ship engineering officers by monitoring, lubricating, maintaining, and repairing vessel machinery.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain machinery-condition inputs by reading and logging pressure and temperature displays and checking specified pressures and lubricant flows.
interpret_scope: Assess gauge readings, recorded operating data, and machinery observations against specified conditions to identify maintenance or repair needs.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate maintenance, lubrication, adjustment, or repair priority within engineering officers’ direction.
act_scope: Support vessel engineering operations by lubricating, maintaining, repairing, and adjusting ship machinery and engines.

job_role_definition: Sell technically complex business products or services by assessing customer needs, configuring solutions, and supporting the sales process.
acquire_scope: Gather customer operating requirements, equipment constraints, account and market opportunities, and current product, technology, pricing, availability, and competitive information.
interpret_scope: Assess customer needs and installed-equipment conditions to determine technical requirements, solution feasibility, and the expected operational or cost benefits of alternatives.
decide_scope: Select target opportunities and recommend the product or service configuration, custom-development inputs, commercial proposal, and course of technical sales support suited to each customer.
act_scope: Present and demonstrate configured technical solutions, develop proposals and contracts, secure or renew orders and coordinate delivery, and provide the technical guidance needed for installation, use, operation, or maintenance.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate sales operations to achieve revenue, distribution, and customer-service objectives.
acquire_scope: Gather customer preferences and requirements, sales and financial records, market conditions, operating constraints, and partner or outlet information needed to manage sales operations.
interpret_scope: Analyze customer, sales, operating, and market information to identify needs, forecast performance and profitability, and assess sales opportunities and operational effectiveness.
decide_scope: Set sales priorities, customer solutions, pricing and discounts, budgets, staffing and development plans, promotional coordination, operating policies, and complaint resolutions.
act_scope: Lead sales organizations and outlets, coordinate sales and service programs, develop customers and channel partners, promote offerings, advise stakeholders, and carry out service recoveries.

occupation_name: Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel
job_role_name: Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel
