job_role_definition: Sell services to prospective and existing customers by identifying needs, presenting options, negotiating agreements, and supporting client accounts.
acquire_scope: Gather prospect, customer, service, pricing, availability, contract, and market information needed to pursue and support service accounts.
interpret_scope: Assess customer needs, service fit, costs, vendor capabilities and limitations, and market conditions to form a sales understanding.
decide_scope: Select the service options, feature emphasis, pricing, credit, contract, and fulfillment terms to recommend or offer.
act_scope: Engage customers, present and explain proposals and terms, negotiate and complete agreements, and provide post-sale account support.

occupation_name: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
job_role_name: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
job_role_definition: Sell wholesale or manufactured nontechnical products to business customers by developing accounts, advising buyers, negotiating terms, and securing orders.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather prospective-customer leads, buyer needs, product and availability details, credit information, and relevant market, competitor, and account conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess customer requirements, product fit, commercial viability, and applicable pricing, delivery, warranty, and contract information.
decide_scope: Select products, quotations, recommendations, account approaches, and negotiated commercial terms that best secure and sustain business orders.
act_scope: Develop and contact accounts, present products and information, negotiate with buyers, prepare and transmit orders and contracts, coordinate fulfillment, and provide post-sale support.

occupation_name: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Technical and Scientific Products
job_role_name: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Technical and Scientific Products
job_role_definition: Sell technical and scientific products and related services by assessing customer needs, recommending solutions, completing sales, and providing sales-related support.
acquire_scope: Gather customer needs, technical requirements, prospective-account and credit information, product knowledge, market and regulatory information, and delivery or installation inputs relevant to a sale.
interpret_scope: Assess customer requirements against product capabilities, specifications, regulations, costs, savings, and technical issues to determine the practical fit of available offerings.
decide_scope: Select the suitable product or service configuration, commercial terms, and delivery or support approach to recommend for the customer.
act_scope: Present, demonstrate, quote, negotiate, contract, and sell technical or scientific products and services, then provide delivery coordination, usage guidance, and ongoing technical sales support.

occupation_name: Sales and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Sales and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Perform sales and related work not classified in a more specific sales occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain customer, market, product, and transaction information required for the sales or related work performed.
interpret_scope: Assess the available information to determine relevant customer needs, opportunities, and transaction conditions.
decide_scope: Select the sales or related-work approach, priorities, and proposed disposition appropriate to the situation.
act_scope: Carry out the selected sales or related work and deliver its resulting customer or transaction outcome.

occupation_name: Sawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Wood
job_role_name: Sawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Wood
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and perform routine upkeep on sawing machines that cut wood stock to specified dimensions and shapes.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job specifications; inspect and measure stock and finished workpieces; mark stock; and observe machine operation, cut progress, and equipment condition.
interpret_scope: Translate specifications into dimensional and setup requirements and assess stock quality, cut accuracy, and operating conditions for defects or deviations.
decide_scope: Select the cutting plan, stock, saw blade, machine configuration, operating adjustments, and corrective or routine upkeep actions suited to the work.
act_scope: Set up and operate sawing equipment, position and feed stock, make specified cuts, adjust equipment, clear jams, service blades, and perform routine cleaning and lubrication.

job_role_definition: Maintain student safety and orderly conduct while assisting passengers during school-bus transportation, boarding, exiting, and emergencies.
acquire_scope: Observe passenger conduct, mobility and support needs, route and stop information, and transportation hazards while receiving student requests and relevant safety updates.
interpret_scope: Assess observed behavior, accessibility needs, and roadway or emergency conditions to determine their implications for passenger safety and orderly travel.
decide_scope: Select appropriate safety interventions, assistance priorities, driver signals, evacuation responses, and incident communications based on those assessments.
act_scope: Maintain safe, orderly transportation by assisting, securing, directing, supervising, and evacuating passengers; communicating route information; managing conflicts; and coordinating safety signals and incident reports.

job_role_definition: Assess student educational, behavioral, and developmental needs and deliver individual and schoolwide psychological services that support learning and adjustment.
education_most_common_level: Post-Master's Certificate - awarded for completion of an organized program of study; designed for people who have completed a Master's degree but do not meet the requirements of academic degrees at the doctoral level.
acquire_scope: Select, administer, and score assessments; gather observations, school records, and information from students, families, and school personnel; and collect service and program outcome data.
interpret_scope: Evaluate integrated assessment and contextual evidence to identify educational, behavioral, and developmental needs, diagnose relevant conditions, and assess program effectiveness.
decide_scope: Form eligibility and service recommendations, then develop individualized plans, teaching strategies, school programs, referrals, and responses to student safety concerns.
act_scope: Deliver and document individual and schoolwide psychological services through counseling, consultation, crisis and family support, educational programming, implementation support, reporting, and required protective notifications.

job_role_definition: Develop and optimize search and digital marketing strategies to improve online visibility, engagement, user experience, and conversion outcomes.
acquire_scope: Gather search, market, competitor, user-intent, campaign-performance, revenue, catalog, technology, and regulatory inputs through research, analytics instrumentation, and optimization testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze performance metrics, search behavior, user intent, market conditions, forecasts, technology and regulatory constraints, and test results to assess visibility, engagement, user experience, and conversion opportunities.
decide_scope: Set performance measures and select integrated search and digital marketing strategies, content, channel, placement, technology, and optimization priorities.
act_scope: Deliver performance findings and develop, execute, coordinate, and optimize digital assets, site and conversion experiences, campaigns, listings, and cross-channel marketing activities.

occupation_name: Secondary School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
job_role_name: Secondary School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
job_role_definition: Teach academic subjects to secondary school students by planning and delivering instruction, assessing learning, managing classrooms, and supporting student development.
acquire_scope: Gather curriculum requirements, instructional resources, and information on students’ performance, behavior, development, needs, progress, and family or staff perspectives.
interpret_scope: Evaluate observations, classwork, assignments, and standardized assessments to determine students’ learning progress, strengths, needs, and academic or behavioral problems.
decide_scope: Set course and lesson objectives, select instructional activities and materials, and determine adaptations, remedial support, behavioral responses, and student priorities.
act_scope: Prepare learning environments and materials; deliver and manage safe, orderly instruction; assess and communicate student progress; and provide academic, developmental, accessibility, and counseling support.

occupation_name: Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive
job_role_name: Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive
job_role_definition: Provide routine administrative support by managing office communications, schedules, records, documents, supplies, transactions, and related clerical activities.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive calls, visitors, mail, requests, records, availability, transaction details, and needed reference information for routine office support.
interpret_scope: Assess inquiries, correspondence, records, forms, schedules, and transaction information for relevance, completeness, accuracy, formatting, and required handling.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate recipient, response, filing or information source, scheduling arrangement, supply order, and routine processing priority under established procedures.
act_scope: Deliver routine administrative support by communicating and routing information, maintaining calendars and records, preparing and distributing documents, operating office systems, processing routine transactions, supplying the office, and arranging meetings, events, or travel.

occupation_name: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
job_role_definition: Assess customer needs and sell or recommend financial services and investment solutions suited to their circumstances and objectives.
acquire_scope: Elicit prospective and current clients’ financial circumstances and objectives, and obtain current security prices, issuer information, transaction details, and other financial inputs.
interpret_scope: Analyze client financial status, needs, and relevant financial information to assess suitability and prepare plans, proposals, and monitoring reports.
decide_scope: Select the financial services, investment solutions, and security purchase or sale recommendations suited to each client’s circumstances and objectives.
act_scope: Present, explain, recommend, and sell the selected services or investments; communicate transaction information; and ensure agreements and contracts are carried out properly.

occupation_name: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
job_role_definition: Execute and arrange securities, commodities, and derivatives transactions while monitoring markets, positions, pricing, and regulatory compliance.
acquire_scope: Monitor markets and positions, obtain price quotations and issuer information, and gather market, economic, transaction, and counterparty data relevant to securities, commodities, and derivatives transactions.
interpret_scope: Analyze price-moving conditions, determine instrument values and transaction costs, and assess transaction information for accuracy and regulatory conformance.
decide_scope: Develop trading, option, or hedge strategies and select opportunities, recommendations, instruments, prices, terms, and buy-or-sell courses for customer or dealer transactions.
act_scope: Place, relay, execute, arrange, document, and report transactions, and provide clients and colleagues with relevant transaction, market, pricing, and trading information.

job_role_definition: Protects people, property, and premises by controlling access, patrolling, monitoring for threats, enforcing rules, and responding to incidents.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor premises, access points, alarms, security equipment, screening devices, and persons to obtain security-relevant observations, identities, credentials, and evidence of hazards or irregularities.
interpret_scope: Assess observations, alarms, screening results, and incident circumstances to identify threats, unauthorized activity, rule violations, safety needs, and equipment tampering.
decide_scope: Determine whether to admit or deny entry, prioritize and escalate incidents, select an enforcement or protective response, and arrange emergency or medical assistance.
act_scope: Protect people, property, and premises by controlling access, patrolling and maintaining order, securing facilities, responding to incidents and emergencies, enforcing rules, providing escorts or personal protection, and documenting material activities and irregularities.

job_role_definition: Assess organizational security risks and design, implement, and oversee physical-security systems and processes that protect personnel and facilities.
acquire_scope: Gather threat, vulnerability, incident, system-condition, design, regulatory, and operational evidence through audits, inspections, testing, document reviews, monitoring, and interviews.
interpret_scope: Analyze collected evidence to determine security risks, vulnerabilities, incident causes and losses, design adequacy, compliance, system performance, and protection needs.
decide_scope: Select countermeasures and define security policies, procedures, system designs, specifications, integration approaches, improvements, priorities, budgets, and schedules.
act_scope: Implement, maintain, repair, and oversee physical-security systems and processes; train personnel, deliver operational and case documentation, and respond to emergencies.

job_role_definition: Direct organizational security functions to protect people, facilities, operations, and assets.
acquire_scope: Gather security-relevant evidence and operating inputs through monitoring, inspections, audits, investigations, financial review, incident documentation, and coordination with relevant agencies.
interpret_scope: Assess threats, vulnerabilities, breaches, compliance, operational performance, and incident evidence to determine security conditions, consequences, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set security policies, standards, budgets, staffing and procurement priorities, and select protective, investigative, emergency, contingency, event, and executive-protection plans.
act_scope: Direct and implement organizational security operations, lead and train personnel, coordinate protective and emergency responses, maintain required security programs, and communicate security status and findings.

occupation_name: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
job_role_name: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers
job_role_definition: Install, program, maintain, and repair security and fire alarm systems in accordance with site requirements and applicable codes.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect sites and existing systems, consult clients on security requirements, perform functional tests, and obtain plans, work orders, manuals, specifications, and required materials.
interpret_scope: Assess site conditions, code-relevant installation constraints, system requirements, and observed circuit, sensor, battery, and feature behavior to identify needed configurations or faults.
decide_scope: Select the installation approach, materials, equipment placement, wiring routes, unit settings, and corrective measures that meet site requirements and applicable codes.
act_scope: Install, connect, program, adjust, maintain, and repair security and fire alarm equipment, and demonstrate the completed system’s operation to customers.

job_role_definition: Install durable segmental-paver surfaces by preparing bases, laying and finishing paving units, and completing edge and joint treatments.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain the client’s design requirements, inspect and measure the site and soil conditions, and assemble the paving, base, sand, and edge-restraint materials.
interpret_scope: Assess ground stability, drainage, surface levels, and site dimensions to determine the installation conditions and required fit of paving units.
decide_scope: Select the paving layout, alignment, grading and drainage approach, material placement, and necessary cutting or rescreeding adjustments.
act_scope: Establish layout references, prepare and stabilize the base, place and level base and bedding materials, lay and cut pavers, install and cement edges, fill joints, compact the surface, and finish it for traffic.

job_role_definition: Teach individuals or groups nonoccupational subjects and skills for personal enrichment or recreation.
acquire_scope: Gather learner needs, interests, abilities, performance evidence, course requirements, instructional content, and the materials, equipment, and settings needed for instruction.
interpret_scope: Assess learner characteristics, progress, test and work performance, and instructional results to identify understanding, limitations, strengths, and improvement needs.
decide_scope: Set learning objectives and standards; choose lesson structures, teaching approaches, assessments, activities, resources, adaptations, and revisions to address learners' needs safely.
act_scope: Deliver individual and group instruction, demonstrations, workshops, supervised practice, projects, and recreational learning activities; guide learners, enforce safe use and class rules, and communicate performance feedback and grades.

job_role_definition: Operate and maintain semiconductor manufacturing processes and equipment to produce, prepare, and inspect crystals, wafers, and components with specified properties.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work specifications and materials and perform inspections, tests, measurements, counts, and equipment observations needed for semiconductor processing and conformance evaluation.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, process readings, test results, defect observations, and equipment symptoms to determine conformance, processing conditions, and emerging crystal-growth or equipment problems.
decide_scope: Determine processing sequences, material quantities, etching durations, equipment settings, control adjustments, product disposition, and repair needs to achieve specified properties.
act_scope: Operate, load, unload, adjust, clean, and maintain processing equipment to prepare, grow, clean, etch, pattern, finish, identify, separate, and route semiconductor materials and record production and conformance results.

occupation_name: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend equipment that separates, filters, clarifies, precipitates, or distills materials to recover refined products.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Load and measure process materials, collect and test product samples, and obtain operating-condition and equipment-status readings needed for refining.
interpret_scope: Assess instrument readings, sample results, and equipment inspections to determine process condition, product quality, and operational or safety issues.
decide_scope: Select operating settings and corrective process or equipment responses needed to maintain acceptable refining conditions.
act_scope: Set up, operate, adjust, and tend separation equipment to recover refined products, including material transfer, equipment cleaning, sterilization, clearing, and necessary maintenance.

occupation_name: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
job_role_name: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
job_role_definition: Clean, diagnose, maintain, and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, drains, and related wastewater structures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect wastewater structures and pipe conditions, retrieve diagnostic evidence from lines, measure and mark access or excavation locations, and assemble the needed tools, equipment, and work inputs.
interpret_scope: Determine the location, type, extent, and likely cause of stoppages, deposits, leaks, breaks, or other wastewater-system damage from inspections and diagnostic evidence.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate cleaning, access, repair, sealing, replacement, and restoration approach, including the equipment configuration and work sequence suited to the observed conditions.
act_scope: Clean, maintain, and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, drains, and related wastewater structures by configuring and operating cleaning equipment, accessing and excavating lines, replacing or sealing components, and restoring excavations.

occupation_name: Service Unit Operators, Oil and Gas
job_role_definition: Diagnoses and removes stuck pipe, casing, tools, and other downhole obstructions using fishing methods and specialized equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather well, pipe, tool, and borehole information and obtain obstruction-depth evidence using detection instruments and equipment observations.
interpret_scope: Assess instrument readings and equipment sounds to determine obstruction location, well conditions, and equipment faults relevant to the recovery operation.
decide_scope: Select the fishing method, specialized tools, and recovery approach suited to the identified downhole obstruction and conditions.
act_scope: Prepare and safely operate the wellsite equipment, pressure controls, rig components, cables, and crew activities to remove or sever the obstruction.

occupation_name: Service Unit Operators, Oil and Gas
job_role_definition: Operates service-unit equipment to improve production, assess well conditions, perform interventions, or retire oil and gas wells.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather wellbore, equipment, and site-condition inputs through inspections, operational observations, fluid-level monitoring, and consultation on borehole and tool requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to identify equipment faults, well conditions, obstructions, fluid levels, and the serviceability of inactive or underperforming wells.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate production-improvement, diagnostic, intervention, or well-retirement approach and the required equipment or technique.
act_scope: Mobilize and operate service-unit equipment, rigging, pressure-control devices, pumps, cables, perforating tools, and applicable well-service methods to carry out the selected work, including sealing retired wells.

job_role_definition: Designs physical exhibits and displays that present objects, information, or themes effectively to visitors.
acquire_scope: Gather client, content, object, venue, budget, schedule, material, technical, conservation, and security requirements, and obtain the exhibit objects, specimens, graphics, and production inputs needed for the display.
interpret_scope: Assess objects, themes, spatial conditions, visitor circulation, costs, safety, environmental protection, and lighting or sound needs to establish workable exhibit requirements.
decide_scope: Select the exhibit concept, layout, presentation methods, materials, construction approach, environmental and security provisions, and budget or fabrication adjustments.
act_scope: Create exhibit renderings, specifications, displays, and supporting design deliverables; coordinate assigned staff, contractors, and production disciplines; oversee installation; and verify the completed exhibit conforms to requirements and operates satisfactorily.

job_role_definition: Designs functional production sets for film, video, television, and theater based on scripts and production requirements.
acquire_scope: Gather scripts, production requirements, budget and location information, period and architectural research, and rehearsal and production-team input relevant to the set.
interpret_scope: Assess narrative, visual, spatial, safety, performance, camera, lighting, sound, cost, and fabrication constraints to determine functional set requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the set concept, layout, scenic treatment, props, materials, staffing priorities, and design revisions that satisfy production, budget, and schedule needs.
act_scope: Produce set drawings and scale models, communicate and refine approved designs, and direct set construction, erection, decoration, and on-site setup to deliver the functional production set.

job_role_definition: Sewers, Hand manually sew, join, reinforce, finish, and decorate manufactured articles using needle, thread, and related materials.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain specifications, materials, measurements, markings, seam and edge references, and client-fit observations needed to prepare each article.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, measurements, material positioning, seam alignment, and garment fit to identify construction, finishing, or alteration requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the appropriate thread or other material, hand-sewing technique, pattern or alteration approach, and placement of fasteners or decorative elements.
act_scope: Prepare, cut, shape, align, assemble, hand-sew, reinforce, finish, alter, press, trim, and decorate manufactured articles to the required result.

job_role_definition: Operate and tend industrial sewing machines to assemble, reinforce, decorate, and finish textile or related manufactured products.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Select and prepare compatible materials, components, patterns, machine attachments, and correctly sequenced textile pieces for the specified sewing operation.
interpret_scope: Monitor stitching and machine performance and inspect, measure, and locate defects in materials and finished articles to assess conformance to specifications.
decide_scope: Determine the required machine settings, guides, assembly sequence, and corrective response to material, stitching, or equipment conditions.
act_scope: Set up, operate, tend, adjust, and maintain industrial sewing equipment to cut or position materials, sew, join, reinforce, decorate, finish, trim, and repair textile products.

job_role_definition: Shampoo, condition, rinse, and provide related care for customers' hair and scalps.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Observe customers’ hair and scalps and obtain the appropriate cleansing and specialized treatment materials or equipment.
interpret_scope: Assess the observed hair and scalp condition to distinguish routine care needs from conditions requiring specialized care or medical attention.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate hair and scalp care approach, including whether to recommend medical treatment for chronic or potentially contagious conditions.
act_scope: Massage, shampoo, condition, rinse, and provide the selected specialized care or treatment for customers’ hair and scalps.

job_role_definition: Sheet Metal Workers fabricate, assemble, install, inspect, and repair sheet metal products and equipment to specified dimensions, fit, and performance.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain project drawings or instructions, site and component measurements, and suitable sheet metal materials for the required work.
interpret_scope: Determine required dimensions, configurations, installation conditions, and quality criteria from specifications, measurements, and inspections.
decide_scope: Select material gauges, layouts, work sequence, forming and joining methods, installation approaches, and corrections needed to achieve specified fit and performance.
act_scope: Lay out, cut, shape, finish, and join components; install or repair assemblies; and inspect completed sheet metal work for conformity.

job_role_definition: Operate, maintain, and supervise shipboard propulsion, engineering, and supporting vessel systems to keep the vessel safe and operational.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Monitor and test propulsion, machinery, safety, pollution-prevention, and vessel-service systems; record operating data and orders; and obtain required fuel, stores, and replacement materials.
interpret_scope: Assess indicators, test results, equipment condition, and maintenance findings to identify abnormalities, malfunctions, causes, and compliance or operational needs.
decide_scope: Determine engineering priorities and maintenance or repair actions, coordinate safe and efficient vessel operations with the captain and shore personnel, and direct technicians' work.
act_scope: Operate and regulate propulsion and liquid-transfer equipment; maintain, repair, install, fabricate, and clean engineering and vessel-support systems; conduct emergency drills; and supervise and inspect maintenance work to keep the vessel safe and operational.

job_role_definition: Receives incoming materials by verifying deliveries, documenting shipment details, resolving discrepancies, and routing items internally.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive incoming materials and obtain shipment contents, delivery documentation, and relevant order or manifest records for verification.
interpret_scope: Compare materials and shipment details with records to determine accuracy, condition, shortages, damages, and specification discrepancies.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate discrepancy resolution and internal destination for received materials.
act_scope: Document shipment details and discrepancies, coordinate correction of delivery problems, and route materials to the appropriate departments.

job_role_definition: Prepares and coordinates outbound shipments by packaging goods, producing records and documents, and arranging transportation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain shipping materials, shipment details, weights, space availability, carrier rates, and route information needed to prepare outbound goods.
interpret_scope: Evaluate shipment data, charges, capacity, delivery requirements, discrepancies, and the environmental effects of available shipping options.
decide_scope: Select the shipping method, route, rate, and carrier instructions that meet shipment requirements.
act_scope: Pack, seal, label, and post goods; prepare and record shipping documents and shipment data; arrange transportation; and resolve shipment problems.

job_role_definition: Operate or tend machinery to join, decorate, reinforce, or finish shoes and shoe parts according to specifications.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain work-order specifications, assemble shoe parts and required supplies, test machinery, and inspect in-process and finished products for production and conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Determine machine readiness and assess whether shoe construction, stitching, stapling, decoration, reinforcement, and finishing conform to specifications.
decide_scope: Select material layouts, supplies, machine configurations and settings, and corrective actions needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Set up, operate, tend, clean, and maintain machinery to join, decorate, reinforce, finish, trim, and secure shoes and shoe parts.

occupation_name: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
job_role_name: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
job_role_definition: Construct, decorate, fit, and repair footwear and other leather or leather-like products.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer specifications, prescriptions, measurements, foot casts, product condition details, and suitable leather, patterns, hardware, and other materials for the requested work.
interpret_scope: Assess material properties, article defects and wear, fit requirements, and measurements or prescriptions to determine the product or repair requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the materials, patterns, components, and construction, fitting, modification, or repair approach that will meet the established requirements.
act_scope: Cut, shape, join, construct, decorate, fit, finish, clean, modify, and repair footwear and other leather or leather-like products, including therapeutic footwear and replacement components.

job_role_definition: Drive motor vehicles to transport and assist passengers safely according to scheduled or requested service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive service requests, schedules, directions, and dispatch updates; inspect the vehicle and monitor traffic, road, and passenger-access needs before and during service.
interpret_scope: Assess vehicle readiness and the meaning of roadway, traffic, safety, and passenger conditions for the trip.
decide_scope: Select safe, lawful routing, driving responses, timing adjustments, and passenger-handling measures needed to complete the requested service.
act_scope: Prepare and operate the vehicle to pick up, transport, and drop off passengers on schedule or request, assisting boarding, luggage, accessibility, and onboard safety and comfort.

job_role_definition: Install, inspect, test, maintain, and repair railroad signaling, crossing, track-switch, and related control equipment to ensure safe operation.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect and test railroad signaling, crossing, track-switch, and related control equipment, including their mechanical, electrical, and circuit components, to obtain condition and fault information.
interpret_scope: Assess inspection and test results to identify defective, worn, loose, or improperly functioning components and connections.
decide_scope: Determine the required maintenance, repair, replacement, or installation work needed to restore safe, proper equipment operation.
act_scope: Install, maintain, lubricate, clean, adjust, repair, and replace signaling, crossing, track-switch, and related control equipment, and document completed work and equipment needing replacement.

job_role_definition: Provide cosmetic facial and body skincare treatments and client guidance to improve skin appearance and condition.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine clients’ skin, elicit their needs and preferences, and assemble the service history, equipment, and treatment materials needed for care.
interpret_scope: Assess skin condition and appearance to identify cosmetic-care needs and recognize problems requiring medical attention.
decide_scope: Select suitable treatments, products, colors, home-care regimens, and medical referral or coordinated perioperative care when indicated.
act_scope: Deliver selected facial and body skincare, grooming, and cosmetic services; provide care and makeup instruction; carry out referrals and clinical coordination; and maintain hygienic tools and work areas.

job_role_definition: Cuts, processes, and packages meat into marketable products.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain the dressed carcasses or meat portions and required packaging materials for processing.
interpret_scope: Assess the meat portion and production requirements to identify the applicable standard cut, processing step, or packaging form.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate cuts, processing sequence, and product form within established specifications.
act_scope: Cut and debone meat, perform assigned line processing and grinding, and wrap the resulting marketable meat products.

job_role_definition: Kills animals and dresses carcasses for further meat processing.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Secure and position live animals and carcasses and assemble the parts and surfaces needed for slaughter and dressing.
interpret_scope: Distinguish edible portions from offal and assess which carcass, viscera, head, and hide areas require cleaning, trimming, or removal.
decide_scope: Select the sequence and extent of separation, trimming, cleaning, and handling needed for each animal, carcass, and by-product.
act_scope: Stun and bleed animals, then eviscerate, skin, clean, trim, divide, and prepare carcasses and by-products for further processing.

job_role_definition: Assist social scientists by supporting the collection, management, analysis, and communication of social science research data and findings.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare research inputs through literature and web research, participant recruitment and screening, consent and scheduling, interviews and tests, and data entry, coding, validation, and database assembly.
interpret_scope: Translate research needs and prepared data into study requirements, quality assessments, statistical findings, and concise explanations of results.
decide_scope: Select or refine survey instruments, data-handling methods, quality-control procedures, and analytical approaches suited to the project requirements.
act_scope: Create and operate data-management and analysis programs, implement quality-control procedures, and deliver findings through tables, reports, manuscripts, and presentations.

occupation_name: Social Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary, All Other
job_role_name: Social Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary, All Other
job_role_definition: Teach postsecondary courses in social science disciplines not separately classified within the occupation system.
acquire_scope: Assemble disciplinary content, instructional materials, course requirements, and evidence of students' prior knowledge and progress needed to teach the course.
interpret_scope: Assess student understanding, performance, and learning needs in relation to course objectives.
decide_scope: Set instructional priorities, course organization, teaching approaches, and evaluation methods based on disciplinary objectives and student progress.
act_scope: Deliver postsecondary social science instruction, facilitate learning activities, and provide feedback and grades to produce the course's educational outcome.

occupation_name: Social Scientists and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Social Scientists and Related Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Conducts social-science research or related professional work not classified under a separate occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain relevant social, behavioral, or institutional information and other inputs for the research or related professional work.
interpret_scope: Analyze the gathered inputs to develop findings, assessments, explanations, or other task-relevant conclusions.
decide_scope: Select appropriate research methods, analytical approaches, priorities, or professional recommendations.
act_scope: Produce and communicate the resulting analyses, reports, professional services, or recommendations.

job_role_definition: Teach and support postsecondary students in social work while carrying out associated scholarly, service, and institutional responsibilities.
acquire_scope: Gather current social work scholarship, student work and performance evidence, course requirements, instructional resources, and research data needed for teaching, scholarship, and institutional service.
interpret_scope: Evaluate student learning and support needs, derive scholarly findings from research evidence, and assess curricula, instructional methods, and academic or institutional issues.
decide_scope: Select course content and instructional approaches, assign grades and determine student guidance, and set research, service, and institutional courses of action.
act_scope: Deliver instruction and feedback, supervise field, teaching, and research work, advise and mentor students and faculty, disseminate scholarship, and carry out academic, community, and institutional service.

job_role_definition: Provide social work services not represented by separately classified social worker occupations.
acquire_scope: Gather client histories, needs, circumstances, available supports, and relevant service information for social work service delivery.
interpret_scope: Assess client situations, needs, risks, strengths, and barriers from the information obtained.
decide_scope: Select appropriate service approaches, priorities, referrals, and intervention plans within the social work service provided.
act_scope: Provide the selected social work services, interventions, advocacy, coordination, and follow-through for clients.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate social service programs or community outreach organizations to meet community needs.
acquire_scope: Gather community and participant input, program performance and resource data, and relevant policy, regulatory, and legislative information.
interpret_scope: Assess community needs, service quality, resource use, and the operational effects of policies, regulations, or proposed rule changes.
decide_scope: Set program directions, goals, administrative procedures, eligibility and benefit policies, staffing priorities, and budget allocations.
act_scope: Direct and staff service operations, administer resources and training, coordinate partner relationships, and communicate program policies and services to personnel, clients, and community stakeholders.

job_role_definition: Assist social and human service providers by assessing client needs, providing practical support, and connecting clients with benefits, resources, and community services.
acquire_scope: Gather client histories and assess cognitive, physical, emotional, practical, and household needs through interviews, visits, observation, and review of relevant records.
interpret_scope: Evaluate the gathered information to identify client needs, barriers, appropriate interventions, and suitable benefit, resource, housing, nutrition, and community-service options.
decide_scope: Select individualized care or behavioral-management plans, practical guidance, referrals, and service priorities in consultation with the responsible provider when needed.
act_scope: Deliver practical support by implementing care plans, explaining services and requirements, advising clients, completing needed forms, making referrals, arranging or assisting access to housing and services, accompanying clients when needed, overseeing group activities, and documenting client contacts and outcomes.

job_role_definition: Study human society and social behavior through sociological research, analysis, communication, consultation, and applied problem-solving.
acquire_scope: Obtain sociological evidence through observations, interviews, document review, questionnaires, and other designed data-collection methods.
interpret_scope: Analyze social data and group interactions to explain behavior, assess conditions and progress, and develop or test sociological theories.
decide_scope: Set research approaches and select evidence-based solutions, intervention procedures, and policy or practice recommendations for social problems.
act_scope: Conduct research and applied interventions; communicate findings through publications, public and professional presentations, teaching, and consultation.

job_role_definition: Teach sociology courses to postsecondary students while supporting their academic development and, where applicable, contributing scholarly research and institutional service.
acquire_scope: Gather current sociological scholarship, instructional materials and supplies, student-performance information and records, and research evidence needed for courses, mentoring, scholarship, and institutional work.
interpret_scope: Assess student learning and advising needs, synthesize disciplinary literature and research findings, and evaluate course content, instructional methods, and academic issues.
decide_scope: Select curricula, instructional approaches, assessment outcomes, academic and career guidance, research directions, and positions on teaching, research, or institutional matters.
act_scope: Deliver sociology instruction and facilitated learning activities, communicate and record student outcomes, advise and supervise students and faculty, publish scholarly findings where applicable, and perform institutional service.

job_role_definition: Designs, develops, modifies, and validates software systems to meet user needs, technical constraints, interface requirements, and performance standards.
acquire_scope: Gather user needs, system constraints, interface and performance requirements, and relevant system data from stakeholders and existing software.
interpret_scope: Analyze requirements, technical constraints, system data, and validation results to assess feasibility, defects, performance, and design consequences.
decide_scope: Select software designs, performance standards, implementation or modification plans, and testing approaches that address requirements and identified constraints.
act_scope: Implement and modify software, execute selected tests, integrate components, and deliver software that meets the defined requirements and performance standards.

occupation_name: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
job_role_name: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
job_role_definition: Develop, execute, and evaluate software tests to identify defects and support software quality and release readiness.
acquire_scope: Execute and monitor planned software evaluations across relevant scenarios and environments, gathering requirements, quality criteria, customer reports, documentation, test data, operational observations, diagnostic artifacts, and defect-resolution status.
interpret_scope: Analyze software behavior, test results, defect patterns, standards deviations, documentation, and diagnostic evidence to identify defects, risks, performance or compatibility issues, likely problem sources, and release readiness.
decide_scope: Select test strategies, scenarios, schedules, quality methods, investigation priorities, defect dispositions, and recommendations for software changes or problem resolution.
act_scope: Create and maintain test scripts, programs, tools, environments, and reproducible procedures; document and report findings and recommendations; and coordinate user, third-party, and beta testing.

job_role_definition: Researches agricultural plants and their biological interactions to improve growth, production, resilience, quality, and pest control.
acquire_scope: Conduct plant, crop, pest, insect, bee-health, and environmental experiments and assemble observations, specimens, and production-practice data needed to evaluate agricultural plant performance.
interpret_scope: Analyze experimental evidence to explain plant growth and environmental responses, classify relevant pest species, and assess effects on yield, quality, resilience, and pest pressure.
decide_scope: Select promising crop varieties, cultivation and handling practices, pest-control approaches, and measures to prevent the spread of injurious species.
act_scope: Develop and refine the selected plant varieties, environmentally safe pest-control methods or products, and agricultural production practices, and communicate the resulting findings and recommendations.

job_role_definition: Studies soil properties and develops guidance and practices for soil use, conservation, classification, management, and remediation.
acquire_scope: Collect soil, land, water, microbial, ecosystem, and management-practice data through sampling, surveys, analyses, experiments, and technical research.
interpret_scope: Assess soil properties, processes, degradation, contamination, productivity, land capability, environmental effects, and responses to management or amendment practices.
decide_scope: Determine soil classifications and select guidance, conservation, management, remediation, reclamation, sustainability, and regulatory approaches suited to site conditions and intended land use.
act_scope: Develop and deliver soil-use practices, improvement and remediation plans, measurement or conservation methods, program oversight, technical consultation, and findings to landowners, practitioners, regulators, and the public.

job_role_definition: Direct and coordinate solar energy system installation projects and crews to deliver safe, code-compliant, functioning systems.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather site and customer requirements, installation constraints, code and safety requirements, system-performance measurements, and resource, equipment, contractor, and cost inputs for solar projects.
interpret_scope: Assess site feasibility, design requirements, system functionality, code conformance, project status, technical issues, risks, efficiency opportunities, and contractor suitability.
decide_scope: Select system architecture, installation plans, schedules, resource allocations, equipment or subcontractors, inspection timing, and corrective or cost-control actions.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate installation crews and subcontractors, provide technical guidance, oversee conformance to plans and safety standards, arrange inspections, and start up and test systems for customer implementation.

job_role_definition: Design, analyze, and support the implementation and performance of site-specific solar energy systems and components.
acquire_scope: Collect site structural and electrical conditions, evaluate photovoltaic cells or modules, and assemble relevant component and project inputs for solar system engineering.
interpret_scope: Analyze site and component data through performance, thermal, stress, cost, and generation simulations to assess system behavior and design constraints.
decide_scope: Select system architectures, component configurations, design requirements, engineering changes, and development, monitoring, and evaluation approaches that meet solar design objectives.
act_scope: Produce solar and collector-system designs, specifications, electrical drawings, operating and inspection standards, and technical direction for installation, commissioning, testing, and performance support.

job_role_definition: Assemble, install, commission, inspect, and maintain solar photovoltaic systems in accordance with site requirements, schematics, and applicable codes.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain site, design, code, material, and electrical inputs and collect physical inspection, wiring, voltage, and operating-performance observations from photovoltaic systems.
interpret_scope: Assess site suitability, hazards, electrical requirements, installation integrity, and measured system condition to identify conformity, performance issues, and deficiencies.
decide_scope: Select photovoltaic system configurations, array layouts and mounting methods, protective-device and connection specifications, installation sequencing, control settings, and corrective measures consistent with site and code requirements.
act_scope: Assemble, install, weather-seal, label, configure, activate, commission, repair, and maintain photovoltaic equipment and arrays so the system operates as required.

job_role_definition: Sell and recommend solar energy systems by assessing customer needs and sites, estimating system performance and costs, and guiding customers through purchase decisions.
acquire_scope: Gather prospective-customer requirements, quote or order details, and site measurements and conditions needed to evaluate a solar installation.
interpret_scope: Assess site suitability and translate energy needs, solar resources, shading, orientation, pricing, incentives, and system information into performance and cost estimates.
decide_scope: Select and tailor the solar system, services, and energy-management package that best fits the customer's requirements and site.
act_scope: Prepare and present the recommended design, specifications, proposal, quote, and contract; explain equipment and purchase options, demonstrate use, and guide the customer through ordering.

job_role_definition: Installs and commissions solar thermal water-heating systems and their associated rooftop, plumbing, electrical, and control components.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain site conditions and measurements, system plans and specifications, required components and materials, and results from structural inspections and mechanical, plumbing, electrical, control, leak, and operational tests.
interpret_scope: Evaluate site and mounting suitability, collector orientation and tilt, installation hazards, applicable requirements, and test evidence to determine system integrity and proper operation.
decide_scope: Select the system configuration, component locations, installation methods, work priorities, and corrective actions needed to satisfy site, safety, and performance requirements.
act_scope: Install, connect, protect, seal, insulate, label, and fill the collectors, mounting, plumbing, storage, pumping, electrical, control, and monitoring assemblies; commission the completed system and demonstrate its operation, maintenance, diagnostics, and safety procedures.

job_role_definition: Diagnoses, maintains, and repairs installed solar thermal systems to restore reliable operation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Test the installed solar thermal system’s mechanical, plumbing, electrical, and control functions to obtain operational evidence.
interpret_scope: Diagnose the source and nature of faults from the system’s test results and operating condition.
decide_scope: Select the maintenance or repair approach needed to restore baseline operation.
act_scope: Perform the selected maintenance and repairs to restore reliable solar thermal system operation.

job_role_definition: Edit, mix, synchronize, reproduce, and prepare recorded audio for completed media productions and archival use.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather production sound goals, recorded audio assets, visual references, and source media or files needed for postproduction and archival preparation.
interpret_scope: Assess the content, quality, balance, timing, and visual alignment of dialogue, music, effects, and other recorded sound.
decide_scope: Determine the editing, mixing, synchronization, equalization, format-conversion, and reproduction treatments required to meet the production's intended sound and preservation needs.
act_scope: Edit, separate, combine, mix, synchronize, equalize, convert, reproduce, duplicate, and prepare recorded audio as completed production and archival deliverables.

job_role_definition: Capture, control, and mix sound during recording sessions, live performances, and events.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain the production’s desired sound requirements and assemble, position, test, and adjust microphones, recording equipment, and signal inputs for sessions and live events.
interpret_scope: Monitor sound signals and equipment performance to assess levels, quality, separation, technical faults, and the effects of recording or live conditions.
decide_scope: Choose the sound balance, routing, processing, corrective adjustments, and mixing approach needed to achieve the intended production sound.
act_scope: Capture recorded sound and operate recording, control, mixing, editing, and postproduction equipment to control and combine voices, instruments, music, and effects for recording sessions, performances, and events.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate spa operations, staff, services, customer experience, and financial performance.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather client, appointment, staffing, facility, inventory, financial, credential, equipment, compliance, and market information needed to operate the spa.
interpret_scope: Assess customer feedback, operational conditions, staff performance, financial results, resource needs, and health, safety, and hygiene compliance to identify service and business needs.
decide_scope: Set service programs, customer-service standards, staffing and facility priorities, personnel selections, budgets and financial goals, inventory orders, marketing approaches, and corrective actions.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate daily spa operations by scheduling guests and staff, recruiting and training personnel, maintaining client and financial records, resolving customer issues, overseeing sales and maintenance, and carrying out operational plans.

job_role_definition: Provide specialized instruction and educational support to students with disabilities not covered by separately classified special education teaching occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain student records, observations, assessments, and progress information needed to provide specialized instruction and educational support.
interpret_scope: Assess students’ disability-related learning needs, strengths, and progress to determine their educational implications.
decide_scope: Select individualized instructional approaches, supports, accommodations, and priorities responsive to those needs.
act_scope: Deliver specialized instruction and educational support to students with disabilities not covered by separately classified special education teaching occupations.

job_role_definition: Teach and support elementary school students with disabilities through individualized academic, behavioral, social, and life-skills instruction.
acquire_scope: Gather student performance, behavior, developmental, health, test, family, and professional input, and assemble accessible instructional materials and supports.
interpret_scope: Evaluate observations, assessments, and standardized-test results to identify each student's strengths, needs, progress, and barriers to learning or participation.
decide_scope: Set individualized objectives and select instructional, behavioral, accessibility, curriculum-modification, placement, safety, and support plans with families and relevant school staff.
act_scope: Deliver and supervise individualized academic, behavioral, social, personal-development, daily-living, recreational, and experiential instruction; provide accommodations and access support; maintain an orderly, safe learning environment; and communicate student progress.

job_role_definition: Teach kindergarten students with disabilities through individualized instruction and support for their academic, social, behavioral, and life-skill development.
acquire_scope: Gather student assessment results, observations of learning, behavior, development, and health, family and professional input, and the accessible instructional materials and supports needed for individualized teaching.
interpret_scope: Evaluate evidence of each student's academic, social, behavioral, physical, and functional development to identify needs, progress, barriers, and learning responses.
decide_scope: Set individualized educational priorities and select or revise IEP-aligned objectives, curriculum adaptations, instructional approaches, behavioral supports, activities, and access arrangements.
act_scope: Teach and support kindergarten students with disabilities through adapted academic, social, behavioral, sensory-motor, communication, recreational, and life-skill instruction while maintaining a safe, structured, accessible learning environment.

job_role_definition: Teach and support middle school students with disabilities through individualized academic, social, life-skills, and inclusive education services.
acquire_scope: Gather student performance, behavior, health, assessment, progress, family, and staff information, along with instructional materials and access needs.
interpret_scope: Assess students’ strengths, disabilities, academic, social, behavioral, physical, and independent-living needs from observations, assessments, and progress evidence.
decide_scope: Set individualized educational goals, IEP provisions, instructional objectives, curriculum adaptations, behavior supports, service priorities, and inclusive placements.
act_scope: Deliver individualized academic, social, life-skills, vocational, behavioral, and inclusive instruction and supports, including safe use of materials, assistive access, progress communication, and coordinated classroom implementation.

job_role_definition: Teach and support preschool-aged children with disabilities through individualized instruction, developmental care, and special education services.
acquire_scope: Gather developmental, behavioral, health, and learning information from observation, assessment, records, families, and specialists, and assemble safe, accessible learning environments, materials, and supports.
interpret_scope: Assess children’s developmental levels, disabilities, performance, behavior, and emerging needs to identify strengths, barriers, progress, and required accommodations.
decide_scope: Set individualized educational and developmental objectives and select, adapt, and coordinate instructional, behavioral, care, placement, and support strategies with families and educational professionals.
act_scope: Deliver individualized preschool special education, developmental care, behavior and social-skills support, accessible activities, safety supervision, family communication, staff direction, and required student documentation.

job_role_definition: Teach adapted academic, social, and life skills to secondary students with disabilities while planning and coordinating individualized educational support.
acquire_scope: Gather student performance, behavior, development, health, assessment, and family-and-professional input, and assemble adapted instructional materials and accessible supports.
interpret_scope: Evaluate assessment results and ongoing evidence to determine each student's strengths, needs, progress, and barriers to learning and participation.
decide_scope: Set individualized goals and priorities and select instructional objectives, curriculum adaptations, behavior and support strategies, lesson plans, and appropriate inclusive placements.
act_scope: Deliver adapted academic, social, daily-living, vocational, and self-advocacy instruction; manage a safe learning environment; and coordinate individualized educational access and support.

job_role_definition: Create animations, special effects, and related visual content using digital and traditional media for entertainment, advertising, and other products.
acquire_scope: Assemble visual references, source material, scanned artwork or objects, project requirements, and production constraints needed to develop visual content.
interpret_scope: Evaluate those inputs to determine narrative flow, motion, appearance, spatial form, simulated behavior, and technical presentation requirements.
decide_scope: Select the visual concept, design treatment, sequencing, production approach, and resource priorities for the content.
act_scope: Create, model, animate, render, edit, coordinate, and produce animations, special effects, illustrations, and related finished visual media using digital and traditional techniques.

job_role_definition: Implement unconventional military operations by air, land, or sea as a member of an elite team during combat or peacetime.
acquire_scope: Gather operational intelligence, terrain and environmental observations, mission requirements, equipment, and team-status inputs needed for unconventional operations.
interpret_scope: Assess intelligence, conditions, threats, team readiness, and mission constraints to establish their operational meaning.
decide_scope: Select immediate tactics, movement, engagement, support, and contingency actions within the assigned mission.
act_scope: Execute unconventional military operations by air, land, or sea as an elite team member in combat or peacetime.

job_role_definition: Lead elite teams in planning and conducting unconventional and politically sensitive military operations during combat or peacetime.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble mission objectives, intelligence, team capabilities, resources, and operational conditions for unconventional and politically sensitive operations.
interpret_scope: Assess operational, political, security, and human factors to determine mission implications, threats, opportunities, and constraints.
decide_scope: Select operational plans, priorities, team employment, and risk-responsive courses of action for combat or peacetime missions.
act_scope: Lead elite teams in preparing for, coordinating, and conducting the selected operations.

job_role_definition: Assess, diagnose, and treat communication and swallowing disorders while supporting clients, families, and care or education teams.
acquire_scope: Administer communication and swallowing evaluations, gather relevant medical, educational, and background information, and observe treatment responses to establish and update the client evidence base.
interpret_scope: Analyze evaluation findings and ongoing progress to identify the type and degree of communication or swallowing impairment and determine treatment-relevant needs.
decide_scope: Select, individualize, and revise treatment plans, communication strategies or devices, service referrals, and coordinated recommendations for clients and care or education teams.
act_scope: Deliver speech, language, voice, fluency, swallowing, and alternative-communication interventions; educate clients, families, and teams; coordinate care; and document evaluation, treatment, progress, and discharge.

job_role_definition: Assist speech-language pathologists by delivering directed treatment activities, supporting assessment, and monitoring client progress and communication supports.
acquire_scope: Gather client screening, assessment, and treatment-performance observations, and prepare the materials and functioning equipment needed for directed services.
interpret_scope: Organize and synthesize client observations and performance data into progress records and visual displays against established treatment objectives.
decide_scope: Select suitable instructional and communication-support materials for activities within the directed treatment plan.
act_scope: Deliver directed treatment activities that remediate or develop clients' speech and language skills.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, rehabilitate, and help prevent sports- and activity-related injuries and medical conditions in athletes.
acquire_scope: Obtain athletes’ histories, examinations, laboratory and imaging results, fitness and injury-risk evaluations, and relevant observations at practices or competitions.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical, functional, and mental-health findings to diagnose sports- and activity-related injuries or medical conditions and assess fitness, risk, pain, and rehabilitation progress.
decide_scope: Determine treatment, medication, rehabilitation, referral, protective-equipment, exercise, emergency-care, prevention, and activity-participation plans, including restrictions on harmful practices or return to competition.
act_scope: Deliver and coordinate medical care for injuries and conditions, prescribe indicated therapies and equipment, supervise rehabilitation, provide event coverage and emergency readiness, and counsel athletes and care teams on prevention and safe participation.

job_role_definition: Operate, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot stationary boilers, engines, and auxiliary equipment that provide utilities for buildings, vessels, or industrial processes.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Monitor and inspect utility equipment, controls, safety devices, and ventilation; obtain operating readings, water-quality and electrical test results, fuel-use measurements, and operating instructions needed to sustain safe service.
interpret_scope: Evaluate instrument readings, test results, equipment condition, and alarms to identify departures from required operating, water-quality, electrical, air-quality, efficiency, and safety conditions.
decide_scope: Determine required operating adjustments, corrective treatment, control mode, equipment isolation, repair response, and escalation needed to maintain continuous, reliable utility service.
act_scope: Operate boilers, engines, burners, and auxiliary equipment; adjust valves and controls; perform startup, shutdown, isolation, cleaning, lubrication, installation, repair, and other corrective work to provide required utilities safely.

job_role_definition: Compile, validate, analyze, and present data to support statistical studies and related reporting.
acquire_scope: Collect survey and source-record data, organize and code it, enter it into usable datasets, and obtain presentation requirements for statistical studies and reporting.
interpret_scope: Verify data completeness, accuracy, and usability, then compute and analyze the validated data to develop statistical findings.
decide_scope: Select appropriate statistical tests, resolve the disposition of unusable responses, and determine the analytical and presentation approach.
act_scope: Maintain the resulting data resources and prepare, publish, and distribute reports, charts, graphs, and other presentations of the findings.

job_role_definition: Develop and apply statistical theories and methods to design studies, analyze numerical data, and communicate valid findings.
acquire_scope: Obtain and prepare study and method-validation evidence by retrieving or collecting observations, applying and directing sampling or tabulation procedures, testing candidate designs or methods, and checking, organizing, adjusting, and weighting raw data.
interpret_scope: Analyze study and validation evidence, source limitations, and relevant theory to identify relationships, trends, differences, influential factors, method validity, and defensible conclusions.
decide_scope: Select and tailor research designs, data-collection and sampling plans, and statistical methods appropriate to the question, evidence limitations, and validity requirements.
act_scope: Develop and deliver new or adapted statistical methods and analytical programs, and communicate chosen study plans and findings through visual, technical, scholarly, and oral reports.

job_role_definition: Fulfills customer or coworker orders by interpreting requisitions, retrieving and checking specified stock, packing it, and issuing or distributing completed orders.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain incoming requisitions and retrieve candidate merchandise from storage, using appropriate stock-handling equipment when needed.
interpret_scope: Determine required item identifiers, attributes, and quantities, then assess retrieved stock for matches, wear, defects, or other discrepancies.
decide_scope: Select suitable stock, packaging, and handling methods, and determine how to resolve shortages, defects, or mismatches before release.
act_scope: Pack suitable stock, report fulfillment-blocking defects, issue or distribute completed orders, and finalize order receipts and outgoing-order records.

job_role_definition: Stockers maintain accessible, sale-ready inventory by receiving, inspecting, organizing, labeling, moving, recording, and replenishing merchandise.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive, unload, unpack, count, and inspect merchandise while obtaining shipment records, inventory data, price lists, demand information, and storage constraints.
interpret_scope: Assess shipment accuracy, merchandise identity and condition, replenishment needs, and placement constraints using counts, records, price data, demand, and facility conditions.
decide_scope: Select storage methods and locations, replenishment priorities, safe handling approaches, and appropriate return or disposal routes for damaged or defective merchandise.
act_scope: Record receipts and stock changes; move, store, label, price-mark, and replenish merchandise safely, using handling equipment and processing defective items.

job_role_definition: Create and finish ornamental designs, figures, reliefs, and detailed surfaces in stone.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain design specifications, models, sketches, dimensional measurements, and tactile observations of carved surfaces.
interpret_scope: Assess design references, cut depths, dimensions, and surface condition to identify layout, conformance, and finishing requirements.
decide_scope: Select carving or cutting techniques, tools, stencil configurations, work sequence, and needed refinements.
act_scope: Lay out designs on stone and carve, cut, drill, blast, shape, detail, and smooth the stone to the specified design and finish.

job_role_definition: Cut, shape, and finish stone blocks and surfaces to specified dimensions and patterns.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain diagrams, patterns, models, and blueprints; transfer specified layouts to stone; and measure cut depths and dimensions for conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Translate design specifications and measurement results into required forms, dimensions, depths, finishes, and conformance findings.
decide_scope: Select cutting and carving techniques, appropriate tools, their sequence of use, and adjustments needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Set up and operate cutting, carving, drilling, blasting, stenciling, and surface-dressing processes to shape and finish stone to the specified dimensions and patterns.

job_role_definition: Build, install, finish, and repair stone, marble, and related masonry structures and monuments.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble specified patterns, site measurements, foundation and surface conditions, masonry materials, and placement references needed for the work.
interpret_scope: Assess measurements, patterns, alignment, fit, surface condition, and damage to establish construction, finishing, and repair requirements.
decide_scope: Select the work sequence and appropriate positioning, anchoring, joint-treatment, finishing, or repair methods for the established requirements.
act_scope: Lay out, shape, place, align, anchor, join, clean, finish, and repair stone, marble, monuments, foundations, specialized linings, and related masonry structures.

job_role_definition: Erect, position, align, secure, modify, and dismantle structural steel and related components to form structural frameworks and assemblies.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and stage steel and related components, retrieve requirements from drawings and instructions, and take layout and alignment measurements needed for erection, modification, or dismantling.
interpret_scope: Determine required member locations, sizes, orientations, connections, and alignment conditions from drawings, instructions, and measurements.
decide_scope: Select the hoisting, positioning, alignment-correction, connection, fabrication, or dismantling sequence needed to achieve the specified assembly.
act_scope: Fabricate or modify components and physically rig, hoist, guide, position, align, secure, fit associated components, and dismantle structural frameworks and assemblies.

job_role_definition: Fabricate, position, align, fit, and assemble structural metal components and products to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain drawings, specifications, materials, and workpieces, and measure and inspect stock, components, and assemblies for dimensional and conformance evidence.
interpret_scope: Derive material requirements, dimensions, allowances, fabrication sequences, fit assessments, and conformance findings from drawings, measurements, and inspections.
decide_scope: Select fabrication and assembly methods, equipment settings, positioning approaches, and corrective actions needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Lay out and mark workpieces; prepare fixtures, equipment, and access; and move, form, cut, fit, align, join, finish, correct, assemble, and install structural metal components and products.

occupation_name: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
job_role_definition: Develop, implement, and evaluate community education and prevention programs addressing substance use and behavioral disorders.
