acquire_scope: Gather community needs, substance-use and behavioral-disorder data, prevention resources, stakeholder input, and program outcome information.
interpret_scope: Assess community prevention needs, relevant evidence, and outcome data to determine program relevance and effectiveness.
decide_scope: Set program objectives and select, refine, or discontinue education and prevention approaches with community partners.
act_scope: Create program materials, coordinate implementation with community partners, and deliver community education and prevention programs addressing substance use and behavioral disorders.

occupation_name: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
job_role_name: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselor
job_role_definition: Counsel clients and families affected by substance use or behavioral disorders through assessment, treatment planning, therapeutic intervention, and recovery support.
acquire_scope: Gather client histories, interviews, records, biological test results, family and professional input, and ongoing treatment and post-discharge progress information.
interpret_scope: Assess substance-use dependency, mental and physical condition, program suitability, goal progress, treatment effectiveness, and changes in client needs.
decide_scope: Develop, revise, and prioritize individualized treatment, referral, crisis-response, discharge, and aftercare plans in coordination with relevant providers and services.
act_scope: Deliver individual, group, and family counseling; provide recovery education, advocacy, referrals, program orientation, coordinated care, follow-up support, and required client-progress documentation.

job_role_definition: Provide temporary classroom instruction and student supervision by carrying out an absent teacher's lesson plans.
acquire_scope: Obtain the absent teacher’s lesson plans and instructional materials, record attendance, monitor students’ questions, work, conduct, and access needs, and collect completed assignments or tests.
interpret_scope: Assess student understanding, academic or adjustment difficulties, behavior, and support needs from classroom interactions, observations, and completed work.
decide_scope: Select instructional pacing, explanations, individual or small-group assistance, supervision responses, and classroom-management actions consistent with the lesson plans.
act_scope: Deliver planned instruction, answer and tutor students, facilitate learning and recreational activities, distribute needed materials, maintain order, and supervise and support students in classroom and school settings.

job_role_definition: Operate subway trains and streetcars safely and on schedule to transport passengers.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Continuously obtain operating inputs by monitoring route signals, track and crossing conditions, vehicle indications, schedule status, and passenger service needs.
interpret_scope: Assess those inputs to identify hazards, vehicle problems, schedule deviations, and the operational significance of passenger or emergency circumstances.
decide_scope: Select speed, dwell and door timing, service communications, and necessary responses to operational problems or emergencies.
act_scope: Operate the rail vehicle and doors to transport passengers safely and on schedule, communicate service conditions and operational problems, and direct evacuations when required.

job_role_definition: Direct and coordinate integrated supply chain activities to optimize the cost, availability, movement, storage, and environmental performance of materials and products.
acquire_scope: Obtain demand, forecast, cost, inventory, process-flow, supplier, transportation, materials, technology, and environmental-performance inputs through planning coordination, monitoring, site observations, and measurement.
interpret_scope: Analyze supply, inventory, cost, supplier, life-cycle, carbon-footprint, and market-condition information to assess availability, performance, waste, service, and environmental effects.
decide_scope: Set performance measures and select integrated sourcing, supplier, material, staffing, routing, warehousing, technology, process, and supply-chain strategies that optimize cost, availability, movement, storage, and environmental performance.
act_scope: Direct purchasing, inventory, receiving, warehousing, distribution, cross-functional transitions, supplier arrangements, process improvements, and reverse-logistics operations to execute the integrated supply chain.

job_role_definition: Perform surgical procedures to diagnose, treat, or manage patients' medical conditions.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble the patient's medical history, examination findings, diagnostic studies, and perioperative measurements needed for surgical care.
interpret_scope: Assess the patient's condition and the clinical meaning of diagnostic and intraoperative findings.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate surgical procedure, operative approach, and treatment plan for the patient's condition.
act_scope: Perform surgical procedures to diagnose, treat, or manage the patient's medical condition.

job_role_definition: Assist surgeons during operations by maintaining a safe sterile field and performing delegated intraoperative patient-care and surgical-support procedures.
acquire_scope: Obtain and verify patient, operative-site, consent, and procedural information; inspect and assemble required instruments, supplies, and equipment; and observe patient status, positioning, blood loss, sterility, operative-field conditions, and post-procedure skin integrity.
interpret_scope: Evaluate patient, procedural, equipment, and operative-field information to assess readiness and identify clinically relevant changes, contamination, positioning injury, bleeding, or other hazards.
decide_scope: Select and prioritize the procedural-support adjustments, patient-care responses, and escalation steps indicated by readiness findings and intraoperative conditions.
act_scope: Prepare and position the patient and operative environment, establish and maintain a sterile unobstructed field, and carry out instrument handling, direct surgical assistance, patient-care and emergency interventions, and wound or device completion procedures.

job_role_definition: Assist surgical teams by maintaining sterile conditions, preparing the operating room and patients, and providing intraoperative technical support.
acquire_scope: Assemble, inspect, count, and arrange surgical instruments, equipment, supplies, fluids, and dressings, and monitor operating-room, equipment, patient-condition, and team-need information.
interpret_scope: Assess sterility, instrument-count status, equipment operation, operating-room conditions, vital signs, and evolving patient and surgical-team needs to identify task-relevant issues.
decide_scope: Prioritize and select appropriate setup adjustments, replacement supplies, equipment responses, and technical support actions within the surgical team's directions and established procedures.
act_scope: Prepare the operating room and patient, sterilize equipment, support scrubbing and gowning, maintain the sterile field, provide intraoperative technical assistance and instruments, manage specimens and postoperative dressings, and restore and restock the room.

job_role_definition: Plan, design, conduct, manage, and analyze surveys to produce reliable findings for clients or research purposes.
acquire_scope: Elicit client requirements, research survey topics, and obtain respondent, record, and other source data through planned collection activities.
interpret_scope: Classify and statistically analyze survey data, and assess field progress, response rates, and performance to derive reliable findings.
decide_scope: Specify survey objectives, samples, information sources, instruments, procedures, weighting, staffing, and warranted implementation changes.
act_scope: Implement survey designs, coordinate and oversee field operations, train and direct data-collection personnel, and deliver documented methods and findings through summaries, tables, graphs, and fact sheets.

job_role_definition: Creates, updates, verifies, and manages maps and geographic information products from spatial source data.
acquire_scope: Compile spatial source data and inspect existing map layers against GPS records, deeds, survey notes, aerial imagery, reference maps, and geographic databases.
interpret_scope: Analyze source imagery and records, calculate mapping coordinates and measurements, identify geographic features and discrepancies, and assess map accuracy.
decide_scope: Determine required map updates and corrections and select appropriate scales, linework, colors, and other presentation specifications.
act_scope: Create, update, correct, store, and deliver maps, overlays, contour products, mosaics, plots, and supporting geographic databases.

job_role_definition: Collects, calculates, records, and stakes survey data used to establish locations, elevations, and boundaries.
acquire_scope: Gather source records and boundary evidence, operate and sight surveying instruments, locate existing survey points, measure features and elevations, and record survey observations and methods.
interpret_scope: Calculate and adjust survey measurements, synthesize property information to establish locations, elevations, and boundary relationships, and assess data adequacy against applicable standards.
decide_scope: Select field-survey and staking methods and procedures based on plans, site conditions, and derived survey results.
act_scope: Set out, recover, and place stakes, marks, and monumentation to transfer established survey locations to the site.

job_role_definition: Make and certify precise measurements to establish property boundaries and provide spatial data for mapping, construction, engineering, and other land-related purposes.
acquire_scope: Retrieve deeds, titles, survey records, objectives, and specifications, and obtain accurate ground, geodetic, aerial, hydrographic, and site measurements and observations using properly adjusted instruments.
interpret_scope: Calculate and validate spatial measurements and analyze survey data to determine boundary evidence, positions, elevations, terrain characteristics, and other land-feature relationships.
decide_scope: Select survey methods, procedures, instrument use, measurement plans, and final boundary determinations suited to the required land-related purpose.
act_scope: Establish and mark selected points or sites, and prepare, certify, coordinate, and, when needed, defend the resulting maps, records, reports, and legal descriptions.

job_role_definition: Develop, implement, evaluate, and communicate organizational sustainability programs and initiatives.
acquire_scope: Gather sustainability performance data, environmental-practice information, regulatory, technical, and market evidence, violation facts, and the resources needed for programs and projects.
interpret_scope: Evaluate indicators, program effectiveness, compliance findings, and the cost, feasibility, and acceptance implications of sustainability options.
decide_scope: Set sustainability goals, indicators, initiatives, strategies, plans, policies, and project proposals based on the assessment.
act_scope: Implement and support sustainability programs and projects, secure project funding, and communicate objectives, procedures, and results through reports, presentations, and outreach materials.

job_role_definition: Operate business communication systems to route calls and messages, assist callers, and provide related front-desk support.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive calls, messages, visitor arrivals, alarm signals, and relevant directory or reference information needed to provide communication and front-desk service.
interpret_scope: Identify callers' and visitors' needs, clarify and condense message content, verify access-related details, and assess the urgency and destination of communications or alarms.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate information, recipient, communication channel, access disposition, or emergency escalation for each incoming request or signal.
act_scope: Operate communication and alarm systems to answer, transfer, page, announce, record, relay, and place calls; provide information; and greet, register, badge, and connect visitors with escorts.

job_role_definition: Alters, repairs, and refits existing garments to meet customers' fit, style, and condition requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain customer measurements, fitting observations, garment condition and construction details, and documented alteration requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess fit, defects, proportions, drape, and styling requirements to determine the garment changes needed.
decide_scope: Select the alteration, repair, reshaping, and finishing approach that will meet the required fit, style, and condition.
act_scope: Alter, repair, reshape, assemble, finish, and press the garment to deliver the required refit.

job_role_definition: Designs and constructs made-to-measure garments from customers' requirements and measurements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Elicit customers’ garment requirements, take and record body measurements, assess fit during fittings, and obtain the necessary fabric and construction inputs.
interpret_scope: Translate measurements, fit observations, fabric properties, and construction requirements into fit assessments, pattern requirements, material quantities, and cost estimates.
decide_scope: Select or adapt the garment design, materials, pattern, construction details, and alterations needed to achieve the required fit and appearance.
act_scope: Cut, assemble, sew, shape, alter, repair, finish, and press made-to-measure garments to deliver the selected design and fit.

job_role_definition: Audition, select, and coordinate performers for roles in stage, television, radio, or motion picture productions.
acquire_scope: Gather production requirements and performer information through scripts, consultations, talent records, viewing performances, and auditions or interviews.
interpret_scope: Assess production needs and evaluate performers’ attributes, experience, availability, and demonstrated performance against role requirements.
decide_scope: Determine the required talent mix, whom to invite or recommend, which performers to select, and appropriate engagement terms.
act_scope: Organize and prepare performers for casting sessions, communicate opportunities and outcomes, coordinate parties, and negotiate performer agreements.

occupation_name: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
job_role_name: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
job_role_definition: Load, unload, and safely transfer bulk materials between storage systems and tank cars, trucks, barges, and ships.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Verify load identifiers and vessel placement, inspect vessels and connections, and obtain gauges, samples, meter readings, and operating data needed to transfer bulk materials safely.
interpret_scope: Assess the collected condition, quantity, temperature, specific-gravity, cleanliness, leak, damage, and compliance information to determine transfer readiness and status.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate transfer setup, routing, vessel positioning, operating sequence, and flow adjustments under loading procedures.
act_scope: Load, unload, and transfer bulk materials by positioning and connecting equipment, grounding and securing vessels, operating pumps and material-handling equipment, regulating flow, cleaning or repairing vessels as needed, and documenting completed loads.

job_role_definition: Seal, reinforce, smooth, and finish wallboard joints and surface imperfections to prepare walls and ceilings for final decoration.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect wallboard joints, fasteners, corners, and surface imperfections; assemble, mix, and stage suitable compounds, tape, molding, applicators, and safe high-ceiling access.
interpret_scope: Assess surface condition, joint and fastener readiness, compound coverage and smoothness, and adhesive durability to determine finishing requirements.
decide_scope: Set the appropriate materials, tools, application sequence, coat buildup, and surface treatment needed for the wall or ceiling.
act_scope: Countersink and patch defects; install corner molding; tape, seal, coat, blend, sand, smooth, texture, or prime wallboard surfaces to leave them ready for final decoration.

occupation_name: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
job_role_definition: Audit tax returns and financial records to determine compliance with tax laws and support contested determinations.
acquire_scope: Obtain tax returns, financial and accounting records, taxpayer explanations and supporting documentation, and the applicable tax-law and accounting requirements for each case.
interpret_scope: Evaluate returns, accounting systems, records, and evidence to determine audit issues, the appropriateness of accounting methods, and compliance with statutory provisions.
decide_scope: Set the nature and extent of each audit and select the proposed tax determination or contested-case disposition.
act_scope: Conduct and document case communications and audit actions, issue or pursue determinations, and prepare, present, or refer contested matters for administrative or judicial resolution.

occupation_name: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
job_role_definition: Collect delinquent taxes by pursuing payment, negotiating settlements, and enforcing collection actions.
acquire_scope: Obtain delinquency account information, taxpayer documentation, payment status, and financial, court, lien, mortgage, and asset evidence needed to pursue collection.
interpret_scope: Analyze tax assets, liabilities, claimed inability to pay, return issues, and applicable laws and regulations to assess the delinquency and available resolution paths.
decide_scope: Select payment terms, deadlines, settlement methods, enforcement measures, or referral of contested determinations for appeal.
act_scope: Pursue and secure delinquent-tax payment through taxpayer contact and negotiation, notices and deadline monitoring, collection enforcement and legal-document service, court-case preparation, and case-action recordkeeping.

occupation_name: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
job_role_definition: Review and process tax returns to determine correct tax liability and help taxpayers resolve return issues.
acquire_scope: Obtain filed returns, taxpayer identifiers, supporting documentation, relevant financial information, and current tax-law guidance needed for examination.
interpret_scope: Verify return data and computations against supporting documentation, evaluate claimed credits and deductions under applicable tax law, and establish the correct tax liability.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate resolution for return discrepancies and the resulting refund, payment, or correction disposition.
act_scope: Process and document the disposition, communicate findings and requirements to taxpayers or representatives, assist with return issues and forms, and issue refunds or request payment as warranted.

job_role_definition: Prepare tax returns and provide related tax guidance for individuals and small businesses.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain client income, expense, allowance, and financial-record documentation, and consult applicable tax instructions, tables, laws, and bulletins for routine and atypical returns.
interpret_scope: Analyze client records and tax requirements to identify taxable and deductible items, applicable filing forms, computational inputs, and errors or inconsistencies in prepared forms.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate filing approach, procedures, adjustments, deductions, credits, and forward-looking tax-planning recommendations for the client.
act_scope: Compute tax liabilities or refunds, prepare and complete individual and small-business tax returns, verify return data and totals, and provide guidance that enables accurate filing and explains tax obligations.

job_role_definition: Taxi Drivers provide on-demand motor-vehicle transportation, safely carrying passengers to destinations and determining and collecting fares.
acquire_scope: Receive trip requests and passenger destinations, locate riders, and check vehicle and safety conditions needed for transportation.
interpret_scope: Assess trip requirements, passenger assistance needs, applicable operating constraints, and vehicle readiness for safe fare-based transportation.
decide_scope: Select the pickup and route, determine the applicable fare, and choose a safe response to changing road, passenger, or vehicle conditions.
act_scope: Pick up passengers, transport them safely to their requested destinations, and charge and collect the applicable fare.

job_role_definition: Provide instruction in subjects or settings not covered by separately classified teaching occupations.
acquire_scope: Obtain instructional objectives, subject matter, learner information, and the materials needed to provide instruction in the applicable subject or setting.
interpret_scope: Assess learner needs, progress, and understanding in relation to the instructional objectives and subject matter.
decide_scope: Select instructional approaches, sequencing, activities, and adjustments suited to the subject or setting and learner needs.
act_scope: Deliver instruction and learning activities in subjects or settings not covered by separately classified teaching occupations.

job_role_definition: Support instructional delivery and student learning in teaching-assistant functions not classified elsewhere.
acquire_scope: Obtain instructional materials, lesson requirements, and information about students’ learning needs and progress needed to support instruction.
interpret_scope: Assess those materials and student information to identify where instructional clarification, practice, or individual learning support is needed.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate instructional-support approach, sequence, and level of assistance within assigned teaching-assistant functions.
act_scope: Provide instructional delivery support and direct assistance that helps students engage with and learn the assigned material.

job_role_definition: Assist postsecondary faculty and instructional staff in delivering courses, assessing work, and supporting students.
acquire_scope: Prepare and obtain course, examination, laboratory, and classroom materials, and gather student questions, submitted work, and course-context information needed to support instruction.
interpret_scope: Assess student work and learning needs, identify assignment or laboratory problems, and determine performance findings for grades and instructional feedback.
decide_scope: Select instructional adjustments, student-support approaches, assignment or laboratory modifications, and grade-related dispositions within established course procedures.
act_scope: Deliver courses, discussion, tutorial, laboratory, examination, grading, feedback, office-hour, and mentoring support that assists faculty and students in carrying out the course.

occupation_name: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, and Secondary School, Except Special Education
job_role_name: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, and Secondary School, Except Special Education
job_role_definition: Assist classroom teachers with student instruction, supervision, learning activities, and related classroom operations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Coordinate assigned instructional duties, prepare and assemble learning materials and equipment, and observe and record student performance, attendance, and completed work.
interpret_scope: Assess student progress, assignment results, learning needs, and behavioral or safety-relevant conditions from observations and records.
decide_scope: Select immediate instructional, supervisory, and activity-support responses within the teacher-directed classroom plan.
act_scope: Deliver individual and small-group instruction, reinforce social and subject skills, supervise students and activities, enforce rules and safe equipment use, and carry out related classroom operations.

job_role_definition: Support special education teachers in providing instruction, behavioral guidance, personal assistance, and supervised activities for students with disabilities.
acquire_scope: Gather student performance and behavioral observations, coordinate assigned instructional needs with teachers, and prepare accessible learning materials, equipment, and activity settings.
interpret_scope: Assess students’ progress, responses, safety needs, and support requirements from observed performance and recorded data.
decide_scope: Select immediate instructional, behavioral-support, personal-assistance, supervision, and safety responses within assigned guidance and policies.
act_scope: Deliver individualized and small-group instruction, behavioral and therapeutic support, daily-living and access assistance, and supervised educational and recreational activities.

job_role_definition: Assembles complete products or components as a rotating production-team member while coordinating work and ensuring conformance to specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work orders, blueprints, components, tools, equipment, and observations of in-process products and team readiness needed for assembly.
interpret_scope: Translate work orders and blueprints into assembly and quality requirements, and assess whether products, equipment, and team performance conform to them.
decide_scope: Select task assignments, assembly sequence and procedures, process adjustments, training responses, and dispositions for nonconforming products or parts.
act_scope: Perform rotating assembly and quality-control tasks, operate required production equipment, and coordinate or train the team to produce conforming products.

job_role_definition: Create, revise, and maintain clear technical documentation that explains products, procedures, operations, and maintenance.
acquire_scope: Gather technical specifications, product samples, drawings, catalogs, published materials, and firsthand knowledge of production and operating procedures from subject-matter sources.
interpret_scope: Synthesize the gathered technical information into accurate explanations of products, procedures, operations, maintenance, and production sequences, and assess when documentation requires updating.
decide_scope: Determine the documentation subject matter, technical specifications, organization, content, format, revision scope, and appropriate illustrations for publication.
act_scope: Create, edit, standardize, illustrate, lay out, publish, revise, and maintain clear technical and online-help documentation.

job_role_definition: Designs, configures, implements, supports, and oversees the reliable operation and maintenance of telecommunications systems.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Gather operational requirements, site configurations, vendor specifications and pricing, equipment and system test results, and performance, capacity, security, and fault data for telecommunications systems.
interpret_scope: Assess facility and user needs, evaluate system designs and component compatibility, diagnose network and device problems, and analyze reliability and performance conditions.
decide_scope: Select system modifications, architectures, equipment, recovery and maintenance approaches, security and access controls, and implementation priorities based on the assessments.
act_scope: Design and configure telecommunications systems; implement installations, renovations, maintenance, recovery, security, access, and corrective support; oversee equipment upkeep; and provide operating guidance and technical documentation.

occupation_name: Telecommunications Equipment Installers and Repairers, Except Line Installers
job_role_name: Central Office and Headend Telecommunications Equipment Technician
job_role_definition: Installs, configures, maintains, and repairs telecommunications switching, routing, distribution, and associated network equipment in central offices and headends.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain work orders, technical requirements, equipment records, and available cable information; inspect network equipment and gather circuit, link, power, and system-status test results.
interpret_scope: Analyze test readings, trouble reports, system outputs, and technical documentation to determine equipment requirements, isolate faults, and identify needed repair or maintenance methods.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate equipment configuration, circuit layout, cable use, and corrective or maintenance approach for the identified requirements or faults.
act_scope: Install, connect, configure, program, adjust, maintain, repair, replace, and validate central-office and headend switching, routing, distribution, power, and associated network equipment.

occupation_name: Telecommunications Equipment Installers and Repairers, Except Line Installers
job_role_definition: Installs, tests, maintains, and repairs communications equipment and wiring at customer properties and explains its operation to customers.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather work orders, site and service requirements, equipment records and technical instructions, and obtain inspection, connection, circuit, and performance test evidence for customer-premises communications equipment and wiring.
interpret_scope: Evaluate site conditions, specifications, diagrams, reports, and test readings to determine equipment requirements, isolate faults, and assess whether installed, maintained, or repaired systems conform to required operation.
decide_scope: Select the installation arrangement, maintenance or repair method, connection changes, replacement components, performance adjustments, and escalation needed to meet the identified service requirements.
act_scope: Install, connect, modify, maintain, repair, or replace communications equipment and wiring at customer properties, and demonstrate and explain the completed equipment's operation to customers.

job_role_definition: Install, test, maintain, and repair aerial, underground, and customer-connected telecommunications cable and related line equipment.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather cable, line equipment, tools, access, and signal and line-test measurements needed to install, maintain, or repair telecommunications facilities.
interpret_scope: Analyze transmission tests and wire characteristics to assess service performance and identify faults, malfunctions, or required signal correction.
decide_scope: Select the installation, repair, connection, adjustment, routing, and signal-control actions needed to restore or provide acceptable telecommunications service.
act_scope: Install, connect, splice, seal, tension, adjust, maintain, and repair aerial, underground, and customer-connected cables and related line equipment, including required excavation, cable placement, and pole work.

job_role_definition: Solicit sales, service orders, or charitable donations by telephone while handling related customer interactions and records.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain prospective-contact details and gather customer identity, address, payment, order, and interaction information needed to pursue and process solicitations.
interpret_scope: Assess customers' questions, stated needs, interests, and reactions to understand how the offering or request applies to them.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate tailored sales approach and customer disposition, including follow-up or referral for a sales appointment when warranted.
act_scope: Conduct outbound and inbound telephone interactions to present and explain offerings or charitable requests, persuade and respond to customers, secure sales, service orders, or donations, and maintain the related contact and order records.

job_role_definition: Operate telephone systems to connect callers, provide directory and billing assistance, and support users with calling needs.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive callers' requests and switchboard signals, and retrieve or maintain the directory, location, listing, and billing information needed to assist them.
interpret_scope: Determine the requested connection, information, billing assistance, or accessibility or emergency need, resolving incomplete caller details through available listings and alternatives.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate connection, listing response, routing method, intervention, or special assistance based on the caller's need and call conditions.
act_scope: Operate switchboard, paging, relay, and call-processing functions to complete or advance calls, provide directory or billing assistance, and deliver needed emergency or accessibility support.

job_role_definition: Receive, disburse, record, and safeguard customer funds and negotiable instruments for financial-institution transactions.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Receive and assemble customer funds, negotiable instruments, transaction instructions, account information, and cash inventories required for financial-institution transactions.
interpret_scope: Verify transaction amounts, dates, endorsements, signatures, identification, account availability, document validity, balances, and applicable fees or exchange terms, and identify discrepancies.
decide_scope: Determine whether to process, pay, hold, correct, or otherwise resolve a transaction or account discrepancy under applicable transaction requirements.
act_scope: Receive, disburse, post, receipt, reconcile, prepare, and securely maintain funds and negotiable instruments while completing customer financial-institution transactions.

job_role_definition: Install, finish, repair, and seal durable decorative terrazzo surfaces on floors, stairways, and fixtures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Measure, mix, and move terrazzo, grout, concrete, reinforcement, membrane, division-strip, and finishing materials, and inspect existing surfaces and specified layout and finish requirements.
interpret_scope: Assess surface roughness, damage, alignment, accessibility, material type, and required appearance to determine the condition and installation requirements.
decide_scope: Select and adjust the mixing, grouting, placement, grinding, cleaning, and repair approach suited to the materials, surface condition, and installation.
act_scope: Install bases, membranes, reinforcement, joints, forms, and decorative terrazzo; place, level, shape, repair, grind, polish, finish, cure, and seal floors, stairways, and fixtures.

occupation_name: Textile Bleaching and Dyeing Machine Operators and Tenders
job_role_name: Textile Bleaching and Dyeing Machine Operators and Tenders
job_role_definition: Operate and tend machinery that washes, bleaches, dyes, shrinks, or finishes textiles and fibers to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain processing specifications and order details; prepare, weigh, test, and add prescribed dyes, chemicals, water, and textile goods; and monitor machine, solution, and product-condition inputs throughout processing.
interpret_scope: Assess specifications, solution-test results, operating readings, equipment condition, and textile appearance and feel to identify setup needs, deviations, defects, and malfunctions.
decide_scope: Determine machine setup and processing settings and select needed control adjustments, solution corrections, or escalation for equipment problems to keep production within specification.
act_scope: Load, join, thread, program, start, operate, adjust, and tend textile-processing equipment; carry out washing, bleaching, dyeing, shrinking, soaking, or finishing; remove processed goods; and maintain equipment as needed for acceptable operation.

occupation_name: Textile Cutting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Textile Cutting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain textile-cutting machines to produce fabric parts that meet specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production orders, patterns, specifications, fabric materials, and setup references, and gather operating, test-cut, product-inspection, and machine-condition evidence.
interpret_scope: Evaluate setup requirements, fabric characteristics, operating and test evidence, cut-part conformity, and machine condition to identify production or maintenance needs.
decide_scope: Select component arrangements, cutting methods, program and control settings, operating adjustments, production stop points, and responses to equipment faults.
act_scope: Set up, thread, align, program, start, and operate cutting equipment; implement adjustments and stopping decisions; and clean, lubricate, or repair machinery to produce specified fabric parts.

occupation_name: Textile Knitting and Weaving Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Textile Knitting and Weaving Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Sets up, operates, and tends textile knitting and weaving machinery to produce goods that meet specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production orders, setup requirements, specifications, patterns, samples, and operating information, and observe product and machine conditions during production.
interpret_scope: Assess cloth quality, detected defects, loom stoppages, machine condition, and test results against specifications to determine the cause or significance of production issues.
decide_scope: Select machine settings, adjustments, production stopping points, defect dispositions, and needed repair or maintenance actions to maintain specified output.
act_scope: Set up, thread, align, program, operate, monitor, adjust, maintain, and tend textile knitting and weaving machinery, correct cloth defects, and produce goods that meet specifications.

occupation_name: Textile Winding, Twisting, and Drawing Out Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Textile Winding, Twisting, and Drawing Out Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, and tend textile machinery that winds or twists yarn or draws out and combines fibers into specified products.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Obtain setup specifications and product samples, and observe machine operation, material supply, bobbin dimensions, equipment condition, and product output.
interpret_scope: Assess observations, measurements, samples, and specifications to identify product defects, supply shortages, malfunctions, repair needs, and setup or tension requirements.
decide_scope: Determine machine settings and operating adjustments, whether to stop at the specified production amount, and when equipment requires repair or escalation.
act_scope: Set up, thread, supply, start, operate, tend, adjust, stop, and maintain winding, twisting, and drawing-out machinery to produce specified textile products.

occupation_name: Textile, Apparel, and Furnishings Workers, All Other
job_role_name: Textile, Apparel, and Furnishings Workers, All Other
job_role_definition: Performs textile, apparel, or furnishings work not classified in a more specific occupation.
acquire_scope: NA — the frozen role provides no task-specific inputs or evidence-gathering work.
interpret_scope: NA — the frozen role provides no task-specific assessment or meaning-making work.
decide_scope: NA — the frozen role provides no task-specific planning or selection work.
act_scope: Performs the applicable textile, apparel, or furnishings work not classified in a more specific occupation.

job_role_definition: Provide therapeutic services in specialties not separately classified in O*NET.
acquire_scope: Obtain relevant client information and therapeutic inputs needed to provide the specialty service.
interpret_scope: Assess the therapeutic relevance of the available information within the specialty service.
decide_scope: Select the therapeutic approach, priorities, and adjustments appropriate to the service.
act_scope: Deliver the therapeutic services and carry out the selected therapeutic approach.

job_role_definition: Apply, install, repair, and finish tile, stone, and comparable materials on building surfaces and related structures.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Study drawings and site surfaces, measure and mark work areas, and obtain the specified tile, stone, backing, fixtures, and installation materials.
interpret_scope: Assess drawings, dimensions, surface conditions, material quantities, and required fit to establish installation requirements.
decide_scope: Choose the layout, pattern, placement sequence, and fitting approach that satisfy the specified design and site conditions.
act_scope: Prepare, build, level, and waterproof substrates; cut, set, align, grout, seal, finish, repair, and install tile, stone, mosaics, drain tile, fixtures, and related units.

job_role_definition: Precision assembles, adjusts, tests, and repairs timepiece mechanisms to meet specified fit, function, and timing accuracy.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Review work specifications and obtain visual, dimensional, fit, operational, and timing observations from timepiece mechanisms, components, and hairspring assemblies.
interpret_scope: Evaluate those observations to diagnose defects and determine accuracy, fit, truing, endshake, alignment, and other deviations from requirements.
decide_scope: Select the components to replace and the repair, adjustment, positioning, timing, and correction steps needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Precision disassemble, clean, lubricate, assemble, install, adjust, true, tighten, replace, and repair timepiece mechanisms to restore specified fit, function, and timing accuracy.

job_role_definition: Operate tire-building equipment to assemble plies, treads, and reinforcing components into new tire bodies.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Retrieve specified plies and tire components, and obtain stock-width and alignment inputs from guides and gauges for setup.
interpret_scope: Use production specifications and gauge or guide indications to determine the required component arrangement and equipment positioning.
decide_scope: Select setup adjustments and alignment corrections needed to maintain the specified tire-body configuration.
act_scope: Operate and adjust tire-building equipment to apply adhesives, wind, bond, splice, align, and finish plies, treads, reinforcing layers, and inner tubes into new tire bodies.

job_role_definition: Rebuild and repair worn tire casings with new tread for vulcanization and return to service.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect worn casings for faults and damage and measure their dimensions to obtain condition and mold-sizing inputs.
interpret_scope: Assess the inspected condition and measurements against retreading specifications to establish casing condition and requirements.
decide_scope: Determine whether each casing is suitable for retreading and select the required mold and retreading disposition.
act_scope: Prepare accepted casings by buffing, repairing damage, applying and adhering new tread, trimming imperfections, molding, and finishing them for vulcanization and return to service.

job_role_definition: Repair, replace, mount, balance, and service vehicle tires and related wheel assemblies.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect tires, tubes, rims, and wheel assemblies; identify tire specifications; locate leaks or punctures; and obtain balance measurements and required replacement parts.
interpret_scope: Assess observed damage, leaks, tire specifications, rim condition, and balancing results to determine the condition and service requirements of each wheel assembly.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate repair, replacement, inflation, rotation, mounting, and counterweight configuration for the tire and wheel assembly.
act_scope: Safely raise vehicles, remove and prepare wheels, repair or replace tires, tubes, valve stems, and related components, mount and inflate assemblies, install required counterweights, rotate tires, and remount completed wheels.

job_role_definition: Create concise abstracts or summaries of recorded legal and insurance information affecting property titles.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Retrieve recorded property documents and relevant legal or insurance reference information affecting the title.
interpret_scope: Determine the title-relevant meaning of recorded instruments and pertinent legal or insurance details.
decide_scope: Select the information and level of detail to include in a concise title-focused summary.
act_scope: Prepare clear abstracts or summaries of the recorded legal and insurance information affecting property titles.

job_role_definition: Evaluate title evidence to identify defects, determine title or document acceptability, and document actions needed for clearance, registration, closing, or insurance.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Retrieve title, land, closing, and registration records and obtain relevant property information from parties and public offices.
interpret_scope: Analyze title evidence and closing documents to establish ownership, legal descriptions, restrictions, encumbrances, accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
decide_scope: Determine document and title acceptability, registration eligibility and fees, and the corrective actions needed for clearance, closing, or insurance.
act_scope: Document findings and required actions, issue rejection notices, title commitments, and insurance policies, and create or update title records.

job_role_definition: Search property records and related sources to assemble requested title evidence, legal instruments, and property documentation.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain the search request, property and party identifiers, and retrieve relevant legal instruments, property records, and boundary maps or drawings from appropriate sources.
interpret_scope: Determine the requested types of title evidence and assess how retrieved instruments and property documentation relate to the identified land, buildings, and parties.
decide_scope: Select the applicable legal instruments and property documentation to include in the requested title evidence.
act_scope: Assemble the requested title evidence and prepare the list of legal instruments applying to the specified land and buildings.

job_role_definition: Perform precision grinding, sharpening, polishing, and finishing of metal tools, dies, parts, and other workpieces to specification.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain workpiece specifications and layouts, select required abrasives and tooling, and gather dimensional, surface-condition, and machine-operation observations.
interpret_scope: Evaluate measurements, tactile and visual inspection results, machine behavior, and die or part condition against specifications to identify conformance, wear, defects, and needed correction.
decide_scope: Determine the grinding procedure, machine setup and operating sequence, wheel and tool adjustments, corrective response to operating problems, and disposition of nonconforming workpieces.
act_scope: Set up, condition, operate, and maintain grinding, polishing, finishing, and related equipment to produce, repair, shape, fit, and finish metal tools, dies, parts, and workpieces to specification.

job_role_definition: Fabricate, assemble, inspect, test, repair, and modify precision tools, dies, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and related components to specification.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain fabrication requirements from blueprints, sketches, models, and specifications, and gather dimensional, fit, surface, and test-run evidence from stock, parts, and completed tools or dies.
interpret_scope: Derive required dimensions, shapes, tolerances, alignments, clearances, material-property needs, and conformance findings from the requirements and measured evidence.
decide_scope: Choose fabrication sequences, suitable metals, and the designs or modifications of tools, dies, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and templates needed to meet specifications.
act_scope: Lay out, position, machine, heat-treat, finish, fit, assemble, adjust, repair, and modify precision tooling and related components to specification.

job_role_definition: Escort and guide visitors through tours or places of interest while providing interpretation, information, instruction, and safe group coordination.
acquire_scope: Research site, environmental, visitor, and regulatory information; assemble and check tour supplies and safety equipment; and observe group activities and conditions during the tour.
interpret_scope: Assess the significance of site, environmental, regulatory, and visitor information to form audience-appropriate understandings and safety assessments.
decide_scope: Select suitable routes, sites, pacing, instructional approaches, and safety responses based on area knowledge, visitor needs, and changing tour conditions.
act_scope: Escort and coordinate visitors through places of interest, deliver commentary and educational activities, provide directions and equipment guidance, and carry out safety measures including first aid or evacuation when needed.

job_role_definition: Conduct traffic studies and provide technical support for traffic-control planning, operation, permitting, and public coordination under traffic-engineering direction.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect, measure, time, and compile traffic volumes, movements, speeds, delays, crash and development information, field conditions, and traffic-control plan details needed for studies, planning, permits, operations, and public coordination.
interpret_scope: Analyze traffic, safety, visibility, site, and control-plan information to assess conditions, forecast effects, determine control adequacy, and communicate findings through technical charts, diagrams, and drawings.
decide_scope: Select efficient traffic-control designs, signal or speed settings, pavement-marking and closure procedures, permit dispositions and conditions, maintenance changes, and parking strategies under traffic-engineering direction.
act_scope: Deliver traffic-control technical support by preparing plans, work orders, and permits; laying out markings; overseeing devices and permit compliance; maintaining survey equipment; and providing traffic information and responses to the public.

job_role_definition: Plan, direct, and coordinate an organization's employee training and development activities, resources, and staff.
acquire_scope: Gather organizational change and workforce-development needs, training-performance evidence, instructor feedback, compliance requirements, and available instructional resources.
interpret_scope: Analyze needs and evaluation evidence to assess training gaps, program effectiveness, instructor performance, and compliance status.
decide_scope: Set training priorities, program designs and procedures, improvement recommendations, resource allocations, and budget plans.
act_scope: Direct, coordinate, develop, deliver, or arrange employee training and development programs, instructional and evaluation materials, orientations, instructor development, and external course offerings.

job_role_definition: Improve workforce skills and organizational performance by assessing needs and designing, delivering, coordinating, and evaluating work-related training programs.
acquire_scope: Gather workforce development needs, subject-matter updates, training materials, participant information, resource constraints, and evidence on training activities, outcomes, instructors, and costs.
interpret_scope: Determine skill gaps and assess the suitability and effectiveness of training materials, delivery modes, instructors, and programs, including needed improvements.
decide_scope: Select training objectives, program approaches, delivery methods, materials, instructors, participants, schedules, resource allocations, and corrective adaptations.
act_scope: Develop and organize training materials and programs, coordinate instructional resources and participation, deliver instruction and orientation, implement improvements, develop instructors, and report program status, effectiveness, and expenditures.

job_role_definition: Protect transit and railroad property, passengers, employees, and operations through patrol, law enforcement, investigations, and safety and security response.
acquire_scope: Patrol and monitor transit and railroad areas, conduct security and access checks, and gather incident, crime, loss, damage, and hazard evidence through observations, interviews, and investigations.
interpret_scope: Assess observations, credentials, and investigative evidence to identify offenses, security threats, losses, safety hazards, and emergency conditions.
decide_scope: Select enforcement and investigative responses, emergency security measures, preventive programs, and priorities for security personnel and safety training.
act_scope: Apprehend or remove offenders, enforce transit-related laws, coordinate emergency and security operations, implement preventive programs, deliver safety or security training, and report investigative findings.

job_role_definition: Analyzes traffic operations and transportation-system impacts to improve mobility, control systems, and safety.
acquire_scope: Obtain traffic-operation, safety, pedestrian, control-device, transportation-system, and development-plan inputs needed to assess operating conditions and impacts.
interpret_scope: Analyze traffic problems, system and device performance, planned-development impacts, and modeled scenarios to determine mobility, control-system, and safety findings.
decide_scope: Select recommended flow, safety, control-device, lighting, system-modification, expansion, or other transportation solutions.
act_scope: Deliver traffic-operation assessments, impact analyses, and recommended improvements through administrative, technical, or statistical reports.

job_role_definition: Plans, designs, and supports the delivery, modification, and compliance of transportation infrastructure projects.
acquire_scope: Gather site, survey, stakeholder, regulatory, environmental, material, construction, and operational information needed to develop and deliver transportation infrastructure work.
interpret_scope: Analyze engineering calculations, environmental effects, material and completed-work inspections, costs, and project documents to determine safety, performance, completeness, and standards conformance.
decide_scope: Select project configurations, modifications, environmentally sound deconstruction approaches, specifications, budgets, schedules, and delivery responses that meet functional, safety, and compliance requirements.
act_scope: Prepare and issue transportation, drainage, erosion-control, and sustainable-design plans and layouts; coordinate project delivery, staking, bidding, maintenance or repair, public communication, and compliance verification.

job_role_definition: Inspect freight, cargo-handling conditions, and related transport equipment to ensure cargo is safely secured, handled, and transported in compliance with safety requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain cargo, equipment, vessel, route, and environmental-condition evidence through document review, observation, inspection, and measurement.
interpret_scope: Calculate relevant cargo and vessel quantities and assess securing, handling, capacity, dimensions, stability, damage, equipment condition, and maintenance needs against safety requirements.
decide_scope: Select remedial procedures, special cargo treatments, and necessary reloading, bracing, packing, or maintenance actions.
act_scope: Communicate handling requirements, direct corrective loading or securing work, post required warnings, and document and report inspection outcomes.

job_role_definition: Develop transportation plans, analyses, and recommendations that guide transportation-system improvements and project decisions.
acquire_scope: Gather transportation counts, surveys and public feedback, development and land-use information, projections, policies, regulations, and project cost and infrastructure inputs.
interpret_scope: Analyze traffic, geographic, environmental, engineering, economic, population, land-use, regulatory, and legislative information through transportation studies and models to assess needs, effects, feasibility, and consequences.
decide_scope: Define transportation priorities and select sustainable strategies, system improvements, project concepts, and planning recommendations that address identified needs and constraints.
act_scope: Develop and document transportation plans, analyses, models, engineering and environmental materials, approval submissions, and recommendations, communicating proposals and coordinating their advancement with stakeholders and agencies.

job_role_definition: Screens passengers, baggage, and cargo to detect security threats and enforce transportation security requirements.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain screening inputs by checking travel credentials, observing passengers and secured areas, examining baggage and cargo with screening equipment, testing for explosives, and conducting required physical searches.
interpret_scope: Assess screening images, alarm results, physical-search findings, tampering indicators, credentials, and observed behavior to identify prohibited items, possible threats, or special-handling needs.
decide_scope: Determine whether people, baggage, cargo, or access areas require further screening, isolation, confiscation, escalation, pursuit, closure, or release under security requirements.
act_scope: Carry out transportation security screening and enforcement by directing passengers, operating checkpoint processes, searching or rescreening items, securing hazardous items, communicating threats, and implementing breach responses.

occupation_name: Transportation Vehicle, Equipment and Systems Inspectors, Except Aviation
job_role_definition: Inspects transportation vehicles and equipment for mechanical condition, repair quality, emissions, and regulatory compliance.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Examine vehicles and equipment visually, remotely, and with diagnostic and onboard diagnostic testing to obtain condition, repair-quality, emissions, modification, and compliance evidence.
interpret_scope: Assess the collected evidence to determine mechanical condition, repair quality, emissions status, regulatory compliance, and the effect of modifications on inspection conclusions.
decide_scope: Determine the inspection disposition and select any required notice or recommended corrective action for identified infractions or problems.
act_scope: Deliver the inspection result by documenting findings, actions taken, notices, and corrective-action recommendations.

occupation_name: Transportation Vehicle, Equipment and Systems Inspectors, Except Aviation
job_role_definition: Examines transportation carriers and operating systems for compliance with safety regulations and investigates related incidents or violations.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect vehicles, equipment, carrier operations, records, and safety-program materials, and gather complaint and incident evidence relevant to regulatory compliance.
interpret_scope: Assess the collected evidence to determine compliance status, identify safety violations or problems, and establish the circumstances of related incidents.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate disposition of findings and select corrective or enforcement recommendations for identified infractions.
act_scope: Document inspections and investigations, issue required notices, and communicate the resulting actions and corrective recommendations.

job_role_definition: Perform miscellaneous transportation work not classified within a more specific transportation occupation.
acquire_scope: NA — The frozen catch-all definition and no mapped tasks do not identify role-specific inputs.
interpret_scope: NA — The frozen catch-all definition and no mapped tasks do not identify role-specific assessment work.
decide_scope: NA — The frozen catch-all definition and no mapped tasks do not identify role-specific choices.
act_scope: Perform the miscellaneous transportation work assigned outside more specific transportation occupations.

job_role_definition: Direct the cost-effective, compliant, and reliable movement of goods through transportation networks and related logistics services.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain operational, shipment, demand, cost, performance, contractor, equipment-condition, and regulatory-conformance information needed to manage goods movement.
interpret_scope: Assess logistics performance, capacity needs, financial effects, service issues, partner performance, and legal or customs conformity to identify efficient, compliant, and reliable operating conditions.
decide_scope: Select transportation networks, routes, modes, carriers, rates, budgets, staffing assignments, maintenance actions, process changes, and capital investments that meet cost, service, safety, and compliance requirements.
act_scope: Direct transportation, warehouse, import-export, and logistics operations; organize staff and cross-functional work; negotiate services; implement approved changes and customer requirements; and resolve operating problems.

job_role_definition: Direct the safe, compliant, and efficient receipt, storage, inventory control, and distribution of goods through warehouse operations.
acquire_scope: Gather operational, inventory, demand, cost, condition, compliance, customer, and partner information needed to run warehouse receipt, storage, control, and distribution safely and efficiently.
interpret_scope: Assess operational performance, inventory status, capacity needs, safety and regulatory adherence, service issues, facility condition, and financial results to identify constraints and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Set operating procedures, staffing and work assignments, budgets, service arrangements, safety measures, performance targets, and improvement or capital plans for warehouse operations.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate inbound, storage, inventory, and outbound work; implement approved procedures, safety and customer requirements, personnel development, corrective actions, and facility or process changes.

job_role_definition: Plan, book, and sell travel transportation, accommodations, itineraries, and related travel information for customers.
acquire_scope: Elicit customers’ destinations, dates, transport, accommodation, budget, and other travel requirements, and assemble current supplier, fare, package, and destination information.
interpret_scope: Assess customer requirements against travel options, costs, availability, and destination conditions to formulate suitable itinerary information.
decide_scope: Select and recommend the transportation, accommodations, itinerary, tour package, and pricing arrangement that best fits the customer’s requirements.
act_scope: Arrange, book, sell, document, and ticket the selected travel services, provide relevant travel information, and collect payment.

job_role_definition: Plan, organize, and conduct tours and expeditions while coordinating logistics, assisting participants, and supporting safe travel experiences.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather participant needs, route and destination information, permit and document requirements, and verify that required equipment, transport, accommodations, supplies, and safety resources are available and suitable.
interpret_scope: Assess travel conditions, participant needs, equipment and service quality, and itinerary or accommodation problems to determine their implications for a safe, satisfactory tour or expedition.
decide_scope: Select itineraries, logistical arrangements, participant accommodations, safety guidance, and remedies for travel or service disruptions.
act_scope: Conduct tours and expeditions by leading and transporting groups where required, explaining sites and applicable laws, assisting participants with travel needs and skills, providing first aid, and setting up expedition living arrangements when needed.

job_role_definition: Direct an organization's accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, compliance, and related financial-administration activities.
acquire_scope: Obtain financial and operational records, forecasts, audit evidence, staff-performance information, and applicable accounting standards, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements.
interpret_scope: Analyze financial results, projections, transactions, controls, audit evidence, and staff performance to assess financial position, compliance, control effectiveness, risks, and improvement opportunities.
decide_scope: Select financial objectives, budgets, resource priorities, accounting and control policies, tax and capital-asset recommendations, and appropriate personnel dispositions.
act_scope: Direct accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, procurement, investment, audit, tax, and control operations; deliver required reports and filings; and supervise and develop financial staff.

job_role_definition: Direct an organization's cash, funding, investment, banking, and financial-resource activities to maintain liquidity and support financial objectives.
acquire_scope: Obtain cash-flow, reserve, disbursement, banking, investment, operating, policy, and regulatory information needed to manage the organization’s financial resources.
interpret_scope: Assess liquidity, funding and investment needs, financial performance and opportunities, and compliance implications from current, past, and projected financial activity.
decide_scope: Set financial-resource priorities and recommend or authorize funding, investment, disbursement, policy, and short- and long-term financial actions.
act_scope: Direct and coordinate cash, banking, funding, investment, budgeting, and financial-planning activities, including delegating and maintaining external financial relationships.

job_role_definition: Prune, trim, remove, support, and treat trees and shrubs to maintain their safety, health, clearance, and appearance.
education_most_common_level: Less than a High School Diploma
acquire_scope: Inspect trees, shrubs, work sites, and access conditions; assemble the necessary equipment, support materials, and treatment supplies.
interpret_scope: Assess structural condition, disease or pest issues, clearance needs, and desired health, safety, and appearance outcomes.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate pruning, trimming, removal, support, treatment, and debris-handling approach and work sequence.
act_scope: Climb or otherwise access vegetation and carry out cutting, reshaping, removal, support installation, treatment, site clearing, debris processing, hauling, and equipment upkeep.

job_role_definition: Provide individualized or small-group academic instruction and support to help students improve performance and prepare for tests.
acquire_scope: Gather student goals, prior work, assessment evidence, performance observations, and suitable learning materials for individualized or small-group support.
interpret_scope: Evaluate academic understanding, progress, strengths, and learning needs from student work, assessments, and ongoing session observations.
decide_scope: Select tutoring plans, interventions, lesson content, study and test-taking strategies, and appropriate learning resources based on identified needs and goals.
act_scope: Deliver tailored academic instruction, guided practice, feedback, assessments, skill-building, and progress communication to improve performance and prepare students for tests.

occupation_name: Umpires, Referees, and Other Sports Officials
job_role_definition: Evaluate athletic performances and assign scores or penalties to determine competition results.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe athletic performances and rule-relevant events, and obtain the applicable rules and scoring records.
interpret_scope: Assess performance quality and rule compliance, and reconcile scoring information into valid results.
decide_scope: Select the points, penalties, and final rankings warranted by the assessment.
act_scope: Apply the scoring and penalties, maintain standards of play, and verify the results for announcement.

occupation_name: Umpires, Referees, and Other Sports Officials
job_role_definition: Regulate sporting contests by enforcing rules, resolving infractions, and administering penalties.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Observe play and obtain the site, equipment, participant, timing, score, and eligibility information needed to regulate the contest.
interpret_scope: Assess observed conditions and events against sport rules, safety requirements, scoring rules, and competition regulations.
decide_scope: Determine whether violations or complaints occurred and select the applicable ruling, penalty, qualification, or play disposition.
act_scope: Officiate the contest by initiating and controlling play, signaling and communicating rulings, directing participants, and administering penalties.

occupation_name: Underground Mining Machine Operators, All Other
job_role_name: Underground Mining Machine Operators, All Other
job_role_definition: Operate specialized underground mining machinery not classified under a separately listed mining machine operator occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain operating instructions, machine status information, and the materials and site conditions required to conduct underground mining operations.
interpret_scope: Assess equipment readings, underground conditions, and material flow to determine operating status and constraints.
decide_scope: Select machine settings, operating sequence, and immediate responses to changing underground conditions.
act_scope: Operate specialized underground mining machinery to perform the assigned mining work.

job_role_definition: Make, restore, repair, or replace upholstery and related structural components for furniture and transportation vehicles.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job specifications and inspect furniture or vehicle upholstery, frames, springs, webbing, and coverings; take measurements and assemble the required materials, patterns, and component inputs.
interpret_scope: Evaluate defects and translate specifications, sketches, patterns, and material properties into the dimensions, covering layout, and structural upholstery requirements for the workpiece.
decide_scope: Select the materials, quantities, repair or restoration approach, and cutting and construction plan needed to make, restore, repair, or replace the upholstery and related components.
act_scope: Remove defective upholstery components and construct, repair, restore, or replace furniture and vehicle upholstery by repairing frames, preparing and cutting coverings, installing webbing, springs and padding, sewing and finishing materials, and securing covers and trim.

job_role_definition: Develop and guide land-use and community plans that shape the physical development of cities, regions, and other jurisdictions.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain land-use, property, environmental, regulatory, economic, social, transportation, and community input through research, site work, surveys, maps, impact materials, and stakeholder meetings.
interpret_scope: Analyze development proposals, planning data, environmental reports, and legal constraints to assess feasibility, impacts, sustainability, alternatives, and needed changes.
decide_scope: Formulate land-use, community, transportation, and sustainability plans and policies, resolve competing interests, and recommend approval, denial, conditions, priorities, or alternatives.
act_scope: Prepare and communicate planning studies and plans, coordinate their formulation with officials and technical specialists, administer applicable plans or policies, and engage stakeholders to guide physical development.

job_role_definition: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent medical and surgical disorders of the genitourinary system and renal glands.
acquire_scope: Obtain and review patient histories, examinations, imaging, screening, and other diagnostic-test inputs concerning genitourinary and renal conditions.
interpret_scope: Determine the nature, extent, and clinical significance of genitourinary and renal disorders from patient findings and test results.
decide_scope: Select diagnoses, preventive and treatment plans, medications or procedures, referrals, and specialist recommendations appropriate to each condition.
act_scope: Deliver medical and surgical urologic treatment, provide consultations, and direct patient-care staff in carrying out care.

occupation_name: Ushers, Lobby Attendants, and Ticket Takers
job_role_name: Ushers, Lobby Attendants, and Ticket Takers
job_role_definition: Assist entertainment-event patrons with admission, seating, information, safety, and related venue services.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain patrons’ tickets or credentials and gather relevant needs, seating, location, lost-person, and venue-condition information.
interpret_scope: Assess ticket or credential validity, patron needs, seating availability or conflicts, and conditions affecting order or safety.
decide_scope: Determine admission or access, seating resolutions, and the appropriate assistance, safety response, or patron instructions.
act_scope: Provide admission, seating, directions, accessibility and information services; maintain safe orderly facilities; and assist or evacuate patrons as circumstances require.

job_role_definition: Design, execute, and document validation protocols that demonstrate products, processes, equipment, and systems meet required quality, safety, and compliance standards.
acquire_scope: Obtain requirements and compliance criteria, prepare test equipment and samples, and generate observations, measurements, and records through validation tests and process audits.
interpret_scope: Analyze test and audit evidence to assess conformance with quality, safety, and compliance criteria and identify deviations, testing problems, or root causes.
decide_scope: Select validation objectives, criteria, sampling and testing methods, protocols, priorities, schedules, and corrective or methodological revisions.
act_scope: Produce and maintain validation plans, protocols, reports, databases, and compliance records; direct and coordinate validation work; communicate results; and implement selected corrective, fixture, or test-method changes.

job_role_definition: Provides clinical veterinary care by assessing animals, diagnosing health conditions, and delivering preventive, therapeutic, reproductive, palliative, or euthanasia services with client guidance.
acquire_scope: Gather animal and client histories, examine patients, collect specimens, and obtain diagnostic images, test results, postmortem evidence, and current clinical knowledge.
interpret_scope: Evaluate clinical findings, laboratory results, images, and postmortem evidence to diagnose disease or injury and assess cause, prognosis, zoonotic risk, and care needs.
decide_scope: Select care priorities and the preventive, therapeutic, nutritional, reproductive, palliative, or euthanasia plan appropriate to the animal and client.
act_scope: Deliver preventive, medical, surgical, nutritional, reproductive, or palliative care; perform euthanasia; and guide clients and the public on care, zoonotic risks, and loss.

job_role_name: Veterinary Public Health and Inspection Veterinarian
job_role_definition: Protects animal and public health by investigating communicable diseases in animals and directing measures that prevent transmission.
acquire_scope: Inspect live or deceased animals, collect biological specimens, and obtain exposure, handling, and population-health information relevant to communicable-disease assessment.
interpret_scope: Evaluate examination, test, and postmortem findings to determine communicable-disease status, causes of death, transmission pathways, and animal or human population risk.
decide_scope: Select further testing, quarantine, disease-control, and risk-communication measures needed to limit transmission.
