act_scope: Deliver disease surveillance and control by completing investigations, implementing testing or quarantine procedures, and guiding public and animal-worker prevention practices.

job_role_definition: Conducts veterinary research to characterize animal diseases and evaluate the effects of drugs, antibiotics, and surgical techniques.
acquire_scope: Execute selected study protocols to collect animal specimens, images, postmortem findings, and experimental observations.
interpret_scope: Analyze specimens, images, postmortem results, and experimental observations to characterize disease processes, susceptibility, causes of death, and intervention effects.
decide_scope: Select research questions, study designs, samples, diagnostic measures, therapies or techniques to test, and needed experimental changes.
act_scope: Document and communicate veterinary research conclusions and validated evidence about disease processes and intervention effects.

occupation_name: Veterinary Assistants and Laboratory Animal Caretakers
job_role_definition: Maintains the daily health, housing, husbandry, and research-support records of laboratory animals.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain care instructions and supplies, observe animals and recovery status, and collect specimens and husbandry information needed for daily care and research records.
interpret_scope: Assess observations, behaviors, clinical signs, and recovery changes to identify abnormal health or welfare conditions.
decide_scope: Set immediate care priorities within prescribed schedules and protocols and determine when abnormal conditions require veterinary notification.
act_scope: Maintain sanitary housing and equipment; feed, handle, medicate, groom, exercise, restrain, and otherwise provide daily animal care; assist with prescribed procedures and euthanasia or disposal; and complete required husbandry and research-support records.

occupation_name: Veterinary Assistants and Laboratory Animal Caretakers
job_role_definition: Provides supervised clinical, surgical, diagnostic, animal-care, and client-support services in veterinary practices.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather clinical observations and laboratory specimens, perform routine diagnostic testing, monitor recovery and anesthetic effects, and assemble the animals, medications, equipment, supplies, client information, and treatment areas required for care.
interpret_scope: Recognize behavioral, clinical, recovery, and anesthetic changes that indicate illness, injury, distress, or an unusual response to treatment.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate immediate priority, including when observed changes require prompt veterinary notification or emergency support, within prescribed care directions.
act_scope: Deliver supervised clinical, surgical, emergency, hygiene, feeding, comfort, pest-control, euthanasia-support, and client-care services, including administering prescribed treatments and maintaining sanitary care environments.

job_role_definition: Provide technical animal-health services supporting veterinary diagnosis, treatment, surgery, recovery, and clinical operations under veterinary direction.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain and document animal clinical observations, vital measurements, laboratory specimens and test results, diagnostic images, and the medications, sterile instruments, equipment, and treatment materials needed for care.
interpret_scope: Assess clinical signs, recovery status, anesthetic responses, test outputs, and diagnostic images to identify care-relevant findings and changes in condition.
decide_scope: Determine immediate technical priorities and adjustments within veterinary direction, including responses to anesthesia, emergency stabilization steps, and preparation or follow-up needs for procedures and recovery.
act_scope: Deliver technical animal-health care by preparing and restraining animals, administering anesthesia and prescribed treatments, assisting with examinations and surgery, performing authorized therapeutic procedures, supporting recovery and euthanasia, maintaining safe clinical environments and equipment, and communicating care information to clients.

job_role_definition: Design and guide the development of video game features and player experiences from concept through testing.
acquire_scope: Gather player, market, competitive, technical, stakeholder, and playtest inputs needed to shape and assess the game design.
interpret_scope: Evaluate research, feedback, prototypes, and test results to determine player experience, design coherence, technical fit, and adherence to the intended vision.
decide_scope: Set the game’s features, mechanics, narrative, challenges, visual and supplementary elements, requirements, testing approach, and design revisions.
act_scope: Design, document, prototype, communicate, and guide implementation and testing of game features and player experiences from concept through refinement.

job_role_definition: Take patrons' orders and provide table service for food and beverages in dining establishments.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain patrons' dining and beverage preferences, relevant age-identification information, and the menu, specials, ingredients, and service supplies needed for table service.
interpret_scope: Understand patrons' orders and questions, verify eligibility for alcoholic beverages, and assess reported or observed service problems.
decide_scope: Select suitable menu or beverage recommendations and the appropriate response to customer needs or service issues.
act_scope: Record and transmit orders, prepare and deliver food and beverages, maintain and reset assigned tables, present and process checks and payments, and correct service problems.

job_role_definition: Repair, clean, maintain, and adjust watches, clocks, and other timing instruments to restore their function and accuracy.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain problem and service-history information, disassemble and inspect timepieces, and test their operation, accuracy, batteries, and electronic components.
interpret_scope: Determine the causes and extent of defects, wear, misalignment, corrosion, electronic faults, and timing deviations from the collected evidence.
decide_scope: Select the required repair, replacement, fabrication, maintenance, adjustment, and reassembly approach to restore function and accuracy.
act_scope: Clean, lubricate, repair, fabricate, replace, demagnetize, reassemble, maintain, and regulate timepieces to restore reliable operation and accurate timing.

job_role_definition: Designs and implements integrated strategies and programs for water supply, watershed health, water quality, infrastructure, conservation, and regulatory compliance.
acquire_scope: Gather and maintain hydrologic, water-use, watershed-health, compliance, and water-quality evidence through monitoring, sampling, investigations, and spatial data collection.
interpret_scope: Model and analyze water systems, pollution sources, infrastructure designs, treatment options, regulatory conditions, and management alternatives to assess needs and impacts.
decide_scope: Select and recommend integrated watershed, supply, conservation, infrastructure, discharge, regulatory, policy, and program strategies and plans.
act_scope: Implement and support water-resource programs and monitoring methods, oversee water-capture activities, negotiate water-rights arrangements, and communicate technical proposals and findings to communities and stakeholders.

occupation_name: Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant and System Operators
job_role_definition: Operate and maintain treatment systems that process and dispose of sewage and wastewater safely.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect and test wastewater samples and obtain and record operating conditions, meter and gauge readings, and equipment-status data needed to run and maintain the treatment system.
interpret_scope: Assess sample results and operating data to determine treatment performance, load requirements, and equipment malfunctions.
decide_scope: Select equipment adjustments, chemical treatments, maintenance responses, work priorities, and assignments required for safe wastewater treatment.
act_scope: Operate and adjust treatment equipment, apply chemicals, direct routine plant work, and clean, maintain, repair, and lubricate plant assets to process and dispose of wastewater safely.

occupation_name: Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant and System Operators
job_role_definition: Operate and maintain treatment systems that produce safe, clarified, and disinfected water.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect water samples and operating readings, inspect treatment equipment and conditions, and assemble the measurements needed to run and maintain the treatment system.
interpret_scope: Evaluate sample-test results, meter and gauge readings, equipment conditions, and water-treatment loads to assess water quality and identify operating or equipment problems.
decide_scope: Determine treatment-control adjustments, chemical dosing, maintenance responses, and the prioritization and coordination of routine plant operations needed to maintain safe water production.
act_scope: Operate and adjust treatment equipment, apply disinfecting and treatment chemicals, direct routine operations and maintenance work, and clean, repair, lubricate, and maintain plant assets to produce clarified and disinfected water.

job_role_name: Water Resources and Flood Control Engineer
job_role_definition: Plans and analyzes water resources, stormwater, and flood-control systems to manage water availability, environmental impacts, and flood risks.
acquire_scope: Obtain water-use, water-quality, hydrologic, drainage, infrastructure, and environmental data required to evaluate water-resources and flood-control conditions.
interpret_scope: Analyze demand, pollutant sources, environmental effects, drainage and delivery-system performance, and modeled surface- and groundwater behavior to characterize availability and flood risks.
decide_scope: Determine feasible, cost-effective water-resource, efficiency, runoff-collection, and flood-control alternatives and set the recommended development or mitigation plan.
act_scope: Prepare and design the selected water-supply, runoff, and flood-control systems and communicate the supporting technical analyses and plans.

job_role_definition: Designs and evaluates infrastructure for storing, distributing, pumping, and collecting potable water and wastewater.
acquire_scope: Gather water-use, infrastructure, and project-condition data; obtain proposals and design information; and assemble inputs for demand, hydraulic, environmental, feasibility, cost-benefit, and efficiency evaluations.
interpret_scope: Analyze demand forecasts, hydraulic flow and pressure behavior, environmental effects, construction feasibility and economics, delivery-structure efficiency, and design adequacy to evaluate conveyance-system needs and performance.
decide_scope: Select suitable water-resource or efficiency approaches and the infrastructure configurations, improvements, and risk mitigations to address storage, distribution, pumping, runoff, and wastewater collection requirements.
act_scope: Produce engineering designs for water storage, supply and distribution networks, pumping and lift facilities, pipelines, force mains, sewers, and runoff collection systems, and communicate the resulting technical findings and plans.

job_role_definition: Designs and evaluates water and wastewater treatment facilities and processes to ensure effective, compliant treatment and residuals management.
acquire_scope: Conduct and assemble water-quality, pollutant-source, operational, environmental, feasibility, cost, and existing-design information needed to evaluate and develop treatment facilities and processes.
interpret_scope: Assess the collected information to characterize treatment needs, system performance, environmental effects, technical feasibility, economic tradeoffs, and compliance implications.
decide_scope: Select or recommend treatment and equipment approaches, facility improvements, and sludge-treatment or disposal methods that meet treatment and residuals-management requirements.
act_scope: Develop and critique water, wastewater, and sludge-treatment facility designs and oversee construction to deliver effective, compliant treatment systems.

job_role_definition: Assess and improve residential energy efficiency through diagnostic testing, weatherization installation and repair, and client guidance.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Inspect residences and conduct combustion-safety, air-leakage, airflow, and efficiency tests to obtain the conditions and measurements needed for weatherization work.
interpret_scope: Evaluate inspection and diagnostic results to identify energy losses and safety issues and estimate the material and cost requirements for appropriate weatherization measures.
decide_scope: Select compliant weatherization measures and formulate recommendations and specifications suited to the residence.
act_scope: Install insulation, sealing, duct, ventilation, storm-window or storm-door, and water-heater measures; complete necessary minor repairs; and explain conservation measures and recommendations to residents.

job_role_definition: Manage, secure, maintain, test, and improve web environments, websites, and web applications.
acquire_scope: Collect operational, security, backup-recovery, integration, performance, usability, usage, and user-feedback evidence from web environments, websites, and web applications.
interpret_scope: Analyze that evidence to diagnose faults and breaches, assess performance, security, usability, recovery readiness, interoperability, and testing adequacy, and identify improvement needs.
decide_scope: Select access and security standards, remediation and recovery actions, revision and testing procedures, infrastructure changes, and prioritized improvement recommendations.
act_scope: Administer, configure, secure, back up, test, patch, repair, revise, document, and improve web environments, websites, and web applications, including communicating material operational changes.

job_role_definition: Develop and maintain websites, web applications, databases, interfaces, and supporting infrastructure to meet technical and user requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain stakeholder needs and business, content, technical, operational, security, accessibility, privacy, performance, and platform constraints, and generate validation evidence through code inspection, scheduled testing, system monitoring, measurement, and technology research.
interpret_scope: Translate stakeholder inputs into technical requirements and assess inspection, test, monitoring, and research evidence to determine system quality, compatibility, performance, security risks, and causes of operational problems.
decide_scope: Select priorities, specifications, architectures, tools, content and commerce approaches, hosting and server options, validation and revision procedures, and performance, security, or corrective changes.
act_scope: Create and maintain website and web-application designs, code, databases, interfaces, documentation, servers, safeguards, backups, deployments, updates, and operational fixes.

job_role_definition: Design, build, test, and improve websites and digital interfaces to provide accessible, usable, and effective digital experiences.
acquire_scope: Gather user research, stakeholder feedback, project goals, technical and accessibility constraints, and evidence from interface, browser, device, link, and performance testing.
interpret_scope: Analyze research, feedback, constraints, and test results to define requirements, assess usability and effectiveness, and diagnose interface or website issues.
decide_scope: Choose experience strategies, information and interaction structures, visual and technical approaches, tools, priorities, test plans, and revisions that satisfy project goals and user needs.
act_scope: Create and refine interface concepts, models, templates, specifications, style guidance, websites, supporting code, documentation, and deployed updates to deliver accessible and usable digital experiences.

occupation_name: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
job_role_definition: Collects, prepares, stores, and records representative product or material samples for analysis, testing, or distribution.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Collect representative product or material samples and obtain the measurement, weight, identification, quality, and test-result data needed to identify and document them.
interpret_scope: NA — the role records and handles sample information without determining its analytical meaning.
decide_scope: NA — sample handling, storage, and distribution are performed according to established requirements or order tickets rather than by selecting a course of action.
act_scope: Prepare, label, store, transport, and distribute samples, and maintain associated product, sample-location, shipping, receiving, and production records.

occupation_name: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
job_role_definition: Measures, inspects, verifies, and records materials or products for inventory, shipping, receiving, and production control.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain shipment and product identifiers, documents, labels, counts, weights, dimensions, test data, and physical-condition observations using applicable measuring and inspection tools.
interpret_scope: Compare measured quantities, product condition, labels, and shipment documentation with specifications, orders, manifests, and standards to determine accuracy, conformance, shortages, and defects.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate discrepancy disposition, including whether nonconforming materials or loads require removal from stock and notification to the responsible party.
act_scope: Create and maintain the required inventory, shipping, receiving, and production-control records; prepare and attach identification labels; coordinate required weighing, movement, or checking; and maintain the work area for safe, usable operations.

job_role_definition: Fabricates and repairs metal components through welding, thermal cutting, soldering, or brazing.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain job requirements from drawings, specifications, work orders, and safety data, and inspect, measure, mark, and assess metal components, materials, and equipment condition.
interpret_scope: Translate requirements and observed dimensions, defects, fit, material properties, and process behavior into the fabrication or repair conditions needed for conforming work.
decide_scope: Choose the welding, cutting, soldering, brazing, shaping, repair approach, equipment, consumables, settings, layout, and sequencing appropriate to the component.
act_scope: Safely prepare, position, align, clamp, heat, join, cut, shape, straighten, reassemble, finish, and verify metal components to fabricate or repair them.

occupation_name: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_name: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and maintain machines or robots that weld, solder, braze, heat-treat, or cut metal products, components, and assemblies.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Obtain job specifications and assemble, prepare, measure, mark, and fixture the metal workpieces, consumables, tooling, and process inputs required for welding, soldering, brazing, heat-treating, or cutting.
interpret_scope: Evaluate blueprints, material characteristics, trial results, machine indications, and completed-work measurements to determine process requirements, operating condition, and conformance to specifications.
decide_scope: Select materials, tooling, fixtures, machine settings, and corrective adjustments appropriate to the workpiece and process requirements.
act_scope: Set up, operate, monitor, adjust, tend, and maintain welding, soldering, brazing, heat-treating, cutting, robotic, and auxiliary equipment to produce, finish, and handle conforming metal products, components, and assemblies.

job_role_definition: Operate and maintain wellhead pumps and auxiliary equipment to control and monitor oil and gas production from wells.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Gather production measurements and operating-condition inputs by gauging oil and gas output, monitoring control panels and flow lines, inspecting for leaks, and preparing the equipment, connections, and materials required for pumping service.
interpret_scope: Assess production, pressure, flow, leak, and equipment-condition information to determine whether well and auxiliary operations are within required operating conditions.
decide_scope: Select the needed operating configuration, flow routing, well shutoff or repressurization response, and maintenance or corrective action based on production requirements and observed conditions.
act_scope: Operate wellhead pumps, engines, compressors, valves, and flow lines to control production and recover gas, and set up, service, repair, maintain, and replenish the associated equipment and treatment materials.

occupation_name: Wholesale and Retail Buyers, Except Farm Products
job_role_name: Wholesale and Retail Buyers, Except Farm Products
job_role_definition: Purchase and manage merchandise for wholesale or retail resale based on supplier terms, product value, inventory needs, and consumer demand.
acquire_scope: Gather customer-demand, sales, inventory, market, supplier, product-quality and value, environmental, budget, and transportation information needed to manage merchandise for resale.
interpret_scope: Assess merchandise suitability, demand forecasts, inventory needs, pricing and margin implications, supplier and transportation alternatives, and relevant market or environmental trends.
decide_scope: Select merchandise, quantities, specifications, suppliers, target terms, transportation arrangements, pricing or markdown recommendations, and invoice-payment or merchandise-return dispositions.
act_scope: Purchase and order merchandise, negotiate supplier and transportation terms, collaborate with vendors to develop desired products, and authorize invoice payments or merchandise returns.

job_role_definition: Lead and manage the planning, development, permitting, contracting, and delivery of wind energy projects.
acquire_scope: Obtain and assemble site, environmental, engineering, regulatory, cost, schedule, proposal, and stakeholder-agreement inputs for wind projects.
interpret_scope: Assess site and environmental findings, technical documentation, bids, forecasts, budgets, and compliance requirements to determine project implications.
decide_scope: Set project scope, plans, resources, schedules, contingencies, contracting recommendations, and responses to cost, compliance, and delivery conditions.
act_scope: Lead project development, permitting, contracting, engineering and construction coordination, documentation, technical support, oversight, and status communication through wind-project delivery.

job_role_definition: Designs and supports wind-farm infrastructure and wind-turbine systems to meet performance, reliability, construction, and compliance requirements.
acquire_scope: Obtain site, operational, experimental-turbine, component-test, stress, fatigue, construction-observation, and requirements data needed to engineer and support wind-energy systems.
interpret_scope: Analyze turbine and wind-farm behavior, test results, failures, and site constraints to assess performance, reliability, loads, causes, and conformance.
decide_scope: Select wind-farm layouts, infrastructure and collector-system designs, turbine components and controls, specifications, process changes, and corrective actions.
act_scope: Produce engineering models, schematics, reports, control systems, and other design deliverables; provide prototype technical support; and direct compliant construction, installation, and commissioning.

job_role_definition: Manage safe, reliable, and cost-effective wind field operations, including personnel, maintenance, finances, planning, and stakeholder coordination.
acquire_scope: Collect operational, maintenance, safety, asset-condition, resource-use, cost, staffing, contract, warranty, and stakeholder inputs needed to manage the wind field.
interpret_scope: Assess performance, downtime, equipment condition, safety compliance, maintenance requirements, costs, personnel needs, contractual obligations, and operational constraints.
decide_scope: Set operational goals and priorities and select maintenance, staffing, procurement, budget, contract, warranty, and process courses of action.
act_scope: Direct and develop personnel and contractors, oversee maintenance and warranty work, procure resources, prepare budgets and procedures, administer contracts and records, provide technical support, and coordinate with stakeholders.

job_role_definition: Inspect, maintain, diagnose, test, and repair wind turbine systems to ensure safe and reliable operation.
education_most_common_level: Post-Secondary Certificate - awarded for training completed after high school (for example, in agriculture or natural resources, computer services, personal or culinary services, engineering technologies, healthcare, construction trades, mechanic and repair technologies, or precision production)
acquire_scope: Inspect turbine structures, blades, and operating equipment; collect operational data; obtain mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, generator, and control-system test measurements; and assemble the tools and replacement parts needed for service work.
interpret_scope: Evaluate inspection findings, operational data, and test results to identify faults and assess turbine condition and performance.
decide_scope: Select the maintenance, repair, replacement, and operating actions needed to restore safe and reliable operation.
act_scope: Access turbine equipment, perform routine maintenance and repairs on turbine and associated systems, and start or restart generators to return them to operation.

job_role_definition: Perform woodworking not classified within a separately defined woodworker occupation.
acquire_scope: Obtain work requirements, wood and related materials, dimensions, tools, and equipment needed for the assigned woodworking work.
interpret_scope: Translate work requirements and material characteristics into the relevant construction, fit, finish, and safety considerations.
decide_scope: Select the appropriate materials, methods, sequence, and adjustments for completing the woodworking work.
act_scope: Perform the required woodworking operations to produce, repair, or finish the assigned woodwork.

occupation_name: Woodworking Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Except Sawing
job_role_name: Woodworking Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Except Sawing
job_role_definition: Set up, operate, tend, and maintain woodworking machinery to produce wood components that conform to specifications.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain production specifications and materials, and gather evidence by examining raw stock, machine safety and operation, trial output, and finished-workpiece condition and dimensions.
interpret_scope: Translate specifications, observations, trial results, and measurements into processing requirements, defect findings, and conformity assessments.
decide_scope: Select materials and tooling, work methods, machine settings, and corrective or maintenance actions needed to produce conforming components.
act_scope: Configure and run woodworking machinery, position and feed stock, make selected adjustments and manual finishes, service machine components, and unload, mark, and route completed wood components.

job_role_definition: Produce, edit, format, organize, and distribute typed documents from drafts, recordings, and other source materials.
education_most_common_level: High School Diploma - or the equivalent (for example, GED)
acquire_scope: Obtain, register, retrieve, scan, and assemble drafts, recordings, prior documents, technical material, text, numerical data, instructions, and required document materials.
interpret_scope: Review source material and completed documents to identify required content, corrections, data relationships, and spelling, grammar, punctuation, total, and formatting issues.
decide_scope: Determine the appropriate edits, document organization, merged or rearranged content, layout and style settings, and distribution presentation needed to meet instructions.
act_scope: Type, edit, format, compile, organize, store, print, collate, address, copy, and electronically distribute completed documents and related report materials.

job_role_definition: Creates original fiction, nonfiction, and other written works for publication or production.
acquire_scope: Research factual and authentic detail and gather project, audience, and collaborative inputs needed to develop the written work.
interpret_scope: Assess source material, intended audience, and production or publication requirements to shape accurate, effective content.
decide_scope: Choose the work’s concept, structure, organization, voice, and revisions needed to meet the project’s purpose and requirements.
act_scope: Write, edit, revise, format, and deliver original fiction, nonfiction, scripts, stories, advertisements, or other written works for publication or production.

job_role_definition: Creates persuasive advertising and promotional copy to market products and services.
acquire_scope: Gather product, service, audience, client, sales, media, market-trend, survey, and interview information needed to promote the offering.
interpret_scope: Assess the offering, audience, market evidence, and communication context to identify persuasive selling features, audience insights, and message constraints.
decide_scope: Select the advertising concept, promotional emphasis, presentation approach, copy structure, language, tone, style, length, and revisions that best meet the brief.
act_scope: Write, edit, revise, and present advertising and promotional copy, including product names, slogans, scripts, and related marketing materials, for the intended media.

job_role_definition: Study and manage wildlife populations and habitats to support conservation and environmentally responsible land and water use.
acquire_scope: Collect population, habitat, disease, environmental-impact, regulatory, scientific-literature, and stakeholder information needed to evaluate wildlife and land-and-water-use conditions.
interpret_scope: Assess population and habitat status, environmental and industrial effects, disease risks, conservation issues, and compliance conditions from the assembled evidence.
decide_scope: Develop or recommend wildlife and habitat management plans, alternative operating conditions, disease-prevention priorities, and responses to identified violations.
act_scope: Coordinate preventive disease-control programs, carry out management and compliance actions, notify enforcement when warranted, and communicate conservation findings and guidance to affected audiences.

job_role_definition: Study animal characteristics, life processes, classification, and diseases to develop and communicate zoological knowledge.
acquire_scope: Obtain zoological evidence through habitat observations, literature review, experimental studies, and the collection, preparation, dissection, and microscopic examination of animal specimens.
interpret_scope: Analyze animal characteristics, life processes, relationships, diseases, development, genetics, distribution, and environmental effects to develop findings and classifications.
decide_scope: Select research approaches and scientifically supported recommendations, including alternative industry operating conditions when animal impacts warrant them.
act_scope: Communicate zoological findings, knowledge, and recommendations through reports, scientific papers, presentations, and talks.
